papers.title: DART: A Degradation-Aware Recurrent Transformer for Archival Film Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Archival film restoration is a challenging problem because historical footage contains compound degradations such as scratches, dust, blur, noise, flicker, and photometric aging, while clean reference videos are unavailable. Existing video restoration methods largely treat these degradations implicitly, reconstructing frames without explicit knowledge of where damage occurs or how severe it is. We propose DART, a degradation-aware recurrent transformer for archival film restoration. DART predicts and propagates a soft defect mask through time, using it to guide temporal fusion and condition the restoration network on both damage location and severity. This makes the restoration process explicitly aware of film artifacts rather than relying only on reconstruction losses. Experiments on real archival benchmarks show that DART improves no-reference perceptual quality over prior restoration architectures while remaining compact and efficient, producing cleaner and more temporally consistent restorations of structured film damage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DART，一种退化感知循环Transformer（degradation-aware recurrent transformer），用于档案胶片修复。通过预测并传播软缺陷掩码，显式利用损伤位置和严重程度指导时间融合，无需干净参考视频。在真实档案基准上，无参考感知质量优于先前方法，产生更干净、时间一致的重建。
Motivation: 现有视频修复方法隐式处理复合退化（如划痕、灰尘、模糊等），缺乏对损伤位置和严重程度的显式知识，且历史镜头无干净参考，导致修复效果受限。
Method: DART采用循环架构，预测随时间传播的软缺陷掩码，并将其作为条件引导修复网络的时间融合，使修复过程显式感知退化。
Result: 在真实档案基准上，DART相比先前修复架构提升了无参考感知质量，产生更干净、时间一致的重建结果。
Conclusion: 显式退化感知（软缺陷掩码）有助于档案胶片修复，尤其在复合退化场景下，模型紧凑高效。

papers.title: ICAE-Bench: Evaluating Coding Agents as Interactive Project Builders
papers.abstract_en: The recent emergence of vibe-coding workflows is changing what coding agents are expected to do. Instead of merely completing code under fully specified instructions, agents are increasingly expected to transform incomplete product intent into working software by combining various abilities including planning, requirement clarification, tool use, debugging, and repository-level construction. Yet existing benchmarks have not fully caught up with this shift, evaluating agents on static, fully specified tasks. In this paper, we introduce ICAE-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under interactive project-building settings. The basic idea is to start from a fuzzy product requirement, simulating the dynamic paradigm with an automated User Agent. To make this setting both realistic and evaluable, ICAE-Bench introduces three key designs. First, to avoid the ambiguity of unconstrained fuzzy requirements, each task derives ambiguity from a precise real open-source repository with executable behavior. Second, to ensure high-quality and reproducible user simulation, ICAE-Bench grounds interaction through User Agent Data, allowing the User Agent to reveal hidden constraints without inventing new requirements or leaking implementation artifacts. Third, to evaluate open-ended repositories fairly, ICAE-Bench uses standardized black-box tests together with multi-dimensional diagnostics, including functional correctness, semantic and API similarity, structural fidelity, design quality, and interaction quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ICAE-Bench基准，用于评估编码智能体在交互式项目构建场景下的能力。该基准从模糊的产品需求出发，通过自动化用户代理模拟动态交互，并引入基于真实开源仓库的可执行行为、用户代理数据驱动的交互以及标准化黑盒测试与多维诊断等关键设计，以解决现有基准对静态、完全指定任务的局限。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体评估基准多基于静态、完全指定的任务，未能适应新兴的vibe-coding工作流，即智能体需将不完整的产品意图转化为可工作的软件。
Method: 提出ICAE-Bench，包含三个关键设计：1) 任务源自精确的真实开源仓库，避免模糊性；2) 通过用户代理数据驱动交互，确保模拟真实且可重复；3) 使用标准化黑盒测试及多维诊断（功能正确性、语义与API相似性、结构保真度、设计质量和交互质量）评估开放型仓库。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但描述了基准的设计和评估框架。
Conclusion: 该基准旨在推动编码智能体评估向更贴近真实交互式开发场景的方向发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning-based Seam Correspondence Reconstruction in Sewing Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Digital sewing patterns typically consist of disjoint 2D panels without explicit stitch annotations, making downstream 3D modeling reliant on labor-intensive expert specification. In this paper, we present a graph-based learning framework that reconstructs two-level stitching information, coarse panel connectivity and fine-grained seam correspondence, from 2D panel geometry alone. At the coarse level, panel connectivity is inferred by predicting panel semantics associated with anatomical body regions, enforcing consistency with body structure and garment design conventions. Based on the reconstructed panel graph, fine-grained seam correspondences between panel pairs are inferred by learning latent edge representations that jointly encode local seam geometry and global garment context through graph message passing. The resulting edge embeddings are subsequently decoded into detailed seam correspondences. Our method supports complex sewing-pattern topologies, including many-to-one correspondences, intra-panel seams, and curved seams. Experiments demonstrate high stitching accuracy and strong generalization across garment styles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图的神经网络框架，从2D服装裁片几何信息重建两级接缝信息：粗粒度的裁片连接关系和细粒度的接缝对应。方法通过预测裁片与人体区域的语义关联推断连接图，再利用图消息传递学习隐式边表示以解码出精细接缝对应。实验表明该方法在多种服装款式上具有高缝合精度和强泛化能力。
Motivation: 数字缝纫图案通常由不相连的2D裁片组成，缺少明确的缝合标注，导致下游3D建模依赖人工专家标定，效率低下。
Method: 提出两阶段学习框架：首先通过预测裁片语义（与身体部位关联）推断裁片连接图（粗粒度）；然后在连接图上利用图消息传递学习边嵌入，同时编码局部接缝几何和全局服装上下文，解码得到细粒度接缝对应。
Result: 实验证明该方法在多种服装风格上实现高缝合精度，并具有良好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该方法支持复杂缝纫图案拓扑，包括多对一对应、裁片内接缝及曲线接缝，为自动化服装建模提供了有效途径。

papers.title: Explainable Belief Harmonization under Dynamic Epistemic Partitions
authors: Jarosław A. Chudziak (Warsaw University of Technology)
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches to multi-agent belief combination have established mature foundations for combining uncertain beliefs under common assumptions: consensus methods use iterative averaging, logic-based methods resolve conflicting knowledge bases, and epistemic logic analyzes agents' information states. Typically, these approaches assume that the structure determining what each agent can represent remains fixed. However, in many scenarios, agents gain or lose observational capacity during execution, and what was once admissible may become structurally impossible. This paper presents a formal framework for handling such runtime changes in epistemic partitions over continuous belief profiles. A hybrid approach exploits the advantages of answer set programming in elaboration tolerance, declarative integrity constraints, and explanations, with the numerical flexibility of Python. The framework applies to domains where agents operate at heterogeneous and possibly changing levels of resolution, and provides formal guarantees of admissibility preservation under refinement, unique mass-preserving repair under coarsening, and explanation completeness. Evaluation across 100 randomly generated topology changes confirms complete violation detection and explanation coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个形式化框架，处理多智能体在运行时认识论划分（epistemic partitions）的动态变化（细化与粗化），结合回答集编程（ASP）的声明性约束和解释能力与Python的数值灵活性。框架保证了在划分细化时可接受性保存、粗化时唯一保质量修复以及解释完备性，在100个随机生成拓扑变化上验证了完整违规检测与解释覆盖。
Motivation: 现有信念组合方法通常假设智能体可表示的结构（认识论划分）固定不变，但实际场景中智能体可能获得或失去观测能力，导致结构不可行。本文旨在处理这种运行时的划分变化。
Method: 混合方法：利用回答集编程（ASP）处理精化容忍、声明性完整性约束和解释生成，结合Python处理连续信念轮廓的数值灵活性；对划分细化（refinement）和粗化（coarsening）分别给出形式化修复策略。
Result: 在100个随机生成的拓扑变化上，框架实现了完整的违规检测和解释覆盖，并具备形式化保证：细化时保持可接受性，粗化时存在唯一保质量修复，解释完备。
Conclusion: 该框架为动态认识论划分下的信念协调提供了形式化基础，适用于智能体以异构和可能变化的分辨率运行的领域。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为动态认识论划分下的信念协调提供了形式化基础，适用于智能体以异构和可能变化的分辨率运行的领域。

papers.title: Explainability Framework for Policy-Aware Autonomous Agents
papers.abstract_en: In the field of Artificial Intelligence, an agent is a system which is able to autonomously make decisions in order to reach a desired goal. As these systems grow more prevalent in our day-to-day lives, there has been an increased need to add explainability features which can provide an account for an agent's behavior. We therefore propose a framework that outlines how to produce comprehensible explanations for policy-aware agents, or agents which have rule-enforcing policies incorporated in their decision-making framework. This framework is designed using insights from the social sciences on how to produce good explanations. It is implemented in the Answer Set Programming language while using Python to assist with information extraction and natural-language translation. Because these agents incur penalties when violating policies, we are able to leverage these penalties to detect undesirable events in scenarios that are counterfactual to the agents' original actions. This lends itself to creating contrastive explanations (e.g., "the agent performed this action because, had it not, undesirable event X would have occurred."), which formulate the core component for our explainability framework. The framework is evaluated using a survey wherein human participants provide feedback on our program-generated explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对策略感知自主智能体的可解释性框架，使智能体能够生成易懂的对比解释。框架基于社会科学中关于良好解释的见解，使用回答集编程（Answer Set Programming）实现，并借助Python进行信息提取和自然语言翻译。通过利用智能体违反策略时的惩罚，检测反事实情景中的不良事件，从而生成如“智能体执行此动作是因为如果不这样做，就会发生不良事件X”的解释。通过人类参与者的调查评估了框架的有效性。
Motivation: 随着自主智能体在日常生活中的普及，需要为其决策行为提供可解释性，但目前缺乏针对包含规则执行策略的智能体的系统性解释框架。
Method: 提出一个基于反事实推理的对比解释生成框架，利用策略惩罚机制检测反事实情景中的不良事件，用回答集编程实现逻辑推理，Python辅助信息提取与自然语言生成。
Result: 通过人类参与者调查评估了框架生成的解释的可理解性，但摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该框架能够为策略感知智能体生成符合社会科学良好解释原则的对比解释，有助于提升人机信任。

papers.title: How Rules Represent Causal Knowledge: Causal Modeling with Probabilistic Logic Programming
authors: Felix Weitkaemper (German University of Digital Science)
papers.abstract_en: Pearl famously argues that causal knowledge enables the prediction of intervention effects. By contrast, purely descriptive knowledge supports only conclusions drawn from observations. His theory of causality, however, is developed exclusively within Bayesian networks and causal models. Consequently, it is largely restricted to acyclic causal relationships, and transferring its ideas to other formalisms risks misinterpretation or inconsistency. This paper brings Pearl's approach to causality into probabilistic logic programming (PLP). To this end, such programs are aligned with philosophical foundations established in prior work that do not rely on temporal notions; that is, all relevant events are assumed to occur simultaneously. A formal causal semantics for these programs, together with a notion of intervention and an implementation, is proposed. It is shown that this semantics coincides with the P-log semantics for stratified ProbLog programs, while the two may differ in the non-stratified case and for other PLP formalisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将 Pearl 的因果模型理论引入概率逻辑编程 (PLP)，提出了一种基于非时间性哲学基础的形式化因果语义，定义了干预操作并给出了实现。该语义在分层 ProbLog 程序上与 P-log 语义一致，但在非分层情形或其他 PLP 形式化中可能存在差异。
Motivation: Pearl 的因果理论主要局限于贝叶斯网络和因果模型，且限于非循环关系，将其思想迁移到其他形式化方法时容易导致歧义或不一致。本文旨在为概率逻辑编程赋予一致的因果语义，从而弥合这一鸿沟。
Method: 通过将概率逻辑程序与假定所有事件同时发生的非时间性哲学基础对齐，提出了形式化的因果语义、干预概念及相应的实现。
Result: 证明所提语义在分层 ProbLog 程序上与 P-log 语义等价，但在非分层程序或其他 PLP 形式化中可能不同。
Conclusion: 该工作为概率逻辑编程提供了一个形式化的因果解释框架，并揭示了其与现有 P-log 语义之间的关系，拓展了因果知识表示的范围。

papers.title: A New Well-Supported Semantics for Description Logic Programs
papers.abstract_en: Description logic programs are a powerful formalism for combining rules with ontologies. The well-supported semantics for description logic programs ensures that no answer sets rely on cyclic dependencies. Most popular semantics for logic programming have this property of well-supportedness. We recognize two limitations of the current well-supported semantics for DL programs: its increased computational complexity for the consistency problem and its lack of a reduct transformation characterization. In this work, we present a new semantics which evaluates ontological atoms more strictly than the current semantics. This keeps the complexity of its consistency problem NP-complete, rather than increasing it to the second level of the polynomial hierarchy. Additionally, we identify a syntactic class of description logic programs for which our new semantics is equivalent to the current semantics. We characterize our semantics using a fixpoint operator and a reduct-based transformation. Our new semantics is a strict subset of the current well-supported semantics, so it maintains the prior notion of well-supportedness while inducing its own stricter notion. We prefer our new notion of well-supportedness due to its similarities with logic programming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的描述逻辑程序（DL程序）的well-supported语义，该语义通过更严格地评估本体论原子，将一致性问题的计算复杂度保持在NP完全（而非升至多项式层次第二级），并给出了不动点算子和reduct变换的刻画。新语义是现有well-supported语义的严格子集，同时保持了原有的well-supported性质。
Motivation: 现有描述逻辑程序的well-supported语义有两个局限：一致性问题的计算复杂度上升到多项式层次第二级，且缺乏reduct变换的刻画。本文旨在解决这些问题。
Method: 提出一种新的语义，对本体论原子评估更严格，使一致性问题的复杂度保持在NP完全。识别了一个语法类，在该类上新语义与现有语义等价。通过不动点算子和reduct变换来刻画新语义。
Result: 新语义是现有well-supported语义的严格子集，保持了well-supported性，同时引入了更严格的概念。复杂度保持在NP完全。
Conclusion: 新语义因与逻辑规划的相似性而被优先选择，但未提及实际应用或实验评估。

papers.title: Hybrid MKNF with Classical Negation in the Rule Component
authors: Arun Raveendran Nair Sheela (Université Clermont Auvergne
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid MKNF knowledge bases under the well-founded semantics integrate Description Logics with Logic Programming. However, they do not support classical negation in the rule component, limiting their ability to represent explicit negative knowledge. This limitation is particularly significant in safety-critical applications, where reasoning often requires explicit negative information rather than interpreting the absence of information as evidence of absence. To address this issue, we introduce an extension of Hybrid MKNF that supports classical negation in the rule component. We formally define the syntax and semantics of the extended language and present a general procedure for computing its well-founded model.

papers.title: Bound-Founded Semantics for Answer Set Programming with Difference Constraints: Preliminary Report
authors: Jorge Fandinno (University of Nebraska at Omaha
papers.abstract_en: While the integration of linear constraints has significantly expanded the reach of Answer Set Programming (ASP), existing hybrid solvers often rely on disparate semantic underpinnings that lack a unified logical foundation. We address this gap by introducing a many-sorted variant of the Bound-founded Logic of Here-and-There (HTb), providing a versatile framework capable of characterizing equilibrium models across a wide spectrum of alternative semantics for extensions of ASP with linear constraints. We apply this framework to the setting of difference constraints, focusing on the semantic characterization of clingo[DL]. Central to our approach is the formalization of foundedness for numeric variables. By investigating how different hybrid systems - such as clingo[DL], clingcon, and flingo - justify constraint atoms, we uncover the semantic roots of their varying behaviors. This investigation results in a single, consistent framework that not only formalizes the foundations of current systems like clingo[DL] but also facilitates the rigorous study of program simplifications and the future integration of diverse semantic principles.

Conclusion: 本文提供了一个统一的语义框架，有助于理解现有混合ASP系统，并为未来集成不同语义原则奠定基础。

papers.title: Transformer-based Diffusion models for Hydrological Time Series Probabilistic Imputation and Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: The modeling of hydrometeorological time series with limited observations is a key challenge in the monitoring of hydro-systems and water resources, as well as for flood or drought risk assessment. Due to the high variability of the underlying processes and the sparsity of available measurements, traditional statistical approaches often struggle to accurately represent their dynamics. In this context, recent advances in deep learning offer a promising direction for improving the representation and generation of complex temporal processes sampled at several observation sites. This study investigates the application of transformer-based diffusion models to the simulation and reconstruction of hydrological time series. The proposed framework is applied to the joint modeling of water quantity and quality at six sites spread across three adjacent headwater catchments located in North-East France on a limestone plateau covered by forests and field crops. The model is calibrated and validated using available observational data, which has been quality controlled and corrected for sensor drift and malfunction through collaborative efforts by LNE metrology expertise and Andra monthly quality control over more than 15 years. Its performance is compared with several established baseline approaches commonly used for time series modeling. Quantitative evaluation metrics are employed to assess the ability of the proposed method to reproduce key temporal characteristics of the observed signals in two settings: the imputation of incomplete time series and the forecasting of upcoming hydrological conditions. Results support the effectiveness of the transformer-based approach and highlight its capacity to capture and simulate the complex patterns present in hydrological data. In particular, the results indicate that diffusion models can efficiently sample realistic time series distributions under observation settings with variable missing data for both forecasting and imputation.

papers.title: Towards a Certifying Grounder
papers.abstract_en: Grounding, the translation of high-level theories into equivalent quantifier-free formulas, is a crucial step in declarative solving, yet it has so far escaped the proof-logging revolution. When this grounding step is not certifying, there is no way of knowing that the obtained solutions actually correspond to the original problem specification, resulting in a trust gap. In this paper, we close the trust gap between the user's high-level specification and the solver's low-level input by introducing a novel certifying grounding framework for first-order logic model expansion (FOX) over finite domains. We present CertiFOX, a framework consisting of: (1) a proof format for grounding derivations, (2) GroundFOX, a certifying grounder operating on theories in Grounding Normal Form (GNF)--a new normal form designed for compact, domain-aware grounding--and (3) CheckFOX, an independent proof checker. Our approach guarantees that the grounder's output is equivalent to the input specification, setting the stage for trustworthy end-to-end certified solving pipelines for declarative languages. Experimental evaluation confirms that CertiFOX is a feasible approach. The GroundFOX grounder is broadly comparable with other grounders, and proof checking with CheckFOX adds overhead within a small constant factor of grounding time.

summary_sections.method: 提出CertiFOX框架，包含(1)证明格式，(2) GroundFOX，基于接地正规形式(GNF)进行可认证接地，(3) CheckFOX独立检查器。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明CertiFOX是可行的，GroundFOX与其他接地器性能相当，证明检查开销约为接地时间的常数倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为声明式语言建立可信端到端认证求解管线奠定基础。

papers.title: Declarative Problem Solving in UAM Strategic Deconfliction
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for Urban Air Mobility (UAM) introduces significant challenges in airspace management, particularly within densely populated metropolitan regions. As the number of aerial vehicles-such as drones, air taxis, and helicopters-continues to rise, so does the risk of mid-air collisions and conflicts with existing air traffic and obstacles. Ensuring safe and efficient UAM operations requires robust strategic deconfliction mechanisms. We propose an Answer Set Programming (ASP) based approach for strategic deconfliction, focusing on time synchronization and route optimization for conflict-free flight plans. The solution is benchmarked against Constraint Programming (CP), emphasizing scalability and resource use. Results show that ASP offers faster execution and better scalability for small to medium cases, while CP maintains stable memory but degrades with complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于回答集编程（ASP）的方法，用于城市空中交通（UAM）中的战略冲突消解，针对无人机、空中出租车等飞行器的航线规划，实现时间同步和路径优化以避免冲突。与约束编程（CP）对比，ASP在中小规模问题上执行更快、可扩展性更好，而CP内存稳定但随复杂度性能下降。
Motivation: 城市空中交通（UAM）中飞行器数量增加，导致空中碰撞风险上升，需要稳健的战略冲突消解机制。
Method: 采用回答集编程（ASP）方法进行战略冲突消解，重点在于时间同步和航线优化以生成无冲突的飞行计划，并与约束编程（CP）进行对比基准测试。
Result: 实验表明，ASP在中小规模问题上执行更快、可扩展性更好；CP内存使用稳定但随复杂度增加性能下降。
Conclusion: ASP方法在UAM战略冲突消解中展现出优势，尤其适用于中小规模场景。

papers.title: Case study: solving P-99 with LPTP and an LLM
papers.abstract_en: Ninety-Nine Prolog Problems (P-99) is a famous set of Prolog exercises. We solved the first thirty three just by prompting an LLM (Large Language Model). We used Claude from Anthropic. By solved we mean: generate the Prolog code and a test file, run the tests and check whether they pass, then formally prove types, groundness, termination, uniqueness, existence and also sometimes functional correctness with LPTP (Logic Program Theorem Prover). Hence our approach is an experiment in vibe-coding/vericoding of P-99. It is a vibe-coding experiment because we started from informal specifications written in English and let Claude generate the Prolog code. It also fits within vericoding because the LLM proved reliability guarantees on the generated Prolog code. Claude wrote 58 logic procedures, 508 tests, 257 lemmas for a total of 11800 proof lines. We manually checked each file generated by the LLM. We checked the Prolog code, ran the tests, examined the logical statements generated by Claude and proof-checked Claude's proofs with LPTP. This paper describes this experiment and provides the main details so that it can be reproduced by the interested reader.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一项实验：使用大语言模型（LLM）Claude 求解经典 Prolog 习题集 P-99 的前 33 题。LLM 生成 Prolog 代码、测试文件和证明引理，然后通过自动化测试和逻辑程序定理证明器 LPTP 验证类型、基项性、终止性等性质。实验共产生 58 个逻辑过程、508 个测试、257 个引理和 11800 行证明。作者手动检查了所有生成内容，并提供了可复现的细节。
Motivation: 探索 LLM 在程序合成后的形式化验证能力，将“vibe-coding”与“vericoding”结合，以评估 LLM 生成可靠 Prolog 代码的可行性。
Method: 使用 Claude 从英文非正式规范生成 Prolog 代码和测试文件，然后通过 LPTP 进行形式化证明，包括类型、基项性、终止性、唯一性、存在性和部分功能正确性。
Result: Claude 成功生成了 58 个逻辑过程、508 个通过测试的用例以及 257 个引理，总计 11800 行证明，且所有生成内容经人工检查验证。
Conclusion: 该实验表明 LLM 结合自动定理证明器可以有效合成并验证 Prolog 程序，为类似任务提供了可复现的范例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chess\_db: A framework for working with large chess game datasets
papers.abstract_en: Chess is a two player strategic game that is embedded in classical AI culture as it was once the frontier for intelligent behaviour. There was the silent assumption that the advent of computer engines that play better than the best humans will extinguish interest in the game. However, the opposite has come to pass, with a growing following for the game. A lot of the computational resources are now centered around training of players, where the engine output is just one aspect. Access to past games is also an essential part, both in knowing what games a specific player has played previously, and also which continuations at a certain position have led to victory more often for each of the two colour players. We present Chess_db a suite of logic programming tools that can effectively manipulate games both in memory and via creating back end databases. In particular, we provide versatile code that creates databases from PGN (portable game notation) game files and explore the suitability of open source key-value databases for storing position tables that provide near-instant access to information pertaining to substantially large number of games.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Chess_db，一套基于逻辑编程的工具，用于高效处理大型国际象棋对局数据集。该工具支持从 PGN 文件创建数据库，并利用开源键值存储实现位置表的快速检索，适用于大规模对局的分析。
Motivation: 国际象棋领域的数据规模增长，现有工具在处理大量对局时效率不足，尤其是需要快速访问特定位置的历史结果。
Method: 使用 SWI-Prolog 开发 Chess_db 框架，通过逻辑编程实现 PGN 文件的解析与数据库构建，并采用键值存储（如 Berkeley DB）来组织位置表，提供近实时查询。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称该框架能够有效处理大量对局，并实现位置表的快速访问。
Conclusion: Chess_db 为国际象棋数据管理提供了灵活的解决方案，适合用于训练辅助和棋局分析，但未在摘要中讨论性能上限或对比基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Animation, Verification and Visualisation of Prolog Transition Systems with ProB
papers.abstract_en: ProB is a Prolog-based model checker, animator and constraint solver for high-level formal specifications. One can also use ProB to animate transition systems defined by Prolog predicates, allowing the application of its various validation techniques. In this work, we present the existing features of ProB's Prolog animation mode and its recent extensions. The extended capabilities include simulation for statistical checks, more reliable trace replay, transitions with user input and improved state visualisation. We apply the new features to case studies, particularly for evaluating different strategies in game play, such as Connect Four. The features are useful for many other applications, especially for ProB's new sequent prover for Event-B proof obligations, as well as for demonstration models for teaching in combination with interactive visualisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 ProB 工具中用于动画、验证和可视化 Prolog 定义的状态空间的功能，包括已有的特性和最新扩展，如统计模拟、可靠的轨迹回放、带用户输入的转换以及改进的状态可视化。这些功能通过案例研究（如 Connect Four 游戏策略评估）展示，并适用于 Event-B 证明义务的顺序证明器以及教学演示。
Method: 扩展了 ProB 的 Prolog 动画模式，增加统计模拟、更可靠的轨迹回放、支持用户输入的转换以及改进的状态可视化。
Result: 通过 Connect Four 等游戏策略评估案例展示了新功能的实用性，但未给出定量结果。
Conclusion: 这些功能对 Event-B 证明义务的证明器以及结合交互式可视化的教学模型等应用有价值。

papers.title: Encoding Event-B Proof Rules in Prolog: An Interactive Sequent Prover for ProB
papers.abstract_en: Event-B is a formal method rooted in predicate logic and set theory. We encoded over 600 proof rules in Prolog, enabling a systematic, comprehensible proof analysis and construction. By integrating the proof rules into the Prolog-based validation tool ProB, we obtain an interactive proof system with proof tree visualisation. This has advantages in teaching, giving students direct control over the selection of proof rules. Our tool can import proof obligations from the Rodin platform and provides multiple exports: a trace file for proof replay in ProB, an interactive HTML document for tool-independent exploration of the proof tree, and an export back to Rodin, allowing the ProB prover to be used as second chain. Compared to the previous implementation of the proof rules in Java, the encoding in Prolog is more compact, maintainable and extensible. While a preliminary iterative deepening prover with simple heuristics is already available and useful for finding short proofs, we aim to obtain fast automatic provers in the future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Prolog中编码了超过600条Event-B证明规则，集成到ProB工具中，提供交互式证明系统，支持证明树可视化、从Rodin平台导入证明义务，并导出到多种格式。与Java实现相比，Prolog编码更紧凑、可维护和可扩展。
Motivation: 现有的Event-B证明规则在Java中实现，代码冗长且难以维护和扩展，尤其在教学场景中缺乏直观的证明树可视化和交互控制。
Method: 将Event-B的证明规则用Prolog编码，集成到基于Prolog的验证工具ProB中，实现交互式证明系统，支持证明树可视化、多格式导出，并提供初步的迭代加深自动证明器。
Result: Prolog编码比Java实现更紧凑、可维护和可扩展；工具能导入Rodin的证明义务，并导出跟踪文件、交互式HTML文档和Rodin格式，初步的迭代加深证明器可找到短证明。
Conclusion: 该交互式证明系统在教学中具有优势，未来目标是实现快速自动证明器。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning Model for Cross-Modality Super-Resolution in Fluorescence Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modality image translation offers a route to super-resolution fluorescence microscopy from low-resolution images while reducing phototoxicity and instrumentation demands. However, purely data-driven models can produce visually plausible outputs that are inconsistent with optical image formation. Here, we propose a physics-informed generative adversarial network for confocal-to-STED image translation that incorporates microscope-specific point spread function information into the training objective. Simulated and experimentally measured PSFs were evaluated using a limited paired confocal-STED dataset of TOM20-labeled mitochondria in human primary M2 macrophages acquired across different experimental days. Performance was assessed using reference-based and non-reference-based image-quality metrics, together with complementary frequency- and distribution-sensitive analyses. The no-reference metrics probed physics-relevant image properties, including spatial-frequency content, contrast, and signal-to-noise behavior. PSF-guided models improved structural fidelity, reduced local deviations, and achieved closer agreement with STED references than non-PSF baselines, particularly in frequency-domain analyses. These results demonstrate that optical priors can improve the structural fidelity and physical plausibility of generative microscopy models for cross-modality super-resolution imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息生成对抗网络（Physics-Informed GAN），用于共聚焦显微镜到STED超分辨图像的跨模态翻译。该方法在训练目标中融入显微镜特有的点扩散函数（PSF）信息，利用有限的配对齐共聚焦-STED数据集（TOM20标记的线粒体图像）进行训练。实验表明，PSF引导的模型在结构保真度、频域分析和物理合理性方面优于未使用PSF的基线模型。
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的跨模态图像翻译可能产生视觉合理但与光学成像物理不一致的结果，需要引入光学先验以提高结构保真度和物理可信度。
Method: 将显微镜特定的点扩散函数（PSF）信息以正则化项的形式加入生成对抗网络的训练目标中，分别使用模拟和实验测量的PSF，在少量配对准共聚焦-STED数据上训练。
Result: PSF引导的模型在参考和非参考图像质量指标上均优于非PSF基线，尤其在频域分析中与STED参考的一致性更高，局部偏差更小。
Conclusion: 光学先验（如PSF）能够有效提升生成模型在交叉模态超分辨成像中的结构保真度和物理合理性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Identifying Good Rules for Efficient SAT Encodings of Single-Constant Multiplication Using Machine Learning
authors: The City University of New York)
The City University of New York)
papers.abstract_en: The Single Constant Multiplication problem is a fundamental NP-hard optimization task in hardware design, which seeks to decompose a fixed constant using only additions, subtractions, and bit-shifts. Although dynamic programming methods can produce near-optimal SAT encodings for SCM, their encoding cost remains high for large constants. We propose a neuro-symbolic framework that accelerates SCM SAT encoding by identifying good rules for guiding operator selection during decomposition. Our approach employs a graph neural network model to predict promising operator types from constant decompositions, and exploits the resulting confidence scores to prune no-good choices in the symbolic search. Experimental results on unseen 17-32 bit constants demonstrate one to two orders of magnitude reductions in encoding time, over 97% reduction in memory usage, and an order-of-magnitude decrease in branching, while preserving near-optimal encoding quality in terms of additions. These results show that learning-guided symbolic strategies can significantly improve the scalability and efficiency of SCM encoding. Our code and data are publicly available at: https://github.com/Chufeng-Jiang/SCM_MLDP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对硬件设计中的单常数乘法（SCM）问题，提出一种神经符号框架，使用图神经网络预测操作符类型，加速SAT编码。实验表明，在17-32位常数上编码时间减少一到两个数量级，内存减少97%以上，分支减少一个数量级，同时保持近似的加法次数最优性。
Motivation: SCM问题是NP难优化问题，动态规划方法对于大常数编码成本高，需要更高效的编码方法。
Method: 提出神经符号框架，使用图神经网络模型从常数分解中预测有前景的操作符类型，并利用置信度分数在符号搜索中剪枝不良选择。
Result: 在未见过的17-32位常数上，编码时间减少一到两个数量级，内存使用减少97%以上，分支减少一个数量级，同时保持近似的编码质量。
Conclusion: 学习引导的符号策略可以显著提高SCM编码的可扩展性和效率。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对硬件设计中的单常数乘法（SCM）问题，提出一种神经符号框架，使用图神经网络预测操作符类型，加速SAT编码。实验表明，在17-32位常数上编码时间减少一到两个数量级，内存减少97%以上，分支减少一个数量级，同时保持近似的加法次数最优性。

papers.title: Case study: proving sqrt(2) irrational with LPTP and an LLM
papers.abstract_en: We present the interactions with an LLM (Large Language Model) aiming at proving that the square root of 2 is not a rational number in an LP (Logic Programming) context. We start from a few basic pure logic programming predicate definitions. We rely on the LPTP (Logic Program Theorem Prover) system for stating and proving properties about logic programs. As the proof language of LPTP is based on natural deduction, the proofs are human readable. In our case study, we sketch in LPTP the usual proof showing the irrationality of the square root of 2. Then we describe the interactions we had with the LLM. We end up with a complete formal proof, partially generated by an LLM and fully proof-checked by LPTP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一个案例研究，展示了如何结合大语言模型（LLM）和逻辑程序定理证明器（LPTP）来证明根号2的无理性。研究者从纯逻辑编程谓词定义出发，使用LPTP基于自然演绎的证明语言，最终得到一个部分由LLM生成、完全由LPTP验证的完整形式化证明。
Motivation: 探索LLM在逻辑编程和定理证明中的辅助能力，特别是在生成可读的自然演绎证明方面的潜力。
Method: 使用LPTP系统作为证明框架，通过交互式对话让LLM协助生成证明步骤，最终由LPTP进行完整的形式化验证。
Result: 成功得到了一个关于根号2无理性的完整形式化证明，其中部分证明步骤由LLM生成，并由LPTP完全验证。
Conclusion: 该案例展示了LLM在辅助逻辑编程证明中的潜力，但案例规模较小，有待进一步验证。

papers.title: Differentiable Logic Programming to Mitigate Reasoning Shortcuts in Neurosymbolic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Neurosymbolic (NeSy) systems integrate neural networks with logical reasoning to achieve both generalization and interpretability, but recent work has shown they are susceptible to shortcut reasoning behaviors. We propose a novel method using matrix-based differentiable logic programming to mitigate reasoning shortcuts in two phenomena: constraint satisfaction shortcuts, where constraints are satisfied without achieving the intended task, and cognition shortcuts, where biased data leads to semantically incorrect concept mappings despite logically sound inference. Building on recent matrix-based logic programming semantics, we introduce design elements to mitigate shortcuts, including a unified encoding of rules and constraints in a single matrix. We also identify connections to fuzzy logic t-norms and empirically compare their gradient flow properties. Through carefully designed experiments on MNIST variants, we show that one-to-one grounding of neural outputs to logical atoms significantly reduces both shortcut types compared to previous methods that rely on soft probability distributions. We then confirm that architectural choices in coupling symbolic knowledge with neural learning play a critical role in shortcut mitigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于矩阵的可微逻辑编程（matrix-based differentiable logic programming）来缓解神经符号系统中的两种推理捷径：约束满足捷径（constraint satisfaction shortcuts）和认知捷径（cognition shortcuts）。通过将规则和约束统一编码到单个矩阵中，并采用一对一映射（one-to-one grounding）将神经输出连接到逻辑原子，在MNIST变体上显著减少了两种捷径。
Motivation: 神经符号系统容易受到推理捷径行为的影响，包括约束满足捷径（约束被满足但未实现预期任务）和认知捷径（有偏数据导致语义不正确的概念映射，尽管推理在逻辑上正确）。
Method: 提出使用基于矩阵的可微逻辑编程，引入设计元素：统一编码规则和约束到单一矩阵；探索与模糊逻辑t范数的联系并比较梯度流属性；采用一对一映射（one-to-one grounding）而不是软概率分布。
Result: 在MNIST变体上的实验表明，一对一映射相比先前使用软概率分布的方法显著减少了两种捷径。
Conclusion: 架构选择在耦合符号知识与神经学习中起关键作用，有助于缓解推理捷径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explaining Weather Bulletins via ILP
papers.abstract_en: Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) originated within the Logic Programming community in the Nineties as a framework for combining symbolic learning with declarative knowledge representation. Nowadays, mature ILP frameworks exist and they are capable of learning complex, non-monotonic hypotheses, thus broadening both the modeling capabilities and the scope of real-world applications of ILP. This work is primarily based on the FastLAS2 framework and aims to generate simple, interpretable hypotheses to help clarify the weather bulletins issued by OSMER FVG, the Regional Meteorological Observatory of the Italian region of Friuli Venezia-Giulia. In this paper we present a pipeline that, starting from simulated meteorological raw data and from OSMERs' bulletins (used as ground truth), extracts data as ASP facts and generates ILP examples. From such examples an explanatory hypothesis is then inferred via FastLAS2. Such a hypothesis (translated into natural language) explains the weather forecast issued by human experts, and in particular the rationale behind experts' choices of specific symbols in the bulletin pictogram (the symbol-annotated meteorological map of the forecast). The proposed approach is general, not specific to any particular region and it can equally be applied to bulletins from other sources and to different regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于归纳逻辑编程（ILP）的流水线，利用 FastLAS2 框架从模拟气象原始数据和人工专家发布的天气公报中学习可解释的假设，以解释公报中符号选择的逻辑。该方法适用于不同地区的天气预报解释。
Motivation: 现有天气预报公报依赖专家经验，缺乏对符号选择背后逻辑的显式解释。ILP 框架能结合符号学习与知识表示，为专家决策提供可理解的原因。
Method: 构建流水线：将模拟气象数据转换为 ASP 事实，提取 ILP 正负例，然后使用 FastLAS2 框架学习非单调假设，最后将假设转化为自然语言解释。
Result: 摘要未报告定量结果，仅说明可生成解释性假设，能说明人类专家在公报 pictogram 中选择特定符号的原因。
Conclusion: 该方法具有通用性，不限于特定区域，可推广至其他来源的公报和地区。

papers.title: Representative Sets in Propositional Abduction
papers.abstract_en: The propositional abduction problem is a well-known form of non-monotonic reasoning where we are asked to find an explanation of a given manifestation. Recently, there has been an influx of results asking more refined questions about the solution space rather than only individual solutions. For example, we might be interested in finding two solutions that are sufficiently far from each other (diverse solutions) in the solution space. In this paper we consider a related representation question where we ask if a given set of explanations S can represent any other explanation (that is, whether their symmetric difference is smaller than a given k). We first study this problem from a classical complexity perspective and obtain a complete classification. While only a handful of cases are tractable, the increase in complexity compared to classical abduction is often smaller than expected. We then study the parameterized complexity for several parameters and obtain new tractable and hard cases. Interestingly, a full parameterized complexity classification would require resolving the parameterized complexity of the covering radius problem from coding theory. To the best of our knowledge, no useful relationship between coding theory and non-monotonic reasoning has previously been established, but such connections seemingly become important when asking more complex questions about solution spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究命题溯因（propositional abduction）中解释的代表集问题，即给定一组解释S，判定其能否表示任意其他解释（对称差小于k）。从经典复杂性和参数化复杂性两个角度给出了完整分类，发现多数情况是难解的，但与经典溯因相比复杂性增长较小。有趣的是，完整参数化分类需要解决编码论中的覆盖半径问题，从而建立了非单调推理与编码理论之间的新联系。
Motivation: 近年来，对溯因问题解空间的精细化查询（如多样解、代表集）变得重要，而代表集问题的复杂性尚不清楚。
Method: 从经典复杂性角度给出完整分类，并研究多个参数的参数化复杂性，建立与编码理论覆盖半径问题的联系。
Result: 只有少数情况是易解的；多数情况下复杂性增加但往往小于预期；参数化复杂性完整分类依赖于编码理论的未解决问题。
Conclusion: 代表集问题在经典和参数化意义下大多是难解的，但为研究溯因解空间提供了新视角，并揭示了与编码理论的有趣联系。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safeguards for Speech2Speech LLM-Assistants: A Case Study in Automotive Applications
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances have introduced speech-to-speech (S2S) conversational assistants capable of producing natural-sounding interactions, including non-verbal cues like tonality and mood. In the automotive domain, this enables intuitive and humanlike in-car dialogue experiences. However, integrating these end-to-end assistants limits architectural options for programmable domain-specific safeguards. This paper discusses two implementation approaches for S2S guardrails: transcript-based and tool-based. Through an empirical evaluation, we demonstrate that both strategies are insufficient for industrial deployment in most cases due to prohibitive latency (delaying each answer by 0 to 1.4 seconds even for computationally cheap checks) and technical impediments (like potentially non-deterministic tool call behavior). Finally, we outline open challenges for S2S guardrails in the automotive context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨在汽车领域部署端到端语音到语音（S2S）对话助手时，如何实现领域特定的安全防护（guardrails）。通过实验评估两种方法——基于转录的（transcript-based）和基于工具的（tool-based）——发现两者均因高延迟（每次回答延迟0-1.4秒）和技术障碍（如工具调用非确定性）而难以工业部署。最后总结了汽车场景下S2S防护的开放挑战。
Motivation: 汽车场景中需要可编程的领域特定安全防护，但端到端S2S模型限制了架构选项，亟需评估现有防护策略的可行性。
Method: 比较两种S2S防护实现路径：基于转录的（检查文本转录）和基于工具的（通过工具调用执行规则）。
Result: 实验表明两种策略在大多数情况下无法满足工业部署要求：即使计算成本很低的检查，也会引入0-1.4秒的延迟，且存在工具调用非确定性等技术问题。
Conclusion: 当前S2S防护方法在汽车领域存在延迟和可靠性瓶颈，需要进一步研究解决开放挑战。

papers.title: Out of Sight, Still in Mind: Token Compression for Omni-LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The goal of this paper is to reduce the input token cost of Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) at inference time. Omni-LLMs reason jointly over audio, video and text, but the cost of the three streams is highly unbalanced: visual tokens account for the vast majority of the input, and are highly redundant. In this paper, we propose ReMo, a training-free framework that compresses visual tokens by redistributing their information across modalities: a visual token is kept only if its information appears nowhere else. ReMo achieves this in two ways: (i) it aligns audio and video in a common embedding space, and removes visual tokens already explained by the audio or by other visual tokens; and (ii) it replaces object-level visual tokens with compact text proxies, short descriptions of each object and its location, conveying the same content in far fewer tokens. On Qwen2.5-Omni at two model scales, ReMo removes 54% of the input tokens with no loss in accuracy. Indeed, it slightly exceeds the full-token model, reaching 101.2% and 101.3% of its average accuracy over five audio-visual benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReMo，一种无需训练的框架，用于压缩Omni-modal大语言模型（Omni-LLMs）中的视觉令牌。通过将视觉令牌的信息重新分布到其他模态，ReMo在保持甚至略微提升精度的同时，移除了54%的输入令牌。在Qwen2.5-Omni的两个模型规模上，平均准确率达到全令牌模型的101.2%和101.3%。
Motivation: Omni-LLMs联合处理音频、视频和文本，但视觉令牌数量庞大且高度冗余，导致推理成本高昂。现有方法未能有效利用跨模态冗余来减少视觉令牌。
Method: ReMo通过两种方式压缩视觉令牌：(i) 将音频和视频对齐到共同嵌入空间，移除已被音频或其他视觉令牌解释的视觉令牌；(ii) 用紧凑的文本代理（对象及其位置的简短描述）替换对象级视觉令牌，从而以更少的令牌传达相同内容。
Result: 在五个音频-视觉基准上，ReMo平均移除54%的输入令牌，且准确率超过全令牌模型，达到101.2%和101.3%的平均准确率。
Conclusion: ReMo展示了无需训练即可大幅降低Omni-LLM推理成本，同时不损失甚至提升性能的可能性，为多模态模型的高效部署提供了新思路。

papers.title: Decoupling Cross-Modality Manifold Discrepancy: Leveraging Visible Diffusion Priors for Infrared Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Infrared image super-resolution (IISR) mitigates the limitations imposed by low spatial resolution. Existing methods have recognized that IISR should preserve consistency in global distribution and structural information while enhancing image clarity. However, these methods are either insufficient or overly intrusive, a problem that becomes even more pronounced in diffusion-based models. To address these issues, we propose a dual-path diffusion-based framework for IISR, termed Shift-IISR. The proposed method is designed to improve the consistency of IISR results while preserving the generative capacity of diffusion models. Specifically, we develop a Global Representation Modulation (GRM) module to extract modality-specific information from infrared imagery and guide the global distribution of the diffusion model toward the ground truth. In addition, we introduce a Local Structure Refinement (LSR) module to encourage the model to focus on structural information at each step of the iterative denoising process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method effectively improves distributional and structural consistency while maintaining competitive super-resolution performance. The source code of the proposed Shift-IISR can be available at https://github.com/Assassink8/Shift-IISR.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). Code: https://github.com/Assassink8/Shift-IISR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Shift-IISR，一种基于双路径扩散框架的红外图像超分辨率（IISR）方法。通过全局表征调制（GRM）模块提取红外模态特定信息以引导扩散模型的全局分布，以及局部结构细化（LSR）模块在迭代去噪过程中关注结构信息，旨在提升超分辨率结果的分布一致性和结构一致性。实验表明该方法在保持竞争性能的同时改进了分布与结构一致性。
Motivation: 现有红外超分辨率方法在提升清晰度时难以同时保持全局分布和结构信息的一致性，扩散模型中的这一问题尤为突出，现有方法要么不足要么过于侵入。
Method: 提出双路径扩散框架Shift-IISR，包含全局表征调制（GRM）模块和局部结构细化（LSR）模块，分别用于引导全局分布和增强迭代去噪中的结构信息。
Result: 实验证明该方法有效提升了分布一致性和结构一致性，同时保持了有竞争力的超分辨率性能。
Conclusion: Shift-IISR通过解耦跨模态流形差异，利用可见光扩散先验改善红外超分辨率，代码已开源。

papers.title: Automated Synthesis and Adversarial Validation of Executable Causal Research Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: While automated research systems promise to accelerate empirical analysis, they are prone to silent failures: instances in which analysis code executes successfully yet relies on invalid causal assumptions. We present the Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based Epidemiology Research Assistant (ARA), a framework that makes these failures visible by explicitly encoding causal design principles, study-specific assumptions, and methodological constraints. ARA integrates protocol construction, synthetic data generation, and adversarial validation into a unified pipeline. The framework translates natural language research questions into structured causal protocols and executable analysis code by first constructing a protocol and then generating synthetic datasets using Structural Causal Models (SCMs) with known ground-truth effects. This synthetic-data step can also support pipeline development when access to confidential data, such as medical data, is restricted. The generated analysis is then evaluated under controlled violations of identification assumptions. We evaluate ARA on the Automated Causal Reasoning Benchmark, assessing recovery of identification strategies, causal quantities, treatment and outcome variables, and consistency between generated code and approved protocol. Protocol construction and adversarial validation did not consistently improve numerical agreement with benchmark estimates compared with standard LLM-based generation. However, they changed the failure mode: instead of silently returning causal estimates, ARA often surfaced protocol concerns, diagnostic failures, incomplete inference, or downgraded non-causal interpretations. These findings suggest that validity-first automated science systems should be evaluated not only by answer accuracy, but also by whether they indicate when causal claims are unwarranted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为ARA（基于AI的流行病学研究助手）的框架，通过显式编码因果设计原则、研究特定假设和方法约束，使自动化研究中的无声失败（代码执行但因果假设无效）变得可见。ARA集成了协议构建、合成数据生成和对抗验证，将自然语言研究问题转化为结构化因果协议和可执行分析代码，并利用结构因果模型（SCMs）生成已知真实效应的合成数据集。在自动化因果推理基准上的评估显示，协议构建和对抗验证并未一致提高数值一致性，但改变了失败模式：ARA常常暴露协议问题、诊断失败或不完全推断，而非默默返回因果估计。
Motivation: 自动化研究系统容易产生无声失败，即分析代码成功执行但依赖无效的因果假设，而现有系统缺乏识别此类失败的机制。
Method: 提出ARA框架，通过三个步骤工作：首先将自然语言研究问题转化为结构化因果协议，然后利用结构因果模型生成具有已知真实效应的合成数据集，最后在受控的识别假设违反下评估生成的分析。
Result: 在自动化因果推理基准上，协议构建和对抗验证并未一致提高与基准估计的数值一致性，但改变了失败模式：ARA更常暴露协议问题、诊断失败、不完全推断或降级为非因果解释。
Conclusion: 有效性优先的自动化科学系统不仅应根据答案准确性评估，还应根据它们是否在因果主张不成立时发出指示来评估。

papers.title: Agree on the Model, Verify the Inference: GKR Protocols for HND-Based Transformer Inference
papers.abstract_en: Outsourced Transformer inference exposes clients to model substitution and incomplete execution, while direct replay removes the computational benefit of delegation. We present GKR-HND, a registered-model protocol for verifying the polynomial backbone of Homomorphic--Nonhomomorphic Decomposition Transformers. The retained verifier checks the GKR transcript and registered-weight openings, but delegates expensive public evaluations to an assigned computation worker. Assuming an honest retained verifier and prover--worker non-collusion, the verifier accepts only when the worker's signed, request-bound response agrees with the proof claims. Experiments with pretrained HND models validate the proof path and the delegated public computation without dense-matrix replay.
papers.comment: 24 pages, including 4 pages of supporting information; 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对外包Transformer推理中的模型替换和不完全执行问题，提出GKR-HND协议，用于验证同态-非同态分解(HND) Transformer的多项式骨干。该协议将昂贵的公共评估委托给计算工作者，而保留验证者检查GKR转录和注册权重开放。实验表明，在假设诚实验证者和非共谋条件下，协议能够验证推理路径且无需密集矩阵重放。
Motivation: 外包Transformer推理存在模型替换和不完全执行的风险，而直接重放会丧失委托计算的优势。
Method: 提出GKR-HND注册模型协议，保留验证者检查GKR转录和注册权重开放，将昂贵的公共评估委托给指定计算工作者，依赖诚实验证者与工作者非共谋假设。
Result: 实验使用预训练HND模型验证了证明路径和委托公共计算的有效性，无需密集矩阵重放。
Conclusion: 该协议在假设条件下能够可靠验证推理完整性，为外包Transformer推理提供了可审计方案。

papers.title: SafeStep: AI-powered Travel Assistance for Elderly People with Frailty or Dementia
authors: Elderly People with Frailty or Dementia Azul Debenedetti
papers.abstract_en: More than a million people in the UK suffer from frailty or dementia, which severely compromise their ability to travel in urban environments. This paper presents SafeStep, an AI-driven travel system that assists elderly users with their journeys. At the core of SafeStep is a novel travel graph representation, which integrates route planning with predictive modelling. For each stage of a journey, the system (i) generates personalized failure scenarios using a combi-nation of LLMs and the Anticip8 behavioral prediction engine, (ii) proposes targeted interventions, and (iii) estimates the impact of interventions on out-come probabilities. This enables SafeStep to select interventions that maximize the likelihood of the person reaching their destination. SafeStep was evaluated through experiments on travel graph generation and a field study involving 26 real-world journeys. Results showed that combining Anticip8 for failure pre-diction with GPT-based models for intervention evaluation yields the most re-liable performance. User feedback indicated that SafeStep improves confidence and perceived safety during travel, although interface usability needs to be im-proved for the target demographic. In the future, we would like to improve and release SafeStep. The AI system that was developed for SafeStep could be ap-plied in other areas, such as mental health, career coaching and addiction treatment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SafeStep，一个面向虚弱或痴呆老年人的AI旅行辅助系统。核心是新颖的旅行图表示，集成路线规划与预测建模，利用LLM和Anticip8行为预测引擎生成个性化失败场景、提出干预措施并评估效果。通过旅行图生成实验和26次实地出行评估，表明结合Anticip8与GPT模型性能最可靠；用户反馈显示系统提高了信心和感知安全性，但界面可用性需改进。
Motivation: 英国超过百万人因虚弱或痴呆而难以在城市环境中出行，现有系统缺乏针对这类人群的个性化风险预测和干预。
Method: 提出SafeStep系统，核心是旅行图(travel graph)表示，集成路线规划与预测建模。对每个行程阶段：(i)使用LLM和Anticip8生成个性化失败场景，(ii)提出针对性干预，(iii)估计干预对结果概率的影响，从而选择最大化到达目的地可能性的干预。
Result: 实验表明，将Anticip8用于失败预测与基于GPT的干预评估结合性能最可靠；实地研究（26次真实出行）用户反馈表明系统提高了信心和感知安全性，但界面可用性需要改进。
Conclusion: 论文总结SafeStep改善了老年人出行信心，但界面需改进；未来计划改进并开源，系统可应用于精神健康、职业辅导和成瘾治疗等领域。

papers.title: CRAG-MM-Diagnostics: Enabling Stage-Wise Analysis of Knowledge-Intensive VQA
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-Intensive Visual Question Answering (KI-VQA) benchmarks evaluate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as multimodal knowledge assistants by requiring external information beyond a provided image to answer questions. KI-VQA involves multiple sub-problems -referring expression understanding, visual grounding, object recognition, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning-yet existing benchmarks typically report only end-task accuracy, obscuring where failures arise. To analyze the full KI-VQA pipeline, we introduce CRAG-MM-Diagnostics, a diagnostic benchmark with stage-wise data annotations that isolate 1) language-based visual grounding, 2) object identification, and 3) knowledge retrieval and reasoning. We evaluate fully parametric and retrieval-augmented VLMs, providing fine-grained analyses using newly collected metadata, such as target ROIs, entity names, and visual complexity scores. Our results point to knowledge retrieval and reasoning as the primary bottleneck, but also highlight issues in the other parts of the KI-VQA pipeline, such as the fact that VLMs struggle with target object identification or that image retrievers struggle to integrate textual cues. These findings expose fundamental limitations in current KI-VQA systems and motivate stage-aware evaluation. We, lastly, leverage these findings to propose a grounded bimodal RAG pipeline that integrates a visual grounding module to crop targets before image retrieval, boosting GPT-5 and Qwen's respective accuracies by 13.3 and 8.5 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CRAG-MM-Diagnostics，一个用于知识密集型视觉问答（KI-VQA）的阶段性诊断基准，通过细粒度注释（目标ROI、实体名称、视觉复杂度）将评估分解为语言视觉定位、目标识别、知识检索与推理三个子阶段。实验表明，知识检索与推理是主要瓶颈，但视觉定位和目标识别也存在问题；基于发现提出的融合视觉定位模块的双模态RAG流水线，在GPT-5和Qwen上分别提升13.3和8.5个百分点。
Motivation: 现有KI-VQA基准仅报告端到端准确率，无法定位错误来源，阻碍了多模态知识助手的改进。
Method: 构建CRAG-MM-Diagnostics数据集，包含阶段式注释（视觉定位、目标识别、知识检索与推理）；评估全参数和检索增强型VLM；提出一种结合视觉定位模块的接地双模态RAG流水线。
Result: 知识检索与推理是主要瓶颈，但VLM在目标识别和图像检索器整合文本线索方面也存在困难；所提RAG流水线显著提升GPT-5和Qwen准确率。
Conclusion: 现有KI-VQA系统存在根本性局限，需要阶段感知的评估方法；双模态RAG流水线展示了有效改进方向。

papers.title: V-DEAL: Diagnosing Video Safety De-Calibration as an Understanding-Refusal Coupling Failure
papers.abstract_en: As Video Large Language Models are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, ensuring their safety alignment has become critical. Counterintuitively, we find that harmful videos paired with benign queries achieve higher attack success rates than the same videos paired with explicitly harmful queries. To understand the underlying mechanism of this vulnerability, we present V-DEAL, a three-level diagnostic framework that jointly analyzes this failure across model behaviour, understanding, and internal representations. By progressively ruling out perception failure and quantifying the model's internal refusal tendency, V-DEAL provides a new diagnostic perspective for analyzing the underlying mechanism of the observed vulnerability. We tested six Video LLMs on three public benchmarks and observed that models correctly recognize harmful video content with over 81\% accuracy, yet the average attack success rate still reaches 48.33\% under the condition pairing harmful videos with benign queries. Hidden-state analysis further shows that visual understanding activates a weaker refusal tendency than textual understanding. Furthermore, we introduce a prompt injection intervention method that reduces attack success rates by an average of 48.24 percentage points and achieves performance comparable to prior fine-tuning-based methods, providing an effective and practical means to address such safety risks in Video LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: One More Turn, Less Regret: A Regret-Based Multi-Turn Benchmark for LLMs' Clarification Policies
papers.abstract_en: Ambiguous user requests make clarification a sequential decision problem for conversational LLM assistants: they must decide whether to ask, what to ask, when to stop, and when to answer. We introduce RegretBench, a multi-turn benchmark that evaluates clarification as policy behavior rather than isolated question quality. RegretBench provides a hidden-intent formulation of ambiguity, supports free-form interaction grounded in semantic-state tracking, and introduces a regret-based objective that measures how much value a model loses relative to a reference clarification policy. Experiments on open-domain QA and product recommendation scenarios show that final success alone is insufficient, as models with similar accuracy can differ substantially in efficiency, robustness to user behaviors, and stopping decisions. By jointly measuring intent resolution, interaction cost, ineffective clarification, and regret, RegretBench reveals whether models clarify usefully and efficiently. Our results show that effective clarification requires more than plausible questions: models must ask the right question at the right time and stop once the user's intended meaning is clear.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RegretBench，一个基于遗憾（regret）的多轮基准，用于评估LLM助手在模糊用户请求时的澄清策略。通过隐藏意图形式化歧义，支持基于语义状态追踪的自由交互，并引入遗憾目标衡量模型相对于参考澄清策略的价值损失。实验表明，仅关注最终成功不足，模型在效率、鲁棒性和停止决策上存在显著差异。
Motivation: 现有评估主要关注澄清问题本身的质量，而非澄清策略作为序列决策过程的整体效果，缺乏对效率、时机和停止决策的联合衡量。
Method: 构建RegretBench，包含隐藏意图的歧义设定、语义状态追踪框架，以及基于遗憾的评估目标，比较模型与参考策略的价值损失。
Result: 开放域QA和产品推荐场景中，相似准确率的模型在效率、用户行为鲁棒性和停止决策上差异明显，遗憾目标揭示了澄清的有用性和效率。
Conclusion: 有效澄清不仅需要合理的问题，还需在正确时机提问并在意图明确后停止。当前模型在此方面仍有不足。

papers.title: DTIF: Robust Loop Closure Detection via Delaunay Triangle Topology in Complex Forests
papers.abstract_en: Accurate forest inventory and large-scale mapping are essential for ecosystem monitoring and sustainable forest management. Multiple low-cost edge platforms enable efficient large-area data acquisition, but merging independently constructed local maps in GNSS-denied understory environments still requires initialization-free loop closure detection and global registration. This task is challenging because low-cost LiDAR point clouds are sparse and noisy, while repetitive trunk layouts and the lack of distinctive geometric landmarks lead to severe perceptual aliasing and false correspondences. To address these issues, we propose DTIF (Delaunay Triangulation in Forests), a lightweight trunk-topology-based framework for forest loop closure detection and global registration. Tree trunks are first extracted as stable landmarks and encoded using a Delaunay topology for compact scene representation. Candidate submaps are then screened using edge-length and radius statistics, followed by edge--radius consistency verification and strong/weak vertex support aggregation to construct weighted vertex correspondences. Finally, topology-derived reliability weights are incorporated into a decoupled robust pose estimator that separately estimates yaw, horizontal translation, and elevation translation under gravity alignment. Experiments on simulated and real-world forest datasets demonstrate that DTIF achieves accurate registration with low computational overhead, providing a favorable balance among robustness, efficiency, and deployability on resource-constrained edge platforms.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DTIF框架，利用Delaunay三角剖分拓扑实现复杂森林环境下的鲁棒闭环检测与全局配准。该方法通过提取树干作为稳定地标，构建紧凑的拓扑表示，并设计解耦的姿态估计器，在稀疏噪声点云和感知混淆场景下实现高精度低开销配准。
Motivation: 低成本LiDAR在GNSS缺失的林下环境进行大面积制图时，点云稀疏噪杂，重复树干导致感知混淆，现有方法难以实现无初始化闭环检测和全局配准。
Method: 首先提取树干地标并构建Delaunay三角拓扑表示；然后通过边长-半径统计筛选候选子图，进行边-半径一致性验证和强弱顶点支持聚合以建立加权对应；最后利用拓扑可靠性权重，在重力对齐下解耦估计偏航、水平平移和高度平移。
Result: 在模拟和真实森林数据集上，DTIF实现了准确配准，计算开销低，在鲁棒性、效率和边缘平台部署性之间取得了良好平衡。
Conclusion: DTIF为森林LiDAR地图拼接提供了一种轻量级、无需初始化的解决方案，适用于资源受限的边缘平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safety-oriented sidewalk and road segmentation for smartphone-based assistive navigation
papers.abstract_en: Independent sidewalk mobility is essential for blind and visually impaired pedestrians (BVIPs), yet smartphone-based assistive navigation requires perception models that distinguish walkable sidewalks from adjacent unsafe regions. This study presents a safety-oriented semantic segmentation framework for future mobile guidance. We introduce SENSATION-DS, a chest-height pedestrian-view dataset with 2,752 image-mask pairs and nine-class navigation-relevant taxonomy. External urban and sidewalk datasets were harmonized to this label space, and five segmentation architectures were evaluated using staged target-domain adaptation with mask-conditioned synthetic images and Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) pseudo-labels. Models were assessed using mean Intersection over Union (mIoU), road- and sidewalk-specific metrics, Road-as-Sidewalk Error Rate as a proxy false-safe measure, and Android Open Neural Network Exchange benchmarking. Synthetic augmentation generally improved segmentation accuracy, whereas SAM2 pseudo-labels more consistently reduced Road-as-Sidewalk errors. UPerNet-MobileNetV3 achieved the highest offline mIoU (0.715 +/- 0.006), while DeepLabV3Plus-MobileNetV3 achieved the lowest Road-as-Sidewalk Error Rate (0.079) and highest Android runtime at 512x384 (7.383 FPS). These results show that assistive sidewalk perception should be evaluated jointly by segmentation accuracy, proxy false-safe behavior, and smartphone deployment feasibility, while real-world benefit requires validation with BVIP users. This evaluation supports selecting models that balance accurate perception, conservative error behavior, and practical runtime.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to Assistive Technology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对盲人和视障人士的智能手机辅助导航，提出安全导向的语义分割框架。引入SENSATION-DS数据集（2752图像-掩码对，9类导航标签），通过目标域自适应和SAM2伪标签评估五种分割架构。UPerNet-MobileNetV3取得最高离线mIoU（0.715），DeepLabV3Plus-MobileNetV3取得最低道路-人行道错误率（0.079）和最高Android运行时（7.383 FPS）。结论强调应联合评估准确度、假安全行为和部署可行性。
Motivation: 盲人和视障人士需要智能手机辅助导航来区分可步行的人行道与相邻不安全区域，但现有感知模型缺乏安全导向的评估和专用数据集。
Method: 构建SENSATION-DS数据集并整合外部数据集，采用掩码条件合成图像和SAM2伪标签进行目标域自适应，评估五种语义分割架构（包括UPerNet-MobileNetV3、DeepLabV3Plus-MobileNetV3），使用mIoU、道路-人行道错误率等指标，并在Android设备上基准测试。
Result: UPerNet-MobileNetV3达到最高离线mIoU（0.715±0.006），DeepLabV3Plus-MobileNetV3达到最低道路-人行道错误率（0.079）和最高Android运行时（7.383 FPS）。
Conclusion: 辅助人行道感知应联合评估分割准确度、假安全行为（道路-人行道错误率）和智能手机部署可行性；实际有效性需通过盲人和视障用户验证。

papers.title: Demographically-Informed Heat-Mortality Risk Curves via Risk Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Estimating heat-related mortality risk is a core task in environmental epidemiology, typically addressed with Distributed Lag Non-linear Models (DLNMs); interpretable exposure-response surfaces fitted to temperature-mortality time series. DLNMs are effective but ignore demographic and geographic context, despite well-established relevance to heat vulnerability. We propose Risk Graph Neural Networks (RGNNs), a hierarchical GNN encoder that uses granular census features to optimise DLNM coefficient vectors, preserving interpretable risk curve outputs while substantially improving predictive calibration. Evaluated across 10 regions of England and Wales on two unprecedented heat years, RGNN variants maintain both lower point-errors and near-nominal uncertainty coverage during the 2022 heatwave where baselines collapse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出风险图神经网络（RGNN），通过层级GNN编码器利用细粒度人口普查特征优化分布式滞后非线性模型（DLNM）系数向量，在保持可解释风险曲线的同时改善预测校准。在英格兰和威尔士10个地区的两个前所未有的高温年份评估中，RGNN变体在2022年热浪期间维持了较低的逐点误差和接近名义的不确定性覆盖，而基线模型失效。
Motivation: 传统DLNM模型虽然有效，但忽略了人口和地理背景，而这些因素与热脆弱性密切相关，导致预测校准不足。
Method: 提出RGNN，一种层级GNN编码器，使用细粒度人口普查特征来优化DLNM系数向量，保留可解释的风险曲线输出。
Result: 在英格兰和威尔士10个地区的两个前所未有的高温年份（包括2022年热浪）评估中，RGNN变体实现了较低的逐点误差和接近名义的不确定性覆盖，而基线模型在2022年热浪中崩溃。
Conclusion: RGNN通过融入人口统计信息，在保持DLNM可解释性的同时显著改善了预测校准，为环境流行病学提供了更具鲁棒性的热-死亡风险估计方法。

papers.title: Hardware-Software Co-Design for Float16 On-Device Training on RISC-V Single-Core
papers.abstract_en: By leveraging standard RISC-V extensions, namely Zfh (scalar float16) and Zvfh (vector float16), this work proposes an open-source framework to enable complete on-device training on resource-constrained RISC-V single-core. Our approach allows memory footprint reduction by about 50% as compared to using float32 and with minimal model performance degradation. We also facilitate transfer learning and fine-tuning scenarios by incorporating layer-freezing capabilities. Our work builds onto AIfES, an open-source, modular and generic DNN training and inference framework for embedded systems that can be extended with custom hardware-specific functions. The benefits of float16 is further emphasized by outlining the low area overhead of Zfh on a RV64GC super-scalar out-of-order FPGA softcore (+1.15% LUT6 and +0.05% FF at 175MHz). Finally, we discuss the architecture of a Zvfh implementation within the same RISC-V core.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于RISC-V标准扩展Zfh（标量float16）和Zvfh（向量float16）的开放框架，在资源受限的RISC-V单核上实现完整的设备端训练。相比float32，内存占用减少约50%，模型性能下降极小，并支持通过层冻结实现迁移学习和微调。该框架基于AIfES嵌入式DNN框架，并评估了Zfh在RV64GC超标量乱序FPGA软核上的低硬件开销（LUT6增加1.15%，FF增加0.05%，频率175MHz）。
Motivation: 现有设备端训练在资源受限的RISC-V平台上受限于内存和计算效率，浮点32位模型占用过高，而float16精度可降低内存需求且性能损失可控，但需要硬件和软件的协同支持。
Method: 利用RISC-V的Zfh和Zvfh扩展，在单核上实现float16训练；通过在AIfES框架中集成层冻结功能支持迁移学习；通过硬件实现评估Zfh的面积开销。
Result: 内存占用减少约50%；在RV64GC软核上，Zfh硬件面积开销仅为LUT6增加1.15%和FF增加0.05%；模型性能仅有极小退化。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了在资源受限的RISC-V单核上使用float16进行设备端训练的可行性，并展示了低硬件开销，为嵌入式系统上的高效深度学习提供了开源方案。

papers.title: Causal-AgentIR: Self-Evolving Causal Memory for Adaptive Image Restoration Agents
papers.abstract_en: Image restoration agents have recently emerged as a flexible paradigm for handling diverse and unpredictable degradations in real-world scenarios. Existing agents typically formulate restoration as a tool-using process, where the agent perceives degradations, searches candidate tools, executes restoration operations, and revises the plan through reflection or rollback. However, their knowledge is often stored as static tool descriptions, manually defined degradation priors, or unstructured textual summaries, which limits the accumulation, verification, revision, and forgetting of restoration knowledge over long-term experience. In this paper, we propose Causal-AgentIR, a hierarchical multi-agent framework with self-evolving causal memory for collective image restoration intelligence. Instead of representing restoration experience as isolated textual records, Causal-AgentIR organizes degradation patterns, image regions, restoration tools, actions, quality changes, and user preferences into a structured causal memory graph. This graph supports graph-based retrieval and multi-hop causal reasoning, enabling agents to infer how specific restoration operations or tool sequences affect restoration quality under different degradation conditions. The framework further organizes multiple agents into a collaborative system, including planning, degradation analysis, tool expertise, causal memory reasoning, outcome critique, and memory curation. Through this design, restoration experience can be added, updated, merged, reinforced, ignored, or discarded according to observed quality changes and feedback, allowing the agent to maintain reliable and transferable restoration knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Causal-AgentIR，一种基于自演化因果记忆的分层多智能体框架，用于自适应图像恢复。该框架将退化模式、图像区域、恢复工具、动作、质量变化和用户偏好组织成结构化的因果记忆图，支持图检索和多跳因果推理，使智能体能够推断不同退化条件下操作序列对恢复质量的影响。通过多个协同智能体（规划、退化分析、工具专长、因果记忆推理、结果评判、记忆策展）实现经验的动态增加、更新、合并、强化、忽略或丢弃。实验表明该框架有效。
Motivation: 现有图像恢复智能体通常将知识存储为静态工具描述、手动定义的退化先验或非结构化文本摘要，缺乏长期经验的积累、验证、修正和遗忘机制，限制了智能体从长期交互中持续改进恢复知识的能力。
Method: 提出Causal-AgentIR，构建分层多智能体系统，核心是结构化的因果记忆图，将恢复经验表示为节点（退化模式、图像区域、工具、动作、质量变化、用户偏好）和边（因果关系）。系统包含规划、退化分析、工具专长、因果记忆推理、结果评判和记忆策展六个智能体模块，通过观察质量变化和反馈动态更新记忆图。
Result: 在图像恢复任务上的大量实验表明，所提出的因果记忆框架能够有效提升恢复性能，并验证了知识自演化和因果推理的有效性（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
Conclusion: 通过因果记忆的自演化机制，智能体能够维护可靠且可迁移的恢复知识，为长期自适应图像恢复提供了一种新的组织范式，有助于解决实际场景中退化种类多样和不可预测的问题。

papers.title: Approximate Quantum State Preparation Through Proximal Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In this work, a quantum architecture search framework for approximate quantum state preparation (QSP) is proposed. QSP is a challenging task, since the search space grows exponentially with the number of qubits, making the identification of the optimal circuit non-trivial. To address this problem, deep reinforcement learning is employed through an agent based on proximal policy optimization. The objective of the agent is to identify the best possible approximation of the target state while simultaneously minimizing the number of gates used. At each step, the agent appends a new gate to the circuit and recomputes the fidelity between the approximated state and the target states. Various experiments have been performed from 2 to 5 qubits. Both predefined states, such as Bell, GHZ, W, and Dicke states, and completely random states are considered. The proposed framework is able to achieve approximation errors of $10^{-14}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于近端策略优化（PPO）的量子架构搜索框架，用于近似量子状态制备（QSP）。通过强化学习智能体逐步添加量子门，在最小化门数量的同时最大化与目标态的保真度。在2至5量子比特上，对Bell、GHZ、W、Dicke等预定义态及随机态均实现了10^{-14}的近似误差。
Motivation: 量子状态制备的搜索空间随量子比特数指数增长，传统方法难以找到最优电路，需要高效的自动化搜索方法。
Method: 采用深度强化学习中的近端策略优化（PPO）算法，智能体每一步从动作空间中选择一个门加入电路，并基于当前保真度和门数奖励进行优化。
Result: 在2至5量子比特实验上，对多种目标态（Bell、GHZ、W、Dicke及随机态）均达到10^{-14}的近似误差。
Conclusion: 提出的PPO-based框架能有效逼近目标量子态，同时保持电路门数较小，适用于中等规模量子态制备。

papers.title: Relative Value Learning
papers.abstract_en: In reinforcement learning, critics typically estimate absolute state values $V(s)$, estimating how good a particular situation is in isolation. However, it turns out that only differences in value are relevant for control. Motivated by this, we propose Relative Value Learning (RV), a framework that learns value differences directly via an antisymmetric function $Δ(s_i, s_j) = V(s_i) - V(s_j)$. We introduce a pairwise Bellman operator and prove it is a $γ$-contraction with a unique fixed point equal to the true value differences, derive well-posed $1$-step, $n$-step and $λ$-return targets and reconstruct generalized advantage estimation from pairwise differences to obtain an unbiased policy-gradient estimator (R-GAE). Beyond theoretical results, we integrate RV with PPO and achieve competitive performance on the Atari benchmark (49 ALE games) compared to standard PPO, indicating that relative value estimation is an effective alternative to absolute critics.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出相对价值学习（Relative Value Learning, RV），在强化学习中直接学习状态价值差而非绝对状态价值。作者定义了配对贝尔曼算子并证明其γ-收缩性，推导了1步、n步和λ-return目标，并基于配对差异重构广义优势估计得到无偏策略梯度估计器（R-GAE）。将RV集成到PPO中，在Atari基准（49个ALE游戏）上取得与标准PPO相当的性能，表明相对价值估计是绝对价值函数的有效替代。
Motivation: 强化学习中，对于控制而言只有价值差是相关的，但传统批评家估计绝对状态价值。本文旨在直接学习价值差异，避免绝对价值估计的冗余。
Method: 提出相对价值学习框架，通过反对称函数Δ(s_i, s_j) = V(s_i) - V(s_j)直接学习价值差。定义配对贝尔曼算子并证明其收缩性，推导多步目标，并基于配对差异重构广义优势估计得到R-GAE，结合PPO进行训练。
Result: 在Atari 49个游戏上，集成RV的PPO与标准PPO性能相当，表明相对价值估计可作为绝对价值函数的有效替代。
Conclusion: 相对价值学习是一个理论上完备的框架，能够直接学习价值差，并在实践中与PPO结合取得竞争性表现，为强化学习中的价值估计提供了新思路。

papers.title: The Second LoViF 2026 Challenge on Real-World All-in-One Image Restoration: Methods and Results
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a review of the second LoViF Challenge on Real-World All-in-One Image Restoration. The challenge aims to advance unified image restoration under diverse real-world degradation conditions, including blur, low-light, haze, rain, and snow. It provides a common benchmark for evaluating the restoration accuracy, robustness, and generalization capability of models across multiple degradation categories within a unified framework. The competition attracted 158 registered participants, and 20 teams were included in the final ranking after their submitted results were successfully reproduced and verified. This report provides a comprehensive analysis of the submitted solutions and corresponding results, highlighting recent advances in real-world all-in-one image restoration. The summarized methods and empirical findings reveal effective design strategies and establish an updated benchmark for future research in real-world low-level vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回顾了第二届LoViF挑战赛，旨在解决真实世界中多种退化条件下的统一图像恢复问题，包括模糊、低光、雾、雨和雪。挑战赛吸引了158名注册参与者，最终20支队伍进入排名。报告总结了提交的解决方案和结果，提供了有效设计策略和更新的基准。
Motivation: 现有图像恢复方法通常针对单一退化类型，缺乏处理多种真实世界退化的统一框架。该挑战通过建立公共基准，推动模型在跨退化类别上的恢复精度、鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Method: 挑战赛组织者提供了统一的训练和测试数据，包含多种退化类型。参赛团队提交了各自的模型和结果，经过重现和验证后纳入排名。报告对获胜方案和常见设计策略进行了综合分析。
Result: 摘要提到20支队伍进入最终排名，但未给出具体数值结果。报告总结了有效设计策略，并建立了更新的基准。
Conclusion: 该挑战赛及报告为真实世界统一图像恢复提供了当前最新方法的系统评估，并指出了有前景的研究方向。

papers.title: GlucoTune: A Unified Framework for Blood Glucose Preprocessing, Forecasting, and Benchmarking in Diabetes
papers.abstract_en: Preprocessing blood glucose time-series data is a critical yet often overlooked step in developing data-driven methods for diabetes management, particularly for type 1 diabetes. The lack of standardized preprocessing workflows and evaluation protocols hinders reproducibility and complicates fair comparison across studies. These challenges are further exacerbated by data-sharing restrictions, as privacy and licensing constraints often prevent the redistribution of preprocessed medical datasets. To address these limitations, we present GlucoTune, a comprehensive and extensible framework for reproducible experimentation with blood glucose time-series data. The framework standardizes the entire experimental workflow, from preprocessing to model evaluation, enabling reproducible experiments directly from the original datasets. Reproducible preprocessing is achieved through configurable pipelines defined in portable YAML configuration files, ensuring consistent data handling without distributing sensitive preprocessed data. Beyond preprocessing, GlucoTune provides a unified interface for implementing, training, and evaluating blood glucose prediction models. The framework integrates public datasets through standardized wrappers and provides a curated collection of state-of-the-art blood glucose prediction and general time-series forecasting methods, while remaining readily extensible to additional datasets, preprocessing strategies, and forecasting models. To promote transparent and consistent evaluation, GlucoTune includes a benchmarking leaderboard that reports results across datasets, preprocessing configurations, and forecasting methods, enabling systematic comparison of experimental settings. We demonstrate the effectiveness of GlucoTune through comprehensive experiments and assess its usability in a user study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GlucoTune是一个用于血糖时间序列数据标准化预处理、预测和基准测试的综合性框架。它通过YAML配置文件实现可复现的预处理流程，提供统一的模型训练和评估接口，并集成公开数据集和多种预测方法，旨在提高糖尿病管理研究的可复现性和公平比较。实验和用户研究验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 血糖时间序列数据预处理缺乏标准化，导致研究结果难以复现和公平比较；同时隐私和数据共享限制阻碍了预处理数据的重新分发。
Method: 开发一个可扩展的框架，包含可配置的预处理管道（YAML定义）、统一的预测模型接口、标准化的数据集封装以及基准排行榜，支持从原始数据到模型评估的完整工作流。
Result: 通过综合实验和用户研究，展示了GlucoTune在标准化预处理和预测基准测试方面的有效性。
Conclusion: GlucoTune通过标准化流程和可复现配置，为血糖预测研究提供了统一的实验平台，有助于提升该领域的可复现性和比较公平性。

papers.title: TOUR: A Trajectory-Level Unlearning Benchmark for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents are trained on fixed behavioral trajectories, which makes trajectory-level deletion important when selected data must be removed after training. Evaluating such deletion is difficult because a lower membership score can reflect trajectory removal, residual memorization visible to another attack, or policy collapse that destroys useful behavior. We introduce Trajectory-level memOrization and Unlearning in offline RL (TOUR), a benchmark that combines trajectory-level partitioning, matched non-member controls, retraining references, retained-performance anchors, and multi-attack privacy auditing. Across D4RL locomotion experiments and an exploratory AntMaze extension, TOUR shows that common deletion baselines have environment-dependent privacy-utility behavior. Retraining and fine-tuning often provide stronger retained-utility references than uniform GA+Refit, while TrajDeleter remains a useful comparator but is not uniformly stronger under the same audit. Reference-model, threshold, deviation, equivalence, action-error, representation-based, and query-limited attacks further show that a single likelihood-based membership score can overstate deletion quality. In the evaluated settings, conclusions about offline RL unlearning are therefore not stable under single-score auditing. They depend on matched non-member construction, retraining-relative calibration, attack family, retained utility, and explicit scope for diagnostic architecture or component-level evidence.

papers.title: AttriMem: Attribution-Guided Process Feedback for Agent Memory Learning
papers.abstract_en: Effective memory is crucial for LLM agents, yet constructing it effectively remains challenging. A memory-construction policy decides what information to extract, store, update, compress, or discard as interactions accumulate. Heuristic memory methods rely on subjective, task-specific rules, which can misalign with downstream objectives and limit cross-task adaptability. RL-based methods, by contrast, learn from task feedback but mainly use outcome- or module-level rewards. These coarse signals indicate task success but cannot identify which intermediate memory contents support the final answer, creating a fine-grained credit-assignment bottleneck. However, constructing such process feedback is prohibitively difficult because intermediate memory decisions lack unique ground-truth targets, while the appropriate credit varies with the agent's uncertain reasoning trajectory and therefore cannot be specified in advance. We propose AttriMem, an attribution-guided process-feedback framework for learning memory-construction policies with RL. AttriMem augments the global outcome reward with local rewards derived from token-level contributions to the final answer. Experiments on long-horizon dialogue question answering show that AttriMem outperforms retrieval-based, heuristic, and RL-based baselines, generalizes across benchmarks and answer models, stabilizes RL optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AttriMem，一种基于归因引导的过程反馈框架，用于使用强化学习学习智能体记忆构建策略。该方法通过从token级贡献中导出的局部奖励增强全局结果奖励。在长程对话问答实验上，AttriMem优于基于检索、启发式和强化学习的基线方法，并能跨基准和答案模型泛化，稳定强化学习优化。
Motivation: 现有记忆构建策略要么依赖主观任务特定规则（启发式方法），难以跨任务适应；要么使用结果或模块级奖励，无法识别中间记忆内容对最终答案的贡献，存在细粒度信用分配瓶颈。构建过程反馈因缺乏真实目标而困难。
Method: AttriMem通过归因引导的过程反馈框架，利用token级贡献导出局部奖励，增强全局结果奖励，用于强化学习训练记忆构建策略。
Result: 在长程对话问答任务上，AttriMem在性能上优于检索式、启发式和强化学习基线，并展现出跨基准和答案模型的泛化能力，同时稳定强化学习优化。
Conclusion: 归因引导的过程反馈可以有效解决智能体记忆学习中的信用分配问题，提升记忆构建策略的性能和泛化性。

papers.title: HalluScope: Fine-grained Hallucination Diagnosis for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Although Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved strong performance across a wide range of vision-language tasks, they still suffer from hallucinations, where model outputs become inconsistent with the visual content, textual context, or commonsense knowledge. Existing studies primarily address this problem through coarse-grained detection. However, these approaches often provide insufficient diagnostic information for understanding hallucination types and supporting downstream hallucination mitigation. To bridge this gap, we propose fine-grained hallucination diagnosis for MLLMs, a new unified task that jointly performs hallucination detection, classification, and interpretable explanation generation. We develop an automated data generation pipeline and construct HalluScope-30K, a large-scale diagnostic dataset covering eight sources and five task categories. Based on this dataset, we design a multi-granular joint reward function and train two diagnosis models, HalluScope-4B and HalluScope-8B, which achieve state-of-the-art performance on both the MHALO benchmark and our fine-grained hallucination classification benchmark. Notably, detection and classification are mutually beneficial under joint optimization. Furthermore, diagnosis-driven feedback experiments show that the fine-grained diagnostic explanations produced by our model effectively guide target models to correct their hallucinations, with full diagnosis substantially outperforming all baselines on both Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and LLaVA-1.5-7B.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). This is not the camera-ready version. 18 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出细粒度幻觉诊断任务，同时进行幻觉检测、分类和可解释性解释生成，构建了HalluScope-30K数据集，训练了HalluScope-4B和HalluScope-8B模型，在MHALO基准和细粒度分类基准上达到最优性能，且诊断反馈能有效引导目标模型纠正幻觉。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型存在幻觉问题，但现有研究主要做粗粒度检测，缺乏对幻觉类型的细粒度诊断信息，难以支持下游幻觉缓解。
Method: 提出自动数据生成流水线并构建HalluScope-30K数据集，覆盖8种来源和5种任务类别；设计多粒度联合奖励函数，训练两个诊断模型（4B和8B参数）。
Result: 在MHALO基准和细粒度幻觉分类基准上达到最优性能；检测与分类在联合优化下相互促进；诊断反馈实验表明，细粒度解释能有效指导Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct和LLaVA-1.5-7B纠正幻觉，完整诊断显著优于所有基线。
Conclusion: 细粒度幻觉诊断有助于理解和缓解多模态大语言模型中的幻觉，诊断驱动的反馈可有效改善目标模型输出。

papers.title: Can Generative Recommendation Reach Cold Items? A Temporal Perspective on Semantic-ID Generation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation represents items as sequences of shared semantic tokens, enabling token recombination beyond isolated item IDs. However, closed-world recombination does not necessarily imply temporal open-token cold-start induction, where new items enter the item catalog with unseen atomic tokens or weakly supported SID paths. In this work, we revisit SID-based generative recommendation under an absolute-time temporal protocol that separates seen and unseen targets and diagnoses the cold item reachability at the token level. Through seen/unseen-hit analysis, coldness taxonomy, and oracle-prefix probing, we show that current SID-based models can occasionally reach future items supported by observed tokens and prefixes, but struggle with unseen atomic tokens and unsupported SID paths. We further explain this boundary by interpreting SID generation as hierarchical semantic bucketing: early tokens select coarse semantic regions, while later tokens refine item-specific paths. These findings show that SID generation is compositional but not fully open-ended, and suggest future directions in more independent SID spaces, scoring-based interfaces, and dynamic textual context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从时间视角研究基于语义ID（SID）的生成推荐是否能够覆盖冷启动项目。通过在绝对时间协议下进行实验，发现当前SID模型可以偶尔接触到由已观察标记和前缀支持的未来项目，但在处理未见过原子标记和不支持的SID路径时表现困难。作者将SID生成解释为层次语义分桶，并指出其具有组合性但非完全开放，暗示了未来方向。
Motivation: 现有基于SID的生成推荐虽然通过共享语义标记实现重组，但能否真正覆盖冷启动项目（尤其是包含未见原子标记的项目）尚不清楚。本文旨在从时间角度诊断这一能力边界。
Method: 采用绝对时间协议将项目分为已见和未见，通过seen/unseen-hit分析、冷启动分类和oracle-prefix探测来评估模型在标记层级上的冷启动可达性。
Result: 实验表明，当前SID模型能够偶尔达到由已观测标记和前缀支持的未来项目，但对于未见原子标记和不支持的SID路径，模型效果较差。
Conclusion: SID生成具有组合性但并非完全开放，未来需要更独立的SID空间、基于分数的接口和动态文本上下文。
