papers.title: Machine Learning for Charge State Characterization of Isolated Double Quantum Dots
papers.abstract_en: Scaling semiconductor quantum dot arrays toward fault-tolerant quantum computing requires efficient tuneup of spin qubits, a process that depends on the analysis of charge stability maps (CSMs) and remains largely manual. While machine learning has been widely applied to CSM analysis in reservoir-coupled devices, automated tuning in the increasingly important isolated-mode regime has received limited attention. In isolated-mode CSMs, charge transitions appear as near-vertical lines, making them well suited to compact, task-specific models. We present two convolutional neural networks with fewer than one million parameters, trained on CSMs collected from 32 silicon metal-oxide-semiconductor (SiMOS) double-quantum-dot devices measured at approximately 1 K using an automated cryogenic probing system. Sixteen devices were used for training and sixteen were held out to evaluate cross-device generalization against hand-labeled ground truth. CSMClassifier identifies charge instability and sensor artifacts, achieving 94% macro-averaged accuracy across three quality classes on 2,407 held-out images. ChargeLineNet localizes charge-transition lines and determines electron occupancy, achieving 95.3% exact line-count accuracy on 1,131 held-out images. Combined into a single pipeline, the models correctly determine electron occupancy for 93.8% of clean held-out images. Pre-training on synthetic images substantially improves label efficiency. Fine-tuning the pre-trained model on limited experimental data maintains over 90% accuracy, whereas training from scratch degrades significantly under the same conditions. Together, the two models occupy only 6.5 MB and process images in less than 60 ms on standard laboratory hardware, demonstrating a practical path toward scalable, automated characterization and tuneup of quantum-dot devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对孤立半导体双量子点器件中电荷稳定性图（CSM）的自动分析，提出了两个轻量卷积神经网络（参数<100万）。CSMClassifier用于识别电荷不稳定性和传感器伪影，在2407张图像上达到94%宏平均准确率；ChargeLineNet用于定位电荷线并确定电子占据数，在1131张图像上达到95.3%精确线计数准确率。组合流水线对干净图像的正确电子占据数判定率为93.8%。模型仅占6.5 MB，在标准硬件上处理时间<60 ms。
Motivation: 半导体量子点阵列向容错量子计算扩展需要高效的量子比特调谐，而电荷稳定性图分析仍依赖人工。现有机器学习方法多针对储库耦合器件，孤立模式（isulated mode）下的自动调谐研究不足。
Method: 提出两个卷积神经网络：CSMClassifier（三分类）和ChargeLineNet（回归电荷线位置）。采用在32个SiMOS双量子点器件（~1K测量）收集的CSM数据训练，16个器件训练，16个器件测试跨器件泛化能力。预训练使用合成图像，然后微调。
Result: CSMClassifier在2407张图像上达到94%宏平均准确率；ChargeLineNet在1131张图像上达到95.3%精确线计数准确率。组合流水线对1131张干净图像正确确定电子占据数93.8%。预训练+微调在少量实验数据上保持>90%准确率，而从头训练则显著下降。
Conclusion: 本文证明轻量级CNN可以在孤立模式双量子点CSM分析中实现高精度自动调谐，模型体积小、速度快，为大规模量子点器件自动化表征提供了实用方案。

papers.title: ViSTR-Bench: Can MLLMs Reason from Continuous Visual Cues in Dynamic Scenes?
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse expert-level tasks, but they still struggle with fundamental abilities that humans naturally develop through continuous observation of the real world, such as spatial perception and dynamic reasoning. Recent studies have recognized this gap and introduced dedicated benchmarks to evaluate the spatial-temporal capabilities of MLLMs. However, existing benchmarks mostly focus on static scenes or require exact quantitative predictions, leaving intuitive reasoning from temporal cues largely underexplored. In this paper, we introduce the Visual Spatial-Temporal Reasoning Benchmark (ViSTR-Bench), a novel evaluation suite designed to systematically assess whether MLLMs can perform qualitative reasoning from continuous visual cues in dynamic scenes. Guided by the principles of temporal emphasis, reasoning orientation, and qualitative evaluation, ViSTR-Bench establishes a comprehensive four-dimensional evaluations covering Motion Perception, Spatial Relations, Outcome Prediction, and Physical Dynamics. The benchmark comprises 15 distinct subtasks and 1,340 high-quality video question-answer pairs spanning diverse tabletop, indoor, and outdoor scenarios. Extensive evaluations of a broad spectrum of state-of-the-art proprietary, open-source, and specialized spatial MLLMs reveal that, despite their strong general video understanding capabilities, current models still face substantial bottlenecks in complex spatial-temporal reasoning and remain far below human performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了ViSTR-Bench，一个评估多模态大语言模型在动态场景中基于连续视觉线索进行定性推理的能力的基准。该基准包含15个子任务和1340个视频问答对，覆盖运动感知、空间关系、结果预测和物理动力学四个维度。评估显示当前模型在复杂时空推理上远落后于人类。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在基础时空推理能力上存在不足，现有基准多关注静态场景或要求定量预测，缺乏从时间线索进行直觉推理的评估。
Method: 提出ViSTR-Bench，基于时间强调、推理导向和定性评估原则，构建四维度评估体系，包含15个子任务和1340个高质量视频问答对。
Result: 对多种最新MLLMs的评估表明，尽管它们具备强大的视频理解能力，但在复杂时空推理上存在严重瓶颈，远低于人类表现。
Conclusion: 当前MLLMs在动态场景的连续视觉线索推理方面仍远落后于人类，ViSTR-Bench旨在推动该方向研究。

papers.title: Agentic Designer: Progressive Multi-Agent Collaboration for Structure-Aware Interior Layout Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic interior furniture layouts that strictly adhere to architectural constraints (e.g., walls, doors, and windows) remains a fundamental challenge in automated spatial design. Existing approaches, primarily based on one-shot generation using diffusion models or Large Language Models (LLMs), lack explicit mechanisms for intermediate geometric constraint verification, often resulting in structural collisions and functionally infeasible arrangements under complex room constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Agentic Designer, a progressive, multi-agent framework that formulates structure-aware interior layout generation as an iterative and constraint-verified decision process. By decomposing layout synthesis into modular stages of proposal, verification, and adjustment, the framework coordinates three specialized agents, a Generator, an Evaluator, and a Refiner, through a Progressive Consensus Mechanism. This mechanism enforces stepwise geometric validation and correction before each placement is committed, thereby preventing error accumulation. To facilitate this structure-aware paradigm and standardize evaluation, we establish InStruct, a comprehensive benchmark that integrates a dataset comprising over 18,000 high-quality, parametrically annotated samples with a novel suite of structure-centric metrics. Extensive quantitative evaluations, qualitative analyses, and user studies show that Agentic Designer significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating substantial improvements in strict structural adherence and functional design coherence.

papers.title: Position Bias is Hidden Behind Ceiling Effects: A Permutation Diagnostic for LLM Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Position bias in multiple-choice LLM evaluation is widely cited as a confound in capability comparisons, but published measurements rely on single answer-order shuffles whose results confound the bias signal with content-level noise and sampling stochasticity. I introduce inspect_permute, an open-source extension to the inspect_ai evaluation framework that runs exhaustive answer-order permutations per question and reports the chi-squared / Cramer V signature of position bias with bootstrap confidence intervals. I apply the tool across four vendors (gpt-4o-mini, claude-haiku-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash, grok-3) on five MMLU subjects, 24,000 API calls under temperature-0 generation, with falsifier predictions pre-registered via a public SHA-256 hash before half the data was observed. Position bias turns out to be statistically detectable only within a roughly 60-95% base-accuracy Goldilocks zone. Below it, processing-load dominance swamps subject-specific signal; above it, ceiling effects compress the variance below the chi-squared test resolution. Detectable cells separate into two mechanism types: monotone A-to-D decrease (processing_load, in low-tier models) and non-monotone D-drop (content_ambiguity, in a narrow capability band). Standard MMLU places every frontier-tier model above the detection band, so absence of signal there should be read as not measurable, not unbiased. Together with the ceiling-effect characterisation in arXiv:2606.26185, this work brackets the detectable region of position-bias measurement and makes the field central question askable in a verifiable form. Package, data, preregistration under MIT.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 2 appendices. Code, data, and preregistration verification at https://github.com/TambaClan/inspect_permute. Companion paper: arXiv:2606.26185
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 inspect_permute 工具，通过穷举答案排列顺序检测多选题 LLM 评估中的位置偏差，并使用卡方检验和 Cramer V 统计量。在四个模型和五个 MMLU 科目上，发现位置偏差仅在基础准确率约 60-95% 的区间内可检测，超出此范围因天花板效应或处理负载影响而不可测。标准 MMLU 中前沿模型准确率过高，位置偏差不可测量。
Motivation: 现有位置偏差测量依赖单次答案顺序打乱，无法区分偏差信号与内容噪声和采样随机性，导致测量结果不可靠。
Method: 开发 inspect_permute，在 inspect_ai 框架上扩展，对每道题执行所有答案顺序的排列组合，计算卡方统计量和 Cramer V，并带自助法置信区间。在 gpt-4o-mini、claude-haiku-4-5、gemini-2.5-flash、grok-3 上对 MMLU 五个科目进行 24000 次 API 调用，温度设为 0，并预先注册假说。
Result: 位置偏差仅在基础准确率约 60-95% 的区间内统计上可检测，低于此区间受处理负载主导，高于此区间天花板效应压缩方差。可检测的偏差分为单调 A 到 D 递减（处理负载，低端模型）和非单调 D-drop（内容歧义，狭窄能力带）。标准 MMLU 中前沿模型准确率高于检测带，因此无偏差信号不可解读为无偏差，而是不可测量。
Conclusion: 本文界定了位置偏差测量的可检测区域，指出天花板效应使高准确率模型的位置偏差无法直接测量，并提供可验证的测量框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probabilistic Residual Learning for Online Recommendations
papers.abstract_en: Modern recommender systems are typically based on deep learning (DL) models, where a dense encoder learns representations of users and items. As a result, these systems often suffer from the black-box nature and computational complexity of the underlying models, making it difficult to systematically enhance their recommendation capabilities. To address this problem, we propose Probabilistic Residual Learning (PRL), a causal Bayesian recommendation model that models the residual between ground-truth and base predictions, enabling targeted refinement of existing systems. Specifically, PRL (1) probabilistically groups users for localized residual modeling, (2) models domain-level confounders that influence user and item representations, and (3) aggregates cluster-specific residual predictions over the confounders using do-calculus. Experiments demonstrate that our plug-and-play PRL is compatible with various base deep learning recommender systems, improving their performance while automatically discovering meaningful user clusters.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对深度推荐模型的黑盒性和计算复杂性，提出概率残差学习（PRL），一种因果贝叶斯推荐模型，通过建模真实值与基础预测之间的残差来系统增强现有系统。摘要表明 PRL 是即插即用的，可兼容多种基础深度学习推荐系统，提升性能并自动发现有意义的用户聚类。
Motivation: 深度学习推荐系统存在黑盒性和计算复杂性问题，难以系统性地增强推荐能力。
Method: PRL 采用因果贝叶斯方法，概率性地对用户分组进行局部残差建模，建模影响用户和物品表示的领域级混杂因子，并使用 do-calculus 聚合聚类特定的残差预测。
Result: 实验表明 PRL 即插即用，兼容多种基础推荐系统，提升性能并自动发现有意义的用户聚类。
Conclusion: 本文提出的 PRL 框架为增强现有推荐系统提供了一种灵活的残差建模与因果推断方法。

papers.title: Multilevel Graph Wavelet Compressed Sensing with Scale-Aware Neural Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Scientific machine learning methods such as neural operators and physics-informed neural networks have advanced engineering applications and inverse problems, but their training typically requires large volumes of simulated data. This makes data preparation and model training expensive. We propose Graph Wavelet Compressed Sensing (GWCS), a learning-based framework for offline compression of graph signals by representing them as sparse, interpretable wavelet-domain representations using the spectral graph wavelet transform. The framework combines a nonparametric multilevel importance sampler, which retains high-energy wavelet coefficients within each scale for a given compression ratio, with a scale-aware graph neural network that reconstructs the signal from the sparse coefficients. We evaluate the proposed framework on synthetic approximately band-limited graph signals over random graphs and four PDE simulation datasets over meshes, which include Turbulent Radiative Layer, Viscoelastic Instability, Kolmogorov Flow, and Dynamic Stall. We compare against graph signal sampling methods and graph autoencoder baselines. Results demonstrate that the framework achieves high reconstruction fidelity and substantial data compression compared to existing benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Graph Wavelet Compressed Sensing (GWCS)，一种基于学习的图信号离线压缩框架。它利用谱图小波变换将图信号表示为稀疏、可解释的小波域表示，结合非参数多级重要性采样（保留各尺度高能小波系数）和尺度感知图神经网络（从稀疏系数重建信号）。在合成图信号及四个PDE仿真数据集（Turbulent Radiative Layer、Viscoelastic Instability、Kolmogorov Flow、Dynamic Stall）上，与图信号采样和图自编码器基线相比，GWCS实现了高重建保真度和显著数据压缩。
Motivation: 科学机器学习方法（如神经算子、物理信息神经网络）通常需要大量模拟数据进行训练，导致数据准备和模型训练成本高昂。现有图信号压缩方法在保真度和压缩比方面仍有不足。
Method: 提出GWCS框架，包含两个组件：1）非参数多级重要性采样器，在给定压缩比下保留每个尺度的高能小波系数；2）尺度感知图神经网络，从稀疏系数中重建原始图信号。使用谱图小波变换进行域变换。
Result: 在合成图信号和四个PDE仿真数据集上的实验表明，与图信号采样和图自编码器基线相比，GWCS在保持高重建保真度的同时实现了显著的数据压缩。
Conclusion: GWCS提供了一种有效的图信号离线压缩方法，在科学计算应用中可减少数据存储和传输成本，但当前评估限于合成和PDE网格数据，对更复杂图信号（如降水网络）的适用性有待验证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Code Monitor Red Teaming for Public-Test-Passing Code
papers.abstract_en: Visible tests are a common gate for LLM-generated code, but passing them does not certify specification correctness. We study a deployment-like monitoring problem: after code has passed public tests, can a weaker LLM verifier identify the residual hidden bugs? We introduce Code Monitor Red Teaming, a monitor-red-teaming protocol that fixes a public-check information boundary while varying generator pressure, verifier scaffolding, and weak-to-strong capability. We instantiate it as CodeMonitorBench, spanning function-level, data-science, and workflow code. Across 71,000 generated candidates, 43,677 pass public tests and 23,081 of those fail hidden tests. Weak verifiers improve with scaffolding and model family, but still miss most hidden bugs at 5% false-positive rate. As a robustness stress test, adversarial public-test-overfit pressure lowers verifier AUROC and raises low-FPR miss rates in most cells. A GLM-5.1 verifier recovers part of the gap under the same evidence boundary; an inferability audit shows that remaining misses mix verifier failures with M1 evidence limits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM生成代码通过公共测试后，弱验证器识别隐藏bug的能力。提出Code Monitor Red Teaming协议和CodeMonitorBench基准，涵盖函数级、数据科学和工作流代码。在71000个候选代码中，43677通过公共测试，其中23081未通过隐藏测试。弱验证器在5%假阳性率下漏检大部分隐藏bug，且对抗性过拟合压力进一步降低性能。
Motivation: 可见测试通过不能保证代码规范正确，需要研究部署场景下验证器能否发现残留隐藏bug，以提升代码可靠性。
Method: 提出Code Monitor Red Teaming协议，固定公共测试信息边界，变化生成器压力、验证器脚手架和模型规模；实例化为CodeMonitorBench基准，包含函数级、数据科学和工作流代码类型。
Result: 在71000个候选代码中，43677通过公共测试，其中23081未通过隐藏测试。弱验证器在5%假阳性率下漏检大部分隐藏bug；对抗性过拟合压力降低验证器AUROC并提高低FPR漏检率。GLM-5.1验证器在同一证据边界下部分恢复性能差距。
Conclusion: 弱验证器在固定信息边界下性能有限，剩余漏检混合了验证器失败和M1证据限制，需要在验证器能力和证据边界上进一步改进。

papers.title: Auditing Evidence Use in Medical LLM Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Medical LLMs are often evaluated by whether they select the correct diagnosis, but diagnostic accuracy alone does not show whether the model used the case evidence appropriately. We present a behavioral audit of evidence use in medical diagnosis. For each case, we decompose patient information into evidence units, score candidate diagnoses under controlled evidence subsets, and mine low-order interactions in diagnostic margins. Because medical evidence is diagnosis-relative, the audit separates interaction discovery from failure assignment: large or negative interactions can reflect plausible differential diagnosis, while suspicious interactions require robustness checks and clinical review. We evaluate five open-weight LLMs on DDXPlus, CupCase, and MedCase. Across datasets, faithful support and differential conflict or cancellation account for most interaction strength, showing that many evidence interactions are clinically plausible rather than failures. In a DDXPlus-focused blinded five-reviewer 130-item enriched review sample, invalid or shortcut-like cases concentrate in negated or absent findings and clinically local evidence. These results show that accuracy can hide candidate evidence-use failures and motivate role-aware audits for medical LLM evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种行为审计方法，用于评估医学LLM在诊断中是否正确使用病例证据。通过将患者信息分解为证据单元，在受控证据子集下评分候选诊断，并挖掘诊断边界中的低阶交互作用。在DDXPlus、CupCase和MedCase上评估五个开源LLM，发现大多数证据交互作用在临床上是合理的，而非失败。准确率可能掩盖证据使用缺陷，应引入角色感知审计。
Motivation: 现有评估仅关注诊断准确性，无法判断模型是否恰当使用病例证据，缺乏对证据使用过程的审计。
Method: 将患者信息分解为证据单元，针对不同证据子集评分候选诊断，通过低阶交互作用分析诊断边界，并结合临床审查区分合理鉴别诊断与可疑交互。
Result: 在三个医学诊断数据集上，忠实支持和鉴别冲突或取消解释了大部分交互强度，表明交互作用多为临床合理。在DDXPlus的130个案例盲审中，无效或捷径式案例集中于否定或缺失发现和局部临床证据。

papers.title: Offline RL with Hierarchical Action Chunking
papers.abstract_en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (RL) holds the promise of learning general-purpose policies from static datasets. However, scaling these methods to long-horizon tasks remains a challenge due to the curse of horizon, where value estimation errors can compound through long chains of bootstrapped Bellman backups. Existing hierarchical approaches mitigate this by decomposing tasks into subgoals, yet they often rely on low-level controllers that suffer from myopic execution and biased value estimates. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Implicit Q-Chunking (HiQC), an offline goal-conditioned RL algorithm that combines high-level latent planning with low-level action chunking. By conditioning the low-level critic on temporally extended action sequences, HiQC enables unbiased k-step value backups, compressing the horizon at both the planning and execution levels. We theoretically demonstrate that this dual decomposition results in a tighter bound on value error under a bounded per-backup error model compared to standard hierarchy or flat chunking alone. Empirically, HiQC achieves the highest aggregate performance among the compared methods on the OGBench suite, with its largest gains on long-horizon navigation tasks such as humanoid-giant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hierarchical Implicit Q-Chunking (HiQC)，一种离线目标条件强化学习算法，通过高层潜在规划与低层动作分块结合，实现无偏的 k 步值备份，从而缓解长时域任务中的值估计误差累积问题。理论分析表明双重分解比单独使用层次结构或平面分块更紧的误差界；在 OGBench 套件上，HiQC 取得最高聚合性能，尤其在长时域导航任务上提升显著。
Motivation: 离线目标条件 RL 在长时域任务中面临值估计误差随贝尔曼备份链传播的维度灾难问题，现有层次方法依赖的低级控制器存在短视执行和有偏值估计。
Method: 提出 HiQC，将高层潜在规划与低层动作分块结合，使低层评论家依赖时间扩展的动作序列，从而实现无偏 k 步值备份，在规划与执行层面双重压缩时域。
Result: 在 OGBench 基准套件上，HiQC 取得最高聚合性能，尤其在 humanoid-giant 等长时域导航任务中增益最大。
Conclusion: 理论证明双重分解在 bounded per-backup error 模型下给出比标准层次结构或平面分块更紧的值误差界。

papers.title: Beyond Heavy Log Curation: Perplexity-Based APT Detection via Unsupervised, Context-Augmented Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) remain difficult to detect because only a small fraction of events in large-scale logs are attack-related, and investigation is expensive and hard to scale. Prior machine-learning approaches can reduce analyst workload, but they often rely on heavily curated training data and sophisticated preprocessing pipelines. Building and maintaining such pipelines require substantial domain expertise and engineering cost. Motivated by insights from a study of a strong APT detection baseline, we propose CAPTAIN (Context-Augmented Perplexity-based Threat Activity log detectIoN), a perplexity-based detector that leverages general, pre-trained language models with minimal, domain-agnostic preprocessing, enabling robust scoring of long, minimally processed log entries. CAPTAIN encodes recent history with an encoder model and a Q-Former-style bridge, then injects the compact context tokens into the decoder input so that perplexity reflects temporal context. To improve stability, CAPTAIN additionally applies smoothing filters to the perplexity time series. Across APT-oriented benchmarks, CAPTAIN competes with strong existing baselines and remains robust under substantially less curated inputs, that reduces the development and operational cost of advanced log preprocessing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAPTAIN，一种基于困惑度（perplexity）的APT检测方法，利用预训练语言模型和最小预处理对长日志条目进行评分，减少对人工日志清洗的依赖。
Motivation: 现有APT检测依赖大量人工标注和复杂预处理，成本高且难以扩展，需要更轻量的自动化方法。
Method: CAPTAIN使用编码器模型和Q-Former桥接结构编码日志历史，将上下文令牌注入解码器输入，通过困惑度反映时序上下文，并应用平滑滤波提高稳定性。
Result: 在APT基准测试中，CAPTAIN与强基线方法性能相当，且对低质量输入鲁棒，降低了日志预处理成本。
Conclusion: CAPTAIN通过最小预处理和通用语言模型实现了有效的APT检测，减少了工程开销。

papers.title: Auditing Provenance Sensitivity in LLM Agent Action Selection
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents choose tools and arguments from context that mixes user requests, tool outputs, retrieved records, memory, and untrusted text. Evidence can be relevant without being authorized to determine a decision, so a correct action need not be grounded only in permitted evidence. We introduce a target-specific authorization audit that labels context factors separately for each tool and argument target. Its primary test holds the task, proposition, position, and policy fixed while changing only the proposition's source authority. We then test behavior when valid evidence is weakened and use context-subset interactions as a secondary localization diagnostic. Across 450 controlled next-action tasks and multiple open-weight LLM families, trusted and untrusted variants produce different actions in 5.4 percent of competing cases versus 1.7 percent of supporting cases. Under controlled degradation, unauthorized competition is retained in a full-correct, mixed-error, clean-correct pattern in 2.4 percent of comparisons, with a 95 percent confidence interval from 2.1 to 3.0 percent. These are controlled stress-set rates, not deployment prevalence. The models respond to textual source-authority cues, but this does not prevent untrusted evidence from influencing their actions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对LLM agent行动选择中来源敏感性的审计方法，通过分离上下文因素并测试不同来源权限下的行动变化，发现未受信证据在5.4%的竞争情况下影响行动，但模型仍会响应文本来源权威线索。
Motivation: LLM agent选择工具和参数时混合了用户请求、工具输出、检索记录、记忆和未受信文本，正确行动不一定只基于允许的证据，需要审计模型是否不当使用未授权证据。
Method: 引入目标特定授权审计，为每个工具和参数目标单独标记上下文因素，通过固定任务、命题、位置和策略，仅改变命题的源权限来测试行动变化，并使用上下文子集交互作为次级定位诊断。
Result: 在450个控制下一行动任务和多个开源LLM家族中，受信与未受信变体在不同行动中占比5.4%（竞争情况）和1.7%（支持情况）；在受控退化下，未授权竞争以完全正确-混合错误-干净正确的模式出现，比例为2.4%（95%置信区间2.1%-3.0%）。
Conclusion: 模型响应文本来源权威线索，但这并不能阻止未受信证据影响其行动，需进一步研究可控性。

papers.title: Robust Asynchronous Q-Learning under Reward and State Corruption via Batching
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by reinforcement learning in harsh environments, we consider the problem of learning an optimal policy subject to adversarially corrupted feedback. Specifically, at each time-step, an adversary can perturb both the reward and state observations of the learner following the Huber contamination model. To defend against such data corruption, we propose {\texttt{BR-Async-Q}}: a novel, epoch-based, robust \(Q\)-learning algorithm built upon two key ideas: (i) partitioning the online data stream into batches to reduce variance, and (ii) constructing robust estimates of the Bellman optimality operator using such batched data. We prove a high-probability $\ell_\infty$ error bound for {\texttt{BR-Async-Q}} that matches that for vanilla \(Q\)-learning, up to a small additive term that scales with the fraction of corrupted samples. To our knowledge, this provides the first robustness guarantee for asynchronous \(Q\)-learning subject to both reward and state corruption. Furthermore, when only rewards are corrupted, the dependence of our algorithm's bound on the corruption fraction is minimax optimal.
papers.comment: To appear at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习在恶劣环境中受到对抗性反馈扰动的场景，提出了一种基于批处理的鲁棒异步Q-learning算法BR-Async-Q。该算法通过将在线数据流划分为批次以降低方差，并利用批次数据构造鲁棒的Bellman最优性算子估计，在奖励和状态观测均可能被污染（Huber污染模型）的情况下，实现了与标准异步Q-learning相当的ℓ∞误差界，仅多出一个与污染样本比例相关的附加项。这是首个针对奖励和状态双重污染的异步Q-learning鲁棒性保证。当仅奖励被污染时，算法界的污染比例依赖性是极小极大最优的。
Motivation: 现实环境的强化学习常面临对抗性数据污染（如奖励和状态观测被扰动），现有Q-learning方法缺乏在此类双重污染下的鲁棒性保证。
Method: 提出BR-Async-Q算法，核心思想：(i) 将在线数据流分批以降低方差，(ii) 利用批次数据构造鲁棒的Bellman最优性算子估计。
Result: 证明算法的高概率ℓ∞误差界与标准异步Q-learning匹配，仅附加一个与污染样本比例相关的项；当仅奖励被污染时，界对污染比例的依赖是极小极大最优的。
Conclusion: 这是首个同时针对奖励和状态污染的异步Q-learning鲁棒性分析，算法在理论上保证了对抗性污染下的学习性能。

papers.title: Efficient and Interpretable Body-Based Emotion Recognition with Lightweight Temporal Convolutional Networks
papers.abstract_en: Body-based emotion recognition is important for real-time affective systems, but graph-based skeleton models can be computationally expensive. This paper studies whether lightweight temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) can provide an efficient and interpretable alternative for body-based emotion classification. We evaluate a family of TCN models on DIEM-A and compare them with a graph-based time-series graph (G-TSG) baseline using accuracy, macro-F1, parameter count, and inference latency. Although G-TSG achieves the highest mean performance, TCN-Base remains within $1.58$ accuracy points and $1.25$ macro-F1 points while using $79.18\%$ fewer parameters and reducing classifier latency by approximately $12.5\times$. We also analyze body-region contributions using region-specific TCN models, zero-based occlusion, and G-TSG gradient saliency. The results show that upper-body motion provides the strongest standalone regional cue, that the usefulness of body regions varies across emotions, and that different interpretability methods capture distinct aspects of model behavior. These findings suggest that lightweight TCNs can support efficient body-based emotion recognition while also providing practical insight into how motion cues contribute to classification.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 14th International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究轻量级时间卷积网络（TCN）用于基于身体姿态的情感识别。在DIEM-A数据集上，与图模型（G-TSG）相比，TCN-Base在精度仅差1.58个点的情况下，参数量减少79.18%，推理延迟降低约12.5倍。此外，通过区域贡献分析发现上半身运动是最强的独立线索，且不同情绪依赖不同的身体区域。
Motivation: 基于图模型的骨架情感识别计算开销大，不适合实时系统；需要一种高效且可解释的替代方案。
Method: 构建多组TCN模型（如TCN-Base）与图模型G-TSG对比，评估准确率、宏F1、参数量和推理延迟；并使用区域掩码、零化遮挡和梯度显著性分析身体区域贡献。
Result: G-TSG平均性能最高，但TCN-Base精度差距在1.58个点以内，参数量减少79.18%，延迟降低12.5倍；上半身运动是最强区域线索，不同情绪对区域依赖不同，不同解释方法捕获的模型行为侧重不同。
Conclusion: 轻量级TCN能在保证较高精度的同时大幅降低计算开销，并提供实用的运动线索解释，适用于实时情感识别系统。

papers.title: Explainable graph attention network for stress recognition (StressGAT) via differential action units
papers.abstract_en: Stress is a dynamic process characterized by significant individual variability in facial expression. Traditional architectures, such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), often overlook person-specific baselines or lack the representational capacity to model the non-linear temporal progression of distress due to sequential bottlenecks and rigid grid-based constraints. Furthermore, many deep learning models lack the interpretability required for clinical deployment. This study introduces StressGAT, a Graph Attention Network that leverages the relational inductive bias of graph modeling to capture complex facial dynamics that indicate acute stress. By using Differential Action Units, the framework normalizes individual responses relative to neutral baselines to achieve personalized recognition. The proposed model achieves 88.62\% accuracy on a diverse stress-induction cohort (58 participants) using a subject-independent, Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) cross-validation protocol. Beyond predictive accuracy, the architecture integrates a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) attention mechanism to identify peak stress intervals and reveal distinct expressivity phenotypes. By simultaneously optimizing for accuracy and interpretability, this framework provides a robust, explainable solution for personalized affective monitoring.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StressGAT，一种基于图注意力网络（Graph Attention Network）的压力识别框架，利用差分动作单元（Differential Action Units）相对于中性基线归一化个体反应，实现个性化压力识别。在58名受试者的压力诱导数据集上，采用留一法交叉验证达到88.62%的准确率。模型还集成了多实例学习（MIL）注意力机制，用于识别峰值压力区间和不同的表达表型。
Motivation: 现有方法（如RNN、CNN）忽略个体基线差异或缺乏建模非线性时间动态的能力，且缺乏可解释性，限制了临床部署。
Method: 使用图注意力网络建模面部动作单元之间的空间关系，通过差分动作单元实现个体基线归一化，结合多实例学习注意力机制识别关键压力区间。
Result: 在58名受试者的数据集上，使用留一法交叉验证达到88.62%的准确率。
Conclusion: 模型在保持高准确率的同时提供了可解释性，适用于个性化情感监测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Balancing Sequential Sampling: Fast Convergence with Controlled Predictability
papers.abstract_en: Many instances of sequential sampling, including audit and inspection scheduling, representative sampling, and treatment assignment, require selections to be distributed evenly without becoming easy to anticipate or exploit. We study a family of sequential sampling rules that adaptively bias sampling probabilities in order to achieve faster convergence of the empirical distribution to a desired target law, while keeping the resulting samples as unpredictable as possible. The resulting self-balancing sampler is simple to implement, arises naturally among a class of Markovian samplers sharing a certain invariance property, and admits a stochastic mirror-descent interpretation. Our main results show that (i) this self-balancing sampler converges at the fastest possible $O(n^{-1})$ rate with explicit dependence on biasing parameters, beating the standard $O(n^{-1/2})$ rate of IID sampling, (ii) it is the unique solution to a natural entropy-regularized optimization problem which balances the convergence rate of the empirical law and the unpredictability of the samples, and (iii) in the weak-biasing regime, the properly centered counts process converges to an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process in the diffusive limit. Together, these results support a practical framework for reducing repeated selections and long gaps in coverage without making future selections overly predictable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一类自适应有偏序列采样规则，旨在使经验分布快速收敛到目标分布的同时保持样本的不可预测性。理论证明该自平衡采样器以最快O(n^{-1})速率收敛（依赖偏置参数），优于IID采样的O(n^{-1/2})，并且是熵正则化优化问题的唯一解。
Motivation: 在许多顺序采样问题（如审计、检查调度、代表性抽样）中，需要样本分布均匀且难以预测，但传统IID采样收敛速度慢。
Method: 提出自平衡采样器，通过自适应偏置采样概率实现，源于一类具有不变性的马尔可夫采样器，并具有随机镜像下降解释。
Result: 该方法以最快O(n^{-1})速率收敛，显式依赖偏置参数；弱偏置下，计数过程在扩散极限下收敛到Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程。
Conclusion: 该框架能减少重复选择和覆盖空缺，同时避免未来选择过于可预测，为实际应用提供理论支持。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Enhancing Explainable Cardiac Diagnosis with Guide-Grounded Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The electrocardiogram (ECG) is a cornerstone of cardiac as- sessment, yet clinical deployment of deep learning models remains con- strained by limited interpretability and the hallucination risk of large language models (LLMs). Existing CNN+Grad-CAM+multimodal LLM frameworks can generate ECG reports, but their explanations are often only weakly grounded in established diagnostic criteria, reducing trust- worthiness and reproducibility. We propose a guide-grounded multimodal framework that explicitly anchors report generation in curated clinical knowledge. A convolutional neural network (CNN) and Grad-CAM first produce class probabilities and class-specific heatmaps from 12-lead ECG images. In parallel, authoritative ECG textbooks and guideline materials are distilled offline into a structured ECG Interpretation Guide, which is injected as a fixed knowledge block for every sample. Conditioned on the ECG image, Grad-CAM overlay, CNN-derived fact pack, and the in- jected guide, a multimodal LLM generates structured diagnostic reports with guideline-consistent terminology and criteria usage. Experiments on the full PTB-XL test set demonstrate that guide grounding improves se- mantic quality and perceived consistency of generated reports while pre- serving competitive classification performance. In particular, our method increases the average BERTScore of generated impressions from 0.818 to 0.953 relative to a strong CNN+Grad-CAM+MLLM baseline, indicat- ing closer alignment with reference reports. These findings suggest that injecting a distilled interpretation guide into the multimodal prompting pipeline offers a practical pathway to reduce hallucinations and enhance the clinical plausibility of LLM-based ECG explanations, bringing ex- plainable cardiac diagnosis closer to real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于指南引导的多模态大模型框架，用于增强心电诊断的可解释性。通过将心电图图像、Grad-CAM热图、CNN生成的事实包以及离线蒸馏的结构化心电解释指南注入多模态LLM，生成符合指南术语的结构化诊断报告。在PTB-XL数据集上，该方法将生成印象的BERTScore从0.818提升至0.953，表明与参考报告的语义对齐度显著提高。
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型在心电诊断中可解释性不足，多模态LLM易产生幻觉，且解释缺乏与既定诊断标准的强关联。
Method: 提出指南引导的多模态框架：CNN+Grad-CAM提取心电特征和热图，离线蒸馏权威教科书和指南为结构化解释指南，作为固定知识块注入，多模态LLM基于图像、热图、事实包和指南生成结构化报告。
Result: 在PTB-XL完整测试集上，与强基线相比，生成印象的平均BERTScore从0.818提升至0.953，同时保持竞争性分类性能。
Conclusion: 将蒸馏的解释指南注入多模态提示管道可减少幻觉，增强基于LLM的心电解释的临床可信度，推动可解释心电诊断向实际部署迈进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SubSplat: High-Resolution Pixel-aligned 3DGS via Sub-pixel Gaussian Reparameterization
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-aligned Gaussian splatting enables efficient and generalizable novel-view synthesis. However, high-resolution rendering faces a critical trade-off where increasing input resolution improves detail at the expense of quadratically rising network computational cost. Conversely, maintaining low-resolution inputs stabilizes this cost but results in insufficient Gaussian density and artifacts. To address this, we propose SubSplat, which introduces Sub-pixel Gaussian Reparameterizer(SPGR) to subdivide primary Gaussians into fine-grained primitives, restoring structural density directly from low-resolution features. We further enhance the reparameterization quality through feature aggregation, which effectively captures high-frequency details across multiple views. Experiments on RealEstate10K and ACID demonstrate that SubSplat achieves high-fidelity rendering with superior efficiency. Our results validate that the proposed framework successfully resolves the trade-off between reparameterization fidelity and network computational cost inherent in pixel-aligned Gaussian Splatting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SubSplat，通过子像素高斯重参数化器（SPGR）从低分辨率特征中细分原始高斯粒子，恢复结构密度，实现高分辨率像素对齐的3D高斯泼溅渲染，在RealEstate10K和ACID数据集上验证了高效高保真渲染。
Motivation: 像素对齐的高斯泼溅在高分辨率渲染时面临权衡：提高输入分辨率会显著增加网络计算成本，而低分辨率输入则导致高斯密度不足和伪影。
Method: 引入子像素高斯重参数化器（SPGR），将主高斯粒子细分为更精细的基元，并结合跨视图特征聚合以捕捉高频细节。
Result: 在RealEstate10K和ACID数据集上实现高保真渲染，且效率优于现有方法，解决了重参数化保真度与网络计算成本之间的权衡。
Conclusion: SubSplat能够从低分辨率特征恢复结构密度，实现高效高分辨率像素对齐渲染，验证了该框架的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: New Complexity-Theoretic Frontiers of Tractability for Neural Network Training
papers.abstract_en: In spite of the fundamental role of neural networks in contemporary machine learning research, our understanding of the computational complexity of optimally training neural networks remains incomplete even when dealing with the simplest kinds of activation functions. Indeed, while there has been a number of very recent results that establish ever-tighter lower bounds for the problem under linear and ReLU activation functions, less progress has been made towards the identification of novel polynomial-time tractable network architectures. In this article we obtain novel algorithmic upper bounds for training linear- and ReLU-activated neural networks to optimality which push the boundaries of tractability for these problems beyond the previous state of the art. In particular, for ReLU networks we establish the polynomial-time tractability of all architectures where hidden neurons have an out-degree of $1$, improving upon the previous algorithm of Arora, Basu, Mianjy and Mukherjee. On the other hand, for networks with linear activation functions we identify the first non-trivial polynomial-time solvable class of networks by obtaining an algorithm that can optimally train network architectures satisfying a novel data throughput condition.
papers.comment: Appeared in the proceedings of NeurIPS 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络最优训练的计算复杂度，针对线性激活和ReLU激活网络提出了新的多项式时间可解架构。对于ReLU网络，证明了所有隐藏神经元出度为1的架构可在多项式时间内训练，改进了先前工作；对于线性激活网络，通过引入数据吞吐量条件，识别了第一个非平凡的多项式时间可解类。
Motivation: 尽管神经网络应用广泛，但最优训练的计算复杂度仍未完全理解，尤其是识别新的多项式时间可解架构方面进展缓慢，而现有下界结果日趋收紧。
Method: 通过算法分析，对ReLU网络限制隐藏神经元出度为1，从而设计多项式时间算法；对线性激活网络，提出数据吞吐量条件并基于此构造训练算法。
Result: 在ReLU网络上，所有隐藏神经元出度为1的架构实现多项式时间可解；在线性网络上，首次识别出满足数据吞吐量条件的非平凡多项式时间可解类。
Conclusion: 这些结果推进了神经网络训练可解性的前沿，但仅适用于特定架构和激活函数，更一般情况的复杂度仍开放。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Profiling Lightweight Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed locally on personal computers and are expected to play a growing role in resource-constrained edge and mobile environments. In such settings, energy consumption, execution time, and memory usage directly affect practical usability, yet existing evaluations of LLM efficiency largely rely on proxy descriptors such as parameter count or FLOPs, often decoupled from task precision. This paper introduces a PTME-based experimental framework for the precision-aware profiling of lightweight LLM inference, jointly measuring Precision, execution Time, peak Memory usage, and Energy consumption through direct hardware-level measurements. The methodology is applied to a representative set of lightweight LLMs executed locally under edge-class resource envelopes on a controlled desktop platform, using benchmarks spanning code generation, mathematical reasoning, and multi-task understanding. We find that static proxy descriptors approximate inference cost well but fail to predict precision. Tightening the resource envelope increases cost without affecting precision, amplifying execution time more strongly than energy and penalizing larger models the most. Moreover, no single model dominates across all PTME dimensions, and a Pareto analysis reveals non-dominated configurations that would be hidden by accuracy-only or efficiency-only assessments, providing practical guidance for selecting models under different resource envelopes. These results show that selecting lightweight LLMs by size, FLOPs, latency, or accuracy alone can select the wrong deployment candidate; PTME profiling exposes configurations that preserve useful accuracy at lower physical cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于PTME（精度、执行时间、峰值内存、能耗）的实验框架，用于对轻量级大语言模型（LLM）进行精度感知的性能分析。通过在边缘资源约束的桌面平台上对一组代表性轻量级LLM进行基准测试（包括代码生成、数学推理和多任务理解），发现静态代理描述符无法预测精度，且资源收紧会加大成本而不影响精度，Pareto分析揭示了单一指标评估可能错过的非支配配置。
Motivation: 现有LLM效率评估多依赖参数数量或FLOPs等代理描述符，且与任务精度脱钩，缺乏同时考虑精度、时间、内存和能耗的联合测量方法。
Method: 提出PTME实验框架，通过直接硬件级测量同时记录精度、执行时间、峰值内存和能耗；在受控桌面平台上模拟边缘资源条件，对多个轻量级LLM进行基准测试。
Result: 静态代理描述符能近似推理成本但无法预测精度；资源收紧显著增加时间成本（比能量更明显）且惩罚较大模型；无单一模型在所有PTME维度上占优；Pareto分析揭示了被单指标评估忽略的非支配配置。
Conclusion: 选择轻量级LLM时仅凭规模、FLOPs、延迟或精度可能选出错误部署候选；PTME性能分析能暴露在较低物理成本下保持有用精度的配置。

papers.title: The Geometry of Personality: Activation Steering with Jungian Cognitive Functions
authors: Joemon M. Jose (1) ((1) University of Glasgow
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering enables control and interpretation of LLMs, yet existing work primarily models personality through static trait frameworks such as the Big Five. We investigate whether personality can instead be represented and controlled as a set of cognitive processes using the eight Jungian Cognitive Functions. To this end, we introduce a framework comprising a Jungian evaluation protocol and a dataset of over 2,100 role-playing character narrations. Activation steering vector extraction and evaluation experiments on Llama-3.1-8B demonstrate effective monotonic control over all eight cognitive functions through activation steering. Beyond controllability, our analysis reveals that: 1. personality information is concentrated in middle transformer layers; 2. steering vectors exhibit structured geometric relationships consistent with distinctions between rational and irrational functions; 3. effective multi-dimensional steering directions cannot be recovered as linear combinations of single-function directions. These findings provide new insights into the representation of personality in LLM activation space and establish a framework for studying interpretable, effective, and multi-dimensional personality control.

papers.title: ERank in Latent Space as an Image-Complexity and Richness Measure
papers.abstract_en: We propose the effective rank (ERank) of the channel covariance of an image's deep feature map as a per-sample, label-free measure of visual richness, computed from a single forward pass through a frozen pretrained encoder. ERank counts how many decorrelated channel directions an image activates, and we characterize its properties, including its behavior under noise. Empirically, ERank orders images from plain to visually rich, correlates with codec bitrate, sharpness, and edge density, and correlates with human complexity annotations on IC9600 with $r = 0.72$. As a data-selection criterion, removing low-ERank samples improves super-resolution and removing high-ERank samples improves OCR, in both pretraining and finetuning, while selection does not help classification, segmentation, or denoising. ERank is thus a cheap richness signal, useful exactly when task difficulty is governed by input richness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出有效秩（ERank），从预训练编码器提取的图像深度特征图通道协方差计算，作为无需标签的视觉丰富度度量。ERank通过单次前向传播计算，能够量化图像激活的去相关通道方向数，并对噪声具有鲁棒性。实验表明ERank与人类复杂度注释相关（r=0.72），并可用作数据选择标准：移除低ERank样本提升超分辨率性能，移除高ERank样本提升OCR性能，但对分类、分割和去噪任务无效。
Motivation: 需要一种廉价、无标签的图像复杂度度量，用于根据输入丰富度指导数据选择，从而提升特定任务的训练效率。
Method: 计算图像深度特征图的通道协方差的有效秩（ERank），该值统计图像激活的近似去相关通道方向个数，仅需单次前向传播通过冻结的预训练编码器。
Result: ERank与IC9600数据集上人类复杂度注释的相关系数为r=0.72；作为数据选择标准，去除低ERank样本可改善超分辨率，去除高ERank样本可改善OCR，且在预训练和微调中均有效；但选择对分类、分割和去噪无帮助。
Conclusion: ERank是一种廉价的丰富度信号，在任务难度受输入丰富度支配时有用，但并非通用有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probabilistic Physics-Aware Machine Learning Predictions of Electric Truck Energy Consumption with Field Data
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we incorporate first principle physics into the construction of data-driven methods by considering a model that accounts for the different sources of energy losses during vehicle operations. Our results show that Bayesian linear regression based on this physics-aware model can improve the reliability of the expected energy consumption, as compared with standard linear regression. Further, it is shown that more complex machine learning models such as neural networks and gradient boosted regression trees, based on the same physical model, can further improve the accuracy in energy forecasting and significantly outperform standard versions of the same machine learning models. In addition to point predictions of the energy consumption, we develop a framework for estimating the corresponding uncertainty in the form of predicted standard deviation. Our results show that all of the models learn to estimate the uncertainty reasonably well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将第一性原理物理模型融入数据驱动方法，用于预测电动卡车的能耗。基于物理感知模型，贝叶斯线性回归提高了能耗期望的可靠性；更复杂的模型如神经网络和梯度提升回归树进一步提升了预测精度，并显著优于标准版本。此外，还开发了以预测标准差形式估计不确定性的框架。
Motivation: 电动卡车能耗预测需要高精度和可靠性，但纯数据驱动方法可能忽略物理规律，导致泛化不足。
Method: 构建考虑能量损失物理来源的模型，并基于该模型分别应用贝叶斯线性回归、神经网络和梯度提升回归树进行点预测与不确定性估计。
Result: 物理感知的贝叶斯线性回归比标准线性回归更可靠；物理感知的神经网络和梯度提升回归树在能量预测精度上显著优于对应的标准模型，且所有模型的不确定性估计较为合理。
Conclusion: 将物理先验融入机器学习可提升电动卡车能耗预测的准确性和不确定量化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Self-Evolving Default Action for Cooperative Tasks with Continuous Action Space
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual credit assignment has proven effective in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for discrete action spaces, yet its extension to continuous-action cooperative tasks remains challenging. Existing methods that approximate the counterfactual baseline via Monte Carlo sampling often introduce bias into policy gradients and fail to guarantee convergence to local optima, as the sampled actions may not have been sufficiently trained. To address these limitations, we propose SAFE, a novel MARL framework that employs a counterfactual baseline conditioned on a self-evolving default action sampled from each agent's experience buffer. This design naturally extends to continuous action spaces without relying on additional simulations, reward models, or environment-specific prior knowledge. The baseline accurately quantifies each agent's contribution, and introduces no bias into the deterministic policy gradient, ensuring convergence to local optima. Extensive experiments on cooperative vehicular tasks demonstrate that SAFE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续动作空间的多智能体协作任务，提出SAFE框架，使用自进化默认动作的条件反事实基线，消除策略梯度偏差并保证收敛到局部最优。在协作驾驶任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有反事实信用分配方法在离散动作空间有效，但扩展到连续动作空间时，蒙特卡洛采样引入偏差且无法保证收敛。
Method: 提出SAFE框架，使用从每个智能体经验缓冲区采样的自进化默认动作作为条件反事实基线，无需额外仿真或模型。
Result: 在协作驾驶任务上，SAFE一致优于现有最先进模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在连续动作空间下无偏差且保证收敛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anticipate Before Acting: Future-State-Conditioned Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end vision-language navigation (VLN) with causal vision-language models maps instructions and egocentric observations directly to actions, but standard behavior cloning supervises only the next action and does not explicitly encourage the policy state to be predictive of future visual outcomes, limiting long-horizon decision making. A privileged-input diagnostic shows that access to an expert-trajectory future image can substantially improve navigation, indicating that future observations contain rich, actionable cues, though such inputs are unavailable at deployment. Motivated by this signal, we propose Future-State-Conditioned VLN (FSC-VLN), a deployable model that augments a causal policy with a future-query token and uses training-only future-state supervision to distill information from future observations into the policy state. Concretely, during training we align the future-query representation to a frozen visual embedding $Δ$ steps ahead, while inference requires only past and current observations. This design preserves the baseline inference pattern and adds only two learned prefix tokens, implying minimal overhead. On R2R val-unseen, FSC-VLN improves SR/OSR/SPL over a StreamVLN-style baseline under two training-data regimes, with larger gains on long-horizon episodes; ablations further support the dual-query design that separates future and action queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 Future-State-Conditioned VLN (FSC-VLN)，通过在训练时利用未来视觉状态监督，使模型在推理时仅依赖历史和当前观测，无需未来图像。在 R2R 数据集上提升了导航成功率（SR）和路径长度加权成功率（SPL），尤其在长序列上增益更大。
Motivation: 现有端到端视觉语言导航模型使用因果视觉语言模型，但标准行为克隆仅监督下一步动作，未明确鼓励策略状态预测未来视觉结果，限制了长程决策能力。通过特权输入诊断发现，未来观测包含丰富可操作线索，但部署时不可用。
Method: 提出 FSC-VLN，在因果策略中加入一个未来查询 token，并在训练时将其表示与未来 Δ 步的冻结视觉嵌入对齐，推理时只需过去和当前观测。仅增加两个可学习的前缀 token，保持基线推理模式。
Result: 在 R2R val-unseen 上，相比 StreamVLN 基线，FSC-VLN 在两种训练数据设置下均提升了 SR/OSR/SPL，在长序列上增益更大。消融实验支持分离未来查询和动作查询的双查询设计。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该方法通过训练时未来状态蒸馏来提升可部署的导航策略，在标准基准上取得改进，尤其有益于长程任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlashPDE: A Drop-In Fused Triton Operator Library for Neural PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) solve PDEs by incorporating physical constraints into neural-network training, but large-scale problems are limited by automatic-differentiation memory overhead and inefficient execution of grid-based PDE operators. We present FlashPDE, a drop-in fused operator library for grid-based scientific machine learning. FlashPDE replaces fragmented PyTorch finite-difference execution with differentiable Triton kernels. Each operator integrates fused stencil evaluation, an analytic discrete-adjoint backward pass, and boundary-gradient correction within a unified PyTorch autograd.Function interface. The library provides 14 differentiable PDE operators covering 17 configurations across 1D--3D elliptic, parabolic, and Navier--Stokes systems, while remaining independent of neural architectures and training strategies. Experiments on an NVIDIA A100 GPU show that FlashPDE reduces peak memory usage by up to 37.0x compared with coordinate-based automatic differentiation and reduces CUDA kernel launches by up to 3.5x compared with eager PyTorch finite-difference implementations. Across six representative PDE benchmarks, FlashPDE achieves up to 2.30x end-to-end time-to-solution speedup and up to 19.2x kernel-level acceleration while maintaining numerical agreement with PyTorch finite-difference references. FlashPDE provides a hardware-efficient execution layer that bridges differentiable PDE solvers and GPU-optimized numerical computation within the PyTorch ecosystem.
papers.comment: 9 pages of main text, 4 figures. Code available at https://github.com/factnn/FlashPDE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashPDE 是一个即插即用的融合算子库，用于基于网格的科学生成学习，通过可微的 Triton 核替代碎片化的 PyTorch 有限差分执行，提供 14 个覆盖 1D-3D 椭圆、抛物线和 Navier-Stokes 系统的可微 PDE 算子。实验在 A100 GPU 上显示，相比基于坐标的自动微分，峰值内存降低 37.0 倍；相比即时 PyTorch 有限差分实现，CUDA 核启动减少 3.5 倍；在六个 PDE 基准上实现 2.30 倍端到端加速和 19.2 倍核加速，同时保持数值一致性。
Motivation: 物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 在大规模 PDE 问题中受限于自动微分的显存开销和网格 PDE 算子的低效执行。
Method: 提出 FlashPDE，一个基于 Triton 的融合算子库，将碎片化的 PyTorch 有限差分执行替换为可微的 Triton 核，每个算子集成融合模板评估、解析离散伴随反向传播和边界梯度校正，提供 14 个覆盖 1D-3D 的 PDE 算子，独立于神经网络架构和训练策略。
Result: 在 A100 GPU 上，相比于基于坐标的自动微分，峰值内存降低 37.0 倍；相比于即时 PyTorch 有限差分实现，CUDA 核启动减少 3.5 倍；在六个 PDE 基准上，端到端加速 2.30 倍，核加速 19.2 倍。
Conclusion: FlashPDE 在 PyTorch 生态系统中提供了一个硬件高效的执行层，弥合了可微 PDE 求解器与 GPU 优化数值计算之间的差距。

papers.title: Can AI Agents Really Complete RTL-to-GDS? Lessons from Benchmarking Tool-Interactive EDA Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending electronic design automation (EDA) beyond static RTL generation toward long-horizon, tool-interactive workflows. Yet it remains unclear whether general-purpose coding agents, even with domain-specific EDA skills, can reliably execute an end-to-end RTL-to-GDS flow encompassing synthesis, physical implementation, and engineering change order (ECO) optimization. We evaluate AI agents on a PicoRV32 RTL-to-GDS flow using commercial EDA tools under two timing targets. Their performance is assessed using end-to-end design score, stage completion, and Token ROI, a cost-efficiency metric relating design quality to runtime and cost. Comparing three agent architectures and four foundation models, we derive three practical lessons. First, domain-specific skills improve agents' understanding of individual subtasks but do not ensure reliable completion of a long-horizon EDA flow. Second, agents that achieve similar design progress can still differ by up to 141 times in Token ROI, revealing substantial differences in runtime and cost efficiency. Third, low-level tool-interface mismatches are a major source of physical design failures, particularly when Tcl commands depend on the tool version or execution mode. These results suggest that robust Agentic EDA requires not only stronger models but also structured tool interfaces, persistent design context, controlled execution, and process-level evaluation.

papers.title: Spectral Concentration and Recovery in Sparse High-Dimensional Random Geometric Graphs
papers.abstract_en: We study sparse threshold random geometric graphs generated by high-dimensional spherical or Gaussian latent vectors. Although each edge has marginal probability $p$, shared latent variables make the adjacency entries dependent. At the connectivity scale $np=Ω(\log n)$, the spherical adjacency matrix satisfies, with high probability,$\|A-\mathbb E A\|_{\mathrm{op}}=O\left(\sqrt{np\log n}+npτ\right)$, where $τ$ is the cap threshold; an analogous estimate holds for Gaussian vectors after controlling radial fluctuations. This sharpens the spectral bound in Liu, Mohanty, Schramm, and Yang (2023) under weaker assumptions and strengthens the global-synchronization guarantee of Abdalla, Bandeira, and Invernizzi (2024) for the homogeneous Kuramoto model. The leading eigenspace also estimates the latent geometry. When $np\gg\log n$, vector and relative Gram-matrix errors vanish for$\log(1/p)\ll d\ll np\log(1/p)/\log n$ in the spherical model and $\log^2(1/p)\log n\ll d\ll np\log(1/p)/\log n$ in the Gaussian model, improving the recovery conditions of Li and Schramm (2023). For the Gaussian mixture block model introduced there, a polynomial-time semidefinite program gives, to our knowledge, the first exact-recovery guarantee at the connectivity scale in a moderate-separation regime. At much larger separation, fixed edge density creates isolated vertices and makes exact recovery impossible. Our reusable decoupling and matrix concentration framework avoids trace-moment methods and applies broadly to random graph models with latent vectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了稀疏高维随机几何图谱的谱集中与恢复问题，针对球面或高斯潜在向量生成的阈值随机几何图，证明了邻接矩阵的谱范数界，并改进了隐含几何结构的恢复条件。
Motivation: 现有谱界和恢复结果依赖更强的假设或更复杂的矩方法，本文旨在简化假设并推广到更一般的随机图模型。
Method: 利用解耦和矩阵集中框架，避免迹矩方法，直接分析稀疏高维随机几何图的谱性质。
Result: 在连接尺度 $np=Ω(\log n)$ 下，得到谱界 $\|A-\mathbb E A\|_{\mathrm{op}}=O(\sqrt{np\log n}+np\tau)$；在 $np\gg\log n$ 时，向量和相对Gram矩阵误差消失的条件被改进。
Conclusion: 该框架可广泛适用于具有潜在向量的随机图模型，并在高斯混合块模型中首次给出连接尺度下的精确恢复保证。

papers.title: RF Spectrogram Anomaly Detection with Quantum Kitchen Sinks: Architecture, Representation, and Hardware Validation
papers.abstract_en: The broadcast nature of wireless channels exposes radio-frequency (RF) networks to anomalous and malicious transmissions, making anomaly detection a fundamental requirement for secure spectrum management. Quantum Kitchen Sinks (QKS) offer a lightweight hybrid quantum feature map suitable for near-term quantum devices, yet their behavior on structured signal data remains poorly understood. In this paper, we extend the standard QKS template with multi-depth data re-uploading and ring entanglement, and evaluate the resulting pipeline on controlled RF spectrogram anomaly detection. We introduce a validation-locked five-stage ablation protocol that systematically separates the effects of shallow architecture, re-uploading depth, episode budget, input representation, and classical readout. Across the completed benchmark, Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) representations consistently dominate raw and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) inputs, moderate-depth entangled QKS configurations form the strongest operating regime, and QKS improves over matched classical direct-readout baselines across all evaluated representation-readout pairs on the held-out test set, with the best configuration reaching a test Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.8778 and a test F1 of 0.7995. The study bridges two levels of realism: real measured sub-6\,GHz cellular signals on the data side and real-device validation on the ibm_quebec Quantum Processing Unit (QPU) on the computing side, with AUROC deviations below 0.013 relative to simulation. These results provide a practical, reproducible framework for deploying QKS-based anomaly detection in wireless networks.
papers.comment: Paper accepted to IEEE quantum week 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究量子厨房水槽（QKS）在射频频谱图异常检测中的应用，提出多深度数据重上传和环纠缠的扩展方案，并在真实量子硬件上验证。在子6GHz蜂窝信号数据集上，离散余弦变换（DCT）输入表示优于原始和PCA输入，中等深度纠缠QKS配置达到最优，测试AUROC为0.8778，F1为0.7995，且量子硬件上的AUROC偏差小于0.013。
Motivation: 无线信道的广播性质使RF网络易受异常和恶意传输影响，现有QKS方法对结构化信号数据的理解不足。
Method: 扩展标准QKS模板，引入多深度数据重上传和环纠缠，并采用五阶段消融协议系统分离浅层架构、重上传深度、样本预算、输入表示和经典读出等影响因素。
Result: DCT表示在所有评估中优于原始和PCA输入；中等深度纠缠QKS构成最强工作区间；QKS在所有评估的表示-读出对上优于匹配的经典直接读出基线；最佳测试AUROC为0.8778，F1为0.7995，且QPU验证AUROC偏差低于0.013。
Conclusion: 该研究为在无线网络中部署基于QKS的异常检测提供了实用、可复现的框架，并强调输入表示和量子架构深度的重要性。

papers.title: DriveFace: A Cross-Spectral Through-Glass Face Dataset for On-the-Move Vehicular Border Control
papers.abstract_en: The continuous growth in cross-border mobility places increasing pressure on existing border control infrastructures, motivating on-the-move biometric authentication, in which travellers are identified directly inside their vehicles at checkpoints. Face recognition is well-suited to this setting, as it can be acquired passively and at a distance. Its development, however, is hindered by the lack of representative datasets: existing benchmarks are collected in controlled environments and do not capture the challenges inherent to vehicular acquisition, including motion blur, variable illumination, occlusions, and cross-spectral enrollment. To address this gap, we introduce a dataset for on-the-move face recognition in border-control scenarios, comprising NIR vehicle-crossing videos paired with smartphone-based pre-enrollment data. Baseline evaluations with state-of-the-art models show clear performance limitations under these realistic conditions, highlighting the need for dedicated methods to advance the field.
papers.comment: Accepted in IJCB 2026; Project page: https://www.idiap.ch/paper/driveface/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个用于车载移动式边境控制场景的跨光谱车窗人脸识别数据集 DriveFace，包含近红外车辆通行视频和智能手机预注册数据。基线评估显示现有模型在此现实条件下性能有限，表明需要专门方法推进该领域。
Motivation: 现有的人脸识别基准多在受控环境中收集，未能涵盖车辆获取中的运动模糊、光照变化、遮挡和跨光谱注册等挑战，缺乏代表性数据集阻碍了车载移动式边境控制中人脸识别的发展。
Method: 构建了一个包含近红外车辆通行视频和智能手机预注册数据的跨光谱车窗人脸数据集，并采用现有先进模型进行基线评估。
Result: 基线评估显示，在现实边界控制条件下，现有模型性能明显受限。
Conclusion: 该数据集揭示了车载移动式边境控制中人脸识别的挑战，强调了开发专用方法的必要性。

papers.title: Reflecting Process Expertise in Procedural Material Generation
papers.abstract_en: Procedural material creation underpins applications in digital content creation, visual effects, and 3D asset design. Achieving high-quality results requires more than reproducing node graphs -- it demands understanding the process by which experts construct materials. We formulate procedural material generation as retrieval-time process reasoning over expert demonstrations, elevating process to a first-class representation beyond graph-only synthesis. Concretely, we represent expert workflows as process traces: textual records of construction steps, parameters, and design intent. To instantiate this idea, we use a pretrained LLM-based ProcessSynthesizer to synthesize a process trace aligned with a user's intent and a pretrained LLM-based Compiler to ground the process trace into an executable Blender material graph. Because procedural expertise is most naturally conveyed through demonstrations, we leverage tutorial videos as a source of process knowledge and extract textual, LLM-compatible traces using automated video analysis tools. In an expert study with five Blender artists (avg. 7.5 years of experience), materials generated by reflecting expert demonstrations were found to produce workflows requiring fewer edits, and more closely match professional design strategies than methods operating solely on static artifacts. A user study with 150 participants further shows that our approach achieves superior generation and editing performance compared to prior procedural systems. All code, models, and data will be available at https://materialapprentice.github.io
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://materialapprentice.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将程序化材质生成任务建模为检索时的过程推理，通过LLM合成并编译专家工作流轨迹（process traces）为可执行的Blender材质图。从教程视频中自动提取过程知识，专家研究表明生成结果更符合专业设计策略，用户研究（150人）显示生成和编辑性能优于此前系统。
Motivation: 现有程序化材质生成仅关注节点图的复现，忽略了专家构建材质时的设计过程与意图，导致生成结果难以编辑和适配专业工作流。
Method: 使用预训练LLM（ProcessSynthesizer）根据用户意图合成过程轨迹（记录步骤、参数和设计意图），再通过另一LLM（Compiler）将轨迹转化为Blender材质图；同时利用自动化视频分析从教程中提取过程知识。
Result: 5位资深Blender艺术家（平均7.5年经验）的专家研究表明，该方法生成的材质工作流需要的编辑次数更少，更贴近专业设计策略；150人用户研究证实生成和编辑性能优于先前程序化系统。
Conclusion: 将专家的过程经验作为一等表示引入生成系统能够改善程序化材质的质量和可用性，代码、模型和数据将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Contrast-Free ICA and Causal Inference via Wasserstein Distances to the Gaussian
papers.abstract_en: We study the squared $2$-Wasserstein distance to the standard Gaussian as a non-Gaussianity criterion and use it for linear Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and causal discovery in Linear Non-Gaussian Acyclic Models (LiNGAM). Unlike commonly used parametric contrasts and approximations of information-theoretic quantities, this criterion requires no distributional regularity beyond finite second moments, involves neither approximation nor tuning parameters, and can be computed exactly and efficiently from empirical order statistics. Our analysis relies on a strict subadditivity property of the $2$-Wasserstein distance to the Gaussian. At the population level, we prove exact identification of the ICA unmixing matrix, up to signed permutation, and give an analogous characterization of causal orders through sequential least-squares residuals. We then define empirical plug-in estimators and prove distribution-free uniform convergence under finite-moment assumptions, before detailing three practical solvers: a Picard-style orthogonal optimizer for ICA, an exhaustive dynamic program for causal order search, and a greedy order search variant. Empirically, we demonstrate competitive performance for both tasks and provide open-source implementations for source separation and causal discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用平方2-Wasserstein距离到标准高斯分布作为非高斯性准则，用于线性独立成分分析（ICA）和线性非高斯无环模型（LiNGAM）中的因果发现。该准则无需分布正则性假设，无需近似或调参，可从经验序数统计量精确高效计算。文中证明了总体水平的ICA解混矩阵识别和因果序刻画，给出了经验估计的一致收敛性，并设计了三种实用求解器。实验展示了竞争力。
Motivation: 现有ICA和因果发现方法常依赖参数化对比度或信息论近似，需要分布假设或调参。本文旨在提出一个无需分布正则性、无需近似或调参的非高斯性准则。
Method: 使用平方2-Wasserstein距离到标准高斯作为非高斯性准则，基于严格次可加性。在总体水平证明ICA解混矩阵的精确识别（至多符号置换），并通过逐次最小二乘残差刻画因果序。定义经验插件估计量并证明分布自由的一致收敛性。提出三种求解器：Picard风格正交优化器、穷举动态规划因果序搜索、贪婪序搜索。
Result: 实验证明在ICA和因果发现任务上与现有方法竞争，并提供开源实现。
Conclusion: 论文表明基于Wasserstein距离的准则可以有效地用于ICA和因果发现，且无需分布假设和调参。

summary_sections.method: 使用平方2-Wasserstein距离到标准高斯作为非高斯性准则，基于严格次可加性。在总体水平证明ICA解混矩阵的精确识别（至多符号置换），并通过逐次最小二乘残差刻画因果序。定义经验插件估计量并证明分布自由的一致收敛性。提出三种求解器：Picard风格正交优化器、穷举动态规划因果序搜索、贪婪序搜索。
summary_sections.result: 实验证明在ICA和因果发现任务上与现有方法竞争，并提供开源实现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文表明基于Wasserstein距离的准则可以有效地用于ICA和因果发现，且无需分布假设和调参。

papers.title: Compile, Then Page: Executable SOP Programs and a Capability-Gated Runtime for Procedural LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise agents must follow long-horizon, conditional, safety-critical standard operating procedures (SOPs). We compile machine-readable SOP constraints into executable pseudo-code and run them with a program-guided (PG) stack machine that pages the active frame while an LLM performs semantic execution. A three-arm SOPBench study across six models separates representation from runtime: compiled text never significantly hurts and gains up to 16.0 points where official prose underperforms. Runtime guidance is capability-gated. Two strong models independently show positive seven-domain PG contrasts (58:19 and 75:31 discordant pairs), whereas weak models are harmed. A full-program cursor ablation (active frame first, complete program retained) recovers much of the strong-model refusal gain; selective visibility adds a smaller improvement. Paired probe and audit measurements track this divide to spontaneous state discipline rather than reconstruction ability. On Bank the three primary arms rise from 70.4 to 86.4 to 92.8, with 100% refusal correctness. Practical guidance: compile first; enable active-frame paging only after a model-level discipline check.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业代理需遵循长程、条件性、安全关键的标准化操作程序（SOP）的问题，提出将机器可读的SOP约束编译为可执行伪代码，并通过程序引导（PG）栈机运行，该栈机在LLM执行语义操作时对活动帧进行分页。在SOPBench上跨六个模型的三分支实验表明，编译文本从未显著损害性能，且在官方文本表现不佳时提升高达16.0分；运行时指导是能力门控的，强模型受益（58:19和75:31不一致对），弱模型受损。全程序光标消融恢复了强模型的大部分拒绝增益；选择性可见性带来较小改进。主要三种方法在银行业务中从70.4升至86.4再至92.8，拒绝正确性达100%。
Motivation: 企业代理必须执行长程、条件性且安全关键的SOP，现有表示和运行时方法存在不足。
Method: 将机器可读的SOP约束编译成可执行伪代码，并通过一个程序引导的栈机运行，该栈机对活动帧进行分页，LLM负责语义执行。
Result: 编译文本从不显著损害性能，在官方散文表现不佳时提升高达16.0点。强模型正面对比（58:19和75:31不一致对），弱模型受损。全程序光标消融恢复强模型大部分拒绝增益；选择性可见性增加较小改进。Bank场景中三个主要分支从70.4升至86.4再至92.8，拒绝正确性100%。
Conclusion: 实用指南：先编译；仅在模型级自律检查后才启用活动帧分页。

papers.title: The Hidden Footprint: Making Storage a First-Class Metric for LLM Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLM agent benchmarks measure task completion, reliability, and inference cost, but not the persistent data an agent run leaves on disk, including logs, context snapshots, checkpoints, and debug traces. We introduce AgentFootprint, a cross-framework benchmark of post-run agent storage footprint. Its serialization-aware metric suite measures total retention, channel composition, duplication, growth, compressibility, and conversation-history reconstructability. It addresses a measurement trap: naive byte-level measurement understates duplication by an order of magnitude because database paging and JSON escaping obscure repeated content. A fixed-trace control separates agent-generated logical volume from persistence-layer amplification: replaying the same trajectory through seven persisting frameworks yields a 6.7x spread. Under identical models, tools, and tasks, configurations with 100% accuracy differ by 15.7x in retained bytes, although their defaults support different recovery and audit capabilities. Three full-history configurations grow superlinearly on a repeated-observation stress task. Exported trajectories from 108 instance-normalized SWE-bench Verified submissions span three orders of magnitude per instance, with no detectable correlation with resolve rate. A content-addressed store reduces retention by 4.8x-32.7x while preserving every reconstructability score. These results establish persistent storage as a resource metric to report jointly with accuracy and reconstructability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentFootprint，一个跨框架的LLM代理存储占用基准测试，测量代理运行后留在磁盘上的持久数据，包括日志、上下文快照、检查点和调试跟踪。研究发现：相同轨迹在不同框架下存储占用差异达6.7倍，相同准确率的配置保留字节数差异达15.7倍；全历史配置在重复观察压力任务上超线性增长；SWE-bench提交的实例存储占用跨度三个数量级且与解决率无相关性；内容寻址存储可减少4.8-32.7倍保留量并保持重构性。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理基准测试衡量任务完成度、可靠性和推理成本，但忽略了代理运行留下的持久数据存储占用，这会影响成本、隐私和可审计性。
Method: 提出AgentFootprint基准测试，包含序列化感知的度量套件（总保留量、通道组成、重复、增长、可压缩性和会话历史可重构性），并引入固定轨迹控制以分离代理生成逻辑卷与持久层放大效应。
Result: 同一轨迹通过七个持久化框架产生6.7倍存储占用差异；相同准确率的配置保留字节数相差15.7倍；全历史配置在重复观察任务上超线性增长；SWE-bench提交实例存储占用跨度三个数量级，与解决率无相关性；内容寻址存储减少4.8-32.7倍保留量。
Conclusion: 持久存储应作为与准确率和可重构性并重的资源度量指标，内容寻址存储可大幅降低存储占用而不损失重构能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Navigate Efficiently with Only 0.58M Trainable Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in visual navigation has largely been driven by scale: end-to-end policies with hundreds of millions of parameters trained on billions of frames or large-scale simulated data. We ask how much of this scale a single task family actually requires, and what structure can substitute for it. We propose a decomposed navigation model in which operations with known closed-form structure, such as projective geometry, occupancy, and coordinate transforms, are computed analytically and serve as interfaces between three small learned modules: an egress predictor that grounds the episode goal as a local subgoal in the current view, a navigation predictor that estimates a goal-conditioned posterior over where trajectories travel, and an endpoint-pinned residual diffusion generator that samples trajectory shapes from this posterior. The system trains only 0.58M out of a total of 22.7M parameters, on 44k frames in under one GPU-hour, yet approaches the performance of state-of-the-art models on navigation tasks across 6060 point-goal episodes and 60 environments, while having 233$\times$ fewer trainable parameters, the lowest collision rate among all evaluated methods, and 10+ Hz inference rate on a Jetson Xavier NX. The decomposition further transfers to no-goal exploration by retraining only the 123k-parameter egress head, and its failure modes under sensor corruption are transparent and analytically correctable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种分解式视觉导航模型，仅用0.58M可训练参数（总参数22.7M）和44k帧数据训练不到1 GPU小时，在60个环境的6060个点目标任务中接近SOTA性能，碰撞率最低，推理速度10+ Hz。模型将投影几何、占用、坐标变换等已知闭式结构计算为固定模块，连接三个小学习模块：出口预测器、导航预测器和端点锚定残差扩散生成器。
Motivation: 现有视觉导航方法依赖大规模参数（数亿）和大量数据（数十亿帧），本文质疑单个任务族是否需要如此规模，并探索用结构化分解替代规模。
Method: 将导航分解为三个小学习模块：1）出口预测器将全局目标映射为当前视图中的局部子目标；2）导航预测器估计目标条件下的轨迹后验分布；3）端点锚定残差扩散生成器从后验中采样轨迹形状。已知闭式结构（投影几何、占用、坐标变换）作为模块接口被解析计算。
Result: 仅用0.58M可训练参数（SOTA模型1/233）和44k帧数据，在60环境6060个点目标导航任务中接近SOTA性能，碰撞率最低，Jetson Xavier NX上推理10+ Hz。该分解可迁移到无目标探索，仅需重训练123k参数的出口预测头；传感器损坏下的失败模式透明且可解析修正。
Conclusion: 结构化的分解可以大幅减少视觉导航对参数和数据规模的需求，同时保持强性能和低碰撞率，且具有可解释性和硬件可部署性。

papers.title: TabPFN beyond Tabular Data: Calibration and Accuracy on Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot multimodal classification commonly attaches a lightweight head, such as $k$-nearest neighbors, logistic regression, or a linear SVM, to a frozen pretrained encoder. Although computationally efficient, these heads can produce poorly calibrated confidence scores, limiting their reliability in calibration-sensitive applications. We evaluate TabPFN as a plug-and-play, zero-gradient classification head for frozen image, text, and audio encoders. Across 22{,}820 evaluation episodes spanning 14 datasets, 11 encoders, and three modalities, TabPFN achieves the best mean rank among nine classification heads on both negative log-likelihood (NLL) and expected calibration error (ECE). At a representative setting, it reduces NLL by 48--62\% and ECE by 2.1--5.3$\times$ relative to the average of the eight baselines while matching or exceeding their average accuracy. Its accuracy advantage is conditional, concentrating at moderate-to-high shot counts and low-to-moderate feature dimensions ($k \ge 50$, $d \le 32$), and diminishing when labeled data are scarce, feature dimensions are high, or competing methods approach ceiling accuracy. In targeted backbone-adaptation experiments, replacing the trained linear head with TabPFN substantially improves calibration while preserving competitive accuracy. These results provide empirical guidance for using TabPFN as a training-free head in calibration-sensitive multimodal classification. To support transparency and reproducibility, we publicly release the source code, experiment configurations, and evaluation scripts in our GitHub repository: https://github.com/Jingxiang-Zhang/tabpfn-multimodal-embeddings.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Jingxiang Zhang and Lujia Zhong contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/Jingxiang-Zhang/tabpfn-multimodal-embeddings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估TabPFN作为即插即用、零梯度的分类头，用于冻结的图像、文本和音频编码器。在涵盖14个数据集、11个编码器和三种模态的22820个评估episode中，TabPFN在负对数似然和期望校准误差上取得最佳平均排名，相比基线平均降低了48-62%的NLL和2.1-5.3倍的ECE，同时匹配或超过平均准确率。其准确率优势在有中等至高样本数且特征维度较低时最显著。
Motivation: 少样本多模态分类常用轻量头（如k最近邻、逻辑回归、线性SVM）虽然计算高效，但生成的置信度分数校准差，限制了在校准敏感应用中的可靠性。
Method: 将TabPFN作为训练无需梯度的分类头，直接应用于预训练编码器输出的嵌入，通过处理嵌入表格化表示进行分类。
Result: 在22820个episode中，TabPFN在NLL和ECE上取得最佳平均排名；典型设置下NLL降低48-62%，ECE降低2.1-5.3倍，准确率匹配或超过八种基线平均。该优势在样本数≥50且特征维度≤32时集中，在样本少、维度高或基线接近上限时减弱。
Conclusion: TabPFN作为一种无需训练的分类头，在校准敏感的多模态分类中可显著改善校准同时保持竞争力，为实际应用提供经验指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Silent Failures in Quantized LLM Reasoning: A Taxonomy-Based Analysis of Hollow Convergence and Failure Mode Shifts
papers.abstract_en: We show that post-training quantization can silently alter how large language models reason even when task accuracy is preserved. Using a six-category failure taxonomy validated by two independent human annotators (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.906), we classify 30,000 chain-of-thought outputs from five instruction-tuned LLMs (3B--14B parameters) across three quantization precisions (FP32, FP16, NF4) and four reasoning benchmarks. We find that while accuracy is robust across precisions (maximum 3.1 pp drop), Hollow Convergence (correct answers reached through incomplete or unverifiable reasoning) shows a significant size-dependent shift under NF4, dropping sharply for the two smallest models tested but remaining invariant for models at 12B parameters and above. This effect is also benchmark-specific: GSM8K is categorically immune while LogiQA and ARC-Challenge show the largest shifts. Furthermore, under NF4, Shortcut Collapse rises from 44% to 78% of wrong-answer failures in LLaMA 3.2-3B while Confidence Snowballing collapses from 15.8% to near zero, a qualitative shift invisible to accuracy metrics. Finally, we show Hollow Convergence cannot be reliably detected from surface-level text features (best F1 = 0.53), establishing it as a deployment-relevant failure mode that standard evaluation pipelines cannot catch.

papers.title: WildTrace: Benchmarking Natural Evidence Trails in Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Answering complex questions over long documents frequently requires integrating evidence that the source itself disperses naturally across distant passages. In an incident report, the operating condition, design flaw, and missed safety check that jointly explain a disaster may appear dozens of sections apart; in a novel, a character's true motive may surface only through scenes far removed from the moment it becomes relevant. This source-internal evidence integration is central to real-world long-document analysis, yet existing benchmarks largely sidestep it. Needle probes, planted facts, and reverse-engineered multi-hop chains embed evidence that may differ from the host text in distribution, placement, or register, making it unclear whether strong performance reflects genuine source reasoning or distributional artifacts. We introduce WILDTRACE, a benchmark of 481 tasks over 214 naturally occurring long-form sources such as technical incident reports and lesser-known literary narratives, where all evidence trails arise from the document's own causal, temporal, and narrative logic. Drawing on Pearl's causal hierarchy and prior multi-hop reasoning typologies, we define seven source-internal evidence geometries that characterize the distinct relational demands of analytical reading in long documents. A source-first construction pipeline mines candidate trails from document structure before writing questions; each item then undergoes multi-stage validation covering clue necessity, answer groundedness, rubric fidelity, contamination resistance and answerability. As models are increasingly entrusted with real-world high-stakes analytical tasks, this gap between accessing information and reasoning over naturally dispersed evidence emerges as a defining challenge for the next stage of long-context research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WildTrace是一个针对长上下文推理中自然证据轨迹的基准测试，包含481个任务，覆盖214个自然长文档（如技术事故报告和文学叙事），其中所有证据线索均源自文档自身的因果、时间与叙事逻辑，而非人工植入。该基准定义了七种源内证据几何形状，并通过多阶段验证确保问题质量。实验表明现有模型在整合自然分散证据方面存在显著不足。
Motivation: 现有长上下文基准多依赖植入线索或逆向工程的多跳链，这些线索在分布、位置或语域上可能与原文不同，导致模型性能可能源于分布伪影而非真正的源推理。现实中的长文档分析需整合自然分散的因果关联，而现有基准未能充分捕捉这一挑战。
Method: 采用源优先构建流程：从文档结构中挖掘候选证据踪迹，再撰写问题。每个任务经过线索必要性、答案基础性、评分标准、抗污染性和可回答性等多阶段验证。基于Pearl因果关系层次和多跳推理类型学，定义了七种源内证据几何形状。
Result: 基准包含481个任务和214个自然长文档，涵盖技术报告和文学叙事。实验揭示了当前模型在推理自然分散证据时的性能差距，表明信息访问与因果推理能力之间存在显著脱节。
Conclusion: 随着模型日益被用于高风险分析任务，弥合信息获取与自然分散证据推理之间的差距成为长上下文研究的核心挑战。WildTrace为评估这一能力提供了标准化工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnchorPrune: Relevance-Anchored Contextual Expansion for Visual Token Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models incur substantial inference costs because high-resolution inputs introduce thousands of visual tokens, many of which are redundant for a given query. Existing pruning methods often combine query relevance and token diversity, yet these objectives can conflict under aggressive compression: relevance-driven selection may overconcentrate the budget on correlated local evidence, while diversity-driven selection may suppress indispensable tokens or retain distinct but uninformative regions. We introduce AnchorPrune, a training-free framework that first constructs a protected relevance anchor and then expands it with complementary visual context. AnchorPrune adaptively determines the anchor size from the novelty profile of relevance-ranked tokens, preserving a compact set of query-critical evidence, and allocates the remaining budget through importance-weighted novelty to recover informative, non-redundant context relative to the anchor. This ordered design prevents contextual expansion from displacing indispensable query cues while improving overall visual coverage. AnchorPrune is lightweight, architecture-aware, and requires neither retraining nor model modification. Across image and video vision-language models and benchmarks, it consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over training-free baselines, particularly under severe compression. On LLaVA-NeXT-7B, AnchorPrune preserves 97.6% of full-token performance using only 160 of 2,880 visual tokens. These results establish relevance-anchored contextual expansion as an effective principle for efficient multimodal inference. Code is available at https://github.com/MULTI-cau/AnchorPrune.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorPrune 是一个无需训练的视觉 token 剪枝框架，通过先构建受保护的相关性锚点（anchor），再分配剩余预算扩展互补上下文，解决了剪枝中相关性与多样性目标冲突的问题。在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上仅用 160/2880 个 token 保留了 97.6% 的全 token 性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 剪枝方法在追求 query 相关性和 token 多样性时存在目标冲突，高压缩率下会导致关键信息丢失或保留冗余。
Method: 提出 AnchorPrune：首先根据相关性排序 token 的新颖性分布自适应确定锚点大小，保留 query 关键证据；然后通过重要性加权的新颖性分配剩余预算，从锚点扩展出非冗余的上下文信息。
Result: 在多个图像和视频视觉语言模型上，AnchorPrune 一致提升了精度-效率权衡，尤其在高压缩率下表现突出。例如 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上仅用 160 个 token 即达到 97.6% 的全 token 性能。
Conclusion: 相关性锚定的上下文扩展被证明是高效多模态推理的有效原则，该方法轻量、无需训练或修改模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Heat-Kernel Entropy Profiles and Geometric Effective Sample Size for Weighted Measures on Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Weighted empirical measures on compact manifolds appear in importance sampling, particle approximations, posterior summaries, quadrature, and representation learning. Ordinary effective sample size and related weight summaries ignore the geometry of the support. We introduce heat-kernel entropy profiles to measure nonuniformity after intrinsic diffusion at a range of scales. For order-two Rényi entropy, pairwise heat-kernel overlaps give an exact profile and a geometric effective sample size. This effective sample size discounts nearby or duplicate particles. It approaches ordinary effective sample size as overlaps between distinct particles vanish. On compact boundaryless manifolds, we establish profile monotonicity, gESS scale limits, deterministic-weight consistency, and a bounded-ratio result for self-normalized importance sampling. On spheres, the unlogged profile decomposes into spherical-harmonic energies. The first terms are squared mean-resultant and traceless-second-moment energies, which give vMF- and Bingham-type scalar summaries. Experiments identify antipodal, girdle, multimodal, and duplicate-particle structures that weight-only and first-moment summaries miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出热核熵轮廓（heat-kernel entropy profiles）来度量紧致流形上加权经验测度的非均匀性，并引入几何有效样本量（geometric effective sample size, gESS），该量在粒子重叠时打折，并趋近于传统ESS。在无边界紧致流形上证明了单调性、尺度极限等性质，并在球面上分解为球谐能量。实验发现仅靠权重和一阶矩无法识别的对映、环带、多峰和重复粒子结构。
Motivation: 传统的有效样本量（ESS）等权重摘要忽略了加权测度在流形上支撑集的几何结构，无法区分邻近或重复粒子。
Method: 引入热核熵轮廓，通过不同尺度下的内在扩散测量非均匀性；对于二阶Rényi熵，利用成对热核重叠给出精确轮廓和几何有效样本量gESS。
Result: 在无边界紧致流形上证明了轮廓单调性、gESS尺度极限、确定性权重一致性和自归一化重要性抽样的有界比结果。在球面上，未取对数的轮廓分解为球谐能量，前几项对应平方均值和零迹二阶矩能量，给出vMF型和Bingham型标量摘要。实验识别了对映、环带、多峰和重复粒子等结构。
Conclusion: 本文提出的gESS能捕捉仅靠权重和一阶矩无法发现的几何结构，为流形上加权测度的非均匀性提供了多尺度刻画。

papers.title: Parameter-Free Encoders Remain Viable for RDB Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Given a relational database (RDB) storing heterogeneous tabular information, how can we predict missing (or future) values in some target column of interest? As the space of potential targets is vast across enterprise settings, it is preferable to avoid learning a new model from scratch each time there is a new prediction task. Frozen foundation models based on RDB-specific encoders provide a viable solution, but ideal design remains an open question. On the one hand, it has recently been argued that certain parameter-free subgraph encoders combined with single-table foundation models can achieve near SOTA performance, with no RDB-specific pre-training required. Meanwhile, other contemporary studies advocate for parameterized encoders pre-trained to exploit observable labels for learning task-specific representations. To address this ambiguity, we analyze RDB encoder properties specifically when labels are present as inputs, proving limitations on the potential efficacy of trainable encoder parameters. As empirical validation, we demonstrate that considerably simpler parameter-free encoders are still capable of strong performance across many relevant benchmarking tasks.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对关系数据库中缺失值预测问题，比较了无参数子图编码器与参数化编码器在RDB基础模型中的表现。作者通过理论证明和实验表明，在标签作为输入的情况下，可训练编码器参数存在局限性，而更简单的无参数编码器仍能在多个基准任务上取得强劲性能。
Motivation: 当前RDB基础模型中编码器设计存在争议：无参数编码器声称无需预训练即可接近SOTA，而参数化编码器则认为有标签预训练更优。本文旨在消除这种歧义。
Method: 对标签作为输入时的RDB编码器属性进行理论分析，证明可训练编码器参数潜在有效性的局限性，并通过实验验证无参数编码器的性能。
Result: 在多个相关基准任务上，更简单的无参数编码器仍能展现出强劲性能，挑战了参数化编码器的必要性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在标签作为输入的情况下，无参数编码器仍然可行，为RDB基础模型设计提供了简化方向。
