papers.title: SafeHarbor: Defining Precise Decision Boundaries via Hierarchical Memory-Augmented Guardrail for LLM Agent Safety
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in foundation models have transformed LLMs from passive conversational systems into autonomous agents capable of reasoning and tool execution. While these capabilities unlock substantial practical value, they also introduce new security risks, as adversaries can manipulate agents into performing harmful actions in real-world environments. Existing defense strategies mitigate such threats but frequently struggle to balance safety and utility, resulting in over-refusal of benign user requests. To mitigate this trade-off, we propose SafeHarbor, a novel framework designed to establish precise decision boundaries for LLM agents. Unlike static guidelines, SafeHarbor extracts context-aware defense rules through enhanced adversarial generation. We design a local hierarchical memory system for dynamic rule injection, offering a training-free, efficient, and plug-and-play solution. Furthermore, we introduce an information entropy-based self-evolution mechanism that continuously optimizes the memory structure through dynamic node splitting and merging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SafeHarbor achieves state-of-the-art performance on both ambiguous benign tasks and explicit malicious attacks, notably attaining a peak benign utility of 63.6\% on GPT-4o while maintaining a robust refusal rate exceeding 93\% against harmful requests. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/ljj-cyber/SafeHarbor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SafeHarbor，一种用于LLM智能体安全性的分层记忆增强防护框架，通过上下文感知的防御规则、免训练的内存系统和基于信息熵的自进化机制，在保持高安全拒绝率的同时提升良性任务可用性。在GPT-4o上实现63.6%的良性效用，对有害请求拒绝率超过93%。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体防御策略难以平衡安全性和实用性，常过度拒绝良性用户请求。
Method: SafeHarbor利用增强对抗生成提取上下文感知防御规则，设计局部分层记忆系统动态注入规则，并引入基于信息熵的自进化机制优化记忆结构。
Result: 在GPT-4o上良性任务效用达63.6%，对恶意攻击拒绝率超93%，实现最先进性能。
Conclusion: SafeHarbor通过精确决策边界有效平衡安全与效用，且无需训练、即插即用。

summary_sections.result: 在GPT-4o上良性任务效用达63.6%，对恶意攻击拒绝率超93%，实现最先进性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: SafeHarbor通过精确决策边界有效平衡安全与效用，且无需训练、即插即用。

papers.title: Streamliners for Answer Set Programming
papers.abstract_en: Streamliner constraints reduce the search space of combinatorial problems by ruling out portions of the solution space. We adapt the StreamLLM approach, which uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate streamliners for Constraint Programming, to Answer Set Programming (ASP). Given an ASP encoding and a few small training instances, we prompt multiple LLMs to propose candidate constraints. Candidates that cause syntax errors, render satisfiable instances unsatisfiable, or degrade performance on all training instances are discarded. The surviving streamliners are evaluated together with the original encoding, and we report results for a virtual best encoding (VBE) that, for each instance, selects the fastest among the original encoding and its streamlined variants. On three ASP competition benchmarks (Partner Units Problem, Sokoban, Towers of Hanoi), the VBE achieves speedups of up to 4 to 5 times over the original encoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）为答案集编程（ASP）自动生成流线型约束（streamliner constraints），以缩小解空间并提高求解效率。在三个ASP竞赛基准（Partner Units Problem、Sokoban、Towers of Hanoi）上，虚拟最佳编码（VBE）相比原始编码实现了最高4-5倍的加速。
Motivation: 流线型约束能通过排除部分解空间来减少组合问题的搜索空间，但手动设计这类约束耗时且需要领域知识。本文旨在利用LLM自动生成适用于ASP的流线型约束。
Method: 给定ASP编码和少量训练实例，向多个LLM提示生成候选约束。丢弃导致语法错误、使可满足实例变为不可满足或在所有训练实例上降低性能的候选。然后，将保留下来的流线型约束与原始编码一起评估，并报告虚拟最佳编码（VBE）的结果——VBE为每个实例选择原始编码及其流线型变体中最快的一个。
Result: 在三个ASP竞赛基准（Partner Units Problem、Sokoban、Towers of Hanoi）上，VBE相比原始编码实现了最高4-5倍的加速。
Conclusion: 该方法可自动生成有效的流线型约束，提升ASP求解性能。但摘要未提及方法对超出其评估基准的通用性或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Glass Surface Reconstruction via Depth Prior for Robot Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Indoor robot navigation is often compromised by glass surfaces, which severely corrupt depth sensor measurements. While foundation models like Depth Anything 3 provide excellent geometric priors, they lack an absolute metric scale. We propose a training-free framework that leverages depth foundation models as a structural prior, employing a robust local RANSAC-based alignment to fuse it with raw sensor depth. This naturally avoids contamination from erroneous glass measurements and recovers an accurate metric scale. Furthermore, we introduce \ti{GlassRecon}, a novel RGB-D dataset with geometrically derived ground truth for glass regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, especially under severe sensor depth corruption. The dataset and related code will be released at https://github.com/jarvisyjw/GlassRecon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对室内机器人导航中玻璃表面导致深度传感器测量严重失真的问题，本文提出一种无需训练的框架，利用深度基础模型（如Depth Anything 3）作为结构先验，通过鲁棒的局部RANSAC对齐融合原始传感器深度，从而避免玻璃错误测量污染并恢复准确的度量尺度。同时引入了一个新的RGB-D数据集GlassRecon，包含几何导出的玻璃区域真值。实验表明该方法在传感器深度严重损坏的场景下持续优于现有基线。
Motivation: 玻璃表面会使深度传感器产生严重测量误差，影响机器人导航，而现有深度基础模型虽提供良好几何先验但缺乏度量尺度，需要一种能结合二者优势且不受玻璃污染的方法。
Method: 提出训练无关的框架，利用深度基础模型作为结构性先验，采用鲁棒的局部RANSAC对齐将先验与原始传感器深度融合，从而避免玻璃区域错误数据的污染并恢复准确度量尺度。
Result: 在多个室内场景中，该方法在玻璃表面深度重建精度上显著优于现有基线，尤其在传感器深度严重损坏时表现突出。
Conclusion: 该工作通过无训练的方式有效融合深度先验与原始传感器数据，显著提升了玻璃表面的深度重建质量，并提供了新的数据集以支持后续研究。

papers.title: Towards Disentangled Preference Optimization Dynamics: Suppress the Loser, Preserve the Winner
papers.abstract_en: Preference optimization is widely used to align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, many margin-based methods also suppress the chosen response when they try to suppress the rejected one, and there is no general way to prevent this across different objectives. We address this issue with a unified incentive-score decomposition of preference optimization, revealing that different objectives share the same local update directions and differ only in their scalar weights. This decomposition provides a common framework for analyzing objectives that were previously studied in separate settings. Building on this decomposition, by analyzing the dynamics of the chosen/rejected likelihoods, we identify the disentanglement band (DB), a simple, testable condition that tells us when training can follow the desired path: suppress the loser while preserving the winner, possibly after an early stage. Using the DB, we propose reward calibration (RC), a plug-and-play method that adaptively rebalances the updates for chosen and rejected responses to satisfy the DB, without redesigning the base objective. Empirical results show that RC leads to more disentangled dynamics, with better downstream performance observed across several settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/IceyWuu/DisentangledPreferenceOptimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过激励-分数分解统一了偏好优化目标，揭示不同目标共享相同局部更新方向而仅权重不同。提出解缠带条件，用于判断训练是否遵循“抑制拒绝响应、保留选择响应”的理想路径，并设计奖励校准方法自适应重平衡更新以满足该条件。实验表明该方法带来更解缠的动态和更好的下游性能。
Motivation: 现有基于边界的偏好优化方法在抑制拒绝响应时也会不必要地抑制选择响应，且缺乏通用方法在不同目标下避免此问题。
Method: 提出激励-分数分解框架统一分析偏好优化目标，推导出解缠带条件，并基于此设计奖励校准，一种即插即用方法，通过自适应重平衡选择和拒绝响应的更新来满足该条件。
Result: 经验结果表明奖励校准带来更解缠的动态，并在多个设置下观察到更好的下游性能。
Conclusion: 解缠带条件和奖励校准为偏好优化提供了一种通用方法，有望在不重新设计基础目标的情况下实现更理想的训练动态。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EvoSpec: Evolving Speculative Decoding via Real-Time Vocabulary and Parameter Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model inference through draft-then-verify generation, yet lightweight draft models face coupled efficiency and quality limitations: large-vocabulary output projection is costly, while limited draft capacity and static parameters reduce acceptance under specialized or shifting inputs. Vocabulary pruning lowers projection cost, but static variants miss locally important long-tail tokens, while dynamic variants remain sensitive to preset selection policies and budgets. Moreover, limited draft capacity can leave the draft distribution misaligned even when the target token is covered. Online alignment improves draft quality, but full-parameter updates introduce substantial memory and latency overhead. We introduce EvoSpec, which jointly adapts the active vocabulary and lightweight draft parameters from verification feedback. EvoSpec asynchronously retrieves semantic and statistical token neighbors and performs curriculum-weighted online LoRA alignment while preserving exact target-model verification. On Qwen3-8B/EAGLE-2, EvoSpec reaches a $2.18\times$ speedup over vanilla decoding and a $1.20\times$ gain over EAGLE-2, while improving specialized-domain coverage and using $27\%$ less auxiliary GPU adaptation memory than full-parameter online adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EvoSpec，通过实时调整活跃词汇表和轻量级草稿模型参数，利用验证反馈进行演化，以加速大语言模型推理。在Qwen3-8B/EAGLE-2上，EvoSpec达到2.18倍加速（相对vanilla解码）和1.20倍增益（相对EAGLE-2），同时减少27%的辅助GPU适配内存。
Motivation: 现有投机解码中，轻量级草稿模型面临词汇表投影成本高、草稿容量有限和静态参数导致接受率低的问题。词汇表剪枝虽降低开销，但静态变体丢失局部重要长尾词，动态变体对预设策略敏感。在线对齐改善草稿质量，但全参数更新带来大量内存和延迟开销。
Method: EvoSpec联合适应活跃词汇表和轻量级草稿参数，通过异步检索语义和统计词汇邻居，进行课程加权在线LoRA对齐，同时保持精确的目标模型验证。
Result: 在Qwen3-8B/EAGLE-2上，EvoSpec达到2.18倍加速（相对vanilla解码）和1.20倍增益（相对EAGLE-2），并提高专业领域覆盖率，辅助GPU内存比全参数在线适应减少27%。
Conclusion: EvoSpec通过实时词汇表和参数自适应，显著加速LLM推理，且内存效率高。

papers.title: Fairness Constraints in High-Dimensional Generalized Linear Models
papers.abstract_en: Most fairness-aware learning methods assume that sensitive attributes are observed, an assumption that may fail due to privacy, legal, or data-collection constraints. We develop a framework for fairness-aware generalized linear models when the sensitive attribute is latent, possibly multi-category, and the predictors may be high-dimensional. Candidate proxy variables are modeled using Gaussian mixtures for continuous predictors and product-multinomial mixtures for categorical predictors. The resulting posterior group-membership probabilities are used to residualize the predictors and reduce their association with the latent sensitive structure. For continuous outcomes, we use constrained least squares to limit the contribution of the estimated sensitive attribute to prediction variability. For binary outcomes, we use penalized logistic regression to reduce dependence between predicted probabilities and estimated group membership. In high-dimensional settings, the procedure is combined with SEMMS variable selection to obtain sparse models. We establish identifiability and latent-class recovery results for Gaussian and categorical mixtures and derive expressions that quantify the loss of predictive power after residualization.Simulations and real-data applications demonstrate favorable accuracy-fairness performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对敏感属性不可观测时的公平性学习问题，提出了一个适用于高维广义线性模型的框架。通过高斯混合和乘积多项混合建模候选代理变量，利用后验组隶属概率对预测变量进行残差化，并采用约束最小二乘或惩罚逻辑回归减少预测对敏感结构的依赖。结合SEMMS变量选择得到稀疏模型，理论证明了可识别性和潜在类恢复结果，模拟和真实数据展示了良好的准确性-公平性权衡。
Motivation: 现有公平性学习方法通常假设敏感属性可观测，但在隐私、法律或数据收集限制下该假设可能不成立。本文针对敏感属性潜在且可能为多类别、预测变量高维的场景，需要在不直接观测敏感属性的情况下实现公平性约束。
Method: 使用高斯混合（连续预测变量）和乘积多项混合（分类预测变量）对候选代理变量建模，得到后验组隶属概率；通过残差化降低预测变量与潜在敏感结构的关联；连续结果使用约束最小二乘限制敏感属性对预测方差的贡献，二元结果使用惩罚逻辑回归减少预测概率与估计组隶属的依赖；高维场景结合SEMMS变量选择获得稀疏模型。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但报告模拟和真实数据应用展示了良好的准确性-公平性表现，并建立了高斯和分类混合模型的可识别性和潜在类恢复结果，推导了残差化后预测能力损失的表达式。
Conclusion: 本文提出的框架在敏感属性潜在时仍能实现公平性约束，理论性质（可识别性、类恢复）和实证表现支持其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Task Alignment: A Simple Proxy for Practical Model Merging Across Diverse Vision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Efficiently merging several models fine-tuned for different tasks, but stemming from the same pretrained base model, is of great practical interest. Despite extensive prior work, most evaluations of model merging in computer vision are restricted to image classification using CLIP, where different classification datasets define different tasks. In this work, our goal is to make model merging more practical and show its relevance on challenging scenarios beyond this specific setting. In most vision scenarios, different tasks rely on trainable and usually heterogeneous decoders. Differently from previous studies with frozen decoders, where merged models can be evaluated right away, the non-trivial cost of decoder training renders hyperparameter selection based on downstream performance impractical. To address this, we introduce the task alignment proxy, and show how it can be used to speed up hyperparameter selection by orders of magnitude while retaining performance. Equipped with the task alignment proxy, we extend the applicability of model merging to multi-task vision models beyond CLIP-based classification. Project page: https://europe.naverlabs.com/task-alignment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出任务对齐代理（task alignment proxy）来加速多任务视觉模型合并中的超参数选择，使模型合并适用于除CLIP分类以外的复杂视觉场景。
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法在超参数调优时依赖下游性能评估，训练解码器成本高昂，限制了实用性。
Method: 引入任务对齐代理，通过代理指标近似下游性能，实现数量级加速的超参数选择。
Result: 代理方法在保持合并模型性能的同时，大幅降低超参数调优时间。
Conclusion: 任务对齐代理使模型合并能够扩展到更多样化的视觉任务，如多任务视觉模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Playing Along: Learning a Double-Agent Defender for Belief Steering via Theory of Mind
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) become the engine behind conversational systems, their ability to reason about the intentions and states of their dialogue partners (i.e., form and use a theory-of-mind, or ToM) becomes increasingly critical for safe interaction with potentially adversarial partners. We propose a novel privacy-themed ToM challenge, ToM for Steering Beliefs (ToM-SB), in which a defender must act as a Double Agent to steer the beliefs of an attacker with partial prior knowledge within a shared universe. To succeed on ToM-SB, the defender must engage with and form a ToM of the attacker, with a goal of fooling the attacker into believing they have succeeded in extracting sensitive information. We find that strong frontier models like Gemini3-Pro and GPT-5.4 struggle on ToM-SB, often failing to fool attackers in hard scenarios with partial attacker prior knowledge, even when prompted to reason about the attacker's beliefs (ToM prompting). To close this gap, we train models on ToM-SB to act as AI Double Agents using reinforcement learning, testing both fooling and ToM rewards. Notably, we find a bidirectionally emergent relationship between ToM and attacker-fooling: rewarding fooling success alone improves ToM, and rewarding ToM alone improves fooling. Across four attackers with different strengths, six defender methods, and both in-distribution and out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation, we find that gains in ToM and attacker-fooling are well-correlated, highlighting belief modeling as a key driver of success on ToM-SB. AI Double Agents that combine both ToM and fooling rewards yield the strongest fooling and ToM performance, outperforming Gemini3-Pro and GPT-5.4 with ToM prompting on hard scenarios. We also show that ToM-SB and AI Double Agents can be extended to stronger attackers, demonstrating generalization to OOD settings and the upgradability of our task.
papers.comment: First two authors contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/The-Inscrutable-X/AIDoubleAgentDefenders
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 ToM-SB 的隐私主题心理理论 (ToM) 挑战任务，要求防御者扮演双重代理，通过建立攻击者的心理模型来引导其信念，从而欺骗攻击者使其误以为成功提取了敏感信息。研究发现 Gemini3-Pro 和 GPT-5.4 等前沿模型在此任务上表现不佳，而通过强化学习训练的 AI 双重代理（结合欺骗奖励和 ToM 奖励）能显著提升性能，且 ToM 与欺骗能力呈双向涌现关系。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在对话系统中需要推理对话伙伴的意图与状态（即心理理论），以应对潜在对抗性交互中的安全挑战。现有模型在复杂场景下难以有效欺骗具有部分先验知识的攻击者。
Method: 设计 ToM-SB 任务，防御者需作为双重代理与攻击者交互；使用强化学习训练模型，分别采用欺骗奖励、ToM 奖励及其组合，并通过推理攻击者信念的提示（ToM prompting）进行比较。
Result: AI 双重代理结合 ToM 和欺骗奖励后，在困难场景下欺骗性能超越 Gemini3-Pro 和 GPT-5.4 的 ToM prompting 方法；ToM 与欺骗能力之间存在双向正相关关系。
Conclusion: 信念建模是 ToM-SB 任务成功的关键；所提方法可泛化到更强攻击者及分布外场景。

papers.title: Real-Time Human Reconstruction and Animation using Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We present HumanGS, a generalizable feed-forward Gaussian splatting framework for human 3D reconstruction and real-time animation from sparse multi-view RGB images and their associated SMPL-X poses. Unlike prior methods that rely on depth supervision, fixed input views, UV maps, repeated feed-forward inference for each target pose or view, or computationally expensive vertex-to-image cross-attention, HumanGS employs a simple transformer architecture that explicitly associates SMPL-X vertices with multi-scale image features through geometric back-projection. This eliminates the need for large pre-trained human representation models while naturally aggregating complementary information from multiple views. The aggregated vertex features are mapped by a lightweight MLP decoder to a canonical set of 3D Gaussian primitives aligned with SMPL-X vertices. One Gaussian is regularized to remain close to the SMPL-X surface, providing a strong geometric prior and stable correspondence to the parametric body model, while a small set of unconstrained Gaussians per vertex captures geometric details beyond the body surface, such as clothing and hair. The resulting canonical representation is animated efficiently using linear blend skinning and Gaussian rasterization without further network inference. Trained entirely from scratch on only 10K frames from THuman2.1, HumanGS achieves reconstruction quality comparable to or better than state-of-the-art methods while reducing reconstruction time by over 15 times compared to recent transformer-based approaches, enabling real-time animation and interactive applications. Code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/Devdoot57/HumanGS .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HumanGS 是一个基于前馈高斯溅射（feed-forward Gaussian splatting）的通用框架，用于从稀疏多视角 RGB 图像和 SMPL-X 姿态进行实时人体 3D 重建与动画。它通过简单的 Transformer 架构将 SMPL-X 顶点与多尺度图像特征关联，无需深度监督或 UV 图，训练仅用 THuman2.1 的 10K 帧，重建质量与 SOTA 相当，速度提升 15 倍以上。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖深度监督、固定视角、UV 图或重复前馈推理，计算成本高，难以实现实时动画。
Method: 提出一种 Transformer 架构，通过几何反投影显式关联 SMPL-X 顶点与多尺度图像特征，聚合多视角信息，再由 MLP 解码器映射为两组 3D 高斯原语：一组贴近 SMPL-X 表面提供几何先验，另一组无约束高斯捕获衣物等细节。动画通过线性混合蒙皮和高斯光栅化实现，无需额外推理。
Result: 在 THuman2.1 上训练，重建质量与 SOTA 相当或更优，重建时间比最近 Transformer 方法减少 15 倍以上，支持实时动画。
Conclusion: HumanGS 实现了无需预训练大模型的高效人体重建与动画，适合交互应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ELT: Elastic Looped Transformers for Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Elastic Looped Transformers (ELT), a highly parameter-efficient class of visual generative models based on a recurrent transformer architecture. While conventional generative models rely on deep stacks of unique transformer layers, our approach employs iterative, weight-shared transformer blocks to drastically reduce parameter counts while maintaining high synthesis quality. To effectively train these models for image and video generation, we propose the idea of Intra-Loop Self Distillation (ILSD), where student configurations (intermediate loops) are distilled from the teacher configuration (maximum training loops) to ensure consistency across the model's depth in a single training step. Our framework yields a family of elastic models from a single training run, enabling Any-Time inference capability with dynamic trade-offs between computational cost and generation quality, with the same parameter count. ELT significantly shifts the efficiency frontier for visual synthesis. With $4\times$ reduction in parameter count under iso-inference-compute settings, ELT achieves a competitive FID of $2.0$ on class-conditional ImageNet $256 \times 256$ and FVD of $72.8$ on class-conditional UCF-101.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出弹性循环Transformer（ELT），一种基于循环架构的高参数效率视觉生成模型。通过权重共享的循环Transformer块替代传统深层独立层，大幅减少参数数量。提出循环内自蒸馏（ILSD）方法，从最大循环的教师配置蒸馏到中间循环的学生配置，确保模型深度一致性。单一训练即可得到一组弹性模型，支持任意时刻推理，在计算量与生成质量间动态权衡。在类条件ImageNet 256×256上FID为2.0，UCF-101上FVD为72.8，参数数量减少4倍。
Motivation: 传统视觉生成模型依赖大量独立Transformer层，参数效率低，且难以在单一模型中实现计算量与质量的动态权衡。
Method: 采用权重共享的循环Transformer块作为核心架构，并提出循环内自蒸馏（ILSD）技术，在单次训练中从最大循环数配置蒸馏到较少循环数配置，保持不同深度下的一致性。
Result: 在类条件ImageNet 256×256上取得FID 2.0，在类条件UCF-101上取得FVD 72.8，参数数量减少4倍且推理计算量相当。
Conclusion: ELT展示了循环架构在视觉生成中的潜力，通过参数共享与蒸馏实现了高效且灵活的生成模型，但方法仅在图像和视频生成上验证，未涉及时序预测或气象领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ImplicitBBQ: Benchmarking Implicit Bias in Large Language Models through Characteristic Based Cues
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models increasingly suppress biased outputs when demographic identity is stated explicitly, yet may still exhibit implicit biases when identity is conveyed indirectly. Existing benchmarks use name based proxies to detect implicit biases, which carry weak associations with many social demographics and cannot extend to dimensions like age or socioeconomic status. We introduce ImplicitBBQ, a QA benchmark that evaluates implicit bias through characteristic based cues, demographically associated attributes that signal implicitly, across age, gender, region, religion, caste, and socioeconomic status. Evaluating 11 models, we find that implicit bias in ambiguous contexts is over six times higher than explicit bias in open weight models. Notably, this bias is distributed unevenly across demographics: caste emerges as the most severe while gender is the least affected. Safety prompting and chain-of-thought reasoning fail to substantially close this gap; even few-shot prompting, which reduces implicit bias by 79%, leaves caste bias at four times the level of any other dimension. These findings indicate that current alignment and prompting strategies address the surface of bias evaluation while leaving demographically associated stereotypic associations largely unresolved. We publicly release our code and dataset for model providers and researchers to benchmark potential mitigation techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ImplicitBBQ 基准测试，通过特征线索（characteristic based cues）评估大语言模型在性别、年龄、地区、宗教、种姓和社会经济地位等维度上的隐式偏见。实验发现，开放权重模型在模糊上下文中的隐式偏见比显式偏见高六倍以上，其中种姓偏见最严重，性别偏见最轻；安全提示和思维链推理效果有限，少样本提示虽然降低79%隐式偏见，但种姓偏见仍比其他维度高四倍。
Motivation: 现有偏见基准主要依赖名字代理来检测隐式偏见，但名字与众多社会人口特征的关联较弱，且无法扩展到年龄、社会经济地位等维度。
Method: 构建 QA 基准 ImplicitBBQ，使用人口统计学关联属性作为特征线索，在模糊语境中提示隐式偏见，覆盖六个社会维度。
Result: 11个模型评估表明，开放权重模型中隐式偏见是显式偏见的六倍以上；种姓偏见最严重，性别偏见最轻；安全提示和思维链效果有限，少样本提示虽降低79%隐式偏见，但种姓偏见仍比其他维度高四倍。
Conclusion: 当前的对齐和提示策略仅解决偏见评估的表面问题，未能消除人口统计学关联的刻板印象。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EZASP - Facilitating the Usage of ASP
papers.abstract_en: Answer Set Programming (ASP) is a declarative programming language used for modeling and solving complex combinatorial problems. It has been successfully applied to a number of different real-world problems. However, learning its usage can prove challenging as the declarative language, from a conceptual perspective, differs substantially from imperative programming, and programs are not required to adhere to any particular structure, offering arguably almost too much freedom for a beginner. Recently, a new methodology called Easy Answer Set Programming (Easy ASP) has been introduced that aims to aid in this learning process by focussing on a well-defined fragment of the ASP language and introducing additional structure to the programs. However, while this methodology can indeed be employed, to the best of our knowledge, no tool integrates its features currently. In this paper, we present EZASP, a Visual Studio Code extension designed to support the development of ASP programs following the Easy ASP methodology. It covers and extends the language fragment of Easy ASP and provides the user with warnings in the case of deviations from the methodology as well as the possibility to automatically reorder the program. Complementarily, it also adds syntax error highlighting, including detection of non-safe variables directly while editing, and configurability, as all features can be optionally disabled. A small user study in the context of university teaching suggests that these features are benefitial for both new and experienced users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了EZASP，一个Visual Studio Code扩展，旨在支持Easy Answer Set Programming (Easy ASP)方法，帮助用户编写ASP程序。该扩展实现了Easy ASP语言片段并进行了扩展，提供偏离方法的警告、自动程序重排功能，以及语法错误高亮和非安全变量检测。在课堂教学中的小规模用户研究表明，这些功能对新用户和有经验用户均有帮助。
Motivation: ASP是一种声明式编程语言，但学习难度大，特别是对于初学者，缺乏结构化和工具支持。Easy ASP方法虽然旨在缓解这一问题，但缺乏集成工具。
Method: 开发了一个VSCode扩展，集成Easy ASP方法并扩展其语言片段，提供实时警告、自动程序重排、语法错误高亮和非安全变量检测等功能，且所有功能可选关闭。
Result: 在课堂教学中的小规模用户研究表明，该扩展的上述功能对新用户和有经验用户都是有益的。
Conclusion: EZASP扩展能够辅助ASP编程学习，通过提供结构指导和实时反馈来降低入门难度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gumbel Distillation for Parallel Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: The slow, sequential nature of autoregressive (AR) language models has driven the adoption of parallel decoding methods. However, these non-AR models often sacrifice generation quality as they struggle to model the complex joint distribution of token sequences. To narrow this performance gap, we introduce Gumbel Distillation, a novel distillation technique that enables parallel decoders to learn this distribution effectively. Our method leverages the Gumbel-Max trick to create a deterministic mapping from a latent Gumbel noise space to the output tokens of a high-performing AR teacher. As a model-agnostic technique, Gumbel Distillation seamlessly integrates with diverse parallel decoding architectures, including MDLM and BD3-LM. Experiments on LM1B and OpenWebText show that Gumbel Distillation substantially improves the generation quality of parallel language models, achieving a 30.0% improvement in MAUVE score and 10.5% in generative perplexity over MDLM trained on OpenWebText dataset. Code available at https://github.com/hxixixh/gumbel-distill.

papers.title: Lessons and Open Questions from a Unified Study of Camera-Trap Species Recognition Over Time
papers.abstract_en: Camera traps are vital for large-scale biodiversity monitoring, yet accurate automated analysis remains challenging due to diverse deployment environments. While the computer vision community has mostly framed this challenge as cross-domain generalization, this perspective overlooks a primary challenge faced by ecological practitioners: maintaining reliable recognition at the fixed site over time, where the dynamic nature of ecosystems introduces profound temporal shifts in both background and animal distributions. To bridge this gap, we present the first unified study of camera-trap species recognition over time. We introduce a realistic benchmark comprising 546 camera traps with a streaming protocol that evaluates models over chronologically ordered intervals. Our end-user-centric study yields four key findings. (1) Biological foundation models (e.g., BioCLIP 2) underperform at numerous sites even in initial intervals, underscoring the necessity of site-specific adaptation. (2) Adaptation is challenging under realistic evaluation: when models are updated using past data and evaluated on future intervals (mirrors real deployment lifecycles), naive adaptation can even degrade below zero-shot performance. (3) We identify two drivers of this difficulty: severe class imbalance and pronounced temporal shift in both species distribution and backgrounds between consecutive intervals. (4) We find that effective integration of model-update and post-processing techniques can largely improve accuracy, though a gap from the upper bounds remains. Finally, we highlight critical open questions, such as predicting when zero-shot models will succeed at a new site and determining whether/when model updates are necessary. Our benchmark and analysis provide actionable deployment guidelines for ecological practitioners while establishing new directions for future research in vision and machine learning.
papers.comment: The first three authors contribute equally. Accepted by ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次统一研究了相机陷阱物种识别随时间变化的问题。作者构建了一个包含546个相机陷阱的基准，采用流式协议按时间顺序评估模型。研究发现：生物基础模型（如BioCLIP 2）在众多站点初始阶段即表现不佳，需要站点特定适配；在现实评估中，简单使用历史数据更新模型可能导致性能低于零样本；类不平衡和物种分布及背景的时间漂移是主要挑战；集成模型更新和后处理可提升准确率，但仍存在上限差距。最后提出了若干开放问题。
Motivation: 现有计算机视觉研究主要将相机陷阱物种识别视为跨域泛化问题，但实践中生态学家面临的主要挑战是固定站点随时间推移的识别可靠性问题，生态系统动态导致背景和动物分布随时间剧烈变化。该问题尚未被系统研究。
Method: 提出了一个包含546个相机陷阱的基准，采用流式协议按时间顺序划分区间评估模型。研究了零样本、基于过去数据的模型更新（模拟实际部署生命周期）以及多种后处理技术，并分析了类不平衡和时间漂移的影响。
Result: 生物基础模型（BioCLIP 2）在众多站点初始区间即表现不佳；朴素更新策略可能导致性能低于零样本；识别出类不平衡和时间漂移是主要困难因素；集成模型更新与后处理可显著提升准确率，但仍无法达到上限。
Conclusion: 强调了站点特定适配的必要性，提出了预测零样本模型何时在新站点成功、以及判断是否需要模型更新等开放问题。为生态实践者提供了部署指南，并为视觉和机器学习研究指出了新方向。

papers.title: Evolutionarily Stable Stackelberg Equilibrium
papers.abstract_en: We present a new solution concept called evolutionarily stable Stackelberg equilibrium (SESS). We study the Stackelberg evolutionary game setting in which there is a single leading player and a symmetric population of followers. The leader selects an optimal mixed strategy, anticipating that the follower population plays an evolutionarily stable strategy (ESS) in the induced subgame and may satisfy additional ecological conditions. We consider both leader-optimal and leader-pessimal selection among ESSs, which arise as special cases of our framework. Prior approaches to Stackelberg evolutionary games either define the follower response via evolutionary dynamics or assume rational best-response behavior, without explicitly enforcing stability against invasion by mutations. We present algorithms for computing SESS in discrete and continuous games, and validate the latter empirically. Our model applies naturally to biological settings; for example, in cancer treatment the leader represents the physician and the followers correspond to competing cancer cell phenotypes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的解概念——进化稳定Stackelberg均衡（SESS），研究在一个领导者与对称跟随者种群构成的Stackelberg进化博弈中，领导者选择最优混合策略，跟随者种群在诱导子博弈中采用进化稳定策略（ESS）并可能满足额外生态条件。作者给出了离散和连续博弈中SESS的计算算法，并进行了经验验证，该模型适用于生物场景如癌症治疗。
Motivation: 现有Stackelberg进化博弈方法要么通过进化动力学定义跟随者响应，要么假设理性最佳响应行为，但未明确强制执行对突变入侵的稳定性。
Method: 定义SESS概念，考虑领导者最优和领导者最差两种ESS选择，并设计算法在离散和连续博弈中计算SESS。
Result: 算法能够有效计算SESS，并通过经验验证了其在连续博弈中的有效性。
Conclusion: SESS为进化博弈中的领导者-跟随者交互提供了稳定性保障，尤其适用于生物学场景（如癌症治疗中医生与癌细胞的博弈）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PISmith: Reinforcement Learning-based Red Teaming for Prompt Injection Defenses
papers.abstract_en: Prompt injection poses serious security risks to real-world LLM applications, particularly autonomous agents. Although many defenses have been proposed, their robustness against adaptive attacks remains insufficiently evaluated, potentially creating a false sense of security. In this work, we propose PISmith, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based red-teaming framework that systematically assesses existing prompt-injection defenses by training an attack LLM to optimize injected prompts in a practical black-box setting, where the attacker can only query the defended LLM and observe its outputs. We find that directly applying standard GRPO to attack strong defenses leads to sub-optimal performance due to extreme reward sparsity -- most generated injected prompts are blocked by the defense, causing the policy's entropy to collapse before discovering effective attack strategies, while the rare successes cannot be learned effectively. In response, we introduce adaptive entropy regularization and dynamic advantage weighting to sustain exploration and amplify learning from scarce successes. Extensive evaluation on 13 benchmarks demonstrates that state-of-the-art prompt injection defenses remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks. We also compare PISmith with 7 baselines across static, search-based, and RL-based attack categories, showing that PISmith consistently achieves the highest attack success rates. Furthermore, PISmith achieves strong performance in agentic settings on InjecAgent and AgentDojo against both open-source and closed-source LLMs (e.g., GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5-nano). Our code is available at https://github.com/albert-y1n/PISmith.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PISmith，一个基于强化学习的红队测试框架，用于系统评估现有提示注入防御的鲁棒性。该框架在实用的黑盒设置下训练攻击LLM优化注入的提示。针对标准GRPO在强防御下奖励稀疏导致策略熵崩溃的问题，引入自适应熵正则化和动态优势加权以维持探索并放大从稀有机会中的学习。在13个基准测试上的广泛评估表明，最先进的提示注入防御仍易受自适应攻击，PISmith在静态、搜索和RL攻击方法中持续取得最高的攻击成功率。
Motivation: 现有提示注入防御的鲁棒性未得到充分评估，可能造成虚假的安全感；标准RL方法在稀疏奖励下难以有效攻击强防御。
Method: 提出PISmith框架，基于GRPO，结合自适应熵正则化和动态优势加权，以应对极端奖励稀疏性，在仅能查询防御LLM输出的黑盒设置下训练攻击模型。
Result: 在13个基准上，PISmith在攻击成功率上一致优于7种基线（包括静态、搜索和RL方法），并在InjecAgent和AgentDojo等代理设置中对开源/闭源LLM（如GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5-nano）达到强性能。
Conclusion: 现有提示注入防御仍然脆弱，PISmith提供了一种有效的自适应攻击评估方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LinearARD: Linear-Memory Attention Distillation for RoPE Restoration
papers.abstract_en: The extension of context windows in Large Language Models is typically facilitated by scaling positional encodings followed by lightweight Continual Pre-Training (CPT). While effective for processing long sequences, this paradigm often disrupts original model capabilities, leading to performance degradation on standard short-text benchmarks. We propose LinearARD, a self-distillation method that restores Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE)-scaled students through attention-structure consistency with a frozen native-RoPE teacher. Rather than matching opaque hidden states, LinearARD aligns the row-wise distributions of dense $Q/Q$, $K/K$, and $V/V$ self-relation matrices to directly supervise attention dynamics. To overcome the quadratic memory bottleneck of $n \times n$ relation maps, we introduce a linear-memory kernel. This kernel leverages per-token log-sum-exp statistics and fuses logit recomputation into the backward pass to compute exact Kullback-Leibler divergence and gradients. On LLaMA2-7B extended from 4K to 32K, LinearARD recovers 98.3\% of the short-text performance of state-of-the-art baselines while surpassing them on long-context benchmarks. Notably, our method achieves these results using only \textbf{4.25M} training tokens compared to the \textbf{256M} tokens required by LongReD and CPT. Our code is available at https://github.com/gracefulning/LinearARD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LinearARD，一种自蒸馏方法，通过注意力结构一致性恢复RoPE缩放后的学生模型，并引入线性内存核克服二次内存瓶颈。在LLaMA2-7B上从4K扩展到32K上下文时，仅用4.25M训练token即恢复98.3%的短文本性能，同时在长上下文基准上超越基线。
Motivation: 现有通过缩放位置编码后轻量CPT扩展上下文窗口的方法常破坏原始模型能力，导致短文本性能下降。
Method: LinearARD采用冻结native-RoPE教师与学生模型对齐Q/Q、K/K、V/V自关系矩阵的行分布，而非匹配隐状态；利用线性内存核每token的log-sum-exp统计并在反向传播中融合logit重计算，精确计算KL散度及梯度。
Result: 在LLaMA2-7B从4K扩展至32K的实验上，LinearARD恢复短文本性能达基线的98.3%，并超越长上下文基线；仅需4.25M训练token，对比LongReD和CPT需256M token。
Conclusion: LinearARD通过注意力结构一致性和线性内存核有效恢复RoPE缩放模型的原有能力，显著降低训练数据需求。

papers.title: QATMA: Quantization-Aware Training with Multimodal Alignment for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Quantizing open-vocabulary object detection (OVOD) models reduces their memory and computational costs, but extremely low-bit quantization severely degrades both cross-modal (region-text) and intra-modal (region-region) alignments. This multimodal degradation is a unique challenge that prior quantization methods for closed-vocabulary detectors fail to resolve. To overcome this, we propose Quantization-Aware Training with Multimodal Alignment (QATMA), the first multimodal-aware and architecture-agnostic QAT framework tailored for OVOD. QATMA integrates two key components: (i) Curriculum QAT, which partitions the detector by functional roles and progressively expands the quantization scope to suppress error accumulation and ensure stable optimization; and (ii) Text-anchored Pairwise Similarity Distillation, which transfers both region-text and region-region alignments from a full-precision teacher model via pairwise cosine similarities in the joint embedding space. Experimental results on LVIS and COCO zero-shot benchmarks demonstrate that QATMA significantly outperforms existing QAT baselines under extremely low-bit settings, achieving gains of up to 4.3 and 7.6 AP, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QATMA，首个面向开放词汇目标检测（OVOD）的多模态感知量化感知训练框架。针对低比特量化导致跨模态和模态内对齐退化的问题，QATMA引入课程式量化感知训练（Curriculum QAT）和文本锚定的成对相似性蒸馏（Text-anchored Pairwise Similarity Distillation）。在LVIS和COCO零样本基准上，极低比特设置下AP提升最高达4.3和7.6。
Motivation: 现有量化方法无法解决开放词汇目标检测中低比特量化导致的跨模态（区域-文本）和模态内（区域-区域）对齐退化问题，这是封闭词汇检测器不存在的新挑战。
Method: 提出QATMA框架，包含两个组件：课程式量化感知训练（按功能角色划分检测器并逐步扩大量化范围以抑制误差累积）和文本锚定的成对相似性蒸馏（通过联合嵌入空间中的成对余弦相似度从全精度教师模型迁移区域-文本和区域-区域对齐）。
Result: 在LVIS和COCO零样本基准上，极低比特设置下QATMA显著优于现有量化感知训练基线，AP增益分别达4.3和7.6。
Conclusion: QATMA是首个针对开放词汇目标检测的多模态感知量化框架，能有效缓解低比特量化带来的对齐退化问题。

papers.title: VPWEM: Non-Markovian Visuomotor Policy with Working and Episodic Memory
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning from human demonstrations has achieved significant success in robotic control, yet most visuomotor policies still condition on single-step observations or short-context histories, making them struggle with non-Markovian tasks that require long-term memory. Simply enlarging the context window incurs substantial computational and memory costs and encourages overfitting to spurious correlations, leading to catastrophic failures under distribution shift and violating real-time constraints in robotic systems. By contrast, humans can compress important past experiences into long-term memories and exploit them to solve tasks throughout their lifetime. In this paper, we propose VPWEM, a non-Markovian visuomotor policy equipped with working and episodic memories. VPWEM retains a sliding window of recent observation embeddings as short-term working memory, and introduces a Transformer-based contextual memory compressor that recursively converts out-of-window observations into a fixed number of episodic memory embeddings. The compressor uses self-attention over a cache of past summary embeddings and cross-attention over a cache of historical observations, and is trained jointly with the policy. We instantiate VPWEM on diffusion policies to exploit both short-term and episode-wide information for action generation with nearly constant memory and computation per step. Experiments demonstrate that VPWEM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines including diffusion policies and vision-language-action (VLA) models by more than 20\% on the memory-intensive manipulation tasks in MIKASA and achieves an average 5\% improvement on the mobile manipulation benchmark MoMaRT. Code is available at https://github.com/HarryLui98/code_vpwem.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). \textcopyright 2026 IEEE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VPWEM，一种配备工作记忆与情景记忆的非马尔可夫视觉运动策略，用于机器人模仿学习。工作记忆保留最近观察的滑动窗口，情景记忆通过Transformer压缩器将历史观察递归编码为固定数量的记忆嵌入，策略以近似恒定的每步计算和内存开销生成动作。在MIKASA记忆密集型操作任务上，VPWEM优于扩散策略和VLA模型超过20%，在MoMaRT移动操作基准上平均提升5%。
Motivation: 现有视觉运动策略通常仅依赖单步观测或短上下文历史，难以处理需要长期记忆的非马尔可夫任务。单纯增大上下文窗口会导致计算和内存成本激增，并易过拟合虚假相关，在分布偏移下灾难性失败，不满足机器人实时性要求。
Method: VPWEM包含两个记忆模块：工作记忆（滑动窗口存储近期观测嵌入）和情景记忆（Transformer压缩器）。压缩器通过自注意力处理历史概要缓存、交叉注意力处理历史观测缓存，递归地将窗口外观测压缩为固定数量的情景记忆嵌入，并联合策略进行端到端训练。实例化为扩散策略，每步内存和计算开销近似恒定。
Result: 在MIKASA基准的记忆密集型操作任务上，VPWEM超越扩散策略与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型基线超过20%；在MoMaRT移动操作基准上平均改进5%。
Conclusion: VPWEM通过工作记忆与情景记忆的协同，使策略能利用整个任务周期的信息而无需显著增加每步计算量，有效解决非马尔可夫机器人控制问题。

papers.title: Post-Hoc Reasoning in Chain of Thought: Decoding and Steering Pre-Committed Answers
papers.abstract_en: As chain of thought (CoT) has become central to scaling reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs), it has also emerged as a promising tool for interpretability, suggesting the opportunity to understand model decisions through verbalized reasoning. However, the utility of CoT toward interpretability depends upon its faithfulness---whether the model's stated reasoning reflects the underlying decision process. We provide mechanistic evidence that instruction-tuned models often determine their answer before generating CoT. Training linear probes on residual stream activations at the last token before CoT, we can predict the model's final answer with >0.9 AUC on most tasks. We find that these directions are not only predictive, but also causal: steering activations along the probe direction often flips model answers, with flip rates substantially exceeding norm-matched orthogonal baselines across most model-dataset pairs. When steering induces incorrect answers, we observe two distinct failure modes: confabulation (fabricating false premises) and non-entailment (stating correct premises but drawing unsupported conclusions). While post-hoc reasoning may be instrumentally useful when the model has a correct pre-CoT belief, these failure modes suggest it can result in undesirable behaviors when reasoning from a false belief.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过机制性证据表明，指令微调的大语言模型在生成思维链（CoT）之前就已确定答案。在CoT之前最后一个token的残差流上训练线性探针，可以高准确率（AUC>0.9）预测最终答案，且沿探针方向操纵激活可因果翻转答案，翻转率显著高于基线。翻转导致两种失败模式：捏造虚假前提和不蕴含（正确前提但推出无支持结论），表明CoT可能是后验合理化。
Motivation: 思维链（CoT）被广泛用于提升推理能力和模型可解释性，但其忠实性——即模型表述的推理是否反映真实决策过程——尚未得到充分验证。本文旨在探究CoT是否是后验合理化。
Method: 在CoT之前最后一个token的残差流上训练线性探针来预测最终答案，并通过沿探针方向操纵激活来验证预测方向的因果作用，使用规范匹配的正交激活作为基线。
Result: 在大多数任务上，探针预测答案的AUC超过0.9；沿探针方向操纵激活可显著翻转模型答案，翻转率高于基线。翻转导致两种失败模式：捏造（编造错误前提）和不蕴含（正确前提但推导无根据结论）。
Conclusion: CoT可能是后验合理化，当模型在CoT前有正确信念时有用，但若从错误信念推理则会导致不良行为。这限制了CoT作为可解释性工具的可靠性和可信度。

papers.title: AG-REPA: Causal Layer Selection for Representation Alignment in Audio Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: REPresentation Alignment (REPA) improves the training of generative flow models by aligning intermediate hidden states with pretrained teacher features, but its effectiveness in token-conditioned audio Flow Matching critically depends on the choice of supervised layers, which is typically made heuristically based on the depth. In this work, we introduce Attribution-Guided REPresentation Alignment (AG-REPA), a novel causal layer selection strategy for representation alignment in audio Flow Matching. Firstly, we find that layers that best store semantic/acoustic information (high teacher-space similarity) are not necessarily the layers that contribute most to the velocity field that drives generation, and we call it Store-Contribute Dissociation (SCD). To turn this insight into an actionable training guidance, we propose a forward-only gate ablation (FoG-A) that quantifies each layer's causal contribution via the induced change in the predicted velocity field, enabling sparse layer selection and adaptive weighting for alignment. Across unified speech and general-audio training (LibriSpeech + AudioSet) under different token-conditioning topologies, AG-REPA consistently outperforms REPA baselines. Overall, our results show that alignment is most effective when applied to the causally dominant layers that drive the velocity field, rather than to layers that are representationally rich but functionally passive.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. 17 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AG-REPA，一种基于因果归因的层选择策略，用于音频流匹配（Flow Matching）中的表征对齐。发现存储语义/声学信息的层不一定是驱动生成速度场的因果主导层（存储-贡献解耦现象），并设计了前向门控消融（FoG-A）来量化各层的因果贡献，实现稀疏层选择和自适应加权。在LibriSpeech和AudioSet上的统一语音与通用音频训练中，AG-REPA优于REPA基线。
Motivation: REPA在音频流匹配中的有效性关键取决于监督层的选择，但传统选择基于深度启发式，缺乏理论依据。
Method: 提出因果层选择策略AG-REPA，包括：1）发现存储-贡献解耦（SCD）现象；2）设计前向门控消融（FoG-A）量化各层对速度场的因果贡献；3）基于因果贡献进行稀疏层选择和自适应加权。
Result: 在LibriSpeech和AudioSet上，AG-REPA在不同token条件拓扑下一致优于REPA基线，表明对齐应施加于因果主导层而非表征丰富但功能被动的层。
Conclusion: 对齐最有效的方式是施加于驱动速度场的因果主导层，而非仅基于表征相似性选择的层。

papers.title: Benchmarking Unlearning for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning (MU) refers to the post-training capability to remove (the influence of) training examples that are incorrect, biased, or leak sensitive/private information. MU is now widely regarded as critical for building safe and fair AI. In parallel, research into transformer architectures for computer vision has been highly successful: Vision Transformers (VTs) increasingly emerge as strong alternatives to CNNs. Yet, MU research for vision tasks has largely centered on CNNs, not VTs. While MU benchmarks have been developed for LLMs, diffusion models, and CNNs, none currently exist for VTs. This work is the first to attempt this, benchmarking MU algorithm performance across different VT families (ViT, Swin-T, and DINOv2) and at different capacities. The work employs (i) different datasets, selected to assess the impacts of dataset scale and complexity; (ii) different MU algorithms, selected to represent fundamentally different approaches for MU; and (iii) both single-shot and continual unlearning protocols. Additionally, it focuses on benchmarking MU algorithms that leverage training data memorization, since leveraging memorization has been recently discovered to significantly improve the performance of previously SOTA algorithms. En route, the work characterizes how VTs memorize training data relative to CNNs, and assesses the impact of different memorization proxies on performance. The benchmark uses unified evaluation metrics that capture two complementary notions of forget quality along with accuracy on unseen (test) data and on retained data. Overall, this work offers a benchmarking basis, enabling reproducible, fair, and comprehensive comparisons of existing (and future) MU algorithms on VTs. Importantly, for the first time, it sheds light on how well existing algorithms work in VT settings, establishing a promising reference performance baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次为视觉Transformer（VT）建立机器遗忘（MU）基准测试，涵盖ViT、Swin-T和DINOv2等多种结构，使用不同数据集、MU算法（包括单次和持续遗忘协议），并重点评估利用训练数据记忆化的MU算法。实验通过统一的遗忘质量、测试集准确率、保留数据准确率等指标进行比较，揭示了现有算法在VT上的表现，为后续研究提供了可复现的基准。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘研究主要集中在CNN、LLM和扩散模型上，缺乏针对视觉Transformer的基准测试，而VT正逐渐成为CNN的强替代品。
Method: 构建基准测试框架，选择ViT、Swin-T、DINOv2三类VT架构，采用不同规模和复杂度的数据集，选取代表性的MU算法（包括利用记忆化的算法），在单次和持续遗忘协议下进行实验，使用统一评估指标。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称首次揭示了现有MU算法在VT上的表现，并建立了有参考价值的性能基线。
Conclusion: 本文为VT上的机器遗忘研究提供了系统基准，支持可重复、公平的比较，并指出利用记忆化的MU算法改进了之前SOTA的性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Diagnosing Pathological Chain-of-Thought in Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is fundamental to modern LLM architectures and represents a critical intervention point for AI safety. However, CoT reasoning may exhibit failure modes that we note as pathologies, which prevent it from being useful for monitoring. Prior work has identified three distinct pathologies: post-hoc rationalization, where models generate plausible explanations backwards from predetermined answers; encoded reasoning, where intermediate steps conceal information within seemingly interpretable text; and internalized reasoning, where models replace explicit reasoning with meaningless filler tokens while computing internally. To better understand and discriminate between these pathologies, we create a set of concrete metrics that are simple to implement, computationally inexpensive, and task-agnostic. To validate our approach, we develop model organisms deliberately trained to exhibit specific CoT pathologies. Our work provides a practical toolkit for assessing CoT pathologies, with direct implications for training-time monitoring.

papers.title: StackingNet: Collective Inference Across Independent AI Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence built on large foundation models has transformed language understanding, computer vision, and reasoning, yet these systems remain isolated and cannot readily share their capabilities. Coordinating the complementary strengths of independently developed, black-box foundation models is essential for trustworthy intelligent systems, yet no established method exists. Here we show that such coordination can be achieved through a meta-ensemble framework termed StackingNet, which aggregates the output predictions of independent models at inference. StackingNet improves accuracy, reduces individual-model error and group-wise disparities, ranks model reliability, and identifies or prunes models that degrade performance, all without access to internal parameters or training data. Across language comprehension, visual attribute estimation, and academic paper rating, it consistently outperforms individual models and classic ensembles, with gains that persist when the base models are uniformly strong. These gains stem from variance reduction and consensus alignment among independent models rather than from any emergent group cognition, and they widen as the model pool grows more diverse. By turning model diversity from a source of inconsistency into a resource for cooperation, StackingNet offers a practical path toward coordinated artificial intelligence, where progress emerges not only from larger single models but from principled cooperation among many specialized ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StackingNet，一种元集成框架，通过在推理时聚合多个独立黑盒基础模型的输出预测，实现模型间的协调。该方法在不访问内部参数或训练数据的情况下，提升了准确性、减少了个体模型误差和群体差异，并对模型可靠性进行排序。在语言理解、视觉属性估计和学术论文评级任务中，StackingNet持续优于单个模型和经典集成方法，且增益随着模型池多样性增加而扩大。
Motivation: 现有独立发展的基础模型能力互补但无法直接共享，缺乏有效的协调方法，限制了可信智能系统的构建。
Method: 提出StackingNet元集成框架，在推理时聚合多个独立黑盒基础模型的输出预测，无需内部参数或训练数据。
Result: 在语言理解、视觉属性估计和学术论文评级任务中，StackingNet consistently 优于单个模型和经典集成，准确性提升，个体误差和群体差异减小，模型可靠性可排序。增益源于方差缩减和共识对齐，且随模型多样性增加而扩大。
Conclusion: StackingNet将模型多样性从不一致来源转化为合作资源，为实现基于原则性合作的多专门模型协调智能提供了实用路径。

papers.title: Wireless TokenCom: RL-Based Tokenizer Agreement for Multi-User Wireless Token Communications
papers.abstract_en: Token Communications (TokenCom) has recently emerged as an effective new paradigm, where tokens are the unified units of multimodal communications and computations, enabling efficient digital semantic- and goal-oriented communications in future wireless networks. To establish a shared semantic latent space, the transmitters/receivers in TokenCom need to agree on an identical tokenizer model and codebook. To this end, an initial Tokenizer Agreement (TA) process is carried out in each communication episode, where the transmitter/receiver cooperate to choose from a set of pre-trained tokenizer models/ codebooks available to them both for efficient TokenCom. In this correspondence, we investigate TA in a multi-user downlink wireless TokenCom scenario, where the base station equipped with multiple antennas transmits video token streams to multiple users. We formulate the corresponding mixed-integer non-convex problem, and propose a hybrid reinforcement learning (RL) framework that integrates a deep Q-network (DQN) for joint tokenizer agreement and sub-channel assignment, with a deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) for beamforming. Simulation results show that the proposed framework outperforms baseline methods in terms of semantic quality and resource efficiency, while reducing the freezing events in video transmission by 68% compared to the conventional H.265-based scheme.

TL;DR: 本文研究多用户下行无线令牌通信中的令牌协商问题，提出一种混合强化学习框架，结合深度Q网络（DQN）进行联合令牌协商和子信道分配，以及深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）进行波束赋形。仿真结果显示，该框架在语义质量和资源效率上优于基线方法，并将视频传输中的冻结事件相比传统H.265方案减少68%。
Motivation: 令牌通信（TokenCom）中，发射机和接收机需要共享相同的分词器模型和码本，因此需要在每次通信会话中执行令牌协商（TA）过程。现有研究未考虑多用户场景下的TA问题，本文针对多用户下行链路场景提出解决方案。
Method: 将多用户下行令牌协商问题建模为混合整数非凸优化问题，并提出混合强化学习框架：DQN负责联合令牌协商和子信道分配，DDPG负责波束赋形。
Result: 仿真结果表明，所提框架在语义质量和资源效率上优于基线方法，相比传统H.265方案，视频传输中的冻结事件减少68%。
Conclusion: 所提混合强化学习框架能有效解决多用户无线令牌通信中的令牌协商问题，提升语义通信性能。

papers.title: OmniCustom: Sync Audio-Video Customization Via Joint Audio-Video Generation Model
papers.abstract_en: Existing mainstream video customization methods focus on generating identity-consistent videos based on given reference images and textual prompts. Benefiting from the rapid advancement of joint audio-video generation, this paper proposes a more compelling new task: sync audio-video customization, which aims to synchronously customize both video identity and audio timbre. Specifically, given a reference image $I^{r}$ and a reference audio $A^{r}$, this novel task requires generating videos that maintain the identity of the reference image while imitating the timbre of the reference audio, with spoken content freely specifiable through user-provided textual prompts. To this end, we propose OmniCustom, a powerful DiT-based audio-video customization framework that can synthesize a video following reference image identity, audio timbre, and text prompts all at once in a zero-shot manner. Our framework is built on three key contributions. First, identity and audio timbre control are achieved through separate reference identity and audio LoRA modules that operate through self-attention layers within the base audio-video generation model. Second, we introduce a contrastive learning objective alongside the standard flow matching objective. It uses predicted flows conditioned on reference inputs as positive examples and those without reference conditions as negative examples, thereby enhancing the model ability to preserve identity and timbre. Third, we train OmniCustom on our constructed large-scale, high-quality audio-visual human dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniCustom outperforms existing methods in generating audio-video content with consistent identity and timbre fidelity. Project page: https://omnicustom-project.github.io/page/.

TL;DR: 本文提出同步音频-视频定制化（sync audio-video customization）新任务：给定参考图像和参考音频，生成保持图像身份并模仿音频音色的视频，说话内容由文本提示指定。提出OmniCustom框架，基于DiT架构，通过身份和音频LoRA模块、对比学习目标以及大规模音视频人类数据集训练，实现零样本同步定制。实验表明该方法在身份和音色保真度上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有视频定制化主要依赖参考图像和文本，缺乏对音频音色的同步定制能力，无法满足需要同时控制视觉身份和听觉音色的应用需求。
Method: 基于DiT的音频-视频生成模型，引入三个关键贡献：1）通过分离的参考身份LoRA和音频LoRA模块在自注意力层实现身份和音色控制；2）在标准流匹配目标基础上增加对比学习损失，以预测流作为正例、无参考条件的流作为负例，增强保真度；3）在大规模高质量音视频人类数据集上训练。
Result: 实验表明，OmniCustom在生成身份和音色一致的音频-视频内容上优于现有方法，实现了零样本的同步定制。
Conclusion: 本文证明了同步音频-视频定制化的可行性和有效性，为多模态生成提供了新方向。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Recommendation System: End-To-End Autonomous Model Optimization With LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing large-scale machine learning systems, such as recommendation models for global video platforms, requires navigating a massive hyperparameter search space and, more critically, designing sophisticated optimizers, architectures, and reward functions to capture nuanced user behaviors. Achieving substantial improvements in these areas is a non-trivial task, traditionally relying on extensive manual iterations to test new hypotheses. We propose a self-evolving system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically those from Google's Gemini family, to autonomously generate, train, and deploy high-performing, complex model changes within an end-to-end automated workflow. The self-evolving system is comprised of an Offline Agent (Inner Loop) that performs high-throughput hypothesis generation using proxy metrics, and an Online Agent (Outer Loop) that validates candidates against delayed north star business metrics in live production. Our agents act as specialized Machine Learning Engineers (MLEs): they exhibit deep reasoning capabilities, discovering novel improvements in optimization algorithms and model architecture, and formulating innovative reward functions that target long-term user engagement. The effectiveness of this approach is demonstrated through several successful production launches at YouTube, confirming that autonomous, LLM-driven evolution can surpass traditional engineering workflows in both development velocity and model performance.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自演化推荐系统，利用 LLM（Gemini）代理自动生成、训练和部署复杂的模型改进，包括优化器、架构和奖励函数。系统包含离线代理（内循环）和在线代理（外循环），在 YouTube 上成功上线，证明 LLM 驱动的自主进化在开发速度和模型性能上超越传统工程流程。
Motivation: 大规模机器学习系统（如推荐模型）的优化依赖大量手动迭代来测试新假设，效率低下。
Method: 构建自演化系统：离线代理基于代理指标进行高通量假设生成，在线代理在生产环境中根据延迟的北星业务指标验证候选方案；代理扮演专业机器学习工程师角色，具备深度推理能力。
Result: 在 YouTube 成功上线多次，证实自主 LLM 驱动进化在开发速度和模型性能上优于传统工程流程。
Conclusion: 该系统展示了利用 LLM 代理实现端到端自动模型优化的可行性和有效性，可超越人工迭代。

papers.title: Multimodal Learning for Arcing Detection in Pantograph-Catenary Systems
papers.abstract_en: The pantograph-catenary interface is essential for ensuring uninterrupted and reliable power delivery in electrified rail systems. However, electrical arcing at this interface poses serious risks, including accelerated wear of contact components, degraded system performance, and potential service disruptions. Detecting arcing events at the pantograph-catenary interface is challenging due to their transient nature, noisy operating environment, data scarcity, and the difficulty of distinguishing arcs from other similar transient phenomena. To address these challenges, we propose a novel multimodal framework that combines high-resolution image data with force measurements to more accurately and robustly detect arcing events. First, we construct two arcing detection datasets comprising synchronized visual and force measurements. One dataset is built from data provided by the Swiss Federal Railways (SBB), and the other is derived from publicly available videos of arcing events in different railway systems and synthetic force data that mimic the characteristics observed in the real dataset. Leveraging these datasets, we propose MultiDeepSAD, an extension of the DeepSAD algorithm for multiple modalities with a new loss formulation. Additionally, we introduce tailored pseudo-anomaly generation techniques specific to each data type, such as synthetic arc-like artifacts in images and simulated force irregularities, to augment training data and improve the discriminative ability of the model. Through extensive experiments and ablation studies, we demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms baseline approaches, exhibiting enhanced sensitivity to real arcing events even under domain shifts and limited availability of real arcing observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对受电弓-接触网系统中电弧检测的难点（瞬态性、噪声、数据稀缺、难以区分相似瞬态现象），提出一个多模态框架，融合高分辨率图像和力测量数据，结合新的损失函数扩展DeepSAD算法（MultiDeepSAD），并设计针对不同数据类型的伪异常生成技术。实验表明该方法在真实数据集和跨域场景下显著优于基线，对真实电弧事件具有高敏感性。
Motivation: 受电弓-接触网接口的电弧检测对铁路系统安全至关重要，但电弧事件具有瞬态性、环境噪声大、真实数据稀缺，且易与其他瞬态现象混淆，现有方法难以准确检测。
Method: 构建两个同步视觉与力测量数据集（一个来自瑞士联邦铁路SBB，另一个来自公开视频与合成力数据）；提出MultiDeepSAD算法，扩展DeepSAD至多模态并引入新损失函数；针对图像和力数据分别设计伪异常生成技术（如合成电弧状伪影和模拟力异常）以增强训练。
Result: 摘要报告所提框架在域偏移和真实电弧观测有限的条件下，显著优于基线方法，对真实电弧事件具有更高的敏感性。
Conclusion: 多模态融合与伪异常生成能有效提升电弧检测的鲁棒性和准确性，尤其在数据稀缺和跨域场景下。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告所提框架在域偏移和真实电弧观测有限的条件下，显著优于基线方法，对真实电弧事件具有更高的敏感性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多模态融合与伪异常生成能有效提升电弧检测的鲁棒性和准确性，尤其在数据稀缺和跨域场景下。

papers.title: Variational Speculative Decoding: Rethinking Draft Training from Token Likelihood to Sequence Acceptance
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates inference for (M)LLMs, yet a training-decoding discrepancy persists: while existing methods optimize single greedy trajectories, decoding involves verifying and ranking multiple sampled draft paths. We propose Variational Speculative Decoding (VSD), formulating draft training as variational inference over latent proposals (draft paths). VSD maximizes the marginal probability of target-model acceptance, yielding an ELBO that promotes high-quality latent proposals while minimizing divergence from the target distribution. To enhance quality and reduce variance, we incorporate a path-level utility and optimize via an Expectation-Maximization procedure. The E-step draws Monte Carlo samples from an oracle-filtered posterior, while the M-step maximizes weighted likelihood using Adaptive Rejection Weighting (ARW) and Confidence-Aware Regularization (CAR). Theoretical analysis confirms that VSD increases expected acceptance length and speedup. Extensive experiments across LLMs and MLLMs show that VSD achieves up to a 9.6% speedup over EAGLE-3 and 7.9% over ViSpec, significantly improving decoding efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出变分推测解码（VSD），将草稿训练视为潜在草案路径上的变分推理，最大化目标模型接受边际概率的ELBO。通过EM过程优化，E步从Oracle过滤后验采样，M步使用自适应拒绝加权和置信感知正则化。实验表明，在LLM和MLLM上相比EAGLE-3和ViSpec分别获得最高9.6%和7.9%的加速。
Motivation: 现有推测解码方法优化单个贪婪轨迹，但实际解码涉及验证和排序多个采样草案路径，导致训练与解码之间的不一致。
Method: 将草稿训练建模为变分推理，最大化接受边际概率的ELBO；采用路径级效用和EM过程，E步从Oracle过滤后验进行蒙特卡洛采样，M步通过自适应拒绝加权和置信感知正则化最大化加权似然。
Result: 在LLM和MLLM上，VSD相比EAGLE-3最高提速9.6%，相比ViSpec最高提速7.9%。
Conclusion: 理论分析证明VSD能增加期望接受长度和加速比，实验验证了其在多种模型上的解码效率提升。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Bridge Between Climate Science and Economics: OPTiMEM and the Heat Conjecture for Estimation of Social Cost of Greenhouse Gases
papers.abstract_en: We present an entirely new physics founded approach to estimating the social cost of carbon (SCC). For this, we developed our Ocean-Heat-Content Physics and Time Macro Economic Model (OPTiMEM) to estimate future heat content. The heat conjecture assumes that weather damages curves are stochastically proportional to ocean heat increase. We model carbon combustion, validate to datasets for greenhouse gas (GHG), temperature, and ocean heat content (OHC). We show that the social cost of 4 GHGs: CO2, CH4, N2O and halogenated hydrocarbons, cannot be single values, but must be represented by a kind of economic phase space. We propose very long-term carbon bonds to implement real discounting. This obviates the Gordian knot of the descriptivist versus prescriptivist discount disagreement that is unsolvable. Implementing these bonds leads to a new monitoring metric: real-dollar spending and bond discount rates compared to SC-GHG cost with variation on the discount scale, where the discount has no relationship to the pure rate of time preference (PRTP). This heat conjecture is based on OPTiMEM. OPTiMEM initiates from a fossil fuel consumption function to produce CO2, with 18 scenarios implemented to provide the uncertainty range. We provide 1:N year loss risk models (1:10, 1:100, 1:1000) that government, engineers, and actuaries should find useful. A scenario implementing DICE family of models carbon and growth assumptions shows +18° C is breached by 2210 CE, and +110° C by 2300 CE -- both of which outcomes are obviously not compatible with the fairly rosy conclusions of DICE models. Concerns are raised about having enough low-cost fossil fuel for conversion to minimal CO$_2$ maximal energy return on energy invested (EROEI) power if nations wait too long, and low EROEI power is questioned because monetary value is dependent on energy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种全新的基于物理的方法来估算温室气体的社会成本（SCC），开发了海洋热含量物理与时间宏观经济模型（OPTiMEM），基于热假设即天气损害曲线与海洋热增加随机成比例。模型验证了CO2、CH4、N2O和卤代烃等温室气体数据，指出社会成本不能是单一值而需用经济相空间表示，并提议使用长期碳债券实现实际贴现，解决描述主义与规范主义贴现分歧。
Motivation: 现有社会碳成本估算缺乏坚实的物理基础，且贴现率选择存在描述主义与规范主义的不可解分歧，需要新的方法统一物理与经济学模型。
Method: 开发OPTiMEM模型，从化石燃料消费函数出发产生CO2，结合海洋热含量数据验证，采用18种情景提供不确定性范围，并建立1:N年损失风险模型（1:10, 1:100, 1:1000）。
Result: DICE模型情景显示2210年升温超过+18°C，2300年超过+110°C，与DICE模型相对乐观的结论矛盾；并指出若等待太久，低化石燃料成本转换高EROEI电力可能不足。
Conclusion: 摘要强调社会成本需用经济相空间表示，长期碳债券可解决贴现率争议，并需关注能源转换可行性。

papers.title: Error Amplification Limits ANN-to-SNN Conversion in Continuous Control
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) can achieve competitive performance by converting already existing well-trained Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), avoiding further costly training. This property is particularly attractive in Reinforcement Learning (RL), where training through environment interaction is expensive and potentially unsafe. However, existing conversion methods perform poorly in continuous control, where suitable baselines are largely absent. We identify error amplification as the key cause: small action approximation errors become temporally correlated across decision steps, inducing cumulative state distribution shift and severe performance degradation. To address this issue, we propose Cross-Step Residual Potential Initialization (CRPI), a lightweight gradient-free mechanism that carries over residual membrane potentials across decision steps to suppress temporally correlated errors. Experiments on continuous control benchmarks with both vector and visual observations demonstrate that CRPI can be integrated into existing conversion pipelines and substantially recovers lost performance. Our results highlight continuous control as a critical and challenging benchmark for ANN-to-SNN conversion, where small errors can be strongly amplified and impact performance. Code is available at https://github.com/xuzijie32/ANN2SNN-CRPI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在连续控制任务中，ANN到SNN转换存在误差放大问题：小的动作近似误差在决策步骤间时间相关，导致状态分布偏移和性能下降。为此提出跨步残差电位初始化（CRPI），一种轻量级无梯度机制，通过跨步传递残差膜电位抑制时间相关误差。实验表明CRPI可集成到现有转换流程中，显著恢复性能。
Motivation: 现有ANN-to-SNN转换方法在连续控制任务中表现差，缺乏合适的基线。识别出误差放大是根本原因：小误差因时间相关性累积，导致状态分布偏移和性能严重退化。
Method: 提出跨步残差电位初始化（CRPI），一种无需梯度的机制，在决策步骤间传递残差膜电位，以抑制时间相关的近似误差。
Result: 在连续控制基准（向量和视觉观测）上，CRPI集成到现有转换流程中能显著恢复性能。
Conclusion: 连续控制是ANN-to-SNN转换的关键挑战性基准，小误差可能被放大并影响性能。CRPI提供了一种有效的缓解方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PILD: Physics-Informed Learning via Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as powerful generative tools for modeling complex data distributions, yet their purely data-driven nature limits applicability in engineering and scientific problems where physical laws must be respected. This paper proposes Physics-Informed Learning via Diffusion (PILD), a framework that unifies diffusion modeling and physical constraints through a probabilistic residual formulation with a virtual residual observation sampled from a Laplace distribution. To make this formulation practical under noisy diffusion states, we introduce a Jensen-gap-aware adaptive residual scale, which reduces the bias induced by residual likelihood marginalization. Additionally, we develop a physics-conditional alignment mechanism for conditional tasks that encourages intermediate latent representations to remain consistent with the observation conditions during denoising. The proposed framework is concise, modular, and broadly applicable to problems governed by ordinary differential equations, partial differential equations, as well as algebraic equations or inequality constraints. Extensive experiments across engineering and scientific tasks show that PILD improves physical fidelity and predictive accuracy over representative physics-informed and diffusion-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出物理信息扩散学习（PILD）框架，通过概率残差公式将物理约束融入扩散模型，使用拉普拉斯分布的虚拟残差观测，并引入Jensen-gap-aware自适应残差尺度以减小偏差，以及物理条件对齐机制。在多种物理问题（ODE、PDE、代数/不等式约束）上验证，PILD提高了物理保真度和预测精度。
Motivation: 扩散模型作为强大的生成工具，但纯数据驱动方式无法保证物理定律的遵守，限制了在工程和科学问题中的应用。
Method: 提出PILD框架，采用概率残差公式，从拉普拉斯分布中采样虚拟残差观测；引入Jensen-gap-aware自适应残差尺度减小边际化偏差；开发物理条件对齐机制以保持中间潜在表示与观测条件一致。
Result: 在多种工程和科学任务上的实验表明，PILD在物理保真度和预测精度上优于代表性物理信息和扩散基线。
Conclusion: 该框架简洁、模块化，广泛适用于ODE、PDE及代数/不等式约束问题。

papers.title: NeuraLSP: A Neural Spectral Preconditioner for Accelerating PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Solving large-scale sparse linear systems originating from partial differential equations (PDEs) is a fundamental topic in high-performance scientific computing, where preconditioners are crucial. Multigrid methods are among the most effective preconditioners, yet their performance is dictated by the accurate construction of grid transfer operators. Current neural multigrid methods learn such operators with graph neural networks (GNNs), typically by extracting connectivity from discretized system matrices. While effective, these graph-based constructions suffer from rank inflation, resulting in unnecessarily large coarse spaces and slower convergence. To ameliorate, this paper advocates NeuraLSP, a new neural multigrid preconditioner that replaces graph aggregation with a fixed low-rank spectral representation derived from the left singular subspace of near-nullspace components. At the network design level, NeuraLSP is trained with a novel subspace loss function, which preserves the error modes most relevant to multigrid convergence while suppressing rank inflation. This paper's grand innovation hinges upon both theoretical guarantees and empirical robustness to rank inflation, affording up to a 53% speedup over SOTA neural preconditioners across a variety of PDE families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuraLSP，一种新型神经谱预条件子，用于加速求解偏微分方程产生的大规模稀疏线性系统。该方法用近零空间分量的左奇异子空间构造固定低秩谱表示，替代传统图神经网络中的图聚合，并引入子空间损失函数进行训练。实验表明，在多种 PDE 族上，NeuraLSP 相比现有最佳神经预条件子实现高达 53% 的加速。
Motivation: 现有神经多网格预条件子依赖图神经网络从系统矩阵提取连接性，但图聚合导致秩膨胀，产生不必要的粗空间并减慢收敛速度。
Method: 提出 NeuraLSP，利用近零空间分量的左奇异子空间构造固定低秩谱表示作为网格转移算子，替代图聚合；并设计子空间损失函数，保留对多网格收敛关键的错误模式同时抑制秩膨胀。
Result: 在多种 PDE 族上，NeuraLSP 相比现有最佳神经预条件子实现高达 53% 的加速。
Conclusion: 该预条件子具有理论保证和对秩膨胀的强鲁棒性，为加速 PDE 求解器提供了有效的神经谱方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided Time-Varying Causal Inference for Arctic Sea Ice Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying the causal relationship between sea ice thickness and sea surface height (SSH) is essential for understanding the mechanisms driving polar climate dynamics. Conventional deep learning models often struggle with treatment effect estimation in climate settings due to time-varying confounding and the lack of physical constraints. To address these challenges, we propose the Knowledge-Guided Causal Model Variational Autoencoder (KGCM-VAE) to quantify the effect of SSH on sea ice thickness. The framework leverages established physical relationships between SSH and surface velocity to generate physically grounded, time-varying continuous treatments, where each treatment value can change at every time step within a sequence. The model also incorporates Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to balance treated and control distributions in the latent space, mitigating observed confounding bias. Using synthetic data, we evaluated the model's ability to predict sea ice thickness responses under hypothetical SSH forcing scenarios, demonstrating that KGCM-VAE achieves lower PEHE compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Ablation studies further confirm that MMD consistently enhances treatment effect estimation over the base model. Additionally, we conducted a real-world case study to examine the sensitivity of sea ice thickness to SSH forcing and validate our findings against existing physical modeling results.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication at ECML PKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识引导因果模型变分自编码器（KGCM-VAE），用于量化海面高度（SSH）对海冰厚度的影响。该模型利用物理关系生成随时间变化的连续处理，并采用最大均值差异（MMD）平衡处理组和对照组分布，从而减轻时变混杂偏差。在合成数据上，KGCM-VAE相比基线降低了PEHE；真实案例研究验证了模型对SSH强迫的敏感性。
Motivation: 传统深度学习模型在气候设置中处理效应估计时难以应对时变混杂和缺乏物理约束，而量化海冰厚度与海面高度的因果关系对理解极地气候动态至关重要。
Method: 提出KGCM-VAE，结合海面高度与表面速度的物理关系生成物理上合理的时变连续处理，并在潜在空间中使用MMD平衡处理与对照分布以减轻混杂偏差。
Result: 在合成数据上，KGCM-VAE在预测海冰厚度对假想SSH强迫的响应时，PEHE低于最先进基线；消融实验证实MMD持续提升处理效应估计。

papers.title: Non-Stationary Functional Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Functional bilevel optimization (FBO) provides a powerful framework for hierarchical learning in function spaces, yet current methods are limited to static offline settings and perform suboptimally in online, non-stationary scenarios. We propose SmoothFBO, the first algorithm for non-stationary FBO with both theoretical guarantees and practical scalability. SmoothFBO introduces a time-smoothed stochastic hypergradient estimator that reduces variance through a window parameter, enabling stable outer-loop updates with sublinear regret. Importantly, the classical parametric bilevel case is a special reduction of our framework, making SmoothFBO a natural extension to online, non-stationary settings. Empirically, SmoothFBO consistently outperforms existing FBO methods in non-stationary hyperparameter optimization and model-based reinforcement learning, demonstrating its practical effectiveness. Together, these results establish SmoothFBO as a general, theoretically grounded, and practically viable foundation for bilevel optimization in online, non-stationary scenarios.

TL;DR: 本文提出SmoothFBO，首个针对非平稳函数双层优化（FBO）的算法，引入时间平滑的随机超梯度估计器，通过窗口参数降低方差，实现次线性遗憾。在非平稳超参数优化和基于模型的强化学习上优于现有FBO方法。
Motivation: 现有FBO方法局限于静态离线场景，在在线非平稳场景中表现不佳，缺乏理论保证和实用算法。

Result: 在非平稳超参数优化和基于模型的RL任务中，SmoothFBO一致优于现有FBO基线，并实现次线性遗憾。
Conclusion: SmoothFBO为在线非平稳场景下的双层优化提供了通用、有理论保证且实用的基础框架。

papers.title: Backpropagation-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Lightweight EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) face significant deployment challenges due to inter-subject variability, signal non-stationarity, and computational constraints. While test-time adaptation (TTA) mitigates distribution shifts under online data streams without per-use calibration sessions, existing TTA approaches heavily rely on explicitly defined loss objectives that require backpropagation for updating model parameters, which incurs computational overhead, privacy risks, and sensitivity to noisy data streams. This paper proposes Backpropagation-Free Transformations (BFT), a TTA approach for EEG decoding that eliminates such issues. BFT applies multiple sample-wise transformations of knowledge-guided augmentations or approximate Bayesian inference to each test trial, generating multiple prediction scores for a single test sample. A learning-to-rank module enhances the weighting of these predictions, enabling robust aggregation for uncertainty suppression during inference under theoretical justifications. Extensive experiments on five EEG datasets of motor imagery classification and driver drowsiness regression tasks demonstrate the effectiveness, versatility, robustness, and efficiency of BFT. This research enables lightweight plug-and-play BCIs on resource-constrained devices, broadening the real-world deployment of decoding algorithms for EEG-based BCI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需反向传播的测试时自适应方法BFT，用于轻量级EEG-BCI系统。BFT通过对每个测试样本应用知识引导的增强或近似贝叶斯推断生成多个预测分数，并用学习排序模块加权聚合来抑制不确定性。在五个EEG数据集上验证了有效性、鲁棒性和效率。
Motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法依赖显式损失函数和反向传播更新参数，带来计算开销、隐私风险和噪声敏感性，限制了轻量级BCI的部署。
Method: 提出BFT，包括样本级变换（知识引导增强或近似贝叶斯推断）生成多个预测分数，以及学习排序模块进行加权聚合。
Result: 在五个EEG数据集（运动想象分类和驾驶员嗜睡回归任务）上展示了有效性、通用性、鲁棒性和效率。
Conclusion: BFT使资源受限设备上的即插即用BCI成为可能，拓宽了EEG-BCI解码算法的实际部署。

papers.title: Vision-Language-Policy Model for Dynamic Robot Task Planning
papers.abstract_en: Bridging the gap between natural language commands and autonomous execution in unstructured environments remains an open challenge for robotics. This requires robots to perceive and reason over the current task scene through multiple modalities, and to plan their behaviors to achieve their intended goals. Traditional robotic task-planning approaches often struggle to bridge low-level execution with high-level task reasoning, and cannot dynamically update task strategies when instructions change during execution, which ultimately limits their versatility and adaptability to new tasks. In this work, we propose a novel language model-based framework for dynamic robot task planning. Our Vision-Language-Policy (VLP) model, based on a vision-language model fine-tuned on real-world data, can interpret semantic instructions and integrate reasoning over the current task scene to generate behavior policies that control the robot to accomplish the task. Moreover, it can dynamically adjust the task strategy in response to changes in the task, enabling flexible adaptation to evolving task requirements. Experiments conducted with different robots and a variety of real-world tasks show that the trained model can efficiently adapt to novel scenarios and dynamically update its policy, demonstrating strong planning autonomy and cross-embodiment generalization. Videos: https://robovlp.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于视觉语言模型的机器人动态任务规划框架VLP，通过微调视觉语言模型，整合语义指令和场景推理生成行为策略，并能动态调整任务策略以适应指令变化。实验显示模型能高效适应新场景并跨实体泛化。
Motivation: 传统机器人任务规划难以连接低层执行和高层推理，且无法在执行中动态更新策略，限制了适应性和通用性。
Method: 提出VLP模型，基于视觉语言模型在真实数据上微调，可解释语义指令并集成场景推理，生成行为策略控制机器人完成任务。
Result: 摘要报告在多种机器人和真实世界任务中，模型能高效适应新场景并动态更新策略，展示了规划自主性和跨实体泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调VLP模型能够动态调整任务策略以适应变化的任务需求，提高机器人的适应性。

papers.title: Trainable Log-linear Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) set the state of the art in visual generation, yet their quadratic self-attention cost fundamentally limits scaling to long token sequences. Recent Top-K sparse attention approaches reduce the computation of DiTs by compressing tokens into block-wise representation and selecting a small set of relevant key blocks, but still suffer from (i) quadratic selection cost on compressed tokens and (ii) increasing K required to maintain model quality as sequences grow. We identify that their inefficiency is due to the single-level design, as a single coarse level is insufficient to represent the global structure. In this paper, we introduce Log-linear Sparse Attention (LLSA), a trainable sparse attention mechanism for extremely long token sequences that reduces both selection and attention costs from quadratic to log-linear complexity by utilizing a hierarchical structure. LLSA performs hierarchical Top-K selection, progressively adopting sparse Top-K selection with the indices found at the previous level, and introduces a Hierarchical KV Enrichment mechanism that preserves global context while using fewer tokens of different granularity during attention computation. To support efficient training, we develop a high-performance GPU implementation that uses only sparse indices for both the forward and backward passes, eliminating the need for dense attention masks. We evaluate LLSA on high-resolution pixel-space image generation without using patchification and VAE encoding. LLSA accelerates attention inference by 28.27x and DiT training by 6.09x on 256x256 pixel token sequences, while maintaining generation quality. The results demonstrate that LLSA offers a promising direction for training long-sequence DiTs efficiently. Code is available at: https://github.com/SingleZombie/LLSA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Log-linear Sparse Attention (LLSA)，一种可训练的稀疏注意力机制，用于扩散 Transformer 中的超长 token 序列。通过层次化 Top-K 选择和层次 KV 增强，将选择和注意力成本从二次复杂度降至对数线性，同时在像素空间图像生成上实现 28.27 倍推理加速和 6.09 倍训练加速，保持生成质量。
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer (DiT) 的自注意力二次复杂度限制了长序列扩展；现有 Top-K 稀疏注意力方法存在二次选择成本且需随序列增长增加 K，其单层粗粒度设计无法有效表示全局结构。
Method: 提出层次化 Top-K 选择，逐层利用前一级索引逐步稀疏化；引入层次 KV 增强机制，在注意力计算中使用不同粒度的更少 token 保留全局上下文。开发了仅基于稀疏索引的高性能 GPU 实现，避免密集注意力掩码。
Result: 在 256×256 像素 token 序列上，LLSA 使注意力推理加速 28.27 倍，DiT 训练加速 6.09 倍，同时维持生成质量。实验在无 patch 化和 VAE 编码的高分辨率像素空间图像生成上进行。
Conclusion: LLSA 为高效训练长序列 DiT 提供了有前景的方向，代码已开源。

papers.title: Boltzmann generators for amorphous particle systems
papers.abstract_en: Sampling configurations in thermodynamic equilibrium is a long-standing challenge in statistical physics. Boltzmann generators address this problem by employing generative models to propose independent configurations, which are then reweighted via importance sampling using exact likelihood evaluations. Recent Boltzmann Generators based on continuous normalizing flows and flow matching have achieved significant success for particle systems and biomolecules. However, these approaches have not been extended to amorphous materials (glasses), for which equilibrium sampling is notoriously slow. Because of their disordered structure, the invariances and geometrical constraints of amorphous materials differ from those of crystals and biomolecules, preventing the direct use of existing generative models. Here, we develop Boltzmann Generators tailored to amorphous materials by building the required equivariances directly into Riemannian stochastic interpolants. Our framework incorporates periodic boundary conditions and particle symmetries using equivariant graph neural networks. Numerical experiments demonstrate that enforcing physical symmetries significantly improves the accuracy of Boltzmann Generators, but also reveal an intrinsic limitation of the continuous-flow formulation: accumulated numerical errors during likelihood integration break time-reversibility, compromising exact thermodynamic reweighting. These results reveal a fundamental challenge for continuous-flow generative models in statistical mechanics and call for alternative approaches that preserve exact thermodynamic consistency.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 10 figures. V2 considerably expands the results compared to v1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非晶材料（玻璃）的平衡采样问题，开发了基于黎曼随机插值（Riemannian stochastic interpolants）的玻尔兹曼生成器，将等变性直接构建到模型中。实验表明强制物理对称性提高了准确性，但也揭示了连续流公式的内在限制：似然积分中的累积数值误差破坏了时间可逆性，从而影响精确热力学重加权。
Motivation: 非晶材料（玻璃）的平衡采样在统计物理中非常困难，现有的连续流生成器在粒子系统和生物分子上成功，但直接用于非晶材料时需要处理其不同的不变性和几何约束。
Method: 将所需的等变性直接构建到黎曼随机插值（Riemannian stochastic interpolants）框架中，利用等变图神经网络实现周期性边界条件和粒子对称性。
Result: 数值实验表明强制物理对称性显著提高了玻尔兹曼生成器的准确性，但连续流公式存在内在局限性：似然积分中的累积数值误差破坏了时间可逆性，从而影响精确热力学重加权。
Conclusion: 结果揭示了连续流生成模型在统计力学中的基本挑战，需要寻求能够保持精确热力学一致性的替代方法。
