papers.title: Evaluation and Prognostic Validation of Deep Regression Models for WSI-Based Gene-Expression Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Gene-expression profiling is widely used in research and central to many areas of precision oncology, but remains costly and not universally accessible. Recent advances in computational pathology enable prediction of transcriptomic profiles directly from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained whole-slide images (WSIs), although optimal modeling strategies and clinical relevance remain unclear. In this study, we systematically evaluate deep regression models for WSI-based gene-expression prediction across multiple regression formulations and pathology foundation models (PFMs), and assess whether the resulting predicted transcriptomic signals retain prognostic utility. Across four TCGA datasets, we find that direct regression using attention-based multiple instance learning together with PFM feature extractors provides a strong and computationally efficient baseline, with no consistent benefit from separately training multiple models on subsets of genes. We then externally validate the selected configuration on an independent cohort of 997 breast cancer patients, demonstrating robust generalization for clinically relevant gene sets such as PAM50. To assess clinical relevance, we further evaluate predicted gene-expression scores in two independent population-representative breast cancer cohorts comprising 4,172 patients with survival endpoints, where predicted scores retain prognostic value in both the full patient cohort and the ER+ & HER2- subgroup. Together, these results demonstrate that WSI-based gene-expression prediction can generalize across independent cohorts and recover biologically and clinically meaningful molecular structure, supporting its potential as a scalable approach for transcriptomic phenotyping and risk stratification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了基于H&E染色全切片图像（WSI）的基因表达预测深度回归模型，比较了多种回归公式和病理基础模型（PFM），并在独立乳腺癌队列中验证了预测信号的预后价值。
Motivation: 基因表达分析在精准肿瘤学中重要但成本高，而计算病理学有望从WSI预测转录组图谱，但最优建模策略和临床相关性尚不明确。
Method: 系统评估了基于注意力的多实例学习（MIL）结合PFM特征提取器的直接回归方法，并独立验证于997例乳腺癌患者，在4172例患者的两项队列中评估预后价值。
Result: 摘要报告在TCGA四个数据集上直接回归提供了强基线，且在外部独立队列中泛化良好，预测的基因表达在完整队列和ER+HER2-亚组中保留了预后价值。
Conclusion: 结果表明WSI基因表达预测可在独立队列中泛化并恢复有临床意义的分子结构，支持其作为可扩展的转录组表型分型和风险分层工具。

papers.title: Exploiting Exogenous Structure for Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study a structured class of Markov Decision Processes, known as Exo-MDPs, in which the state space is partitioned into exogenous and endogenous components. Exogenous states evolve stochastically, independent of the agent's actions, while endogenous states evolve deterministically based on both state components and actions. Exo-MDPs capture many operations research settings, including inventory control, resource management, and ride-sharing. Our first contribution is structural: we establish a representational equivalence between discrete MDPs, Exo-MDPs, and discrete linear mixture MDPs. Our second contribution is statistical. We characterize the minimax regret of learning in Exo-MDPs when the effective dimension r is small relative to the endogenous state and action spaces. When the exogenous states are unobserved, we prove matching upper and lower regret bounds of order $Θ(Hr \sqrt{K})$ over $K$ episodes of horizon $H$, where $r$ is the effective dimension of the Exo-MDP. When exogenous states are observed, the minimax regret improves to $Θ(H\sqrt{ r K})$, revealing a $Θ(\sqrt{r})$ statistical gap due to observation of the exogenous states. These results show that Exo-MDPs decouple sample complexity from action space and endogenous state space. We validate these insights with experiments on inventory control and resource allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一类结构化马尔可夫决策过程（Exo-MDP），其中状态空间分为外生和内生两部分。外生状态独立于动作随机演化，内生状态则基于状态和动作确定性地演化。作者建立了离散MDP、Exo-MDP和离散线性混合MDP之间的表示等价性，并刻画了在有效维度r较小时学习Exo-MDP的极小化遗憾界。当外生状态不可观测时，遗憾界为Θ(H r √K)；可观测时改进为Θ(H √(r K))，揭示了因外生状态观测带来的Θ(√r)统计差距。实验验证了在库存控制和资源分配中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有强化学习样本效率理论往往忽略状态的外生结构，而实际运筹学场景（如库存控制、资源管理）中状态具有明确的外生/内生分解。
Method: 引入Exo-MDP结构，建立表示等价性，并推导外生状态可观测与不可观测情形下的极小化遗憾界。
Result: 当外生状态不可观测时，遗憾界为Θ(H r √K)；可观测时改进为Θ(H √(r K))，样本复杂度与动作空间和内生状态空间解耦。
Conclusion: Exo-MDP结构能显著提升强化学习样本效率，理论界限与实验验证一致。

papers.title: External Clustering Validation by the Homogeneity-Parsimony Trade-off
papers.abstract_en: Scalar metrics are often used to evaluate clusterings against known classes, but they can obscure a fundamental trade-off: clusterings should be informative about class labels while avoiding unnecessary fragmentation. Here we describe normalized scores of cluster homogeneity and parsimony that quantify this trade-off. These scores build on the information bottleneck principle, modified to not reward lossy compression. We show by example and mathematical proof that our definitions of these scores have the intuitive property of varying monotonically under cluster refinement in contrast to related proposals. Extending the information-theoretic framework beyond Shannon entropies, we furthermore derive set-matching and pair-based counterparts of the homogeneity and parsimony scores. These unify commonly used evaluation criteria and show that, in the pair-based setting, the homogeneity-parsimony trade-off recovers the receiver operating characteristic of binary classifiers. We demonstrate the framework's utility for feature selection and algorithm comparison, illustrating how considering scores jointly can clarify clustering operating points and identify Pareto-optimal solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于同质性（homogeneity）与简约性（parsimony）权衡的外部聚类验证框架。通过信息瓶颈原理定义归一化分数，证明其在簇细化下单调变化，并推广到集合匹配与基于对的度量，统一了常用聚类评估标准。
Motivation: 现有标量聚类评估指标可能掩盖聚类应兼具信息性与简洁性的基本权衡，缺乏同时考虑同质性与简约性的统一框架。
Method: 基于信息瓶颈原理，修改为不奖励有损压缩，定义同质性与简约性的归一化分数；并扩展至非香农熵版本，导出集合匹配与基于对的对应度量。
Result: 通过示例与数学证明，新分数在簇细化下单调变化；在基于对设置下，同质性-简约性权衡恢复二分类器的ROC曲线。
Conclusion: 该框架可统一现有聚类评估准则，并应用于特征选择与算法比较，通过联合考量分数明确聚类操作点并识别帕累托最优解。

papers.title: Can an AI System Be Creative? A Critical Perspective from Art and Engineering
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines the question of whether artificial intelligence (AI) systems can be creative, approached from the dual perspective of a researcher trained in electrical engineering, pattern recognition, machine learning, and neural networks, who has also spent most of his life engaged in the arts as actor, stage and film director, writer, composer, and visual artist, and in philosophy. Drawing on Margaret Boden's foundational framework, both her three properties of creativity (novelty, surprise, and value) and her three types of creative processes (combinatorial, exploratory, and transformational), the paper argues that AI systems are structurally incapable of creativity in its strongest sense. While they exhibit genuine capability in the domain of combinatorial creativity, they are significantly bounded in exploratory creativity, and fundamentally incapable of transformational creativity. The paper further argues that the most important limitation of current AI systems is not the absence of novelty per se, but the absence of any mechanism for serendipity, accident, or the unexpected, all of which play a central role in the phenomenology of creativity, and the absence of any subject position from which to recognize and welcome such chance events. The paper concludes by proposing a model of human, AI creative collaboration that is both realistic and generative, illustrated by several concrete experiments. The paper is itself a demonstration of the thesis it advances: it was composed through a deliberate human AI collaborative process, which is described in the methodological note that opens it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从电气工程与艺术哲学的双重视角，批判性地探讨AI系统是否具备创造力。基于Margaret Boden的创造力框架（新颖性、惊喜、价值）和三种创造过程（组合型、探索型、变革型），作者认为AI在最强意义上无法实现创造力：组合创造力上表现真实能力，探索创造力上显著受限，而变革创造力则根本不可能。核心局限在于缺乏意外发现（serendipity）机制以及识别偶然事件的主体位置。论文最后提出人类-AI协同创造力模型，并通过具体实验说明，论文本身也是该过程的一个实例。
Motivation: 当前关于AI创造力的讨论往往缺乏跨学科深度，需要从艺术实践和工程经验两个维度重新审视AI创造力的本质限制。
Method: 基于Boden的三类创造力框架，结合个人艺术实践与工程研究经验，进行理论分析和批判论证，并通过人类-AI协同创作实验验证所提协作模型。
Result: 论证AI在组合创造力上可行，探索创造力受限，变革创造力不可及；缺乏意外发现机制和主体位置是其根本局限。
Conclusion: AI不能独立实现强意义上的创造力，但通过明确人类-AI协作的互动模式，可以实现既有现实性又有生成性的协同创造。

papers.title: Memoir: Should a Model Write to Its Memory While It Thinks?
papers.abstract_en: Memoir combines per-sample fast memory, shared slow parameters, variable-depth latent recurrence, and a future-latent energy objective. We test its riskiest coupling: each pondering iteration may rewrite the fast tier that the same iteration reads. On procedural associative recall with key interference, we compare a coupled arm against an otherwise identical read-only pondering arm. Both arms contain 81,738 parameters, including 76,362 trainable parameters, and use matched declared forward multiply-accumulate counts, data, optimizer, schedule, and seeds. After 240 training steps across 12 seeds, coupled recall is 0.5203 with a 95 percent interval of [0.4522, 0.5883], while read-only recall is 0.6557 with [0.5953, 0.7160]. The arms are paired per seed, and the read-only lead of 0.1354 gives a paired t of 3.23 on 11 degrees of freedom with a 95 percent interval of [0.0431, 0.2277] on the difference, winning on 10 of 12 seeds. After 960 steps across 8 seeds, both arms reach 1.0000, so the measured effect is a learning-speed penalty at a fixed budget, not a demonstrated capability penalty. That longer control is ceiling limited, leaving convergence on a non-saturating task unmeasured. A predicted failure in which memory rewriting corrupts the energy signal did not occur: the energy margin grew and held. Kernel restructuring also reduced delta-rule forward time from 0.907 ms to 0.351 ms on the stated device. Code and evidence are available at https://github.com/RightNow-AI/Memoir
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. Code: https://github.com/RightNow-AI/Memoir
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模型在思考过程中是否应该向自身记忆写入信息。实验对比了耦合（读写同一快层）与只读两种记忆更新策略，在程序性关联回忆任务上，只读策略在固定训练步数内学习速度更快，但最终两者均能达到完美召回。
Motivation: 探究模型在循环思考过程中对快速记忆进行写入操作的风险与收益，特别是当写入可能干扰同一迭代的读取时。
Method: 提出Memoir方法，结合每样本快速记忆、共享慢参数、可变深度潜循环和未来潜能量目标。实验设置耦合臂（允许重写）与只读臂，在程序性关联回忆任务上比较。
Result: 经过240步训练（12种子），耦合召回率0.5203，只读召回率0.6557，差异显著（配对t=3.23）。960步后（8种子）两者均达1.0，表明仅存在学习速度惩罚，而非能力缺陷。能量信号未受破坏，内核重构将前向时间从0.907ms降至0.351ms。
Conclusion: 记忆重写未导致预期的能量信号损坏，但带来了学习速度的代价。未来需在非饱和任务上进一步验证收敛性。

papers.title: Refusal-Gated Decoding: Preserving Refusal Behavior Under High-Temperature Sampling
papers.abstract_en: High-temperature sampling is one of the primary mechanisms for increasing diversity in LLMs. Recent advances in truncation-based sampling techniques have helped mitigate drawbacks of high-temperature sampling such as neural text degeneration, thereby enabling greater diversity in LLM outputs without sacrificing coherence. However, increasing the entropy of the token probability distribution via high temperatures has also been shown to weaken model guardrails by reducing the model's refusal response in the presence of harmful prompts. Despite the potential benefits of high-temperature sampling and the importance of maintaining model safety, there is a lack of existing solutions for maintaining the refusal behavior of LLMs under a higher entropy regime. To address this gap, we systematically study how temperature influences refusal behavior in LLMs and propose an efficient sequential decoding approach which preserves a model's greedy decoding refusal response at high temperatures while incurring minimal additional latency. Through extensive experiments, we show that our approach preserves 91-99% of the greedy decoding refusal behavior across three benchmark datasets without compromising the model's high-temperature response for safe prompts. Our work demonstrates how refusal behavior can be maintained in an efficient manner for applications which require high-temperature sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高温采样下大语言模型拒绝行为弱化的问题，提出一种高效的顺序解码方法Refusal-Gated Decoding，能在高温下保留模型贪婪解码时的拒绝反应，同时最小化额外延迟。实验表明该方法在三个基准数据集上保持了91-99%的贪婪解码拒绝行为，且不影响安全提示下的高温响应。
Motivation: 高温采样能增加LLM输出的多样性，但会削弱模型的安全护栏，降低对有害提示的拒绝率。现有方法缺乏在高温下维持拒绝行为的手段。
Method: 提出一种顺序解码方法，通过对解码过程进行门控，在高温采样时保留原始贪婪解码的拒绝输出。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上，该方法保留了91-99%的贪婪解码拒绝行为，且额外延迟极小，同时不损害安全提示下的高温响应性能。
Conclusion: 本工作展示了在需要高温采样的应用中如何高效维持模型的拒绝行为，弥补了该领域的研究空白。

papers.title: Ocular Verification for Virtual Reality
papers.abstract_en: Virtual reality (VR) headsets (e.g., Meta Quest, Apple Vision Pro) provide a seamless user experience due to their fast, frictionless interaction with the physical world in a simulated environment. User authentication relies on biometric cues such as iris in such headsets. However, traditional iris recognition protocols may not be adequate in cases of unconstrained acquisition, which is typical of VR-based data. In this work, we examine three crucial aspects: (1) evaluating ISO/IEC 29794-6 iris quality metrics on VRBiom dataset and analyzing their limitations, (2) addressing data-specific challenges such as off-axis gaze, non-uniform illumination, and specular reflection using generative models, and (3) performing unimodal (iris, periocular) recognition and multimodal score-level fusion (iris + periocular). We observe that some metrics (e.g., margin adequacy) fail on VR-acquired data; whereas, image adjustments primarily benefit periocular recognition, and multimodal fusion lowers EER by ~11% over unimodal iris recognition performance. We will release the evaluation scripts upon acceptance for reproducibility.

papers.title: 3D-GIMP: When 3D Gaussian Inpainting Meets PatchMatch
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D scene editing have leveraged iterative diffusion models to update input views. However, this process is computationally expensive and struggles to produce sharp details. Meanwhile, ``hallucination drift'' frequently introduces multi-view inconsistencies, leading to structural artifacts when rendering novel viewpoints. To address this problem, we present 3D-GIMP (3D Gaussian Inpainting Meets Patch Matching), a novel hybrid paradigm designed for high-fidelity object removal in 3D Gaussian Splatting. Instead of diffusing every view, 3D-GIMP performs a single generative inpainting on a key reference view, which serves as an appearance prior. We then introduce a 3D-aware PatchMatch algorithm to propagate these reference textures across all remaining views via correspondence matching, effectively bypassing the stochastic nature of frame-by-frame diffusion. By prioritizing reconstructive consistency over iterative generation, 3D-GIMP maintains high-frequency details across arbitrary resolutions while ensuring a mathematically consistent 3D reconstruction. Our experiments demonstrate that 3D-GIMP not only achieves competitive inpainting quality as previous methods using diffusion in multiple views, but also outperforms these methods in rendering speed and view consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出3D-GIMP，一种混合范式，用于3D高斯泼溅中的高保真物体移除。该方法通过在关键参考视图上进行一次生成式修补，然后利用3D感知的PatchMatch算法将参考纹理传播到其他视图，避免了逐帧扩散的高计算成本和不一致性。实验表明该方法在渲染速度和视图一致性上优于多视图扩散方法。
Motivation: 现有基于迭代扩散的3D场景编辑方法计算昂贵，难以产生锐利细节，且容易出现“幻觉漂移”导致多视图不一致和结构伪影。
Method: 3D-GIMP在关键参考视图上执行单次生成式修补作为外观先验，然后引入3D感知的PatchMatch算法通过对应匹配将参考纹理传播到所有剩余视图。
Result: 实验表明3D-GIMP在修补质量上与多视图扩散方法相当，但在渲染速度和视图一致性上更优。
Conclusion: 通过优先考虑重建一致性而非迭代生成，3D-GIMP能够在任意分辨率下保持高频细节，并确保数学上一致的3D重建。

papers.title: Synthetic minority data is redundant or invalid: a data-dependent validity theory and a de-biased test
papers.abstract_en: For two decades, the standard remedy for class-imbalanced learning has been to fabricate synthetic minority examples, and the standard evidence of their validity has been a check that cannot fail: synthetic points are scored against the very data that generated them. We de-bias the check. Validity becomes a population quantity -- the probability that a synthetic point truly belongs to the minority class -- with a consistent estimator that scores synthetic points against withheld real data. Where held-out ground truth is available, the classical test underestimates true invalidity in 96-99% of method-by-imbalance-ratio cells, while the de-biased estimator tracks it closely. We prove validity is a property of the data, not the method: class overlap sets an invalidity floor no faithful generator escapes, making oversampling redundant where classes separate and invalid where they overlap. Across 91 methods, three classifiers, and datasets spanning medicine and finance -- including a generator engineered to pass the classical check -- none clears both bars: gains over the best trivial baseline are noise-thin (median below 0.01 F1, a decision threshold's reach), and most damage calibration. We release the audit as a pip-installable test and flip the burden of proof: synthetic minority data must now demonstrate, on the data at hand, both validity and information gain.
papers.comment: 45 pages, 7 figures; Supplementary Information included as appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了二十年来处理类别不平衡学习（class-imbalanced learning）的标准做法——生成合成少数类样本。作者指出传统有效性检验存在偏差（合成样本被其生成数据本身评估），并提出无偏检验方法。通过理论证明和大量实验（91种方法、3个分类器、医学和金融数据集），发现合成数据要么无效（类重叠导致不可避免的错误），要么冗余（性能提升微乎其微），且会损害模型校准。论文发布了可pip安装的检验工具。
Motivation: 标准合成少数类样本的有效性检验存在系统性缺陷：合成点被其生成数据本身评分，导致检验无法失败，从而掩盖了真正的无效性。
Method: 提出去偏（de-biased）的检验方法，将有效性定义为总体量——合成点真正属于少数类的概率——并使用保留的真实数据对合成点进行评分的一致性估计量。理论证明有效性是数据固有属性，类重叠（class overlap）设定了一个不可逾越的无效性下限。
Result: 在91种方法、3个分类器和跨医学、金融数据集上，没有方法能同时满足有效性和信息增益（相对于最佳基线，中位数F1提升低于0.01，决策阈值即可达到；多数方法损害了校准）。传统检验在96-99%的方法-不平衡比组合中低估了真实无效性，而去偏估计量精确追踪。
Conclusion: 合成少数类数据在大多数实际场景下是冗余或无效的；研究者应转向验证方法在具体数据上的有效性和信息增益，而非默认使用合成数据。

papers.title: Robostral Navigate
papers.abstract_en: Deploying navigation systems at scale requires a recipe that minimizes sensor assumptions, generalizes across robot embodiments, and trains efficiently. Yet, today's best systems depend on depth sensors, multi-camera rigs, or pre-built maps, limiting the hardware they support and increasing deployment cost. We introduce Robostral Navigate, an 8B vision-language model built around this scalability objective. The model consumes only a stream of monocular RGB images - the most ubiquitous sensor across robotic platforms and predicts waypoints by pointing to the next target location in the current camera view. Operating purely in image space, rather than robot-specific coordinates, makes the policy naturally robust to changes in camera intrinsics and scene scale, enabling deployment across wheeled, legged, and aerial robots without recalibration. We generate 2.4 million trajectories across 350k simulated scenes to reduce the reliance on real-world data collection and scale easily. We further introduce a prefix-caching training recipe that packs entire episodes into single training sequences, reducing training tokens by 22x and cutting training time from months to days. A tree-based attention mask prevents conditioning on previous ground-truth actions, encouraging visually grounded action prediction, and reinforcement learning is used to further improve exploration and recovery capabilities. On the Room-to-Room and Room-Across-Room in Continuous Environments (R2R-CE and RxR-CE) benchmarks, Robostral Navigate sets a new state of the art. On R2R-CE, it achieves a 77.4% success rate, surpassing the best monocular method by 10.5 points and the strongest depth- or multi-camera system by 5.3 points despite using only a single RGB camera. On RxR-CE, it reaches 75.1% success rate, outperforming all monocular baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Robostral Navigate，一个 8B 参数视觉语言模型，仅使用单目 RGB 图像进行视觉导航，无需深度传感器或多相机系统。模型通过预测当前视图中的目标航点来输出轨迹，可跨轮式、腿式和空中机器人部署。在 350k 模拟场景中生成 240 万条轨迹，并引入前缀缓存训练方案将训练 token 减少 22 倍，训练时间从数月降至数天。在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上达到新最优，R2R-CE 成功率为 77.4%，比最佳单目方法高 10.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有导航系统依赖深度传感器、多相机或预建地图，限制了硬件兼容性和部署成本。目标是在最小传感器假设下实现跨机器人形态的通用导航，并提高训练效率。
Method: 基于 8B 参数视觉语言模型，输入仅为单目 RGB 图像流，输出当前视图中的目标航点（图像空间坐标）。训练数据为 240 万条模拟轨迹，采用前缀缓存训练方案将整个 episode 压缩为单序列，并使用树状注意力掩码防止模型利用过去真实动作，再结合强化学习优化探索与恢复。
Result: 在 R2R-CE 上成功率达到 77.4%，比最佳单目方法高 10.5 点，比最强的深度/多相机系统高 5.3 点；在 RxR-CE 上成功率达 75.1%，超越所有单目基线。
Conclusion: 仅使用单目 RGB 即可在连续环境导航任务中取得超过依赖深度或多相机的系统，证明了纯视觉导航的可行性和规模化部署潜力。

papers.title: The Human-AI Substitution Principle: When will you be replaced by AI in your organization?
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming organizations, raising a fundamental organizational and economic question: when will a human employee be replaced by AI? We present an analytical model for studying Human--AI Task Allocation (HAT) in hierarchical organizations. A central feature of the HAT model is that it formally encodes the economic asymmetry between human skill acquisition and AI capability scaling. The HAT model allows us to derive how risk-adjusted costs, skills, organizational depth, deployment scale, strategic adaptation, and risk jointly determine when, where, why, and under what structural conditions human--AI replacement occurs. A key result is the Human--AI Substitution Principle, which provides a precise condition --- grounded in the formal asymmetry assumption --- under which AI replaces human labor. Building on this result, we show that AI adoption can produce abrupt workforce transitions, hybrid human--AI organizations, including cases where risk heterogeneity sustains human and AI roles without requiring a minimum-human-fraction constraint, and flatter managerial hierarchies with wider spans of control. The HAT model identifies structural conditions under which middle-management roles exhibit elevated vulnerability to automation, and shows that the vulnerability of highly skilled workers depends on a skill threshold shaped by organizational depth, baseline costs, and risk differentials. More broadly, the paper connects automation economics, organizational design, AI governance, and workforce planning into a unified theory of AI-driven organizational transformation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个人类-AI任务分配（HAT）模型，形式化人类技能获取与AI能力扩展之间的经济不对称性，并推导出人类-AI替代原则。该原则给出了AI替代人类劳动的精确条件。模型分析表明，AI采用可导致突然的劳动力转型、混合人机组织以及更扁平的管理层级，其中中层管理岗位对自动化的脆弱性更高，而高技能工人的脆弱性取决于技能阈值。
Motivation: 组织面临一个根本问题：何时人类员工会被AI替代？现有理论缺乏统一模型来解释人力资本与AI扩展之间的不对称性。
Method: 构建HAT模型，通过数学建模刻画人类技能获取与AI能力扩展的经济不对称性，并推导出替代原则及其条件。
Result: 得出AI替代可引发突发性劳动力转型、混合人机组织、更扁平的管理层级等结论；中层管理岗位脆弱性高，高技能工人的脆弱性受技能阈值影响。
Conclusion: 该论文将自动化经济学、组织设计、AI治理和劳动力规划统一成一个理论框架，为理解AI驱动的组织转型提供分析工具。

papers.title: Rethinking Open-World Video Anomaly Detection: Diagnosing Definition Blindness
papers.abstract_en: Open-world video anomaly detection (OWVAD) is expected to detect events that match a user-specified definition of abnormality. This requirement is stronger than generic anomaly localization: in the same video, changing the definition should change which temporal regions are scored as anomalous. We show that current OWVAD evaluation largely fails to isolate this conditional behavior. Standard VAD metrics and the dynamic-definition protocol can be dominated by target-versus-normal separation, allowing models to obtain strong scores while remaining nearly insensitive to the queried definition. We call this failure mode definition blindness. To explain why it is missed, we decompose dynamic-definition evaluation into target-versus-normal detection and target-versus-other-anomaly discrimination, and find that the former receives 7.2-26.8$\times$ more weight across common VAD benchmarks. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce three definition-conditioned evaluation metrics, DC-Disc, DC-Det$Δ$, and DC-Sel$Δ$, which progressively remove normal-frame, generic-anomaly, and multi-event selection shortcuts. Experiments on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD reveal that several strong VAD, OWVAD, and general vision language model baselines localize anomalous moments but exhibit weak definition following, often with near-zero definition-response margins. To validate that the failure is actionable, we further introduce DeCoS, a definition-contrastive scoring rule that subtracts anomaly evidence shared across definitions. DeCoS improves the strongest baseline by 7.3-16.0 AUROC points on DC-Disc and 15.5-28.3 points on DC-Det$Δ$. Overall, our results argue that OWVAD should be evaluated as definition-conditioned anomaly scoring, not as anomaly detection under different prompt labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断了开放世界视频异常检测（OWVAD）中的“定义盲区”问题，即现有评估指标无法区分模型是否真正根据用户定义进行异常评分，而是主要依赖目标与正常样本的分离。作者提出了三个定义条件化的评估指标（DC-Disc, DC-DetΔ, DC-SelΔ），并引入定义对比评分规则DeCoS，在多个基准上提升了定义跟随能力。
Motivation: 当前OWVAD评估主要测重目标与正常样本的分离，忽略了模型是否真正响应不同异常定义，导致“定义盲区”问题未被识别。
Method: 通过分解动态定义评估为目标-正常检测和目标-其他异常判别，发现前者权重高于后者7.2-26.8倍。基于此，提出三个定义条件化指标，并设计DeCoS方法，通过减去不同定义间共享的异常证据来增强定义敏感性。
Result: 在UCF-Crime、XD-Violence和MSAD上，许多强基线模型表现出弱定义跟随，近零定义响应边际。DeCoS在最强基线上提升DC-Disc 7.3-16.0 AUROC点，DC-DetΔ提升15.5-28.3点。
Conclusion: OWVAD应被评估为定义条件化的异常评分，而非不同提示标签下的异常检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Mechanistic Interpretability of an AI Foundation Model Fine-Tuned for Atmospheric Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: Weather forecasting foundation models (FMs) are increasingly fine-tuned to predict air quality, offering fast global pollution forecasts at lower computational cost than conventional chemical transport models. These FMs are typically trained on reanalysis data and generate forecasts through autoregressive rollout. They do not explicitly represent governing physical or chemical processes. Therefore, high forecast skill does not reveal whether a model has learned physical mechanisms or exploits statistical regularities in its training data. Here, we present the first study of what a FM fine-tuned for atmospheric chemistry has learned by examining Microsoft's Aurora model. We impose controlled chemical perturbations on its forecasts and test them against known photochemical relationships. We then examine the internal representations that generate these forecasts. We find that Aurora captures a first-order ozone response to reactive nitrogen but does not enforce the chemical constraints that a process-based model encodes. It generates chemically inconsistent combinations of related species and relaxes localized emission features such as wildfire plumes toward background. Internally, its representations remain largely organized around the meteorology inherited during pretraining, with little structure specific to chemistry. Using sparse autoencoders, we identify internal components that causally control the chemical forecast but do not map cleanly onto individual atmospheric processes. This work provides a framework for testing whether AI forecasting systems learn atmospheric chemistry from reanalysis data. As these models are increasingly positioned to inform environmental policy decisions, we argue that composition forecasts should also be judged by their internal mechanisms rather than by benchmark skill alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对微调用于大气化学的AI基础模型（Microsoft Aurora）进行机制可解释性研究。通过施加受控化学扰动并分析内部表征，发现模型捕获了臭氧对活性氮的一阶响应，但未强制执行基于过程的化学约束，且内部表征主要围绕预训练继承的气象学组织，缺乏特定化学结构。稀疏自编码器识别了因果控制化学预测的内部组件，但未映射到单个大气过程。
Motivation: 天气预报基础模型越来越多地被微调用于空气质量预测，但其高预测技能并不揭示模型是否学习了物理机制或利用了训练数据中的统计规律。
Method: 对Microsoft Aurora模型施加受控化学扰动，测试其是否符合已知光化学关系，并利用稀疏自编码器分析内部表征和因果控制组件。
Result: Aurora捕获了臭氧对活性氮的一阶响应，但生成化学不一致的物种组合，并松弛局部排放特征（如野火羽流）向背景值。内部表征主要围绕气象学组织，稀疏自编码器识别的组件未清晰映射到单个大气过程。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个测试AI预测系统是否从再分析数据学习大气化学的框架，并主张成分预测应基于内部机制而非仅基准技能来评估。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: HARP: The Human--AI Research Platform
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shifted human--computer interaction from `traditional'' interface journeys toward more conversational exchanges. Researchers studying HCI and UI use moderated usability sessions, interviews, surveys, transcript analysis, and static prototypes. However, static prototypes provide limited opportunities to study interaction with live AI systems or systematically control how an LLM behaves across participants and scenarios. Conversation transcripts reveal little about how users formulate, revise, and hesitate over prompts before submission. We designed the Human--AI Research Platform (HARP) for researchers, designers, and anyone who has ever wondered, `What if AI did this?' HARP places participants in controlled mock scenarios with live, configurable AI agents. Researchers can control agent prompts, model parameters, response characteristics, and experimental conditions; trigger surveys at predefined moments; and record prompt composition time, response latency, deletions, and keystroke pauses. Planned capabilities include voice, facial expression, gesture, and, where legally and ethically appropriate, emotion analysis. We illustrate HARP through a study examining how technical specificity and response length affect retention of LLM output. By pairing controllable live agents with behavioral and self-report measures, HARP enables systematic testing of how AI design choices affect users.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, SAP Academic Community Conference North America, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了人类-AI研究平台HARP（Human-AI Research Platform），用于在受控虚拟场景中研究用户与可配置大型语言模型（LLM）代理的交互。平台能记录提示词编写时间、按键间隔、删除行为等细粒度行为数据，并支持触发问卷、控制模型参数和实验条件。通过一个关于技术细节和响应长度对LLM输出保留影响的示例研究，展示了平台的能力。
Motivation: 现有的静态原型和对话转录方法难以研究用户在与实时AI系统交互时如何形成、修改和犹豫于提示词，也无法系统控制LLM行为在不同参与者和场景中的表现。
Method: HARP平台让研究人员将参与者置于受控的虚拟场景中，使用实时可配置AI代理；可控制代理提示词、模型参数、响应特性和实验条件，在预设时刻触发问卷，并记录提示词编写时间、响应延迟、删除和按键停顿。计划加入语音、面部表情、手势和情绪分析。
Result: 通过一个示例研究，展示了技术细节和响应长度如何影响用户对LLM输出的保留，但摘要未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: HARP通过结合可控实时代理与行为及自我报告测量，为系统测试AI设计选择如何影响用户提供了工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emergent Compositional Skills in Mixture-of-Experts VLAs
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning compositional robot policies end-to-end from expert demonstrations, without any pre-specified notion of task decomposition or hierarchy. We ask whether a VLA trained with a simplified Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) action head can emergently learn to decompose tasks into reusable, interpretable primitives. We find that learned experts are heavily reused across tasks and consistently correspond to qualitatively distinct low-level behaviors, suggesting that the router implicitly learns to perform high-level sequencing while experts serve as compositional primitives. Our MoE matches the task performance of a monolithic baseline while demonstrating meaningful expert specialization, a step toward modular, interpretable robot policies that emerge from data alone.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Compositional Learning at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从专家演示中端到端学习组合式机器人策略，无需预先定义任务分解或层次结构。使用简化混合专家（MoE）动作头的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）能够涌现性地学习将任务分解为可重用、可解释的原语。实验表明，专家模块在任务间被大量重用，且对应不同的低层行为，路由器隐式学习高层序列规划。MoE在任务性能上与单体基线相当，同时展现出有意义的专家特化。
Motivation: 现有机器人策略学习通常依赖预定义的任务分解或层次结构，缺乏从数据中自动涌现组合技能的能力。探索能否通过端到端学习，让模型自主发现可重用的行为原语。
Method: 在VLA模型上使用简化的MoE动作头，每个专家模块学习不同的行为原语，路由器负责根据输入选择专家。训练过程中没有显式监督专家的语义。
Result: MoE在任务性能上与单体基线相当，且专家模块在任务间被重用，每个专家对应可区分的低层行为，表明路由器学会了高层序列规划。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了从数据中涌现模块化、可解释机器人策略的可能性，为无需人工分解的组合学习提供了可行方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memory-Computation Tradeoffs in Semi Amortized Parametric Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Learning-enabled decision systems often use offline data or computation to reduce online compute cost. Despite the empirical success of such approaches, there is limited general understanding of how much offline information is needed to achieve a desired accuracy under a fixed online computation budget. We study this question through the lens of amortized parametric optimization: an offline phase stores a finite memory of solved problem instances, and an online phase produces a solution to a new instance by retrieving a warm start and applying $K$ steps of projected gradient descent. We analyze this setup for smooth convex parametric optimization over a compact domain, using a nonparametric predictor built from the stored offline solutions. For $μ$-strongly convex objectives, we establish matching upper and lower bounds on the memory required to guarantee $\varepsilon$-accuracy under a fixed online iteration budget $K$. For convex objectives satisfying a $β$-growth condition ($β>2$), we obtain near-matching bounds and identify a phase transition in $K$ beyond which additional memory provides no benefit. We further provide a general proof framework that (i) explicitly quantifies the memory cost of acceleration---how much offline memory is required to achieve a prescribed speedup over the unaided online optimizer---and (ii) identifies two key quantities driving this cost: the convergence rate of the online optimizer and the Lipschitz sensitivity of the solution map to the problem parameter. Experiments on parameterized ridge regression confirm the predicted memory--computation--accuracy tradeoffs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究半摊销参数优化中记忆与计算的权衡：离线阶段存储有限数量的已求解问题实例，在线阶段通过检索热启动并应用K步投影梯度下降来求解新实例。针对强凸目标和满足增长条件的目标，给出了保证ε精度所需记忆的匹配上下界。实验在参数化岭回归上验证了预测的权衡。
Motivation: 现有的学习驱动决策系统通常使用离线数据或计算来减少在线计算成本，但缺乏关于实现特定精度所需离线信息量的通用理解。
Method: 提出一个半摊销参数优化框架：离线阶段存储有限记忆，在线阶段检索热启动并运行K步投影梯度下降。对光滑凸参数优化问题进行分析，使用非参数预测器从离线解构建，并推导记忆上下界。
Result: 对于μ-强凸目标，建立了保证ε精度所需记忆的匹配上下界；对于满足β增长条件（β>2）的凸目标，得到近似匹配的界，并发现K超过某个阈值后额外记忆无益。此外，量化了加速的记忆成本，并识别出两个关键驱动力：在线优化器的收敛率和解映射对问题参数的Lipschitz敏感性。
Conclusion: 论文提供了分析半摊销参数优化中记忆-计算-精度权衡的理论框架，并通过参数化岭回归实验验证。

papers.title: Are Diversity Metrics Measuring Diversity? A Capability-Controlled Audit of Majority-Vote Gain in LLM Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Majority voting over LLMs is widely assumed to benefit from diversity, and diversity measures are used to choose which models to combine. We ask whether five such measures track diversity or mainly re-express capability, auditing them as predictors of majority-vote gain over the best member across 31,900 subsets of 30 LLMs on MMLU-Pro (29 on TruthfulQA) under explicit capability controls. Three findings emerge. First, latent complementarity is ubiquitous: oracle gain is positive in 100% of subsets, yet simple voting beats the strongest member in only 9.98% of all canonical size-3 subsets (18.71% with held-out best selection); the pooled size-2-4 rate is 1.27%, partly reflecting deterministic even-size voting behavior. Second, a joint-correctness proxy (strict diversity) is nearly collinear with one minus mean accuracy (size-3 Spearman rho = +0.991 / +0.988); raw diversity-gain associations are strongly capability-entangled and, with one exception, unstable under control. Third, three linear contingency-table statistics are algebraically non-separable; after capability control, the empirically stable remainder is a modest residual pairwise co-failure association in which more shared error corresponds to lower gain. This direction is robust, but its magnitude is configuration-dependent. Joint rawspace linear regressions treating strict diversity, disagreement, and double-fault as independent predictors are rank-deficient by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了五种常用多样性度量是否真正衡量LLM集成中的多样性，还是主要反映模型能力。通过在30个LLM的31,900个子集上实验（MMLU-Pro和TruthfulQA），发现多数投票增益与能力高度纠缠，且大多数多样性度量在控制能力后变得不稳定。
Motivation: 现有LLM集成中，多数投票被假设得益于多样性，但多样性度量是否真正捕获多样性而非能力尚未被严格审计。
Method: 对31,900个子集（30个LLM）在MMLU-Pro和TruthfulQA上进行实验，显式控制模型能力，审计五种多样性度量对多数投票增益的预测能力。
Result: 潜在互补性普遍存在（Oracle增益在100%子集中为正），但简单投票仅在小部分子集中超过最强成员；原始多样性-增益关联强烈依赖于能力，控制能力后大多数度量不稳定；三种线性列联表统计量代数上不可分离，控制能力后稳定的残差是成对共同失败关联。
Conclusion: 多样性度量在能力控制下不稳定，多数投票增益主要由能力而非多样性驱动，现有度量不适合用于选择LLM集成成员。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 现有LLM集成中，多数投票被假设得益于多样性，但多样性度量是否真正捕获多样性而非能力尚未被严格审计。
summary_sections.method: 对31,900个子集（30个LLM）在MMLU-Pro和TruthfulQA上进行实验，显式控制模型能力，审计五种多样性度量对多数投票增益的预测能力。
summary_sections.result: 潜在互补性普遍存在（Oracle增益在100%子集中为正），但简单投票仅在小部分子集中超过最强成员；原始多样性-增益关联强烈依赖于能力，控制能力后大多数度量不稳定；三种线性列联表统计量代数上不可分离，控制能力后稳定的残差是成对共同失败关联。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多样性度量在能力控制下不稳定，多数投票增益主要由能力而非多样性驱动，现有度量不适合用于选择LLM集成成员。

papers.title: ArbiGraph: Arbitrarily Scalable Verifiable Task Graphs for Evaluating Context Management
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ARBIGRAPH, a benchmark generator for evaluating whether tool-assisted language agents can retain, update, compose, and discard task-relevant context across extended reasoning workflows. ARBIGRAPH represents each task as a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver, and composes tasks through typed intermediate states, instantiated here as scalar and list values. This design enables controllable task graphs whose length, dependency structure, distractor count, and value type can be varied while preserving exact automatic verification. We instantiate ARBIGRAPH with math, GSM-style word-problems, and Python-tracing task categories, and evaluate a Qwen3.5-27B tool-assisted agent across four topologies. The results show high accuracy on isolated tasks but substantial degradation on more complex dependent tasks: accuracy drops by up to 33.3% on branching chains of dependent math tasks. This shows that ARBIGRAPH exposes failures that are not visible from single-task evaluation alone. Our code, generated datasets, and evaluation results are available at https://github.com/pavelgolikov/ArbiGraph.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ArbiGraph，一个可扩展的可验证任务图基准生成器，用于评估工具辅助语言代理在复杂推理流程中的上下文管理能力。任务通过自然语言问题和可执行Python求解器表示，并组合成可控长度的任务图，支持数学、文字题和Python追踪类别。在Qwen3.5-27B代理上的评估显示，孤立任务准确率较高，但依赖任务准确率下降达33.3%。
Motivation: 现有基准无法有效评估工具辅助语言代理在需要保留、更新、组合和丢弃上下文的长推理流程中的表现，尤其是复杂依赖任务。
Method: 设计ArbiGraph，将每个任务表示为自然语言问题加可执行Python求解器，通过类型化中间状态（标量和列表）组合成任务图，可控制长度、依赖结构、干扰项数量和值类型，并支持自动精确验证。
Result: 在Qwen3.5-27B代理上，孤立任务准确率高，但分支链上的依赖数学任务准确率下降33.3%。
Conclusion: ArbiGraph暴露了单任务评估无法发现的上下文管理失败模式。

papers.title: Twoblock clustering trees with coskewness-based dimension reduction: recovering piecewise multivariate linear regimes
papers.abstract_en: The twoblock clustering tree (\tbtree) is introduced as a highly interpretable regression tree for multivariate responses. Twoblock trees are deterministic decision trees that have local multivariate linear models as their leaves and use dense or sparse twoblock dimension reduction as local leaf models and in the impurity. The resulting models are both computationally efficient and can be highly interpretable. Beyond proposing the decision tree estimator itself, this paper also introduces an estimator for the twoblock dimension reduced space based on maximizing coskewness, which facilitates identification of non-normal clusters in the data. The tree inherently produces a set of local linear models and is therefore apt to recover peicewise linear regimes, which is illustrated in a simulation. However, two real world data examples illustrate that twoblock trees are also capable of modeling more complexly nonlinear dependencies and can perform on par with black box modeling techniques, such as random forests. At each point, both the twoblock models that generate the splits, as well as the ones in the leaves, can be inspected and interpreted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双块聚类树（twoblock clustering tree）作为一种高可解释性的多变量响应回归树。该树使用确定性决策树，叶子节点为局部多元线性模型，并通过稠密或稀疏的双块降维作为局部叶模型和杂质度量。论文还引入基于最大协偏度（coskewness）的双块降维空间估计器，有助于识别非正态聚类。模拟表明树能恢复分段线性机制，真实数据示例显示其也能建模复杂非线性依赖，性能可与随机森林等黑箱方法媲美。
Motivation: 现有回归树在处理多变量响应时解释性有限，且难以捕获分段线性机制；同时需要一种既能降维又能保持可解释性的方法。
Method: 提出双块聚类树（TBT），结合确定性决策树与双块降维（dense/sparse twoblock dimension reduction），在分裂节点和叶子节点均使用双块模型；并引入基于最大协偏度的降维估计器以识别非正态聚类。
Result: 模拟显示TBT能恢复分段线性机制；两个真实世界数据示例表明其可建模复杂非线性依赖，性能与随机森林相当。
Conclusion: 双块聚类树兼具计算效率和可解释性，每个分裂和叶子模型均可检查和解释，适用于分段线性及非线性多变量回归场景。

papers.title: IssueTrojanBench: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents Against Malicious Issue Requests
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents powered by LLMs are increasingly integrated into real-world software development, where they generate, edit, and execute code with autonomous access to local files and tools. Coding agents inherit security risks from both the LLM backbone, where adversarial prompts, poisoned training data, and backdoor triggers can cause models to emit insecure or attacker-chosen code, and their agentic architecture, where tool-using autonomy enables induced misuse of external APIs, data exfiltration, and persistent compromise of development environments. This paper presents a systematic evaluation of malicious issue requests against state-of-the-art coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex Desktop), powered by two major model families (OpenAI GPT-5.3 Codex/GPT-5.4 and Anthropic Sonnet 4.6). Our novel benchmark IssueTrojanBench contains malicious issues that are constructed based on four novel attack categories (i.e., embedded as malicious instructions in issues), six delivery vectors (e.g., PDF, or issue comment), and further augmented by perturbations. Our results reveal critical vulnerabilities in the as-deployed modern coding agents, i.e., 66.5% of the malicious issues from IssueTrojanBench penetrate all the guardrails (agent- and LLM-level) of coding agents. Our further analysis shows that rejection is almost entirely from LLMs rather than the agent frameworks, with GPT models broadly vulnerable and Sonnet 4.6 exhibiting more selective, risk-aware blocking of high-impact actions. Our evaluation also highlights that the current agent-level defense strategy offers limited additional protection for coding agents. Our findings highlight the urgent need for stronger agent- and model-level safety mechanisms to protect AI coding agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IssueTrojanBench 基准，系统评估了 AI 编码智能体（如 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex Desktop）在面对恶意 issue 请求时的安全性。恶意 issue 基于四种攻击类别、六种传递向量构建，并经过扰动增强。结果显示，66.5% 的恶意 issue 穿透了所有安全防护，且拒绝几乎完全来自 LLM 而非智能体框架，GPT 模型普遍脆弱，Sonnet 4.6 则表现出更具选择性的风险感知阻断。
Motivation: AI 编码智能体在集成到软件开发时，既面临 LLM 本身的安全风险（如对抗性提示、数据投毒、后门触发），也面临智能体架构中工具使用带来的额外风险（如 API 滥用、数据泄露）。现有研究缺乏对恶意 issue 请求的系统评估，因此需要构建基准来暴露实际部署中的漏洞。
Method: 构建 IssueTrojanBench 基准，包含基于四种攻击类别（嵌入为恶意指令）、六种传递向量（如 PDF、issue 评论）并经过扰动增强的恶意 issue。使用两个主流模型系列（OpenAI GPT-5.3 Codex/GPT-5.4 和 Anthropic Sonnet 4.6）驱动的三个编码智能体进行测试。
Result: 66.5% 的恶意 issue 穿透了所有防护（智能体级和 LLM 级）。拒绝几乎全部来自 LLM 而非智能体框架；GPT 模型普遍脆弱，而 Sonnet 4.6 展示出更强的选择性风险阻断。当前智能体级防御提供的额外保护有限。
Conclusion: AI 编码智能体存在严重安全漏洞，迫切需要更强的智能体级和模型级安全机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GaugeQuant: Online Learning of Quantization-Optimal Bases from LLM Symmetries
papers.abstract_en: Transformers are known to have internal continuous symmetries that leave outputs invariant, while modifying quantization. GaugeQuant leverages this in-training by introducing a LogSumExp term to the loss that breaks the symmetries, thus selecting a basis that minimizes activation outliers. A stop-gradient operator ensures that only rotation matrices are updated, yielding the language modeling objective completely unaltered. Our requires no specific calibration data, no quantization simulation, and adds negligible training overhead. With the LLaMA-2 7B model under W4A4 quantization with group size 128, perplexity drops from 8.22 to 6.73, competing with post-training methods that require frozen models and calibration datasets. Under W4A16, perplexity drops from 11.16 to 5.45. Code is available at https://github.com/MPedraBento/gauge-quant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GaugeQuant方法，利用Transformer内部的连续对称性，在训练过程中通过损失函数中的LogSumExp项打破对称性，从而选择最小化激活离群值的量化最优基。该方法无需标定数据、无需量化模拟，且训练开销可忽略。在LLaMA-2 7B模型上，W4A4量化（group size 128）下困惑度从8.22降至6.73，W4A16下从11.16降至5.45，与需要冻结模型和标定数据集的后训练方法竞争。
Motivation: Transformer模型内部存在连续对称性，不同基下的量化效果差异大，现有方法未充分利用这种对称性来优化量化基的选择。
Method: 在训练损失中加入LogSumExp项以打破对称性，通过stop-gradient操作仅更新旋转矩阵，保持语言建模目标不变，从而在线学习量化最优基。
Result: 在LLaMA-2 7B模型上，W4A4量化（group size 128）困惑度从8.22降至6.73，W4A16下从11.16降至5.45，性能优于或持平于需要标定数据的后训练量化方法。
Conclusion: GaugeQuant有效利用模型对称性在线优化量化基，无需额外数据或模拟，训练开销小，为量化感知训练提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A real-time RGB-D perception pipeline for autonomous impact hammers in mining: self-filtering, rock segmentation and rock-breaking poses generation
papers.abstract_en: Impact hammers, also known as rock-breakers, are essential machines in mining operations, where they perform secondary reduction. In underground mining, these machines are typically teleoperated, limiting operational efficiency. This paper presents a real-time RGB-D perception pipeline as a step towards automating the operation of hydraulic impact hammers used in mining. The proposed system simultaneously generates operationally feasible rock-breaking poses and a robot-free 3D representation of the workspace. The proposed approach combines image-based instance segmentation with geometric point cloud processing, and operates on embedded hardware at approximately 10 Hz with a total latency of around 675 ms, enabling responsive closed-loop behavior when integrated with a control system. Experimental results in a representative scaled scenario demonstrate that the proposed system is suitable for real-time autonomous impact hammer operation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于采矿中自主冲击锤的实时RGB-D感知流水线，结合图像实例分割与几何点云处理，在嵌入式硬件上以约10 Hz运行，总延迟约675 ms，能同时生成可行的破岩姿态和无机器人工作区3D表示。实验在缩比场景中验证了系统的实时性和适用性。
Motivation: 采矿中冲击锤通常依赖遥操作，效率低下，需要向自动化迈进。
Method: 提出结合RGB-D图像实例分割与点云几何处理的感知流水线，生成操作可行的破岩姿态和工作区无机器人3D表示。
Result: 系统在嵌入式硬件上达到约10 Hz运行频率，总延迟约675 ms，实验证明适用于实时自主冲击锤操作。
Conclusion: 该系统在缩比场景中验证了可行性，为未来实际矿山部署提供了基础。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Bio-Inspired Robotic Trajectory Planning with Obstacle Avoidance
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in robotics, requiring the generation of collision-free and efficient trajectories in a potentially complex environment. While sampling-based planners remain the dominant approach, they are often computationally expensive, particularly in high-dimensional spaces and obstacle-rich environments. Methods based on model learning offer a promising alternative, enabling efficient planning through a bounded number of forward passes through a neural trajectory planner, but commonly suffer from low sample efficiency or limited generalisation due to their reliance on exploration or expert demonstrations. This follow-up work tests our neuro-inspired self-supervised learning framework for trajectory planning that leverages forward and inverse models as the internal supervisory mechanism in an environment that contains an obstacle. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility of the approach while revealing a tendency of our planner to exploit the learning signal provided by the forward and inverse models. To address this issue, additional training regimes and mitigation strategies are proposed and evaluated.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. To be published in 2026 International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN) proceedings. This research was supported by the Slovak Research and Development Agency, project APVV-21-0105
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于生物启发的自监督学习框架，用于含障碍物环境下的机器人轨迹规划。该方法利用前向模型和逆向模型作为内部监督机制，无需外部专家演示或大量探索。实验验证了可行性，但发现规划器倾向于利用前向和逆向模型提供的学习信号，导致潜在不稳定性，为此提出了额外的训练策略和缓解措施。
Motivation: 现有轨迹规划方法中，采样型方法在高维和障碍密集环境中计算成本高，而基于模型学习的方法常因依赖探索或专家演示导致样本效率低或泛化受限。本文旨在探索一种无需外部标签的自监督神经规划方法。
Method: 提出了神经启发式自监督学习框架，内部包含前向模型和逆向模型，通过二者提供的监督信号训练轨迹规划器。在含障碍物环境中进行测试，并针对规划器利用学习信号的倾向设计了额外训练策略。

papers.title: Adaptive Confidence-weighted Expansion for Trustworthy Multi-Omics Multimodal Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning is a robust approach to improve predictive performance in applications such as medical prognosis. However, the clinical applicability of models that use multimodal learning is hampered by their poor performance under noisy or uninformative data streams. Present fusion approaches often lack robust mechanisms for the dynamic assessment of data quality and for the provision of a trustable confidence score on the final prediction. This dissuades their deployment in safety-critical settings. To address these limitations, we introduce Adaptive Confidence-weighted Expansion (ACE), a novel framework to enhance the trustworthiness of multimodal fusion models. ACE first enhances the multimodal space by generating new, complementary modalities from intra-modality correlations. It then employs a dual-level confidence mechanism that (1) adaptively reweighs all modalities by their reliability before fusion and (2) estimates a global trust score over the fused, final decision. To evaluate ACE, we used four challenging multi-omics datasets (BRCA, KIPAN, LGG, and ROSMAP). ACE significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art algorithms in both classification performance and confidence calibration. Our framework provides a more stable and robust data fusion method that facilitates the use of multimodal learning in addressing high-stakes problems.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应置信加权扩展（ACE）框架，旨在增强多模态融合模型的可信度。ACE通过从模态内相关性生成新的互补模态来增强多模态空间，并采用双层级置信度机制：融合前根据可靠性自适应重加权各模态，融合后估计全局信任分数。在四个多组学数据集（BRCA、KIPAN、LGG、ROSMAP）上，ACE在分类性能和置信度校准方面均显著优于现有最先进算法。
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法缺乏动态评估数据质量的机制，在噪声或无效数据流下性能较差，且无法提供可信的置信度分数，限制了其在安全关键场景（如医疗预后）中的临床部署。
Method: ACE框架包含两个核心步骤：（1）模态内相关性增强，通过生成新的互补模态扩展多模态空间；（2）双层级置信度机制，包括融合前根据模态可靠性自适应重加权和融合后估计全局信任分数。
Result: 在BRCA、KIPAN、LGG、ROSMAP四个多组学数据集上，ACE在分类性能和置信度校准方面显著优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: ACE提供了一种更稳定、鲁棒的数据融合方法，有助于推动多模态学习在高风险问题中的应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Pipelined Gradient Coding
papers.abstract_en: In large-scale machine learning, distributed training commonly involves multiple workers evaluating the gradients of the model on different dataset partitions. A common challenge is the presence of straggling workers, which may significantly slow down training. Traditional gradient coding (GC) addresses this by duplicating dataset partitions across workers, allowing for the replacement of missing gradients from stragglers. However, GC requires workers to evaluate gradients on multiple dataset partitions in each step, potentially increasing overall training time. In this paper, we propose to pipeline GC, such that gradient evaluation is segmented across multiple steps and each worker evaluates gradients on just a single dataset partition per step. We develop the pipelined version for fractional repetition (FR) and cyclic repetition (CR), two representative dataset placement schemes in GC, and prove convergence guarantees for both. Through extensive simulations and experiments on cloud infrastructure, our schemes not only significantly reduce training time but also accelerate convergence compared to GC and other baselines.
papers.comment: This is the extended version of the paper accepted at the IEEE Information Theory Workshop (ITW) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布式训练中的掉队者问题，提出流水线梯度编码（Pipelined Gradient Coding），将梯度评估分段到多个步骤，每个工作节点每步只评估一个数据集分区的梯度。基于分数重复（FR）和循环重复（CR）两种典型数据集放置方案，给出了流水线版本及其收敛保证。模拟和云实验表明，该方法相比传统梯度编码显著减少训练时间并加速收敛。
Motivation: 传统梯度编码（GC）需要工作节点每步评估多个数据集分区，可能增加训练时间。本文旨在减少训练时间并加速收敛。
Method: 提出流水线化梯度编码，将梯度评估分段到多个步骤，每个工作节点每步只评估一个数据集分区。针对分数重复（FR）和循环重复（CR）方案给出流水线版本，并证明收敛性。
Result: 通过大量模拟和云基础设施实验，所提方案相比传统梯度编码（GC）和其他基线显著减少训练时间并加速收敛。
Conclusion: 流水线梯度编码能有效缓解掉队者问题，降低训练时间，同时保证收敛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cardinality-Decomposed Loss: Matching Training Objectives to Relation Structure in Heterogeneous Recommendation Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks trained on heterogenous bipartite graphs form a common basis in recommendation systems. These graphs often express relations that vary in cardinality, for example, user-item preferences are one-to-many and user-attribute features are one-to-one. Traditionally, a unique loss function is applied for all of the network components which is often Bayesian Personalized Ranking (BPR). While BPR works well for the recommendation task, we find that it causes attribute embeddings to collapse to near-random geometry -- a silent failure that leaves standard ranking metrics largely unaffected and therefore invisible to conventional evaluation. This in turn pollutes user node embeddings, which are shaped by both edge types simultaneously, hurting downstream tasks like personalization, segmentation, etc. Here we propose a Cardinality-Decomposed Loss (CDL) that combines both Cross Entropy (CE) and BPR to enable the model to collectively optimize for relations across cardinalities. We confirm this CE-BPR conflict by showing the two losses compete in the shared encoder's parameter space. We evaluate CDL on five datasets spanning two structural configurations -- one-to-one attributes on user nodes (MovieLens-1M, Last.fm-360K, PayPal Audience Factory, BookCrossing) and on item nodes (Yelp) -- and find that CDL consistently improves discriminability in attribute embeddings. We also show that ranking (NDCG) improves when attributes carry meaningful preference signal, but conflicts with it when the correlation is weak. We use a lambda parameter to navigate this trade-off, and a lambda-sweep reveals that dataset behavior is governed by two graph properties -- semantic alignment and topology leakage. Semantic alignment measures whether the attribute predicts preferences, while topology leakage measures whether the graph's connectivity already encodes it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基数分解损失（CDL），通过联合优化交叉熵（CE）和贝叶斯个性化排序（BPR）损失，解决异构推荐图中不同基数关系（如一对多和一对一）导致属性嵌入坍缩的问题。实验表明CDL在五个数据集上一致提升属性嵌入的可区分性，并通过λ参数平衡排序性能与属性信号，数据集行为受语义对齐和拓扑泄漏两个图属性控制。
Motivation: 传统推荐系统在异构图上使用统一BPR损失，导致属性嵌入坍缩为近随机几何，该失败不被标准排序指标检测，却污染用户节点嵌入，影响个性化等下游任务。
Method: 提出CDL，结合CE和BPR损失，分析两者在共享编码器参数空间中的竞争关系，引入λ参数在排序性能和属性判别性之间进行权衡。
Result: 在五个数据集上CDL一致提升属性嵌入的可区分性；当属性携带有效偏好信号时，NDCG提升，否则冲突。
Conclusion: 数据集行为由语义对齐（属性是否预测偏好）和拓扑泄漏（图连接是否已编码偏好）两个图属性决定，λ参数扫描可揭示其权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLMs Get Lost in Evolving User Intent
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs become more capable, they are increasingly deployed as collaborative agents, taking on user-delegated tasks through iterative interaction. Yet genuine interaction is inherently dynamic: users rarely specify their intent upfront, instead disclosing, revising, and reshaping it as the conversation unfolds. Despite this, LLMs are still predominantly evaluated or trained in single-turn, fully-specified settings, leaving open a fundamental question: how well do LLMs track and act on user intent as it evolves over the course of a conversation? To study this, we introduce a framework that transforms static, single-turn tasks into dynamic multi-turn conversations in which the user's intent evolves across turns--incrementally revealed, revised, and at times redirected mid-conversation--while preserving each task's original evaluation protocol, enabling existing benchmarks to be reused as controlled testbeds without new annotation. Across multiple tasks, we surface a consistent phenomenon: strong static-setting performance does not transfer to the evolving-intent setting, with substantial drops across model families. Our findings point to a fundamental gap: today's LLMs do not yet faithfully track and act on the user's evolving intent, a capability invisible to static evaluation yet critical for future collaborative agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM在动态多轮对话中追踪和响应用户演化意图的能力。作者通过将静态单轮任务转化为动态多轮对话的框架，发现LLM在静态设置中的强大性能无法迁移到演化意图场景，性能显著下降，指出当前LLM缺乏忠实追踪演化意图的能力。
Motivation: 当前LLM主要在单轮、完全指定的设置中评估和训练，但真实交互中用户意图是动态演化的，现有评估忽视了这一关键能力。
Method: 提出一个框架，将静态单轮任务转化为动态多轮对话，意图在回合间逐步揭示、修订甚至转移，同时保留原任务的评估协议，从而复用现有基准。
Result: 在多个任务上，静态性能好的模型在演化意图设置中性能大幅下降，这一现象跨模型家族一致。
Conclusion: 当前的LLM未能忠实追踪和响应用户演化意图，这一能力在静态评估中不可见，但对未来协作型智能体至关重要。

papers.title: GPE: Evaluating Robust Evidence Aggregation for Fact Verification under Controllable GEO-Style Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly use search tools to retrieve up-to-date information, introducing a new attack surface in which retrieved documents can be manipulated. This risk is amplified by the development of generative engine optimization, which can make selected content more likely to be retrieved, cited, and adopted by models. Existing fact-verification benchmarks and evaluation frameworks do not provide the controlled evidence environments needed to assess robustness against GEO poisoning. We therefore propose GPE, which consists of a multi-domain fact-verification benchmark and an evaluation framework for controlling evidence sources and poisoning ratios. Experiments across multiple verification methods and poisoning attacks demonstrate that GPE exposes robustness degradation and efficiency trade-offs that cannot be observed through clean evaluation alone, confirming the need to evaluate fact verification under adversarial evidence environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GPE基准与评估框架，用于在可控证据环境中评估事实验证模型对生成引擎优化（GEO）投毒攻击的鲁棒性。实验表明现有验证方法在对抗性证据环境下性能显著下降，且存在效率权衡。
Motivation: 现有事实验证基准缺乏可控的证据环境，无法评估模型对GEO投毒攻击的鲁棒性，而大语言模型使用搜索工具获取信息时可能面临检索文档被操纵的风险。
Method: 构建多领域事实验证基准GPE，包含可控证据来源和投毒比例评估框架，并测试多种验证方法在不同投毒攻击下的表现。
Result: GPE揭示了仅通过干净评估无法观察到的鲁棒性退化与效率权衡，验证了在对抗性证据环境下评估事实验证的必要性。
Conclusion: 事实验证系统需要在对抗性证据环境下进行鲁棒性评估，GPE框架为此提供了标准化手段。

papers.title: Operational Identity: A Finite Audit of Declared and Implemented Rules of Sameness
papers.abstract_en: A record system declares when two records refer to the same entity, occurrence, scope, or rule. Its disclosed implementation mechanisms induce a corresponding operational identity relation. The declared and implemented relations may diverge systematically without producing a provenance gap or detectable contradiction. A system can apply, consistently and with every record individually correct, a rule of sameness that no artifact declares. This paper formalizes that implemented relation. A declared identity regime partitions a finite record domain into co-reference classes; a disclosed mechanism, through its typed identity-relevant outcomes, induces an operational identity partition of the same domain. The audit compares these partitions in the refinement lattice. A mechanism is faithful when the declared partition refines the operational partition, so no declared class is split. A divergence witness is a pair the declaration merges and the mechanism separates; such witnesses are decidable by pair enumeration. When an imported sibling basis also splits a declared class, local comparison with its partition yields sibling-aligned, sub-sibling, super-sibling, or sibling-incomparable divergence. This result reports only the relationship; it does not identify the basis carried by the mechanism. Global equality of the operational and sibling partitions is defined separately as regime substitution and does not follow from sibling alignment. A version field incremented on every textual edit inhabits the sub-sibling case by splitting declared classes more finely than either imported basis. The audit is three-valued and relative to the disclosed artifacts, evaluated surfaces, and identified uses; each boundary has a finite refuting witness. A passing verdict is non-monotone because extending the transformation history can merge declared classes and create a witness among records already examined.

TL;DR: 该论文形式化定义了记录系统中声明的同一性（declared identity）与实现的同一性（operational identity）之间的差异，并提出一种基于划分细化格（refinement lattice）的审计方法，通过有限对枚举检测分歧。
Motivation: 记录系统可能在不产生可检测矛盾的情况下，系统地偏离其声明的同一性规则，现有方法无法有效揭示这种隐含偏差。
Method: 将记录域划分为声明的和操作的两个分区，在细化格中比较它们；通过枚举对（pair enumeration）寻找分歧见证（divergence witness），并引入兄弟分区对齐概念进行局部比较。
Result: 审计结果是一个三值判断，依赖于所披露的工件、评估表面和识别的用途；通过验证是非单调的，因为扩展转换历史可能合并已声明的类并产生新见证。
Conclusion: 该工作为理解记录系统中同一性规则的实现偏差提供了形式化框架和可判定的审计方法。

papers.title: Leaky Language Models: Stealing Architecture and Inference Optimizations via Per-Token Timing
papers.abstract_en: This work presents LeakyLMs, a set of attacks that leak proprietary model, architecture, and deployment information from production language models. LeakyLMs is the first to demonstrate that key model and deployment details can be inferred using only token generation timing, even when interacting through remote APIs. LeakyLMs introduces two core attacks. The first attack targets inference optimizations and deployment strategies. For example, our attack detects whether a provider uses speculative decoding, a widely deployed inference-time optimization, and further identifies the context length of the draft model used in the pipeline. Our measurements show that Google Gemini Flash 2.5 uses speculative decoding with a draft context window of approximately 128K tokens. The second attack recovers key architectural properties, including the number of transformer layers, hidden dimension size, and number of attention heads. To achieve this, LeakyLMs builds a detailed and accurate model of token-generation timing on modern NVIDIA GPUs, characterizing how latency scales with model configuration and hardware parameters. The attack then performs a search over the architecture space using this timing model. In experiments with Llama models, the near-correct architectural configuration appears in the top-10 guesses more than 90% of the time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LeakyLMs攻击方法，首次证明仅通过远程API的token生成时序即可推断推理优化（如推测解码）和模型架构（如层数、隐藏维度、注意力头数）。实验针对Llama模型，能在top-10猜测中超过90%准确率恢复架构。
Motivation: 现有侧信道攻击关注输出层面，但未利用时序信息窃取模型内部细节；生产模型常隐藏架构和部署策略，本工作填补利用token生成时序进行攻击的空白。
Method: 构建两个核心攻击：1）检测推理优化（如推测解码及其草稿模型上下文长度），2）建立精确的NVIDIA GPU时序模型，通过搜索架构空间反演层数、隐藏维度和注意力头数。
Result: 攻击成功识别Google Gemini Flash 2.5使用推测解码且草稿上下文约128K tokens；对Llama模型，接近正确的架构配置在top-10猜测中超过90%概率出现。
Conclusion: 强调时序侧信道对生产语言模型架构和部署策略的泄露风险，呼吁防御措施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Transition-Related Potentials as Markers of Narrative Comprehension in Continuous EEG
papers.abstract_en: Harnessing the potential of electroencephalography (EEG) for brain research is fundamentally limited by intrinsic noise and the diffuse projection of brain-generated activity over the scalp. The standard event-related potential (ERP) paradigm addresses this limitation by relying on repeated independent trials, albeit at the cost of moving away from naturalistic experimental conditions. As a more naturalistic alternative, we collected continuous EEG while participants watched short films and extracted potentials aligned to sharp cinematic transitions (cuts). We demonstrate that such transition-related potentials (TRPs) exhibit canonical ERP-like temporal structure associated with significant information processing. By comparing coherent films with scene-scrambled versions containing matched post-cut sensory input, we find that these responses are systematically shaped by narrative context. We then show that the cut-related EEG signature can be recovered directly from group-averaged continuous recordings with a compact deep neural network (DNN). The detector generalized across films and subject groups, and the resulting TRPs reproduced the main context-dependent effects observed for manually annotated cuts. These results indicate that narrative context leaves a measurable signature in EEG responses, that this signature can be detected directly in continuous recordings, and that such detections provide a semi-automated framework for analyzing how viewers process and understand film narratives. We propose that the method outlined here can be adapted to parse EEG responses to other forms of continuous stimulation, providing a general tool for probing experimental conditions that are closer to natural human experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用连续EEG记录观众观看短片时的脑电信号，提取与电影剪辑（cinematic cuts）对齐的过渡相关电位（TRP），发现TRP具有类ERP的时域结构，且受叙事语境调节。通过对比连贯电影与场景乱序版本，证明叙事语境影响脑电响应。进一步用紧凑深度神经网络从群体平均连续记录中检测剪辑相关EEG特征，该检测器可跨影片和受试者泛化。结果表明叙事语境在EEG中留下可测标记，为分析观众如何理解电影叙事提供半自动化框架。
Motivation: 标准ERP范式依赖重复独立试次，牺牲了自然实验条件。论文旨在利用连续EEG在自然叙事场景中研究脑对电影剪辑的响应，并证明叙事语境的作用。
Method: 采集观众观看短片的连续EEG，对齐电影剪辑（cuts）提取TRP；比较连贯电影与场景乱序版本以分离叙事语境效应；训练紧凑DNN从群体平均连续记录中检测剪辑相关EEG特征。
Result: TRP表现出典型的ERP时域结构；叙事语境显著塑造TRP形态；DNN检测器可跨影片和受试者泛化，再现手动标注剪辑的语境依赖效应。
Conclusion: 叙事语境在连续EEG中留下可检测标记，该方法可推广至其他连续刺激条件，为接近自然体验的脑机制研究提供通用工具。

papers.title: Spatial Generalization Tests for Machine Learning-based Weather Models to Assess Physical Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based weather prediction is revolutionizing weather forecasting by learning from weather data in present-day climate. However, generalization to other climates remains a major challenge. With melting sea ice, land-use change, and increasing ocean temperatures, boundary conditions are changing. Therefore, generalization in time depends on generalization in space. Here, we present three test cases to evaluate whether machine learning-based weather and climate models generalize in space and apply them to GraphCast and NeuralGCM. We reverse or rotate the planet in longitude or latitude under the model's coordinate system and adapt all boundary conditions and forcings accordingly. Physics-based general circulation models simulate a rotated/reversed planet with only rounding errors, but GraphCast and NeuralGCM fail these tests. The analyses furthermore revealed unphysical variable mappings based on correlation rather than causation. We argue that machine learning-based climate models should be designed to pass generalization tests to prevent overfitting on present-day regional climate.
papers.comment: 23 pages (double-spaced), 7 figures in the main text; 14 pages, 4 figures in supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三个空间泛化测试案例，通过翻转或旋转地球坐标来评估机器学习天气模型（GraphCast 和 NeuralGCM）的物理一致性。结果显示这些模型无法通过测试，存在基于相关性的非物理变量映射，而传统物理模型仅产生舍入误差。作者呼吁机器学习气候模型应设计通过泛化测试以避免过拟合于当前区域气候。
Motivation: 机器学习天气预报模型在当今气候下表现良好，但面对海冰融化、土地利用变化等改变边界条件的情况时，时空泛化能力不足。现有模型可能过拟合于区域气候，缺乏物理一致性。
Method: 设计了三个测试案例：在模型坐标系下反转或旋转地球的经度或纬度，并相应调整所有边界条件与强迫。将测试应用于 GraphCast 和 NeuralGCM，并与基于物理的环流模型对比。
Result: 物理模型仅产生舍入误差，而 GraphCast 和 NeuralGCM 均未能通过空间泛化测试。进一步分析发现模型中存在基于相关性而非因果关系的非物理变量映射。
Conclusion: 机器学习气候模型应通过空间泛化测试以确保物理一致性，防止对当前区域气候的过拟合。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: High Minima of Gaussian Processes: Overshoots and Minimizer Locations
papers.abstract_en: Let $X(t)$, $t\in K$, be a centred Gaussian process with continuous sample paths on a compact metric space $K$, and let $M=\min_{t\in K}X(t)$. Let $σ_*^2$ denote the minimum covariance energy associated with $X$, and assume that $σ_*^2>0$. Motivated by the results of \cite{chakrabarty2018asymptotic} for smooth Gaussian processes, we show that, conditionally on $M>u$, the scaled overshoot $u(M-u)$ converges, as $u\to\infty$, to an exponential random variable with mean $σ_*^2$. Moreover, every weak subsequential limit of the conditional law of a measurable minimizer of $X$ is an optimal covariance-energy measure. In particular, if this measure is unique, then the conditional law converges weakly to it. The results are illustrated by stationary Gaussian processes, fractional Brownian motion, and fractional Brownian sheet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究紧度量空间上连续样本轨道的中心化高斯过程在最小值超过高阈值下的条件渐近行为。证明当阈值趋于无穷时，缩放后的超调量依分布收敛到指数随机变量，且最小化点的条件测度收敛到最优协方差能量测度。
Motivation: 关于光滑高斯过程超调量的结果被推广到更一般的连续高斯过程，旨在理解其极小值的高阈值条件行为及最小化点的分布。
Method: 利用协方差能量最小化方法，结合极值理论和测度论工具，推导条件分布的极限形式。
Result: 条件超调量收敛到均值为σ_*^2的指数分布；最小化点的条件测度收敛到最优协方差能量测度（若唯一）。
Conclusion: 理论结果适用于平稳高斯过程、分数布朗运动及分数布朗 sheet等模型。

papers.title: NVIDIA-labs OO Agents: Native Python Object-Oriented Agents
papers.abstract_en: Traditional agent development is split across prompt templates, tool schemas, callback code, and workflow graphs. We present NVIDIA Object-Oriented Agents (NOOA), a model-agnostic Python framework for building reliable AI agents. NOOA takes a simpler approach: an agent is a Python object. Its methods are the actions the model can take, fields are its state, docstrings are its prompts, and its type annotations are contracts. A method whose code body consists of "..." is completed at runtime by an LLM-driven agent loop, while methods with normal bodies remain standard deterministic Python. This gives developers and agents the same interface, so agent behavior can be tested, traced, refactored, and improved just like other software. This paper makes three contributions. (1) We present the agent-as-a-Python-object programming model and the design principles behind it. Where Python has existing abstractions, we adopt them directly. Agent-specific capabilities--context, events, state rendering, long-term memory, and validated LLM loops--are exposed through simple Pythonic APIs, so both developers and agents share one familiar programming model. (2) We identify six model-facing ideas that NOOA is, to our knowledge, the first to combine on a single surface: typed input/output, pass-by-reference over live objects, code as action, programmable loop engineering, explicit object state, and model-callable harness APIs for context and events. We find the community already converging on several of these ideas--often as experimental or partial features--and present the comparison to encourage further adoption. (3) We demonstrate that current models use this interface effectively, both in targeted capability tests and on agentic and reasoning benchmarks such as SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 and ARC-AGI-3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NVIDIA Object-Oriented Agents (NOOA)，一个模型无关的Python框架，将AI代理建模为Python对象：方法作为动作，字段作为状态，文档字符串作为提示，类型注解作为契约。开发者与代理共享同一接口，支持测试、追踪、重构等软件工程实践。论文在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0和ARC-AGI-3等基准上验证了当前模型能有效使用该接口。
Motivation: 传统代理开发分散在提示模板、工具模式、回调代码和工作流图中，缺乏统一的编程模型，导致开发和维护复杂。
Method: 提出agent-as-a-Python-object编程模型，直接采用Python现有抽象，通过简单Pythonic API暴露代理特定能力（上下文、事件、状态渲染、长期记忆、验证的LLM循环），使开发者与代理共享同一编程范式。
Result: 在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0和ARC-AGI-3等基准上，当前模型能有效使用该接口，表明该框架与现有模型兼容且有效。
Conclusion: NOOA通过将代理视为Python对象，简化了代理开发，并鼓励社区采用统一的面向对象方法。

papers.title: Perspective Latents as an Architectural Condition for Causal Emergence in Active Inference Agents
papers.abstract_en: A recent line of work measures causal emergence in reinforcement learning agents through Integrated Information Decomposition, reporting that $Φ_r$ grows with training and tracks reward improvement. For active inference, this raises the question of how reward-free predictive organization relates to such information-theoretic signatures. I test this within an active inference agent whose architecture separates a fast perception latent $z$ from a slow global latent $g$, where $g$ is driven by prediction error and structurally decoupled from policy gradients. In a reward-free environmental regime-switching protocol, $Φ_r$ concentrates in $g$; its aggregate magnitude is largely architectural and decreases with training. The substantive effect of learning becomes legible only at the atom-compositional level: decoupling flips sign from negative to positive and becomes regime-invariant under environmental change, while downward causation carries the regime-dependent adjustment. These results identify $g$ as the architectural locus of $Φ_r$-relevant temporal organization in an active inference agent, and argue against reading scalar $Φ_r$ as a direct index of learned integration.

papers.title: U-CFR: Uncertainty-Guided Cascade Forward Refinement for Interactive Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive image segmentation is critical for efficient image annotation; however, existing methods often require many corrective clicks or rely on passive refinement schemes that converge slowly. We propose Uncertainty-Guided Cascade Forward Refinement (U-CFR), a novel inference-time framework that enables models to autonomously self-correct after each user interaction. U-CFR introduces a boundary-aware uncertainty score that fuses segmentation uncertainty, contour gradients, and explicit edge predictions to guide the placement of internal pseudo-clicks. These self-generated clicks target the most ambiguous boundary regions, providing strong corrective signals without additional manual input. To support this process, we design a dual-head network with a shared encoder-decoder backbone: a segmentation head ensures region consistency, while an edge head sharpens boundary alignment. In inference, U-CFR launches a cascade of refinement steps, where each stage leverages the uncertainty-driven pseudo-clicks to refine the mask progressively. Experiments on standard benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed U-CFR improves click efficiency, initial mask quality, and boundary accuracy. It reduces the required clicks by over 10% on challenging datasets like Berkeley and offers a more intelligent and efficient interactive annotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出不确定性引导级联前向细化（U-CFR），一种用于交互式分割的推理时框架。通过边界感知不确定性分数融合分割不确定性、轮廓梯度和边缘预测，生成内部伪点击以自主修正分割掩码。在Berkeley等数据集上，U-CFR减少了超过10%的用户点击，同时提升了初始掩码质量和边界精度。
Motivation: 现有交互式分割方法需要大量矫正点击或依赖被动细化方案，收敛缓慢，效率低下。
Method: 设计双头网络（分割头和边缘头）共享编码器-解码器骨干；引入边界感知不确定性分数，引导伪点击放置在最有歧义的边界区域；在推理时启动级联细化步骤，逐步优化掩码。
Result: 在标准基准上，U-CFR提高了点击效率，在Berkeley等具有挑战性的数据集上减少所需点击超过10%，并改善了初始掩码和边界准确性。
Conclusion: U-CFR提供了更智能、更高效的交互式注释方案，通过自主伪点击实现快速细化。

papers.title: A Framework for Reputation Aware Uninorm-driven Consensus Algorithms for Blockchain Networks
papers.abstract_en: The operation of blockchain is governed by consensus algorithms (CA). Several consensus mechanisms require significant computational power, while others necessitate high amounts of stakes to select the participant to validate and verify the transactions in the block, leading to centralisation of power and participant exclusion. This paper proposes a novel methodology to address these issues in reputation-based consensus algorithms by studying the reputation behaviour of the validator using intuitionistic fuzzy sets (IFSs) and uninorm aggregation operations (UAOs). Our approach uses IFSs to express the "reputation" because the reputation values in a consensus algorithm eventually imply uncertainty, and IFSs facilitate the representation of a lack of precise knowledge about reputation. Moreover, this methodology utilises uninorm aggregation operations to monitor reputation over time and reinforces the importance of negative and positive reputation. Consequently, this solution allows validators to rectify past failures in subsequent verification processes and foster an equitable consensus algorithm design. The proposed framework maintains linear computational complexity and does not introduce additional communication overhead beyond the underlying consensus protocol. Supported by experimental results, our methodology demonstrates improved performance and evaluation, promising advancements in blockchain network fairness and inclusivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于直觉模糊集 (IFS) 和中性聚合算子 (UAO) 的声誉感知共识算法框架，用于区块链网络。该框架通过 IFS 表示验证者声誉的不确定性，利用 UAO 动态聚合正负声誉，允许验证者修正历史错误，并保持线性计算复杂度且不增加额外通信开销。实验表明该方法能提升区块链网络的公平性和包容性。
Motivation: 现有区块链共识算法存在计算资源消耗大或权益集中导致权力中心化与参与者排斥的问题，声誉机制中的不确定性未被充分建模。
Method: 使用直觉模糊集 (IFS) 表达声誉的不确定性，利用中性聚合算子 (UAO) 对正负声誉进行动态聚合与监控，设计声誉驱动的验证者选择机制。
Result: 该框架保持线性计算复杂度，不增加底层共识协议的通信开销，实验显示在公平性和包容性指标上有所改进。
Conclusion: 本文的声誉感知方法通过不确定性建模和正负声誉平衡，为设计更公平包容的区块链共识算法提供了新思路。

papers.title: CEDAR: Causal Edge Discovery for Autoregressive Processes
papers.abstract_en: We propose CEDAR (Causal Edge Discovery for Autoregressive Processes), a constraint-based method for lagged causal edge discovery in sparse autoregressive time series. CEDAR screens candidate cross-variable lags using AR(1)-residualized, U-centered distance correlation, then applies two targeted conditional-independence tests per significant cross-variable lag candidate and accepts at most one lag per ordered pair. A stable MCI pruning step removes indirect edges, and optional deterministic C-nodes adjust for specified trend-like nonstationarity. In sparse regimes where few lags survive screening, CEDAR requires $O(d^2)$ CI tests after screening while retaining edge-level interpretability. CEDAR is most effective when data are scarce and variables exhibit lag-1 self-dynamics; methods with richer conditioning sets become preferable as $T$ grows or when higher-order autoregressive or simultaneous multi-lag effects are common.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CEDAR是一种基于约束的方法，用于在稀疏自回归时间序列中发现滞后因果边。它通过AR(1)残差化的U中心距离相关筛选候选变量，然后对每个显著候选进行两个条件独立性检验，最多接受每个有序对的一个滞后。稳定MCI剪枝移除间接边，可选的确定性C节点处理趋势型非平稳性。在稀疏场景下，CEDAR在筛选后仅需O(d²)次CI测试，并保持边级可解释性。该方法在数据稀缺且变量具有滞后-1自动力学时最有效。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在稀疏时间序列中可能计算成本高或难以处理滞后结构，尤其当数据量少且变量呈现强自回归特性时。
Method: CEDAR首先使用AR(1)残差化的U中心距离相关筛选候选交叉变量滞后，然后对每个通过筛选的滞后候选执行两个条件独立性检验，每个有序对最多接受一个滞后。之后采用稳定MCI剪枝步骤移除间接边，并可选地包含确定性C节点以适应趋势型非平稳性。
Result: 在稀疏场景下，CEDAR的CI测试次数在筛选后为O(d²)，且保持了边级可解释性。方法在数据稀缺和变量具有滞后-1自动力学时表现最佳。
Conclusion: CEDAR适用于稀疏自回归时间序列的滞后因果发现，特别是当数据有限且变量间关系简单时；对于更长的时间序列或更复杂的滞后结构，其他方法可能更优。

papers.title: Attribution Markets: A Fisher-Market Formulation for Fractional Credit Assignment Between Planned Tasks and Performed Actions
papers.abstract_en: Personal and organizational planning systems maintain two records that drift apart: what was planned (a task's effort budget) and what was done (a logged action's duration and description). Existing systems bridge them with an exclusive, all-or-nothing link that strands genuinely related but unlinked effort and reports false stalls on active goals. We formulate the bridge as a quasi-linear Fisher market: planned tasks are budget-constrained buyers, performed actions are divisible goods, and a fused text/structural/temporal signal sets each buyer's valuation. Two market instruments - a seller reserve price and a buyer cash option - yield conservation, a hard budget cap, and a provable junk filter as theorems. We extend the market with a concave completion utility discounting progress as a task nears its plan; standard convergence theory for the market's algorithm does not transfer here, resolved by a satiation-threshold fixed point with existence (Brouwer) and local uniqueness under an explicit diagonal-dominance condition, validated empirically on random and adversarial instances. A de-circularized, multi-seed benchmark - observed affinity corrupted independently of the scored ground truth - surfaces a genuine weak spot: the market's sharp, zero-entropy equilibrium is more sensitive to affinity noise than entropy-regularized optimal transport's permanently smoothed one. We resolve this with a one-parameter entropy-regularized generalization unifying the two, plus a noise-adaptive rule for its regularization strength. We report full reproducibility parameters, discuss limitations candidly, and relate the result to multi-touch attribution, optimal transport, and online Fisher-market algorithms.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 3 figures. Companion technical report with extended treatment of dynamic/forward-looking markets and reinforcement-learning extensions available separately
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将计划任务与执行动作之间的分数信用分配问题建模为拟线性Fisher市场，其中计划任务是预算约束的买方，执行动作是可分割的商品。通过融合文本、结构和时间信号设定估值，并引入卖方保留价和买方现金选项，证明了市场守恒、硬预算上限和垃圾过滤等性质。为解决零熵均衡对噪声敏感的问题，提出熵正则化推广，并给出了噪声自适应正则化强度规则。实验在随机和对抗实例上验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 现有计划与执行记录系统使用排他性的全有或全无链接，导致相关但未链接的努力被孤立，并报告活跃目标的假性停滞。
Method: 将信用分配问题建模为拟线性Fisher市场：计划任务是预算约束的买方，执行动作是可分割的商品，通过文本/结构/时间融合信号设定估值。引入卖方保留价和买方现金选项，得到守恒、硬预算上限和可证明的垃圾过滤。扩展了凹完成效用函数，并通过饱和阈值不动点解决收敛问题。提出熵正则化推广，结合噪声自适应正则化规则。
Result: 在随机和对抗实例上实证验证了市场性质；发现零熵均衡对亲和噪声敏感，而熵正则化均衡更鲁棒，且所提噪声自适应规则有效。
Conclusion: 论文讨论了局限性，并将结果与多触点归因、最优传输和在线Fisher市场算法相关联。
