papers.title: Achieving Almost Exact Recovery in Almost Quadratic Time: Rank-Based Graph Matching via Local Tree Correlation Tests
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies graph matching under the correlated $\text{Erdős-Rényi}$ (ER) graph pair model. This model first samples an $\mathrm{ER}(n,\fracλ{ns})$ base graph, whose edges are then independently subsampled twice with probability $s$ to produce two correlated $\mathrm{ER}(n,\fracλ{n})$ graphs. We propose a graph matching algorithm that has $n^{2+o(1)}$ time complexity and achieves almost exact recovery with high probability under the assumptions $λ=(\log n)^{α+o(1)}$ for some $α\in(0,1)$ and $s\in(\sqrt{C_{\mathrm{Otter}}},1]$, where $C_{\mathrm{Otter}}\approx 0.338$ is Otter's tree-counting constant. This is the first algorithm with almost quadratic time complexity in this regime of $λ$, while the best known result in this regime is the chandelier-counting algorithm with time complexity $O(n^{c(s)})$, where $c(s)\rightarrow \infty$ as $s$ approaches $\sqrt{C_\mathrm{Otter}}$ from above. The proposed algorithm is based on local tree correlation tests. It uses a rank-based algorithm to match the vertex pairs instead of threshold-based rules in the literature. This avoids the need of computing an explicit threshold, which is computationally difficult to obtain. To prove the almost exact recovery result, we establish a new analysis of tree correlation tests in the diverging-degree regime, where both the mean degree and the tree depth grow with $n$. Based on this new result, we establish the existence of a threshold for a threshold-based graph matching algorithm via local tree correlation tests. Finally, we couple the performance of the rank-based algorithm with the threshold-based algorithm to show almost exact recovery.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究相关Erdős-Rényi图对模型下的图匹配问题，提出一种基于局部树相关性检验的秩次算法，时间复杂度为n^{2+o(1)}，在参数条件λ=(log n)^{α+o(1)}（α∈(0,1)）且s∈(√C_Otter,1]时，能以高概率实现几乎精确恢复。这是该参数区域内首个近二次时间复杂度的算法，与现有枝形吊灯计数算法相比，后者在s接近下限时时间复杂度趋于无穷。
Motivation: 现有图匹配算法在相关ER图对模型中，当平均度发散时（λ随n增长）计算复杂度过高，尤其当节点保留概率s接近Otter常数平方根时，枝形吊灯计数算法的时间复杂度发散至无穷。需要设计更高效的算法来实现几乎精确恢复。
Method: 提出基于局部树相关性检验的秩次算法：通过计算顶点对的局部树相关性统计量，采用排名而非阈值来匹配顶点，避免了求解显式阈值这一计算难题。分析中建立了发散度区域（平均度和树深度随n增长）下树相关性检验的新理论，并证明了基于阈值的算法存在阈值，最后将秩次算法与阈值算法的性能耦合以证明几乎精确恢复。
Result: 算法在λ=(log n)^{α+o(1)}（α∈(0,1)）且s∈(√C_Otter,1]的条件下，以高概率实现几乎精确恢复，时间复杂度为n^{2+o(1)}，这是该区域首个近二次时间复杂度的图匹配算法。
Conclusion: 本文通过局部树相关性检验和排名策略，显著降低了图匹配在发散度区域的计算复杂度，并建立了理论基础。该方法避免了显式阈值计算，但在参数范围上存在限制（λ增长速度受限于对数多项式）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fully Rotation-Equivariant Spectral-Spatial Learning for Multispectral Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing multispectral detectors are limited by discrete spectral processing, a scale-dependent shift in the relative reliability of spectral and spatial cues across pyramid levels, and the lack of explicit rotation-equivariant geometric priors for arbitrarily oriented objects. To tackle these limitations, we propose FressDet, a fully rotation-equivariant spectral-spatial learning framework for multispectral object detection, capable of capturing the continuous, ordered nature of spectral structure and enabling reliable spectral-spatial fusion across pyramid levels under arbitrary in-plane rotations. FressDet integrates three complementary components. Spectral Implicit Warp (SpeIW) enables query-based spectral resampling via a coordinate-conditioned implicit field, yielding a monotone, order-preserving warp. Rotation-Equivariant Consistency Weighting (ReCoW) adaptively fuses spectral and spatial branches based on branch reliability, reinforcing informative cues while suppressing noise across pyramid levels. The oriented-aware head exploits group-indexed features to stably predict oriented objects without parameter replication. Taken together, FressDet learns more discriminative and robust spectral-spatial representations even under rotational perturbations. By achieving state-of-the-art performance with 93% fewer parameters on five public benchmarks, FressDet demonstrates its effectiveness and generalizability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FressDet，一个全旋转等变光谱-空间学习框架，用于多光谱目标检测。通过三个组件（SpeIW、ReCoW、朝向感知头）解决离散光谱处理、尺度依赖的可靠性偏移以及缺乏显式旋转等变几何先验等问题。在五个公开基准上以更少的参数取得了最优性能。
Motivation: 现有多光谱检测器受限于离散光谱处理、金字塔层级间光谱与空间线索的尺度依赖可靠性变化，以及缺乏对任意方向目标的显式旋转等变几何先验。
Method: 提出 FressDet，包含三个组件：SpeIW 通过坐标条件隐式场实现查询式光谱重采样；ReCoW 基于分支可靠性自适应融合光谱与空间分支；朝向感知头利用群索引特征稳定预测定向对象。
Result: 在五个公开基准上以少 93% 的参数取得了最新最优性能，展示了有效性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: FressDet 通过学习具有判别性和鲁棒性的光谱-空间表示，即使在旋转扰动下也能实现优越的多光谱目标检测。

papers.title: A Three-Phase Foundation Model for Tax-Aware Personalized Portfolio Management
papers.abstract_en: We present a three-phase deep reinforcement learning system for personalized portfolio management that addresses three limitations shared by all prior financial RL work: 1) ticker lock-in, 2) monolithic objectives , and 3) static user models. Phase 1 pretrains a ticker-identity-free cross asset encoder via self-supervised learning on a multi-asset corpus, augmented by a frozen parallel branch using Chronos, a T5-based time series foundation model, fused via a learned gating mechanism. To our knowledge, this is the first application of a time series foundation model to portfolio management RL. The encoder generalizes to any publicly traded asset via a 50-dimensional observable metadata vector that requires no retraining for new tickers. Phase 2 fine-tunes a MoE (Mixture of Experts) portfolio actor critic with PPO under an objective-conditioned reward that simultaneously serves six distinct investment goals sampled per episode: short-term alpha, short-term gain, long-term gain, capital preservation, tax-loss harvesting, and long-term-gains-only. A MoE architecture assigns each objective to a specialized expert head (momentum, growth, defensive, tax-aware), and a learned intent router blends experts based on the active objective and current market regime, which eliminates cross-objective gradient conflict. Phase 3 adds a lightweight personalization layer further adapted at inference time to each individual via a 76-parameter LoRA module fine-tuned on real brokerage transaction history, inferring investment objectives from revealed trading behavior rather than questionnaires. A natural language intent parser converts free-form goals directly into structured investment objective parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三阶段深度强化学习系统，用于税务感知的个性化投资组合管理，解决了先前金融强化学习工作中的三个局限性：股票代码锁定、单一目标和静态用户模型。阶段一通过自监督学习预训练一个与股票代码无关的跨资产编码器，并结合Chronos时间序列基础模型；阶段二使用MoE（混合专家）架构和PPO算法，对六个不同投资目标进行条件奖励优化；阶段三引入LoRA个性化层，根据真实交易记录微调，并包含自然语言意图解析器。该系统能够泛化到任何公开交易资产，同时服务多个投资目标，并消除跨目标梯度冲突。
Motivation: 先前金融强化学习工作存在三个共同限制：股票代码锁定（ticker lock-in）导致模型无法泛化到新资产；单一目标（monolithic objectives）无法同时优化多个投资目标；静态用户模型（static user models）无法适应个人偏好。
Method: 三阶段系统：阶段一：自监督预训练跨资产编码器，使用多资产语料，并通过可学习门控机制融合冻结的Chronos（基于T5的时间序列基础模型）分支，编码器基于50维可观测元数据向量，无需为新股票代码重新训练。阶段二：使用MoE架构的portfolio actor critic，通过PPO微调，奖励条件化于六个投资目标（短期alpha、短期收益、长期收益、资本保值、税收损失收割、长期收益优化），每个目标对应专门化专家头（动量、增长、防御、税务感知），并由意图路由器根据活跃目标和市场状态混合专家，消除跨目标梯度冲突。阶段三：轻量个性化层，通过76参数LoRA模块在真实经纪交易历史数据上微调，并包含自然语言意图解析器将自由形式目标转化为结构化投资目标参数。
Result: 系统能够泛化到任何公开交易资产，同时服务六个不同投资目标，并消除跨目标梯度冲突。个性化层适应个人行为，自然语言解析器允许用户直接输入目标。
Conclusion: 该系统为个性化投资组合管理提供了更灵活、可扩展的框架，解决了先前方法的关键局限，但需要更多实证评估来验证其实际性能。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该系统为个性化投资组合管理提供了更灵活、可扩展的框架，解决了先前方法的关键局限，但需要更多实证评估来验证其实际性能。

papers.title: Teaching LLMs String Matching, Backtracking, and Error Recovery to Deduce Bases and Truth Tables for the Combinatorially Exploding Bit Manipulation Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents our algorithmic innovations for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge, focusing on Bit Manipulation Puzzles. In this task, the objective is to discover a hidden logical rule transforming input binary strings to outputs, then apply it to unseen inputs. Large Language Models (LLMs) notoriously struggle here; traditional methods force them to simulate complex boolean logic and arithmetic, leading to hallucinations. Furthermore, the search space of bitwise operations (combinations of shifts, rotations, and logic gates) suffers from a severe combinatorial explosion. To overcome this computational intractability, we present a novel approach that abandons arithmetic logic entirely in favor of string similarity, structured search, and autonomous error recovery. Our core contributions are: 1. Bases and Truth Table Formulation: We reframe logic-gate deduction into a base-selection task, leveraging string similarity (minimal bit flips) to isolate primitive transformations ("bases") and deduce truth tables without complex arithmetic. 2. Backtracking DFS and Error Recovery: We formalize a search process that tests candidate bases, detects logical collisions across examples, and backtracks upon failure to perform robust error recovery. 3. Bit Tokenization and Interactive Reasoning SFT: We force the tokenizer to encode binary strings as individual single-bit tokens. We use dynamic masking to simulate external oracle feedback, training the model to hypothesize, self-evaluate, and backtrack natively. Evaluated on bit manipulation puzzles, our approach achieved over 96% validation accuracy. This represents the highest performance in this category. These algorithmic and training innovations ultimately earned our team the Best Fine-tuning Method and Best Data/Synthetic Data Method awards in the contest, alongside a 7th Place overall finish on leaderboard.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. 7th Place Solution for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge (Kaggle)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对NVIDIA Nemotron模型推理挑战中的位操作谜题，提出了一种基于字符串相似性、结构化搜索和自主错误恢复的方法。该方法放弃算术逻辑，将逻辑门推导重新定义为基选任务，利用回溯DFS和错误恢复，最终在验证集上达到96%以上的准确率，获得比赛最佳微调方法和最佳数据/合成数据方法奖。
Motivation: 传统方法迫使LLM模拟复杂布尔逻辑和算术导致幻觉，且位操作搜索空间存在严重的组合爆炸。
Method: 提出三个核心贡献：1) 将逻辑门推导重构为基选任务，利用字符串相似性（最小比特翻转）隔离原始变换并推导真值表；2) 回溯DFS与错误恢复：测试候选基，检测逻辑冲突并在失败时回溯；3) 比特分词与交互式推理SFT：将二进制字符串编码为独立单比特令牌，使用动态掩码模拟外部oracle反馈，训练模型进行假设、自评估和回溯。
Result: 在位操作谜题上验证准确率超过96%，获得比赛最佳微调方法和最佳数据/合成数据方法奖以及整体第7名。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该算法和训练创新导致了比赛中的最高性能。

papers.title: HAMON: Passive Optical Sequence Mixing for Long-Horizon Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Simple linear and frequency-domain models remain surprisingly competitive in long-horizon time-series forecasting, and recent mechanistic evidence suggests that standard forecasting benchmarks may not require the dense superposed representations that make transformers powerful in other domains. This raises a substrate-level question: if the core forecasting operator is often low-complexity and approximately linear, does it need to be implemented as learned digital temporal mixing? We introduce HAMON, a passive diffractive optical forecasting core in which historical values are encoded onto an optical aperture, future positions are left dark, and cascaded trainable phase masks with free-space diffraction shape the forecast directly in the output field. At inference, prediction is performed by a single passive optical propagation pass with no trainable digital sequence-mixing layer. Across standard benchmarks, HAMON outperforms the strongest digital baselines considered on ETTm2 at all horizons and on ETTh2 at all but the longest horizon, improving MSE by up to 14\% and doing so consistently across horizons rather than at isolated points. It is competitive on Weather and trails the strongest baselines on the remaining ETT settings and on the high-channel-count Traffic and Electricity datasets. Phase encoding, intensity-compatible readout, and phase-scrambling ablations, together with a TorchOptics cross-simulator check, indicate that the forecasts arise from the data-bearing optical field rather than from a digital forecasting head. Because the passive core uses standard Fourier optics, HAMON defines a concrete target for optical hardware and for passive physical sequence mixing.
papers.comment: Withdrawn after identifying an evaluation-window mismatch: the reported validation and test evaluations skip the first 336 target positions, making comparisons with cited baselines non-equivalent. This is not data leakage. Corrected evaluation preserves nontrivial forecasting behavior, but changes some benchmark results. A revised version may follow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HAMON，一种被动衍射光学预测核心，用于长时间序列预测。该方法将历史值编码到光学孔径上，未来位置留暗，通过级联可训练相位掩模和自由空间衍射直接在输出场中产生预测。在标准基准上，HAMON在ETTm2和ETTh2上优于最强数字基线，MSE改进高达14%，但在高通道数数据集上落后。
Motivation: 现有线性模型和频域模型在长时间序列预测中仍然有竞争力，但核心预测算子通常复杂度低且近似线性，引发是否必须使用可学习数字时间混合的问题。
Method: HAMON使用被动衍射光学核心：历史值编码到光学孔径，级联可训练相位掩模与自由空间衍射，通过一次被动光学传播完成预测，无需可训练数字序列混合层。
Result: 在ETTm2所有预测长度和ETTh2除最长外所有长度上优于最强数字基线，MSE改进最高14%；在Weather上具有竞争力，但在Traffic和Electricity等高通道数据集上落后。
Conclusion: HAMON表明被动光学物理序列混合是可行且有效的，为光学硬件和被动物理序列混合提供了具体目标。

papers.title: Wisdom of LLM Crowds: Aggregation and Contamination in Language Model Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: The wisdom of crowds -- the finding that aggregating judgments across individuals often outperforms the best individual -- has been extensively studied with human forecasters. Whether the same phenomenon emerges when the ``crowd'' consists of large language models (LLMs) is an open question with both theoretical and practical implications. We elicited probability estimates from 15 LLMs on 254 binary prediction market questions and evaluated classical and learned aggregation methods. Learned aggregators -- a multilayer perceptron and a logistic regression -- outperformed all individual models and classical methods. The logistic regression was found to match the neural network, suggesting that the benefit of learned aggregation derives from learning a linear combination of diverse model outputs rather than from nonlinear interactions. Symbolic regression applied to the neural network's learned mapping recovered a pure model-disagreement signal as the lowest-complexity useful formula on the Pareto frontier, further supporting this interpretation. Training cutoff contamination proved a pervasive confound: the apparent capability gap between frontier cloud models and smaller local models collapsed from 35.8% to 8.9% on a clean subset of questions resolving after all models' training cutoffs, and individual model rankings showed only moderate stability. Even when the prediction market is evaluated at each model's training cutoff, LLMs remained substantially less accurate, indicating a genuine gap in collective information aggregation. These findings suggest that LLM crowds can exhibit wisdom-of-crowds effects, but that contamination-free evaluation is essential for reliable assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）群体的“群体智慧”效应，通过让15个LLM对254个二元预测市场问题进行概率估计，评估经典与学习型聚合方法。结果显示学习型聚合（多层感知机和逻辑回归）优于所有个体模型和经典方法，且逻辑回归与神经网络表现相近，表明收益主要来自线性组合而非非线性交互。训练截止污染是普遍混淆因素，在干净子集上前后沿模型与小模型差距从35.8%缩小到8.9%。
Motivation: 群体智慧在人类预测中已被广泛研究，但LLM群体是否表现出类似现象尚不明确，具有理论和实践意义。
Method: 收集15个LLM对254个二元预测市场问题的概率估计，采用经典聚合方法（如平均）和学习型聚合（MLP、逻辑回归），并应用符号回归分析神经网络学到的映射，同时评估训练截止污染的影响。
Result: 学习型聚合方法优于所有个体模型和经典方法；逻辑回归与MLP性能相当；符号回归发现模型分歧信号是最低复杂度的有用公式；在无污染子集上，前沿模型与小模型准确率差距从35.8%降至8.9%。
Conclusion: LLM群体可以表现出群体智慧效应，但无污染评估对于可靠评估至关重要。

papers.title: Dimension-Free Convergence of Discrete Diffusion Models: Adjoint Equations Induce the Right Space
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion has become a leading framework for generative modeling in various applications including language, vision, and biology. Existing convergence theory, however, exhibits fundamental limitations. KL-based analyses diverge under singular priors such as the masked distribution, while bounds in total variation (TV) depend on the state space size $S$ and become vacuous for modern language tasks, where vocabularies contain hundreds of thousands of tokens. We develop a unified adjoint-equation-based framework that establishes dimension-free convergence guarantees in any integral probability metric (IPM). To the best of our knowledge, our bounds are the first to be entirely free of $S$ and applicable to both masked and uniform priors. Importantly, our results can extend existing step complexity guarantees to any IPM. In addition, our theory relies only on a single standard rate-matrix regularity assumption and applies to general priors. Five novel techniques drive our improvements: 1. working in the space of observables via adjoint equations rather than directly with probability measures; 2. a regularity analysis that yields bounds on any IPM; 3. a coupling argument that removes $S$-dependence under uniform transitions; and 4. score-marginal cancellation and 5. exit-routing techniques that remove $S$-dependence under masked transitions. Our framework thus sharply departs from prior analyses and avoids the shortcomings of pathspace-KL and existing TV-based approaches. Beyond convergence bounds, our framework provides a versatile toolkit for further theoretical study of discrete diffusion models, including principled choices of loss functions and dimension-free step complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为离散扩散模型建立了无维度收敛保证，通过伴随方程框架在任意积分概率度量（IPM）下得到与状态空间大小S无关的收敛界。这是首个同时适用于掩码先验和均匀先验且完全摆脱S依赖的理论结果。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散模型的收敛理论存在根本局限：基于KL散度的分析在奇异先验（如掩码分布）下不适用，而全变差（TV）距离的界依赖于状态空间大小S，对大型词汇表任务失效。
Method: 提出基于伴随方程（adjoint equations）的理论框架，在可观测空间而非概率测度空间工作；结合正则性分析、耦合论证、分数边际消除和出口路由技术，消除对S的依赖。
Result: 证明在任意IPM下的收敛界完全独立于S，且适用于掩码和均匀先验；该框架可将现有步长复杂性保证扩展到任意IPM。
Conclusion: 该理论框架为离散扩散模型提供了更通用的分析工具，包括损失函数的原理性选择和维度无关的步长复杂性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MuonQ: Enhancing Low-Bit Muon Quantization via Directional Fidelity Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The Muon optimizer has emerged as a compelling alternative to Adam for training large language models, achieving remarkable computational savings through gradient orthogonalization. However, Muon's optimizer state is more sensitive to quantization errors: because the orthogonalization discards the magnitudes of singular values and retains only directional information, even small quantization errors in singular vector directions are amplified in the update. In this work, we propose MuonQ, a low-bit Muon training framework built on the principle of directional fidelity optimization. First, we apply a pre-quantization normalization so that each step introduces quantization errors of the same magnitude, preventing the accumulated error from developing a preferred direction. Second, we introduce a structural decomposition that separately quantizes the dominant singular components via power iteration, ensuring that quantization errors perturb only singular value magnitudes rather than rotating singular vector directions. Third, we adopt $μ$-law companding quantization to allocate higher resolution to densely packed momentum values, shifting the quantization objective from outlier preservation to dense-region distinguishability. Together, these techniques enable stable 4-bit quantization of Muon's optimizer states. Pre-training experiments on GPT-style and LLaMA-style models demonstrate that MuonQ at 4-bit precision recovers most of full-precision Muon's training loss and downstream accuracy while reducing optimizer-state memory by up to 7.3$\times$, offering a favorable point on the accuracy-memory trade-off. Our code is available at https://github.com/YupengSu/MuonQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuonQ，一种基于方向保真度优化 (directional fidelity optimization) 的低比特 Muon 训练框架，通过预量化归一化、结构分解和 μ-law 压扩量化实现 Muon 优化器状态的 4-bit 量化。在 GPT 和 LLaMA 风格模型上的预训练实验表明，4-bit MuonQ 恢复了大部分全精度 Muon 的训练损失和下游准确率，并将优化器状态内存减少高达 7.3 倍。
Motivation: Muon 优化器通过正交化丢弃奇异值幅度而仅保留方向信息，导致对量化误差更敏感，即使小的奇异向量方向误差也会在更新中被放大。现有低比特训练方法未针对这一特性优化。
Method: 提出三项技术：(1) 预量化归一化，使每步量化误差幅度一致，防止累积误差偏向某个方向；(2) 结构分解，通过幂迭代单独量化主导奇异分量，使量化误差只扰动奇异值幅度而非旋转方向；(3) μ-law 压扩量化，为密集的动量值分配更高分辨率，将量化目标从异常值保留转向密集区域区分性。
Result: 在 GPT 和 LLaMA 风格模型上的预训练实验显示，4-bit MuonQ 恢复大部分全精度 Muon 的训练损失和下游准确率，优化器状态内存减少高达 7.3 倍。
Conclusion: 所提方向保真度优化框架使得 Muon 优化器状态的稳定 4-bit 量化成为可能，在准确率-内存权衡上提供有利点。

summary_sections.method: 提出三项技术：(1) 预量化归一化，使每步量化误差幅度一致，防止累积误差偏向某个方向；(2) 结构分解，通过幂迭代单独量化主导奇异分量，使量化误差只扰动奇异值幅度而非旋转方向；(3) μ-law 压扩量化，为密集的动量值分配更高分辨率，将量化目标从异常值保留转向密集区域区分性。
summary_sections.result: 在 GPT 和 LLaMA 风格模型上的预训练实验显示，4-bit MuonQ 恢复大部分全精度 Muon 的训练损失和下游准确率，优化器状态内存减少高达 7.3 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 所提方向保真度优化框架使得 Muon 优化器状态的稳定 4-bit 量化成为可能，在准确率-内存权衡上提供有利点。

papers.title: Direct Bethe Free Energy Minimization for Bayesian Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian neural networks are typically trained on the evidence lower bound (ELBO), which keeps the joint likelihood but pays a Jensen gap at every observation. We train by local consistency instead: direct minimisation of the Bethe free energy, whose data term pays no gap-it scores each observation exactly by its predictive density, a strictly proper rule, for any likelihood with a tractable predictive convolution. Our departure is free routing: the beliefs are trained as free parameters of this objective, jointly with the backbone, rather than bound to the conjugate posterior computed in closed form (closed routing). Instantiated with a Gaussian last layer over a deterministic backbone, exact inference appears as the known, closed-routed corner-the neural-linear marginal likelihood, evidence-optimal, keeping the joint. A shared cavity instead trades it for a batchable per-plate predictive score, and free routing reaches that score's optimum-unattainable under the binding whenever the noise is heteroscedastic-improving NLL and calibration over the exact corner. This instance, SCROLL (Shared-Cavity fRee-rOuting Last-Layer), is a single-pass, any-likelihood Bayesian neural network, implicitly empirical-Bayes-prior precision, observation noise, covariance, and backbone fit in one gradient pass. At a single training run and forward pass per architecture-where the conventional references cross-validate their regularisation weight and ensembles pay 5-50x at inference-a fixed SCROLL variant is best-or-tied on NLL and calibration on 7/8 UCI regression benchmarks, and best on 4/5 across three large tabular datasets and two frozen text/vision embeddings.
papers.comment: Improved the paper - formalization of routing, add classification experiments, new bib items, free routing in linear model, and many more. Also polished the text
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出通过直接最小化Bethe自由能来训练贝叶斯神经网络，取代传统的ELBO优化。其关键在于"自由路由"（free routing）策略，将信念视为自由参数而非闭式后验，从而避免Jensen间隙。在确定骨干网络加高斯最后一层的实例化中，SCROLL方法实现了单次前向传播且支持任意似然的贝叶斯神经网络，在多个UCI回归和表格数据集上取得最佳或并列最佳NLL和校准性能。
Motivation: 标准BNN基于ELBO训练存在Jensen间隙，导致每个观测的似然评分不精确。论文旨在通过直接最小化Bethe自由能来消除这一间隙，使每个观测的预测密度评分严格恰当。
Method: 提出直接最小化Bethe自由能，数据项按每个观测的预测密度精确评分；引入自由路由，将信念作为自由参数与骨干网络联合优化，而非约束于闭式共轭后验。具体实例化为SCROLL（共享空腔自由路由最后一层），实现单次训练和推理。
Result: 摘要报告SCROLL在UCI回归（7/8基准上NLL和校准最佳或并列）和三个大型表格数据集及两个冻结文本/视觉嵌入（4/5基准上最佳）中表现优异，优于需要交叉验证或集成方法的传统参考。
Conclusion: 论文强调自由路由在异方差噪声下能到达闭式路由无法达到的优化点，且SCROLL在任何似然下都是单次通过、可批量化的贝叶斯神经网络，隐式地进行经验贝叶斯先验精度、观测噪声、协方差和骨干网络的联合梯度更新。

papers.title: Hankel and Toeplitz Rank-1 Decomposition of Arbitrary Matrices with Applications to Signal Direction-of-Arrival Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problems of computing the optimal rank-1 Hankel and Toeplitz-structured approximation of arbitrary matrices under L2 and L1-norm error. Such problems arise naturally in engineered systems, including the basic few-shot signal Direction-of-Arrival (DoA) estimation problem that is of importance to modern autonomous systems applications. We develop accurate and computationally efficient structured matrix decomposition algorithms for both formulations and then derive analytically grounded small-sample-support DoA estimators for practical sensing system deployments. The resulting estimators under the L2 and L1 norms are formally shown to be maximum-likelihood optimal under white Gaussian and Laplace noise, respectively. The estimators are further validated through extensive simulation studies and real-world data experiments in few-shot DoA inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考虑在L2和L1范数误差下计算任意矩阵的最优秩1 Hankel和Toeplitz结构逼近，并应用于信号到达方向（DoA）估计。开发了计算高效的结构化矩阵分解算法，并推导出小样本支持下的DoA估计器。这些估计器在白高斯噪声和拉普拉斯噪声下分别具有最大似然最优性。通过仿真和实测数据实验验证了估计器在少样本DoA推断中的有效性。
Motivation: 在工程系统中，如少样本信号到达方向（DoA）估计问题，需要高效且准确的结构化矩阵分解方法，而现有方法可能计算复杂或样本支持不足。
Method: 提出L2和L1范数下的最优秩1 Hankel和Toeplitz矩阵分解算法，并据此推导出小样本支持的DoA估计器，理论上证明其在相应噪声模型下是最大似然最优的。
Result: 通过广泛的仿真研究和真实世界数据实验，验证了所提估计器在少样本DoA推断中的性能。
Conclusion: 所提出的结构化矩阵分解方法能够提供准确且计算高效的DoA估计，适用于实际传感系统部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating Risks in Weak-to-Strong Alignment: A Bias-Variance Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Weak-to-strong alignment offers a promising route to scalable supervision, but it can fail when a strong model becomes confidently wrong on examples that lie in the weak model's blind spots. Understanding such failures requires going beyond aggregate accuracy, since weak-to-strong errors depend not only on whether the strong model disagrees with the weak model, but also on how confidence and uncertainty are distributed across examples. In this work, we analyze weak-to-strong alignment through a bias--variance--covariance lens that connects misfit theory to practical post-training pipelines. We derive a misfit-based upper bound on weak-to-strong population risk and study its empirical components using continuous confidence scores. We evaluate four weak-to-strong pipelines spanning supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) on the PKU-SafeRLHF and HH-RLHF datasets. Using a blind-spot deception metric that isolates cases where the strong model is confidently wrong while the weak model is uncertain, we find that strong-model variance is the quantity most strongly associated with blind-spot deception among the BVC quantities we study. Covariance provides additional but weaker information, indicating that weak--strong dependence matters, but does not by itself explain the observed failures. These results suggest that strong-model variance can serve as an early-warning signal for weak-to-strong deception, while blind-spot evaluation helps distinguish whether failures are inherited from weak supervision or arise in regions of weak-model uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从偏差-方差-协方差视角分析弱到强对齐（weak-to-strong alignment）中的失败模式，推导了基于失配的弱到强总体风险上界，并在PKU-SafeRLHF和HH-RLHF数据集上评估了四种弱到强流程（SFT、RLHF、RLAIF）。研究发现强模型方差是与盲点欺骗（blind-spot deception）最相关的量，协方差提供额外但较弱的信息。
Motivation: 弱到强对齐可能因强模型在弱模型盲点上自信犯错而失败，需超越聚合准确率理解此类失败。
Method: 通过偏差-方差-协方差（BVC）框架连接失配理论与后训练流程，推导弱到强总体风险的上界，并使用连续置信度分数分析实证成分，引入盲点欺骗度量。
Result: 强模型方差是与盲点欺骗最相关的BVC量；协方差提供额外但较弱信息，表明弱-强依赖关系存在但不足以解释观察到的失败。
Conclusion: 强模型方差可作为弱到强欺骗的早期预警信号，盲点评估有助于区分失败是源于弱监督继承还是弱模型不确定区域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LSRM: High-Fidelity Object-Centric Reconstruction via Scaled Context Windows
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Large Sparse Reconstruction Model to study how scaling transformer context windows affects feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Although recent object-centric feed-forward methods produce robust, high-quality reconstructions, they still lag behind dense-view optimization in recovering fine-grained texture and appearance. We show that expanding the context window -- by substantially increasing the number of active object and image tokens -- narrows this gap and enables high-fidelity 3D object reconstruction and inverse rendering. To scale effectively, we adapt native sparse attention for 3D reconstruction with three key contributions: (1) an efficient coarse-to-fine pipeline that focuses computation on informative regions by predicting sparse high-resolution residuals; (2) a 3D-aware spatial routing mechanism that establishes accurate 2D-3D correspondences using explicit geometric distances rather than standard attention scores; and (3) a custom block-aware sequence-parallel strategy with an All-gather-KV protocol to balance dynamic, sparse workloads across GPUs. As a result, LSRM handles 20x more object tokens and >2x more image tokens than prior state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. Extensive evaluations on standard novel-view synthesis benchmarks show substantial gains over the current SOTA, yielding >2.4dB higher PSNR and >40% lower LPIPS. Furthermore, when extending LSRM to inverse rendering, qualitative and quantitative evaluations on widely used benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in texture and geometry details, achieving an LPIPS that matches or exceeds that of SOTA dense-view optimization methods. Code and model weights are available on our project page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Large Sparse Reconstruction Model (LSRM)，通过扩大transformer上下文窗口来改善前馈式3D物体重建的纹理质量，使其接近密集视角优化方法。作者引入粗到细管道、3D感知空间路由和块感知序列并行策略，实现了20倍物体令牌和2倍图像令牌的缩放。在标准新视角合成基准上，LSRM相比现有最优方法PSNR提升>2.4dB，LPIPS降低>40%。在逆渲染任务中，LSRM的LPIPS匹配或超过密集视角优化方法。
Motivation: 现有目标中心的前馈式3D重建方法虽然鲁棒，但在恢复细粒度纹理和外观方面仍落后于密集视角优化方法。本文旨在通过扩大上下文窗口来缩小这一差距。
Method: 提出LSRM，采用三种关键贡献：1）粗到细管道，通过预测稀疏高分辨率残差聚焦于信息区域；2）3D感知空间路由机制，利用显式几何距离建立准确的2D-3D对应；3）自定义块感知序列并行策略和All-gather-KV协议以平衡动态稀疏负载。
Result: 在标准新视角合成基准上，PSNR提升>2.4dB，LPIPS降低>40%；在逆渲染任务中，LPIPS匹配或超过密集视角优化方法，纹理和几何细节一致提升。
Conclusion: LSRM证明了扩大transformer上下文窗口可以显著提升前馈式3D重建的质量，使其在高保真度上接近甚至超过密集视角优化方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SR-TTT Does Not Learn Retrieval: A Correction and Mechanistic Post-Mortem of Surprisal-Aware Residual Test-Time Training
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Training (TTT) language models replace the KV-cache with fast weights updated during inference, achieving O(1) memory but suffering catastrophic failure on exact-recall tasks. Version 1 of this work proposed SR-TTT, which routes high-surprisal tokens to a sparse exact-attention Residual Cache, and reported large Needle-in-a-Haystack gains. We show those gains were evaluation artifacts: the loss and metric read logits at the answer positions rather than one position earlier, training both models to copy an answer already visible in their input (a model trained on retrieval-impossible data reaches 100% accuracy under the flawed metric); additionally, the cache attended non-causally over future tokens, including the answer itself. We release a corrected implementation with startup causality self-tests, then ask whether the SR-TTT hypothesis survives correction. It does not, and the failure decomposes into two independent, separately measured bottlenecks. Storage: surprisal gating is systematically position-biased - the TTT reconstruction loss requires burn-in before a needle becomes relatively surprising, so early-context needles are stored at near-zero rates (0-1% containment at depth 0.1) exactly where long-context memory matters most. Addressing: with storage solved by an oracle and with new trainable read-time projections, per-slot attention supervision raises addressing mass 2.5x (0.06 -> 0.15) yet token accuracy is statistically unchanged, and retrieval extracts only approx. 0.06 nats of the 2.30-nat needle; position-free content addressing cannot resolve ordered slots whose contents are near-interchangeable. Exact match remains 0% in all 2,250 paired trials across all corrected conditions. We retract the claims of v1 and offer the corrected codebase, diagnostic protocol, and negative results as a cautionary reference for surprise-gated memory architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出之前提出的SR-TTT（高意外性令牌路由至稀疏精确注意力残差缓存）方法存在评估缺陷：损失和指标在答案位置读取logits而非前一位置，导致模型直接复制输入中已出现的答案；此外缓存非因果地关注未来令牌。修正后SR-TTT无效，失败分解为存储和寻址两个独立瓶颈：存储门控存在系统性位置偏差，早期上下文令牌存储率极低（深度0.1处0-1%）；寻址监督虽将注意力质量提升2.5倍，但令牌准确率无变化，精确匹配在所有2250次试验中为0%。作者撤回原声称，并提供了修正代码、诊断协议和负结果作为警示。
Motivation: TTT语言模型在精确回忆任务上灾难性失败，先前提出的SR-TTT声称有巨大提升，但本文发现其评估存在致命缺陷，需要纠正并检验该假设是否有效。
Method: 修正评估缺陷（包括因果自测和正确的logits读取位置），然后通过分解实验分析SR-TTT的存储和寻址瓶颈：测量存储门控的位置偏差，以及使用Oracle存储和可训练读取投影下的寻址监督效果。
Result: 修正后SR-TTT在所有条件下精确匹配均为0%；存储门控在早期上下文位置几乎不存储令牌（0-1%）；寻址监督虽将注意力质量从0.06提升至0.15，但令牌准确率无统计变化，且检索仅提取约0.06 nats的2.30 nats信息。

papers.title: What Matters for Simulation to Online Reinforcement Learning on Real Robots
papers.abstract_en: We investigate what specific design choices enable successful online reinforcement learning (RL) on physical robots. Across 100 real-world training runs on three distinct robotic platforms, we systematically ablate algorithmic, systems, and experimental decisions that are typically left implicit in prior work. We find that some widely used defaults can be harmful, while a set of robust, readily adopted design choices within standard RL practice yield stable learning across tasks and hardware. These results provide the first large-sample empirical study of such design choices, enabling practitioners to deploy online RL with lower engineering effort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过在三种真实机器人平台上进行100次训练实验，系统消融了算法、系统和实验设计中的选择，发现一些常见默认设置可能有害，而采用标准强化学习中的稳健设计选择可以在不同任务和硬件上实现稳定学习。这是首次大规模实证研究此类设计选择，为在真实机器人上部署在线强化学习提供了指导。
Motivation: 在线强化学习在真实机器人上的成功依赖于许多隐式设计选择，缺乏系统性研究，导致工程实践困难。
Method: 在三个不同机器人平台上进行100次真实世界训练运行，系统消融算法、系统和实验决策中的各种选择。
Result: 发现一些广泛使用的默认设置可能有害，而一组稳健的设计选择能在任务和硬件间实现稳定学习，提供了首个大样本实证结果。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了哪些设计选择对真实机器人上的在线强化学习成功至关重要，帮助降低部署工程努力。

papers.title: TOPReward: Token Probabilities as Hidden Zero-Shot Rewards for Robotics
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose robot learning requires dense, instruction-conditioned feedback that can distinguish meaningful task progress from stalled, failed, or partially completed behavior. Yet obtaining such feedback at scale remains difficult, since existing approaches often rely on manual progress annotations, task-specific demonstrations, or reward models trained on curated robot datasets. We introduce TOPReward, a training-free progress reward method that probes pretrained Video-Language Models (VLMs) through their internal token probabilities rather than asking them to generate numerical progress values. Given a video prefix and a language instruction, TOPReward measures the model's likelihood that the instructed task has been completed, converting latent video-language understanding into a dense reward signal without task-specific reward-model training or manually annotated progress labels. We evaluate TOPReward on ManiRewardBench, our real-world manipulation benchmark spanning 130 unique tasks and four robot platforms, as well as on Open X-Embodiment datasets. Across these settings, TOPReward substantially outperforms prior training-free VLM reward methods on open-source models and is competitive with a trained reward-model baseline on progress-estimation metrics, while requiring no reward-model training. Additional analyses show that the reward is sensitive to the specified instruction and is not explained by time index alone. Finally, TOPReward supports downstream applications including success detection and offline reward-weighted behavior cloning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TOPReward 是一种无需训练的过程奖励方法，通过探测预训练视频-语言模型（VLM）的 token 概率来生成密集的指令条件反馈，用于机器人学习。在包含 130 个任务和四个机器人平台的 ManiRewardBench 基准上，该方法在开源模型上显著优于先前的无训练 VLM 奖励方法，并与需要训练的奖励模型基线在进度估计指标上具有竞争力。
Motivation: 通用机器人学习需要密集的、指令条件下的反馈来区分任务进展与失败或部分完成的行为，但现有方法依赖人工进度标注、任务特定演示或基于机器人数据集训练的奖励模型，难以规模化。
Method: TOPReward 利用预训练 VLM 的内部 token 概率，而非生成数值进度。给定视频前缀和语言指令，它测量模型认为指令任务已完成的似然，从而将潜在视频-语言理解转换为密集奖励信号，无需任务特定训练或人工标注。
Result: 在 ManiRewardBench 和 Open X-Embodiment 数据集上，TOPReward 在开源模型上显著优于先前的无训练 VLM 奖励方法，在进度估计指标上与训练的奖励模型基线竞争，且无需奖励模型训练。额外分析表明奖励对指令敏感，不单纯由时间索引解释。
Conclusion: TOPReward 支持下游应用如成功检测和离线奖励加权行为克隆，提供了一种无需训练的机器人奖励获取方法。

papers.title: EmoSpace: Immersive Affective Image Generation Guided by Fine-Grained Emotion Prototypes
papers.abstract_en: Immersive affective content generation aims to create visually compelling VR imagery with controllable emotional nuance, yet existing methods typically rely on coarse labels or prompt-only control. Although modern diffusion transformers (DiTs) such as FLUX improve visual fidelity, they are not designed to incorporate structured affective representations. We present EmoSpace, an immersive affective content generation framework guided by fine-grained emotion prototypes, transforming free-form text and emotion descriptions into fine-grained affective imagery through three coordinated components. First, to represent sub-emotion variation beyond conventional categorical models, EmoSpace learns a hierarchical bank of 256 prototypes with input-conditioned adaptation through vision-language alignment. Second, Prototype-Conditioned Steering converts these prototypes into DiT-compatible generation signals through multi-pathway injection and temporal blending, while Iterative Prompt Refinement enriches prompts with prototype-aligned sub-emotion descriptors. Third, Affect-Grounded Modulation coordinates emotion conditioning with controllable LoRAs for panoramic, stylized, and multi-conditional generation. Through quantitative and qualitative evaluations, EmoSpace improves fine-grained emotional alignment while maintaining high aesthetic quality. Our user study shows that EmoSpace outputs are perceived as more emotionally aligned than baseline results and more suitable for immersive scene design. Additionally, we find that immersive presentation alters emotional perception and increases emotional engagement. Together, these findings inform the design of emotion-aware generative systems for immersive media, with potential applications including education, immersive storytelling, and artistic creation. We will release our code and models to facilitate future research along this line.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EmoSpace框架，利用细粒度情感原型指导沉浸式情感图像生成。通过层次化原型库、原型条件引导和情感调节模块，结合扩散变换器（DiT）实现文本到情感图像的生成。实验表明，EmoSpace在细粒度情感对齐和美学质量上优于基线方法，用户研究证实其在沉浸式场景设计中更具情感一致性。
Motivation: 现有沉浸式情感内容生成方法依赖粗粒度标签或纯文本控制，缺乏对细微情感变化的建模能力。
Method: EmoSpace包含三个组件：1）通过视觉-语言对齐学习256个层次化情感原型；2）原型条件引导将原型转换为DiT生成信号，包括多路径注入和时间混合；3）情感调制结合可控LoRA进行全景、风格化和多条件生成。
Result: 定量和定性评估表明，EmoSpace提高了细粒度情感对齐质量，用户感知的情感一致性优于基线方法，且沉浸式呈现增强了情感参与度。
Conclusion: EmoSpace展示了细粒度情感原型在沉浸式媒体生成中的潜力，适用于教育、叙事和艺术创作，代码和模型将开源。

papers.title: Encode Once, Decode Never: Reusing Audio LM Internals for Efficient Temporal Localization
papers.abstract_en: Audio language models process input audio into rich frame-level representations, but the standard approach to temporal localization generates timestamps as sequences of text tokens, which discards the frame-level representations in favor of autoregressive decoding. However, generating timestamps as tokens is slow and not parallelizable, and tends to hallucinate when producing timestamps outside the training distribution. We propose internal frame-level reuse, a method that trains audio LMs to reuse their own internal audio representations for temporal localization directly, bypassing token generation altogether. We introduce a lightweight prediction head trained via different frame-level objectives: a binary frame classifier and a novel inhomogeneous Poisson process (IHP) loss that models temporal event intensity. Across word localization, speaker diarization, and event localization tasks, our approach can achieve a >50x inference speedup over token-based generation and demonstrates robust length generalization, maintaining high accuracy on out-of-distribution audio durations where token-based models collapse completely. We find that reusing audio frame-level representations yields localization accuracies comparable to (and often better than) finetuned token-based baselines.
papers.comment: To appear in COLM 2026. Refer to https://github.com/inkitori/taudio/ for the codebase
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种音频语言模型的时间定位方法，通过复用模型内部的帧级表示，避免生成时间戳文本token，实现高效定位。在单词定位、说话人日志和事件定位任务上，该方法相比基于token生成的方法实现超过50倍推理加速，并在分布外音频长度上保持鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有音频语言模型通过自回归生成时间戳token进行时间定位，速度慢且不可并行，且在训练分布外易产生幻觉。
Method: 提出内部帧级复用（internal frame-level reuse），训练音频LM复用自身内部音频表示进行时间定位，引入二值帧分类器和基于非齐次泊松过程（IHP）的损失函数建模事件时间强度。
Result: 在单词定位、说话人日志和事件定位任务上，相比基于token的基线方法，实现50倍以上推理加速，在分布外音频时长上保持高精度，而基线模型完全崩溃。
Conclusion: 复用音频帧级表示进行时间定位可获得与微调token基线相当甚至更高的精度，并大幅提升推理效率。

papers.title: CLOAK: Contrastive Guidance for Latent Diffusion-Based Data Obfuscation
papers.abstract_en: Data obfuscation is a promising technique for mitigating attribute inference attacks by semi-trusted parties with access to time-series data emitted by sensors. Recent advances leverage conditional generative models together with adversarial training or mutual information-based regularization to balance data privacy and utility. However, these methods often require modifying the downstream task, struggle to achieve a satisfactory privacy-utility trade-off, or are computationally intensive, making them impractical for deployment on resource-constrained mobile IoT devices. We propose Cloak, a novel data obfuscation framework based on latent diffusion models. In contrast to prior work, we employ contrastive learning to extract disentangled representations, which guide the latent diffusion process to retain useful information while concealing private information. This approach enables users with diverse privacy needs to navigate the privacy-utility trade-off with minimal retraining. Extensive experiments on four public time-series datasets, spanning multiple sensing modalities, and a dataset of facial images demonstrate that Cloak consistently outperforms state-of-the-art obfuscation techniques, reducing utility loss by up to 7.21% and privacy loss by up to 5.76%, and is well-suited for deployment in resource-constrained settings.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies, Volume 10, Issue 3, Article 184, September 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cloak，一种基于潜扩散模型的数据混淆框架，利用对比学习提取解耦表示来引导扩散过程，在保留有用信息的同时隐藏隐私。在四个时间序列数据集和一个人脸图像数据集上，该方法优于现有技术，效用损失降低最高7.21%，隐私损失降低最高5.76%，且计算高效适合资源受限设备。
Motivation: 现有数据混淆方法往往需要修改下游任务、隐私-效用权衡不佳或计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限的移动IoT设备上。
Method: Cloak基于潜在扩散模型，通过对比学习从传感器时间序列数据中提取解耦表示，利用这些表示引导扩散过程，使生成的数据保留任务相关特征而模糊隐私属性。
Result: 在四个公开时间序列数据集和一个面部图像数据集上，Cloak在隐私和效用权衡上全面优于SOTA方法，效用损失最多降低7.21%，隐私损失最多降低5.76%。
Conclusion: 该方法允许用户根据隐私需求以最小重训练调整权衡，且模型尺寸和计算量适合在资源受限的移动设备上部署。

papers.title: Interpretable Embeddings with Sparse Autoencoders: A Data Analysis Toolkit
papers.abstract_en: Analyzing large-scale text corpora is a core challenge in machine learning, crucial for tasks like identifying undesirable model behaviors or biases in training data. Current methods often rely on costly LLM-based techniques (e.g. annotating dataset differences) or dense embedding models (e.g. for clustering), which lack control over the properties of interest. We propose using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to create SAE embeddings: representations whose dimensions map to interpretable concepts. Through four data analysis tasks, we show that SAE embeddings are more cost-effective and reliable than LLMs and more controllable than dense embeddings. Using the large hypothesis space of SAEs, we can uncover insights such as (1) semantic differences between datasets and (2) unexpected concept correlations in documents. For instance, by comparing model responses, we find that Grok-4 clarifies ambiguities more often than nine other frontier models. Relative to LLMs, SAE embeddings uncover bigger differences at 2-8x lower cost and identify biases more reliably. Additionally, SAE embeddings are controllable: by filtering concepts, we can (3) cluster documents along axes of interest and (4) outperform dense embeddings on property-based retrieval. Using SAE embeddings, we study model behavior with two case studies: investigating how OpenAI model behavior has changed over time and finding "trigger" phrases learned by Tulu-3 (Lambert et al., 2024) from its training data. These results position SAEs as a versatile tool for unstructured data analysis and highlight the neglected importance of interpreting models through their data.

Method: 利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从文本数据中学习稀疏嵌入，其中每个维度对应于一个可解释的概念，从而提供可控且高解释性的表示。
Result: 在四项数据分析任务中，SAE嵌入相比LLM成本降低2-8倍，并更可靠地识别偏差；相比密集嵌入，在基于属性的聚类和检索任务上表现更好。具体而言，通过比较模型响应发现Grok-4比其他九个前沿模型更常澄清歧义。

papers.title: Environment-Aware Channel Inference via Cross-Modal Flow: From Multimodal Sensing to Wireless Channels
papers.abstract_en: Accurate channel state information (CSI) underpins reliable and efficient wireless communication. However, acquiring CSI via pilot estimation incurs substantial overhead, especially in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems operating in high-Doppler environments. By leveraging the growing availability of environmental sensing data, this treatise investigates pilot-free channel inference that estimates complete CSI directly from multimodal observations, including camera images, LiDAR point clouds, and GPS coordinates. In contrast to prior studies that rely on predefined channel models, we develop a data-driven framework that formulates the sensing-to-channel mapping as a cross-modal flow matching problem. The framework fuses multimodal features into a latent distribution within the channel domain, and learns a velocity field that continuously transforms the latent distribution toward the channel distribution. To make this formulation tractable and efficient, we reformulate the problem as an equivalent conditional flow matching objective and incorporate a modality alignment loss, while adopting low-latency inference mechanisms to enable real-time CSI estimation. In experiments, we build a procedural data generator based on Sionna and Blender to support realistic modeling of sensing scenes and wireless propagation. System-level evaluations demonstrate significant improvements over pilot- and sensing-based benchmarks in both channel estimation accuracy and spectral efficiency for the downstream beamforming task. The source code is available at https://github.com/gm-leung/environment-aware-channel-inference.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 15 figures, 44 references, to appear in IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (TMC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于环境感知的无导频信道推断框架，利用相机、LiDAR和GPS等多模态传感数据直接估计完整信道状态信息（CSI），避免传统导频估计的开销。将传感到信道的映射建模为跨模态流匹配问题，学习一个速度场将多模态特征潜分布连续变换到信道分布，并结合模态对齐损失和低延迟推理机制。基于Sionna和Blender构建的程序化数据生成器进行实验，在下游波束成形任务中，信道估计精度和频谱效率均显著优于导频和传感基线。
Motivation: 大规模MIMO在高多普勒环境下，传统导频估计开销巨大，而环境传感数据日益丰富，但现有方法依赖预定义信道模型，缺乏数据驱动的端到端映射。
Method: 提出跨模态流匹配（cross-modal flow matching）框架：融合多模态特征为信道域潜分布，学习速度场连续变换至真实信道分布；通过等价条件流匹配目标和模态对齐损失进行训练，并采用低延迟推理实现实时CSI估计。
Result: 系统级评估表明，该方法在下游波束成形任务中，信道估计精度和频谱效率均显著优于基于导频和基于传感的基线方法。
Conclusion: 利用环境传感数据通过流匹配进行无导频信道推断是可行且高效的，为未来无线通信中的低开销CSI获取提供了新途径。

papers.title: WebCoach: Self-Evolving Web Agents with Cross-Session Memory Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal LLM-powered agents have recently demonstrated impressive capabilities in web navigation, enabling agents to complete complex browsing tasks across diverse domains. However, current agents struggle with repetitive errors and lack the ability to learn from past experiences across sessions, limiting their long-term robustness and sample efficiency. We introduce WebCoach, a model-agnostic self-evolving framework that equips web browsing agents with persistent cross-session memory, enabling improved long-term planning, reflection, and continual learning without retraining. WebCoach consists of three key components: (1) a WebCondenser, which standardizes raw navigation logs into concise summaries; (2) an External Memory Store, which organizes complete trajectories as episodic experiences; and (3) a Coach, which retrieves relevant experiences based on similarity and recency, and decides whether to inject task-specific advice into the agent via runtime hooks. This design empowers web agents to access long-term memory beyond their native context window, improving robustness in complex browsing tasks. Moreover, WebCoach achieves self-evolution by continuously curating episodic memory from new navigation trajectories, enabling agents to improve over time without retraining. Evaluations on the WebVoyager benchmark demonstrate that WebCoach consistently improves the performance of browser-use agents across three different LLM backbones. With a 38B model, it increases task success rates from 47% to 61% while reducing or maintaining the average number of steps. Notably, smaller base models with WebCoach achieve performance comparable to the same web agent using GPT-4o.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebCoach 是一个模型无关的自演进框架，通过跨会话记忆（cross-session memory）增强多模态大模型驱动的网页浏览代理。它包含三个组件：WebCondenser（压缩导航日志）、外部记忆库（存储完整轨迹）和 Coach（根据相似性和时效性检索相关经验并在运行时注入建议）。在 WebVoyager 基准上，使用 38B 模型时任务成功率从 47% 提升至 61%，且步骤数不变或减少；小模型结合 WebCoach 可达到 GPT-4o 代理的性能。
Motivation: 当前网页导航代理容易出现重复错误，且无法跨会话从过去经验中学习，限制了长期鲁棒性和样本效率。
Method: 提出 WebCoach 框架，包含 WebCondenser（标准化导航日志为摘要）、外部记忆库（组织完整轨迹作为情节经验）和 Coach（检索相关经验并通过运行时钩子注入任务特定建议）。
Result: 在 WebVoyager 基准上，使用 38B 模型时任务成功率从 47% 提升至 61%，步骤数减少或不变；小模型结合 WebCoach 性能与 GPT-4o 相当。
Conclusion: WebCoach 使网页代理能够访问本上下文窗口之外的长时记忆，通过持续整理新轨迹的情节经验实现自演进，无需重新训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Granularity of Causal Effect Identifiability
papers.abstract_en: The classical notion of causal effect identifiability is defined in terms of treatment and outcome variables. In this paper, we consider the identifiability of state-based causal effects: how an intervention on a particular state of treatment variables affects a particular state of outcome variables. We demonstrate that state-based causal effects may be identifiable even when variable-based causal effects may not. Moreover, we show that this separation occurs only when additional knowledge -- such as context-specific independencies -- is available. We further examine knowledge that constrains the states of variables, and show that such knowledge can improve both variable-based and state-based identifiability when combined with other knowledge such as context-specific independencies. We finally propose an approach for identifying causal effects under these additional constraints, and conduct empirical studies to further illustrate the separations between the two levels of identifiability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究因果效应可识别性的粒度，提出状态级（state-based）因果效应的概念，即干预变量特定状态对结果变量特定状态的影响。作者证明即使变量级因果效应不可识别，状态级仍可能可识别，且这种分离依赖于上下文特定独立性等额外知识。进一步考察了状态约束知识的组合效益，并提出了相应的识别方法。实验展示了两个层次可识别性之间的分离。
Motivation: 传统因果效应可识别性定义在变量层面，忽略了实际应用中常关注的特定状态效应。本文旨在探索更细粒度的状态级可识别性，并分析其与变量级识别性的关系及所需知识。
Method: 形式化定义状态级因果效应可识别性，利用上下文特定独立性等知识推导可识别性分离的充分条件，并提出在状态约束与上下文特定独立性组合下的识别算法。
Result: 理论研究证明状态级可识别性可以比变量级更强；实证研究进一步展示了两个层次之间的分离现象。
Conclusion: 强调了状态级可识别性的重要性，并指出利用更细粒度的知识可以突破变量级可识别性的局限。

papers.title: Equivariant Conditional Diffusion Model for Head and Neck CT Image Synthesis from CBCT
papers.abstract_en: Background: Cone-beam computed tomography CBCT is a commonly used modality for image guided radiotherapy. It offers real time anatomical visualization with low acquisition cost and dose. Nevertheless, photon scattering and beam hindrance lead CBCT images to suffer from several artifacts. These involve inaccurate Hounsfield Unit HU values, which render a lower reliability towards the dose calculations and adaptive planning. Purpose: Computed tomography CT, on the contrary, offers better image quality and accurate HU calibration, yet is typically acquired using offline mode and fails to capture the intra-treatment anatomical changes. This renders a need for developing an accurate CBCT to CT synthesis to mitigate the gap in imaging quality in the adaptive radiotherapy workflow. Methods: We propose a novel diffusion based conditional generative model, coined EqDiff-CT, to synthesize high quality CT images from CBCT. EqDiff-CT employs a denoising diffusion probabilistic model DDPM to iteratively inject noise and learn latent representations that enable reconstruction of anatomically consistent CT images. A group equivariant conditional U-Net backbone, implemented with e2cnn steerable layers, enforces rotational equivariance cyclic C4 symmetry, helping preserve fine structural details while minimizing noise and artifacts. Results: The system was trained and validated on the SynthRAD2025 dataset, comprising CBCT-CT scans across multiple head and neck anatomical sites, and we compared it with advanced methods such as CycleGAN and DDPM. EqDiff-CT provided substantial gains in structural fidelity, HU accuracy and quantitative metrics. Visual findings confirm the improved recovery, sharper soft tissue boundaries, and realistic bone reconstructions. Conclusions: The findings suggest that the diffusion model has offered a robust and generalizable framework for CBCT improvements.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables, accepted in Medical Physics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Equivariant Conditional Diffusion Model (EqDiff-CT)，用于从锥束CT (CBCT) 合成高质量的 CT 图像，以改善自适应放疗中的图像质量。该方法基于去噪扩散概率模型 (DDPM)，并采用群等变条件 U-Net 骨干网络（利用 e2cnn 可转向层）实现循环 C4 对称性旋转等变，从而保留细粒度结构细节并减少噪声和伪影。在 SynthRAD2025 数据集上（头颈部多个解剖部位），EqDiff-CT 在结构保真度、HU 准确度和定量指标上优于 CycleGAN 和 DDPM 等先进方法。
Motivation: CBCT 在图像引导放疗中常用，但存在散射和射束干扰导致的伪影和不准确的 HU 值，影响剂量计算和自适应计划；而 CT 虽质量高但离线采集，无法捕捉治疗中解剖变化。因此需要准确的 CBCT 到 CT 合成方法。
Method: 提出 EqDiff-CT，结合 DDPM 迭代去噪和群等变条件 U-Net 骨干（使用 e2cnn 可转向层），强制循环 C4 旋转对称性，以在合成过程中保持解剖结构一致性并抑制噪声和伪影。
Result: 在 SynthRAD2025 数据集上的头颈部 CBCT-CT 扫描实验中，EqDiff-CT 在结构保真度、HU 准确度和定量指标上显著优于 CycleGAN 和 DDPM；视觉结果显示了更锐利的软组织边界和逼真的骨重建。
Conclusion: 扩散模型为 CBCT 图像质量改进提供了鲁棒且可推广的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fitting Generalized Power Diagrams to 3D Image Data: A Prerequisite for Virtual Materials Testing
papers.abstract_en: This paper reviews algorithmic and modeling approaches for fitting generalized power diagrams to three-dimensional image data, a key step in virtual materials testing (VMT). Beyond their practical relevance to materials science, these tessellation models connect to several active areas of applied mathematics, including optimization, computational geometry, stochastic modeling, and optimal transport. Their formulation combines concepts from convex analysis and geometric clustering, offering a rich interplay between theory and computation. We survey recent applications and quantitatively compare algorithmic strategies for fitting Voronoi diagrams, power diagrams, and generalized balanced power diagrams (GBPDs), including linear and nonlinear programming, stochastic optimization via the cross-entropy method, and gradient-based approaches. Comparative results on real datasets illustrate trade-offs between algorithmic complexity and model accuracy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了将广义幂图（包括Voronoi图、幂图和广义平衡幂图）拟合到三维图像数据的算法和建模方法，这是虚拟材料测试的关键步骤。文章比较了线性规划、非线性规划、交叉熵随机优化和梯度方法等策略，并在真实数据集上展示了算法复杂度与模型精度之间的权衡。
Motivation: 虚拟材料测试需要从3D图像数据中构建精确的几何模型，而广义幂图提供了一种灵活的表示方式，但不同拟合方法在精度和效率上存在差异，需要系统比较。
Method: 回顾了多种拟合方法：线性/非线性规划、交叉熵随机优化、梯度法等，并应用于Voronoi图、幂图和广义平衡幂图。
Result: 在真实3D图像数据上，比较了不同方法的计算复杂度和模型拟合精度，揭示了实际应用中的权衡。
Conclusion: 广义幂图拟合是虚拟材料测试的重要前提，本文提供的算法比较为材料科学和数学优化领域提供了实用指导。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Loss-Complexity Landscape and Model Structure Functions
papers.abstract_en: We develop a framework for dualizing the Kolmogorov structure function $h_x(α)$, which then allows using computable complexity proxies. We establish a mathematical analogy between information-theoretic constructs and statistical mechanics, introducing a suitable partition function and free energy functional. We explicitly prove the Legendre-Fenchel duality between the structure function and free energy, showing detailed balance of the Metropolis kernel, and interpret acceptance probabilities as information-theoretic scattering amplitudes. A susceptibility-like variance of model complexity is shown to peak precisely at loss-complexity trade-offs interpreted as phase transitions. Practical experiments with linear and tree-based regression models verify these theoretical predictions, explicitly demonstrating the interplay between the model complexity, generalization, and overfitting threshold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对Kolmogorov结构函数进行对偶化框架，引入统计力学中的配分函数和自由能泛函，并证明结构函数与自由能之间的Legendre-Fenchel对偶性。作者展示了Metropolis核的精细平衡，将接受概率解释为信息论散射振幅。模型复杂度的类磁化率方差在损失-复杂度权衡处出现峰值，解释为相变。在线性和树回归模型上的实验验证了理论预测，揭示了模型复杂度、泛化与过拟合阈值的关系。
Motivation: 现有理论缺乏统一框架来理解模型复杂度与损失之间的权衡，以及过拟合转变的统计力学基础。
Method: 通过对Kolmogorov结构函数进行对偶化，引入统计力学中的配分函数和自由能，利用Legendre-Fenchel变换建立对偶关系，并通过Metropolis动力学解释信息论散射振幅。
Result: 摘要显示模型复杂度的类磁化率方差在损失-复杂度权衡处出现峰值，被解释为相变；实验用线性和树回归模型验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 该框架为理解模型复杂度的泛化行为提供了统计力学视角，并解释了过拟合阈值的相变性质。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Statistical Inference for Generative Model Comparison
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have achieved remarkable success across a range of applications, yet their evaluation still lacks principled uncertainty quantification. In this paper, we develop a method for comparing how close different generative models are to the underlying distribution of test samples. Particularly, our approach employs the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence to measure the distance between a generative model and the unknown test distribution, as KL requires no tuning parameters such as the kernels used by RKHS-based distances, and is the only $f$-divergence that admits a crucial cancellation to enable the uncertainty quantification. Furthermore, we extend our method to comparing conditional generative models and leverage Edgeworth expansions to address limited-data settings. On simulated datasets with known ground truth, we show that our approach realizes effective coverage rates, and has higher power compared to kernel-based methods. When applied to generative models on image and text datasets, our procedure yields conclusions consistent with benchmark metrics but with statistical confidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于KL散度的统计推断方法，用于比较生成模型与测试分布之间的接近程度，并实现不确定性量化。方法扩展至条件生成模型，利用Edgeworth展开处理小样本场景。实验在模拟数据上展示了有效的覆盖率，并比核方法有更高的统计功效。在图像和文本数据集上的结果与基准指标一致且附带统计置信度。
Motivation: 现有生成模型评估缺乏原理性的不确定性量化，需要一种无需调参且能提供置信度的比较方法。
Method: 采用KL散度衡量生成模型与未知测试分布的距离，利用其无需核函数调参且支持抵消项以量化不确定性；进一步扩展到条件生成模型并用Edgeworth展开改进小样本性能。
Result: 在模拟数据上，方法实现有效覆盖率且比基于核的方法统计功效更高；在图像和文本数据上的结论与基准指标一致且附带统计置信度。
Conclusion: 本文为生成模型比较提供了带有统计置信度的评估框架，但未提及具体局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CT-Merging: Consensus Directions and Task-Level Scaling for LoRA Adapter Merging
papers.abstract_en: LoRA adapters provide an efficient way to specialize a pretrained model for many downstream tasks, but deploying one adapter per task requires adapter storage and task selection at inference time. Model merging addresses this issue by combining independently trained adapters into one multi-task adapter. Recent SVD-based LoRA merging methods mainly focus on constructing shared or task specific directions, while the coefficients assigned to the final directions are often directly from the original task SVD. On a fixed merged basis, inherited coefficients preserve component order with high rank correlation, yet their magnitudes differ substantially from the coefficients induced by the task updates. To address this mismatch, we propose CT-Merging, a LoRA-aware merging algorithm that estimates consensus directions from average task subspace projectors and assigns task-level RMS coefficient scales in the final update. CT-Merging uses repeated support across task SVD subspaces to construct the common basis, while reducing reliance on rank wise SVD magnitudes after direction construction. On the DC-Merge CLIP adapter benchmark, CT-Merging achieves superior average normalized accuracy compared to state-of-the-art merging methods and further improves over DC-Merge by 2.56 points on ViT-B/32 and 1.51 points on ViT-L/14 KnoTS-trained checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LoRA 适配器合并中系数不匹配的问题，提出 CT-Merging 算法。该方法通过任务子空间投影器估计共识方向，并分配任务级 RMS 系数尺度，在 DC-Merge CLIP 适配器基准上相比现有方法提升了归一化准确率。
Motivation: 现有 SVD 合并方法在固定合并基上继承的系数与任务更新诱导的系数幅度差异较大，导致合并效果不佳。
Method: CT-Merging 从平均任务子空间投影器估计共识方向，并在最终更新中分配任务级 RMS 系数尺度，减少对秩方向 SVD 幅度的依赖。
Result: 在 DC-Merge CLIP 基准上，CT-Merging 在 ViT-B/32 和 ViT-L/14 上分别比 DC-Merge 提升 2.56 和 1.51 个点，达到最优归一化准确率。
Conclusion: 本文证明了考虑系数尺度匹配的 LoRA 合并方法能有效提升多任务性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chronofy: A Temporal-Logical Decay Architecture for Information Validity in Time-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems retrieve and integrate external knowledge to ground large language model (LLM) outputs. However, current RAG architectures treat all retrieved facts as equally valid regardless of temporal provenance, leading to temporal hallucination, where plausible but obsolete facts corrupt the output. A clinical lab reading from yesterday is actionable; the same reading from six months ago is noise. We present Chronofy, a three-layer neuro-symbolic framework implementing the Temporal-Logical Decay Architecture (TLDA) that embeds temporal validity directly into the representation, retrieval, and reasoning layers of RAG systems. Layer 1 reserves a dedicated temporal subspace within Matryoshka embeddings to make fact age structurally irremovable from the representation. Layer 2 integrates learnable exponential decay functions into graph-based retrieval, where the decay coefficient $β_j$ is grounded in Bayesian decision theory as an approximation of twice the latent process mean-reversion rate. Layer 3 applies Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness functions to evaluate the temporal validity of retrieved knowledge, not LLM output confidence, and enforces the possibilistic weakest-link principle to bound output confidence by the most decayed evidence in the reasoning chain. We evaluate Chronofy on temporal knowledge graph forecasting benchmarks, the TimE temporal QA benchmark, and a domain-specific sensitivity analysis, demonstrating that explicit temporal decay modeling improves retrieval precision, reduces temporal hallucination, and enables principled data re-acquisition triggers when temporal context is insufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chronofy，一个三层神经符号框架，通过时间逻辑衰减架构（TLDA）在 RAG 系统中嵌入时间有效性。第一层在 Matryoshka 嵌入中保留时间子空间，第二层将可学习的指数衰减函数集成到图检索中，第三层应用信号时间逻辑（STL）鲁棒性函数评估检索知识的时间有效性。实验表明，显式时间衰减建模提高了检索精度，减少了时间幻觉，并在时间上下文不足时触发数据重新获取。
Motivation: 当前 RAG 系统将所有检索事实视为同等有效，忽略了时间出处，导致时间幻觉——合理但过时的事实污染输出。例如，昨天的临床读数有信息价值，而六个月前的相同读数可能是噪声。
Method: 提出 TLDA 架构，包含三层：Layer 1 在嵌入中保留时间子空间；Layer 2 在基于图的检索中集成可学习指数衰减函数，衰减系数 β_j 基于贝叶斯决策理论近似为潜在过程均值回归率的两倍；Layer 3 使用 STL 鲁棒性函数评估检索知识的时间有效性，并应用可能性最弱链原则，将输出置信度限制为推理链中最衰减的证据。
Result: 在时间知识图谱预测基准、TimE 时间 QA 基准和领域特定敏感性分析上评估，显式时间衰减建模提高了检索精度，减少了时间幻觉，并在时间上下文不足时实现原则性的数据重新获取触发。
Conclusion: Chronofy 通过时间逻辑衰减架构有效嵌入时间有效性，减少 RAG 中的时间幻觉，但限于时间感知的检索和推理，未涉及其他类型的幻觉。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Joint Utilization of Geospatial and census proxies for Autoencoder-Assisted Downscaling (JUGAAD) of socioeconomic indicators in India
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring poverty and food security indicators is imperative for addressing socioeconomic challenges in developing nations. A limitation is mismatches in scale between data sources: census data provide geographic coverage, while socioeconomic indicators are derived from infrequently conducted surveys at coarse resolutions, posing a methodological challenge. This study introduces a deep learning framework, JuGAAD, using Indian census and survey data from 2001 and 2011 as a case study. We employ a three-step process: census and geospatial data are averaged into intermediate village-cluster-scale tessellations to reduce noise and regularize administrative boundary changes; an autoencoder compresses high-dimensional National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) data into a low-dimensional latent representation; and a regression model maps upscaled census and geospatial data to this representation. This function is applied to fine-grained census data to generate high-resolution predictions, validated against ground-truth district-level NSSO indicators. Results confirm the methodology predicts socioeconomic indicators at fine scales with strong accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JuGAAD框架，利用印度2001和2011年的人口普查与调查数据，通过自编码器压缩高维调查数据，再用回归模型从升尺度的人口普查和地理空间数据映射到潜在表示，从而生成高分辨率的社会经济指标预测，验证表明可准确预测细尺度指标。
Motivation: 监测贫困和粮食安全指标面临数据尺度不匹配的挑战：普查数据空间覆盖广但社会经济指标来自低频粗分辨率调查，需要有效的降尺度方法。
Method: 三步骤流程：1) 将普查和地理空间数据平均到中间村庄集群尺度以降低噪声和规则化边界变化；2) 自编码器压缩NSSO调查数据为低维潜在表示；3) 回归模型将升尺度后的普查和地理空间数据映射到该潜在表示，再应用于细粒度普查数据生成高分辨率预测。
Result: 验证表明该方法能在细尺度上以高精度预测社会经济指标（对比地面真值地区级NSSO指标）。
Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了数据尺度不匹配问题，可在印度等发展中国家实现社会经济指标的高分辨率预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StabilityBench: Benchmarking Instability in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: AI Assistants are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, such as healthcare or government services. Yet their real-world behavior remains poorly understood due to strong context dependence. Current evaluation protocols follow a defense-in-depth paradigm with compounding layers of safeguards, ranging from traditional benchmarks to live or adversarial testing. Such benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, limiting their ability to capture real-world variability in conversational settings. We propose StabilityBench, a principled, general and model-agnostic benchmark operator that transforms single-turn benchmark queries into multi-turn interaction histories. StabilityBench augments existing benchmarks by injecting realistic user simulations, through demographic proxies or sycophantic baits, while preserving original task intent. We apply StabilityBench to four benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, health question-answering and safety, and evaluate nine large language models under these conditions. Our results show that model performance is consistently unstable under these injections, with considerable performance degradations on three out of four benchmarks studied. These highlight important limitations of static evaluations and motivate more realistic evaluation settings. To this end, we propose StabilityBench-Mini: a size-preserving variant of StabilityBench that samples across diversification axes, enabling more realistic evaluation without increasing costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StabilityBench，一种将单轮基准查询转换为多轮交互历史的基准操作符，用于评估大语言模型在多变对话场景中的不稳定性。通过在数学推理、健康问答和安全等四个基准上注入人口统计代理或谄媚诱导，评估九个模型，发现性能持续不稳定，三个基准出现显著下降。
Motivation: 当前评估协议主要依赖静态单轮基准，无法捕捉真实对话场景中的多轮交互变异性，导致对模型在高风险环境下的实际行为理解不足。
Method: 提出StabilityBench，一种模型无关的基准操作符，通过注入模拟真实用户的“人口统计代理”或“谄媚诱导”来增强现有基准，同时保留原始任务意图，生成多轮交互历史。
Result: 在四个基准上对九个LLM的评估显示，模型性能在注入下持续不稳定，其中三个基准出现显著性能下降。
Conclusion: 静态评估存在重要局限性，需要更现实的评估设置；StabilityBench-Mini作为尺寸保留变体，可在不增加成本的情况下实现更现实的评估。

papers.title: Monkey King Bang: A Unified Scientific Multimodal Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery is increasingly shifting from isolated disciplines to multi-domain reasoning, and AI for science faces a similar transition. Existing systems are either specialised for individual domains or unify scientific data mainly through text tokenisation and prompt-based interfaces, limiting their ability to handle diverse scientific inputs, produce modality-native outputs, and support joint understanding, reasoning, and generation across scientific domains. We introduce MKB, a unified scientific multimodal model for both understanding and generation, built around a shared Transformer backbone and modality-tailored encoders, adapters, and decoders. MKB covers six scientific branches, including DNA, RNA, proteins, small molecules, earth science, and medical images, and supports native outputs such as biological sequences, molecular strings, meteorological fields, and segmentation masks. Training follows a two-stage modality-then-language curriculum: Stage 1 aligns modality-specific components with the frozen backbone, and Stage 2 consolidates them with the language backbone using mixed scientific and general corpora. Experiments show that MKB achieves competitive scientific understanding across biological and molecular benchmarks, produces high-fidelity native outputs for weather forecasting, biological generation, and medical-image segmentation, and largely retains the general capabilities of its Qwen3-VL backbone. These results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed paradigm, suggesting that shared-backbone models with modality-tailored components can provide a promising foundation for future cross-domain scientific multimodal exploration. The model and code are publicly available at https://github.com/Shanghai-Academy-of-AI-For-Science/MKB and https://huggingface.co/sais-org/MKB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MKB，一个统一的多模态科学基础模型，基于共享 Transformer 主干和模态特定的编码器、适配器、解码器，支持六个科学领域（DNA、RNA、蛋白质、小分子、地球科学、医学图像）的理解与生成，并能输出生物序列、分子字符串、气象场、分割掩码等原生格式。训练采用两阶段课程：先对齐模态组件与冻结主干，再混合科学和通用语料微调。实验表明 MKB 在生物和分子基准上达到有竞争力的科学理解能力，在天气预报、生物生成和医学图像分割上生成高保真原生输出，同时保留基础模型通用能力。
Motivation: 现有 AI for science 系统要么专精单一领域，要么主要通过文本分词和提示接口统一科学数据，难以处理多样化科学输入、产生模态原生输出，并支持跨领域的联合理解、推理与生成。需要一种能统一多模态科学数据的模型。
Method: MKB 采用共享 Transformer 主干，搭配六个科学领域各自的编码器、适配器和解码器。训练分两步：第一阶段对齐模态组件与冻结主干，第二阶段用混合科学和通用语料与语言主干联合优化。支持生物序列、分子字符串、气象场和分割掩码等原生输出。
Result: 在生物和分子基准上达到有竞争力的科学理解；在天气预报、生物生成和医学图像分割上生成高保真原生输出；保留 Qwen3-VL 主干的大部分通用能力。
Conclusion: 该共享主干加模态特定组件的范式可行，为未来跨领域科学多模态探索提供了有前景的基础。
Relevance: 75

papers.title: KeySI: An Interaction Framework for Tuning Text Embeddings Based on Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: In large-scale text analysis tasks, pre-trained language models are often used to embed text corpora for downstream analysis. However, such models may struggle to capture domain-specific semantics and adapting them typically requires large amounts of labeled data and technical expertise to implement training pipelines. Recent approaches have demonstrated how visual interactions in document projections can capture human feedback as training signals for model tuning. However, these methods operate on document-level feedback, which requires users to open and assess individual documents in order to provide effective feedback. In this paper, we propose KeySI, an interaction framework that enables feature-level feedback through keyword-based concept specification. Users specify feedback by organizing extracted keywords into groups representing concepts, which KeySI translates into document-level supervision for subsequent tuning. By operating on keywords as the primary interaction medium, KeySI reduces the need for manual document inspection and labeling and lowers the barrier to adapting embedding models. We present a prototype implementation that, given a corpus, curates representative keywords, visualizes keywords and document embeddings via dimensionality reduction, allows interactive specification of keyword groups, and supports iterative refinement through system feedback. We evaluate KeySI through a user study, usage scenarios, and quantitative experiments demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing user intent and improving embedding alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KeySI，一个基于关键词语义概念的用户交互框架，通过特征级反馈调整文本嵌入模型，无需用户逐篇检查文档。系统提取关键词并允许用户分组指定概念，自动转化为文档级监督信号进行模型微调，并通过降维可视化支持迭代优化。用户研究和定量实验表明其能有效捕捉用户意图并改善嵌入对齐。
Motivation: 预训练语言模型在领域特定语义建模上存在不足，传统微调需要大量标注数据和技术门槛；现有交互式方法依赖文档级反馈，用户仍需逐一打开和评估文档，效率低。
Method: KeySI框架：从语料库提取代表性关键词，通过降维可视化同时展示关键词和文档嵌入；用户通过交互式分组将关键词组织成概念，系统据此生成文档级监督信号，迭代微调嵌入模型。
Result: 用户研究、使用场景和定量实验证明KeySI能有效捕捉用户意图，提升嵌入对齐质量。
Conclusion: KeySI以关键词为交互媒介，降低了对文档手工检查的需求，降低了嵌入模型适配的门槛，适用于大规模文本分析任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Through-the-Earth Magnetic Induction Communication and Networking: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic induction (MI) communication (MIC) has emerged as a promising candidate for underground communication networks due to its excellent penetration capabilities. Integration with Space-Air-Ground-Underground (SAGUI) networks in next-generation mobile communication systems requires a well-defined network architecture. A recent discovery in MIC research, MI fast fading, remains in its early stages and presents unique challenges. This paper provides a comprehensive survey on through-the-earth (TTE) MIC, covering MI applications, channel modeling, point-to-point MIC design, relay techniques, network frameworks, and emerging technologies. We compare various MIC applications to highlight TTE-specific challenges and review the principles of channel modeling, addressing both MI slow fading and MI fast fading, along with its potential impact on existing MIC theories. We conduct a fine-grained decomposition of MI channel power gain into four distinct physical parameters, and propose a novel geometric model to analyze MI fast fading. We also summarize MI relay techniques, examine crosstalk effects in relay and high-density networks, and explore key research tasks within the OSI framework for a holistic MI network protocol in SAGUI. To bridge the gaps identified, we propose a MIC framework that supports TCP/IP and Linux, enabling full implementation of existing and emerging MIC solutions. This framework empowers researchers to leverage Linux resources and deep learning platforms for accelerated development of MIC in SAGUI networks. Remaining research challenges, open issues, and promising novel techniques are further identified to advance MIC research.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted by the IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials (COMST) for publication. The final published version will be available on IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文全面综述了穿地磁感应通信（Through-the-Earth Magnetic Induction Communication, TTE MIC），涵盖应用、信道建模、点对点设计、中继技术、网络框架及新兴技术。重点讨论了MI慢衰落与快衰落，提出了一种新的几何模型分析MI快衰落，并基于OSI框架设计了支持TCP/IP和Linux的MIC网络协议栈，以加速SAGUI网络中的MIC发展。
Motivation: 地下通信网络需要高穿透性技术，磁感应通信表现出色但其新发现的MI快衰落现象尚处早期研究阶段，且现有综述缺乏对TTE MIC体系化网络架构的全面梳理。
Method: 通过文献调研，对MI信道功率增益进行精细分解为四个物理参数，提出几何模型分析快衰落；在OSI框架下总结中继技术、串扰效应，并设计支持TCP/IP和Linux的MIC框架。
Result: 本文未提供定量实验指标，但给出了MI快衰落的几何模型以及一套可用于实际部署的MIC网络协议栈和软件框架。
Conclusion: 论文指出尚存多项开放问题与挑战，包括MI快衰落对现有理论的影响、高密度网络中的串扰等，并展望了未来研究方向。

papers.title: Double-Scoring: Reliable Extraction of Strong Lottery Tickets
papers.abstract_en: The lottery ticket hypothesis proposes that large random neural networks contain sparse subnetworks that can match the performance of dense models after comparable training. A stronger version asserts that sufficiently overparameterized random networks contain subnetworks that are already accurate before any weight training. Existing theory establishes that such strong lottery tickets exist, but reliable extraction remains difficult. We revisit edge-popup, a frozen-weight score-training method for extracting strong tickets, and identify layerwise sparsity selection as a central bottleneck. We introduce double-scoring, an augmented score-space parameterization that replaces a layerwise sparsity search with optimization over enlarged score tensors. We prove that fixed-density masking in an augmented score space preserves access to all original-coordinate masks, and we show that the resulting method can be interpreted as edge-popup on a zero-augmented network. In controlled experiments, double-scoring substantially improves strong-ticket extraction over fixed-density edge-popup and pruning-at-initialization baselines, improves on the performance of rewound sparse-training topologies, and exhibits markedly lower sensitivity to sparsity hyperparameters. Ablations show that the gain is not merely due to additional trainable score parameters, but is tied to the augmented score-space competition that induces the effective original sparsity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强幸运门票（strong lottery tickets）的可靠提取问题，提出double-scoring方法。该方法通过增广分数空间参数化，将原有的逐层稀疏性搜索转化为对更大分数张量的优化，并证明固定密度掩码在增广分数空间中仍能访问所有原始坐标掩码。实验表明，double-scoring在强门票提取上显著优于固定密度edge-popup和初始化剪枝基线，对稀疏性超参数的敏感度更低，且其增益与增广分数空间竞争而非额外可训练参数直接相关。
Motivation: 现有理论表明强幸运门票存在，但可靠提取仍然困难。edge-popup方法在提取时面临层稀疏性选择的瓶颈。
Method: 提出double-scoring，一种增广分数空间参数化方法，用对更大分数张量的优化替代逐层稀疏性搜索，并可解释为在零增广网络上的edge-popup。
Result: 控制实验中，double-scoping在强门票提取上优于固定密度edge-popup和初始化剪枝基线，也优于倒带稀疏训练拓扑，且对稀疏性超参数不敏感。
Conclusion: 摘要指出性能提升并非仅来自额外可训练参数，而是增广分数空间竞争诱导了有效原始稀疏性。

papers.title: AI-Driven Multi-Hop Relay Selection for Smart Urban NR-V2X Networks via Learning-to-Optimize Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Reliable and low-latency NR-V2X communications are essential for smart mobility in dense urban environments. However, limited Road-Side Unit (RSU) density, frequent non-line-of-sight conditions, and highly dynamic vehicular topologies often prevent many Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs) from maintaining stable single-hop connectivity. Although multi-hop relay-assisted communication can extend infrastructure coverage, selecting relay links in real time under practical flow, capacity, and connectivity constraints remains challenging. Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) yields optimal multi-hop relay decisions, but its computational complexity scales sharply with network density, limiting real-time applicability. To address this, we propose a Learning-to-Optimise (L2O) framework based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for real-time NR-V2X relay selection. Vehicular communication states are modeled as attributed graphs, where CAVs and RSUs are nodes and candidate radio links are enriched with propagation-aware features. An offline MILP oracle provides optimal supervision, while an edge-aware Graph Isomorphism Network (GINE) approximates oracle decisions with near-constant inference latency. Experiments on large-scale urban datasets generated by an integrated SUMO--GEMV2 simulation pipeline show that the proposed approach achieves connectivity comparable to that of the MILP oracle while reducing execution time by orders of magnitude. The framework enables cost-effective enhancement of urban V2X connectivity by leveraging existing vehicular assets and supporting scalable, real-time NR-V2X operation in smart city environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对城市 NR-V2X 网络中多跳中继选择计算复杂度过高的问题，提出一种基于学习优化 (L2O) 的图神经网络 (GNN) 框架。通过将车辆通信状态建模为属性图，利用图同构网络 (GINE) 近似混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 的最优解，在保持接近最优连接性的同时将执行时间降低数个数量级。
Motivation: 城市密集环境中 RSU 密度不足、非视距条件频繁、拓扑动态性高导致单跳连接不稳定；多跳中继虽能扩展覆盖，但实时选择受限于 MILP 的高计算复杂度。
Method: 提出 L2O 框架：离线 MILP oracle 提供最优标签，在线推理使用边感知图同构网络 (GINE) 近似中继选择决策；通信状态建模为带传播感知特征的属性图。
Result: 在 SUMO-GEMV2 仿真生成的大规模城市数据集上，该方法达到与 MILP oracle 相当的连接性能，执行时间降低数个数量级。
Conclusion: 该框架利用现有车载资产实现经济高效的城市 V2X 连接增强，支持实时 NR-V2X 操作。

papers.title: CMI-Mem: Toward Generalizable Long-Term Memory Management via CMI-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Memory Manager models are pivotal in agent systems. Existing methods rely predominantly on LLM-judged synthetic question-answer (QA) pairs, making memory valuation dependent on sampled queries and the downstream reader. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{CMI-Mem}, a reinforcement learning(RL)-based lightweight memory manager model with a hybrid reward that combines downstream QA correctness and intrinsic Conditional Mutual Information (CMI). CMI evaluates the information contributed by new conversational inputs relative to the current memory state without conditioning on a sampled QA query, thereby complementing rather than replacing QA grounding. Our codes are available at: https://github.com/Wyb0627/CMIMem , and the CMI-Mem-4B model checkpoint is available at: https://www.modelscope.cn/models/wyb0627/CMIMem-4B
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CMI-Mem，一种基于强化学习的轻量级记忆管理器模型，通过结合下游 QA 正确性和条件互信息 (CMI) 的混合奖励来改进长期记忆管理。CMI 评估新对话输入相对于当前记忆状态的信息贡献，无需依赖采样查询，从而补充了 QA 基础方法。
Motivation: 现有记忆管理器依赖于 LLM 判断的合成 QA 对，使得记忆评估受限于采样查询和下游读者，缺乏泛化性。
Method: 使用强化学习训练轻量级记忆管理器，奖励函数混合了下游 QA 正确性和条件互信息 (CMI)，其中 CMI 独立于采样查询评估信息贡献。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称方法有助于泛化长期记忆管理，并公开了代码和 4B 模型检查点。
Conclusion: CMI-Mem 通过 CMI 增强强化学习，为记忆管理提供更通用的评估信号，减少对特定查询的依赖。
